primary_endpoint_description: Desirability of outcome ranking (DOOR) at day 70, comprising clinical success, infectious complications, safety complications, mortality, and health-related quality of life
brief_rationale: Superiority required the 95% CI for the probability of dalbavancin having a superior DOOR to be above 50%. The estimated probability was 47.7% (95% CI, 39.8%-55.7%), so the prespecified superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Functional independence, defined as a modified Rankin Scale score of 0 to 1 at 90 days.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy outcome occurred in 40% of the alteplase group versus 26% of the control group, favoring alteplase (adjusted risk ratio, 1.52; 95% CI, 1.14-2.02; P = .004), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Day 90 all-cause mortality
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was explicitly identified as day 90 all-cause mortality. Mortality was 62.1% with bicarbonate versus 61.7% with control (absolute difference, 0.4 percentage points; 95% CI, -7.2 to 8.0; P=.91), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: First occurrence of a composite of stroke, systemic embolism, and major bleeding at 2 years.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary composite outcome occurred in 0.3% of the anticoagulation-discontinuation group versus 2.2% of the continuation group (absolute difference, -1.9 percentage points; 95% CI, -3.5 to -0.3; P=.02), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the intended favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Time from randomization to successful extubation
brief_rationale: Neither dexmedetomidine nor clonidine demonstrated superiority over propofol for the primary outcome (HR 1.09, P=.20, and HR 1.05, P=.34, respectively).

primary_endpoint_description: Hierarchical composite of mortality, duration of vital support, and length of hospital stay assessed at 28 days using a win ratio.
brief_rationale: The CRT-PHR group was superior to usual care on the explicitly identified primary composite outcome, with a win ratio of 1.16 (95% CI, 1.02-1.33; P=.04), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in automated office systolic blood pressure at week 6 for participants randomized to lorundrostat 50 mg versus placebo.
brief_rationale: Lorundrostat produced a significantly greater reduction in automated office systolic blood pressure than placebo at week 6 (least-squares mean difference, -9.1 mm Hg; 95% CI, -13.3 to -4.9; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Difference between intervention groups in the annual rate of change in global cognitive function over 2 years, assessed using a composite of executive function, episodic memory, and processing speed.
brief_rationale: The structured intervention produced a significantly greater annual increase in the global cognitive composite than the self-guided intervention (between-group difference, 0.029 SD per year; 95% CI, 0.008-0.050; P=.008), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: 3-year locoregional recurrence rate
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored robotic surgery: 3-year locoregional recurrence was 1.6% versus 4.0% with laparoscopic surgery (HR, 0.45; 95% CI, 0.22-0.92; log-rank P=.03), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of days alive and free from admission to the index hospital at day 90
brief_rationale: The primary outcome did not favor augmented protein: median 62 vs 64 days, with an adjusted between-group median difference of -1.97 days (95% CI, -7.24 to 3.30; P=.46). Thus, favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in knee pain on a 100-mm visual analog scale at 6 months.
brief_rationale: Metformin produced a significantly greater reduction in the primary pain outcome than placebo (between-group difference, -11.4 mm; 95% CI, -20.1 to -2.6; P=.01), favoring metformin.

primary_endpoint_description: Between-group difference in change in home-measured systolic blood pressure from baseline to week 12
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint difference was -0.68 mm Hg (90% CI, -3.50 to 2.14). The lower confidence bound of -3.50 mm Hg exceeded the prespecified noninferiority margin of -4.4 mm Hg, so amiloride met the noninferiority criterion versus spironolactone.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite at 12 months of maintaining HbA1c below 6.5% throughout the study and achieving at least 5% weight loss, at least 4% weight loss plus at least 150 minutes of weekly physical activity, or an absolute HbA1c reduction of at least 0.2 percentage points
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 31.7% of the AI-led group and 31.9% of the human-led group. The risk difference was -0.2%, with a 1-sided 95% CI lower bound of -8.2%, which remained above the prespecified -15% noninferiority margin; therefore, the noninferiority criterion was met.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to first occurrence of all-cause death or hospitalization/emergency department visit for stroke, acute coronary syndrome, or heart failure.
brief_rationale: The primary composite outcome did not show favorable superiority for bedtime dosing versus morning dosing (adjusted HR, 0.96; 95% CI, 0.77-1.19; P=.70), so the primary endpoint did not meet the success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: All-cause mortality at 90 days
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was explicitly identified as 90-day all-cause mortality. Conservative oxygen therapy did not significantly reduce mortality versus usual therapy (35.4% vs 34.9%; adjusted risk difference, 0.7 percentage points; 95% CI, -0.7 to 2.0; P=.28), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Difference between zilebesiran and placebo in change from baseline in 24-hour mean ambulatory systolic blood pressure at 3 months, assessed in each background-treatment cohort
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint significantly favored zilebesiran in all three cohorts: indapamide, −12.1 mm Hg (P<.001); amlodipine, −9.7 mm Hg (P<.001); and olmesartan, −4.5 mm Hg (P=.02). Thus, the favorable superiority criterion was met.

primary_endpoint_description: Day 29 humoral immune responses to all vaccine-matched influenza and SARS-CoV-2 strains with mRNA-1083 versus licensed comparator vaccines, assessed for noninferiority; reactogenicity and safety were also a primary objective.
brief_rationale: Noninferiority was demonstrated for every vaccine-matched strain: the lower 97.5% CI bounds exceeded the prespecified thresholds of 0.667 for geometric mean ratios and -10% for seroconversion/seroresponse rate differences. The abstract also reports no safety concerns.

primary_endpoint_description: Disease activity, defined as relapse and/or MRI activity (new and/or contrast-enhancing lesions) over 24 months
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred less often with high-dose vitamin D than placebo (60.3% vs 74.1%; HR, 0.66 [95% CI, 0.50-0.87]; P = .004), a statistically significant favorable superiority result.

primary_endpoint_description: Difference in detection of Gleason Grade Group 2 or higher prostate cancers using microultrasonography plus systematic biopsy versus MRI/conventional ultrasonography plus systematic biopsy.
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was 10%. The primary comparison showed a detection-rate difference of 3.52% (95% CI, -3.95% to 10.92%) and met noninferiority (P < .001), so the primary endpoint satisfied the stated success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary endpoints of failure-free survival with an 8% noninferiority margin and incidence of all-grade vomiting assessed for superiority.
brief_rationale: Both coprimary endpoints met their stated criteria: failure-free survival was noninferior (lower 1-sided 95% CI, -3.9%, within the -8% margin; P=.002), and all-grade vomiting was significantly less frequent without concurrent cisplatin (26.2% vs 59.8%; P<.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of participants reporting at least 1 fall during the 12 months following the intervention.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome favored the intervention: 29.7% reported at least 1 fall versus 38.3% with control (odds ratio, 0.67; 95% CI, 0.48-0.91; P = .01), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Days to discharge after randomization
brief_rationale: The primary outcome did not favorably differ between extended caffeine and placebo (median 18.0 vs 16.5 days; adjusted median difference, 0 days [95% CI, -1.7 to 1.7]); thus, caffeine did not shorten hospitalization.

primary_endpoint_description: Three primary endpoints: (1) time to cardiovascular death or first heart failure hospitalization; (2) total heart failure hospitalizations; and (3) time to cardiovascular death or first heart failure hospitalization among patients with transferrin saturation below 20%.
brief_rationale: The prespecified Hochberg success rule was not met: the three primary-endpoint P values were .04, .12, and .07. Thus, all 3 were not ≤.05, 2 were not ≤.025, and none was ≤.0167.

primary_endpoint_description: Biochemically verified continuous vaping abstinence during weeks 9 through 12 (the last 4 weeks of treatment) for varenicline vs placebo.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored varenicline: abstinence was 51% vs 14% with placebo (adjusted OR, 6.5; 95% CI, 3.0-14.1; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of a composite of acute kidney injury, acute myocardial injury, nonfatal cardiac arrest, or death within the first 7 postoperative days.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 33.5% with individualized management versus 30.5% with routine management (relative risk, 1.10; 95% CI, 0.93-1.30; P=.31). Individualized management did not produce the intended reduction, so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary endpoints were changes from baseline to week 24 in nasal polyp score and nasal congestion score, assessed in all patients and in the population with eosinophilia.
brief_rationale: All co-primary comparisons favored stapokibart over placebo, exceeded the stated meaningful-change thresholds, and were statistically significant (P<.001) in both the overall and eosinophilic populations.

primary_endpoint_description: Event-free survival, defined as freedom from distant metastasis, locoregional relapse, or death from any cause.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored adjuvant camrelizumab: 3-year event-free survival was 86.9% versus 77.3% with standard therapy (stratified HR, 0.56; 95% CI, 0.36-0.89; P=.01), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Dose-response relationship for change from baseline in Hamilton Anxiety Rating Scale (HAM-A) score at 4 weeks, assessed using MCP-Mod.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome showed a statistically significant favorable dose-response, with greater HAM-A reductions versus placebo at the 100-µg and 200-µg doses.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of patients free of nephrotic syndrome relapse at 49-week follow-up
brief_rationale: The relapse-free rate at week 49 was significantly higher with rituximab than placebo (87.4% vs 38.0%; 1-sided log-rank P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion for the explicitly identified primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Excellent neurological outcome at 90 days, defined as a modified Rankin Scale score of 0 to 1.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 40.5% of the intra-arterial tenecteplase group versus 26.4% of the standard-treatment group, favoring tenecteplase (relative risk, 1.44; 95% CI, 1.06-1.95; P=.02), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Sustained platelet response, defined as at least 3 of 4 platelet counts greater than 50 × 10^9/L during weeks 6 to 12 without rescue treatment.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 65% of the eltrombopag group versus 35% of the standard-therapy group (difference, 30%; 95% CI, 11%-49%; P=.002), crossing the prespecified monitoring boundary for efficacy.

primary_endpoint_description: Rate of chronic subdural hematoma recurrence at 6 months, assessed by an independent blinded adjudication committee.
brief_rationale: Recurrence occurred in 14.8% with MMA embolization versus 21.0% with standard care, but the favorable difference was not statistically significant (odds ratio 0.64, 95% CI 0.36-1.14; P=.13); therefore, the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Functional disability at 6 months, assessed using the 12-item WHODAS 2.0 score
brief_rationale: The proactive strategy did not improve the primary outcome versus usual care: mean WHODAS scores were 17.7 vs 18.2 (mean difference, -0.5; 95% credible interval, -1.9 to 0.9), far below the prespecified 5-point minimally important difference. The trial was stopped early for futility.

primary_endpoint_description: Percentage of time spent in the pregnancy-specific glucose range (63-140 mg/dL), measured by continuous glucose monitoring from 16 to 34 weeks' gestation
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored closed-loop therapy (65.4% vs 50.3%), with an adjusted difference of 12.5 percentage points (95% CI, 9.5-15.6; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of all-cause death, myocardial infarction, coronary revascularization, acute kidney failure, or ischemic stroke within 90 days after randomization.
brief_rationale: In this superiority trial, the primary outcome occurred in 9.1% with the liberal strategy versus 10.1% with the restrictive strategy (relative risk, 0.90; 95% CI, 0.65-1.24). The confidence interval included no effect, and the liberal strategy did not significantly reduce the primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Adjusted mean between-group difference in Fugl-Meyer Assessment total score at 3 months
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed no favorable superiority of levodopa over placebo: mean difference -0.90 points (95% CI, -3.78 to 1.98; P=.54), and the authors reported no significant improvement.

primary_endpoint_description: Physiologic bronchopulmonary dysplasia or death by 36 weeks' postmenstrual age
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 68.5% of the budesonide-plus-surfactant group and 67.9% of the surfactant-alone group (adjusted RR, 1.00; 95% CI, 0.90-1.11). The trial crossed its prespecified futility threshold and did not demonstrate a favorable reduction in the primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline to 6 months in mixed urinary incontinence symptoms measured by the Urogenital Distress Inventory total score
brief_rationale: The trial tested whether onabotulinumtoxinA was superior to midurethral sling. The primary endpoint showed no significant between-group difference (mean difference, 18.1 points; 95% CI, -4.6 to 40.7; P=.12), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary efficacy endpoint: MATE-3 score at 30 months (acute cellular rejection, cardiac allograft vasculopathy, and chronic kidney disease); primary safety endpoint: MATE-6 score (MATE-3 plus antibody-mediated rejection, infection, and posttransplant lymphoproliferative disorder).
brief_rationale: The primary efficacy endpoint did not show favorable superiority (mean difference −0.32; 95% CI, −0.90 to 0.20; P=.16), while the primary safety endpoint met its noninferiority criterion. Because the primary endpoints had mixed outcomes and no overall trial success rule is stated, the result is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of intrapartum stillbirth, neonatal death, 5-minute Apgar score below 4, acidosis at birth, hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy, neonatal seizures, prolonged neonatal respiratory support or neonatal unit admission, persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn, or meconium aspiration syndrome.
brief_rationale: The primary composite occurred in 5.1% with sildenafil and 5.2% with placebo (relative risk, 1.02; 95% CI, 0.75-1.37), so sildenafil did not significantly reduce adverse perinatal outcomes as intended.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of participants with atrial fibrillation recorded in primary care records within 2.5 years after randomization
brief_rationale: The primary outcome favored ECG patch screening: AF was recorded in 6.8% of the intervention group versus 5.4% of controls (ratio of proportions, 1.26; 95% CI, 1.02-1.57; P=.03), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of gestational diabetes, preeclampsia, or preterm birth before 37 weeks' gestation
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 25.0% of the myo-inositol group and 26.8% of the placebo group (RR, 0.93; 95% CI, 0.68-1.28; P=.67), so myo-inositol did not demonstrate a significant favorable reduction.

This publication is explicitly a prespecified secondary analysis. It identifies cardiorespiratory hospitalization as a prespecified secondary outcome and cardiovascular outcomes as exploratory, but does not identify or report the DAN-RSV trial's prespecified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Newly diagnosed hepatitis C virus infection, defined as detectable HCV RNA
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored nontargeted screening over targeted screening, with significantly more new HCV diagnoses (154 vs 115; RR, 1.34 [95% CI, 1.05-1.70]; P = .02), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of all-cause death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, any revascularization, and stroke at 1 year.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred less often with FFR-guided complete revascularization than with culprit-only revascularization (5.5% vs 13.6%; HR, 0.38 [95% CI, 0.20-0.72]; P=.003), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Attaining or exceeding the minimal clinically important difference in pain severity (at least a 30% decrease on the Brief Pain Inventory–Short Form) from baseline to 3 months.
brief_rationale: At 3 months, both CBT-based intervention groups had significantly higher primary-outcome response rates than usual care: health coach RR 1.54 (95% CI, 1.30-1.82) and painTRAINER RR 1.28 (95% CI, 1.06-1.55). Thus, the primary superiority endpoint was met in the favorable direction for both interventions.

primary_endpoint_description: Success rate of atrial septal defect closure at 6 months, defined as procedural success with a residual shunt diameter of 2 mm or less
brief_rationale: The bioresorbable occluder achieved a 6-month closure success rate of 96.5% versus 97.4% with the metallic occluder; the between-group difference was -0.8 percentage points (95% CI, -5.0 to 3.7), with P<.001 for noninferiority. Thus, the explicitly identified primary endpoint met the noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Participation in colorectal cancer screening (FIT or colonoscopy) at 6 months.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was evaluated, but all 3 active-choice outreach interventions produced significantly lower 6-month screening participation than usual-care default mailed FIT outreach (all P<.001). Thus, the interventions did not demonstrate favorable superiority over usual care.

primary_endpoint_description: Upper gastrointestinal bleeding
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred less often with routine H pylori screening, but the superiority criterion was not met (RR, 0.90; 95% CI, 0.77-1.05; P = .18).

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of inappropriate imaging requests made per department
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed no favorable superiority effect of the CDSS: the difference-in-differences was 1.3 percentage points (99% CI, -2.0 to 1.8; P = .69), which was not statistically significant.

primary_endpoint_description: Completion of any chest CT within 16 weeks.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred more often with mPATH-Lung than with enhanced usual care (24.5% vs 17.0%; odds ratio, 1.6; 95% CI, 1.2-2.1), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of patients with a modified Rankin Scale score of 0 or 1 at 90 days
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored intra-arterial alteplase (44.8% vs 30.2%; adjusted RR, 1.45; 95% CI, 1.08-1.96; P=.01), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to oxygen saturation by pulse oximetry (SpO2) below 80% during 35 minutes of monitoring, comparing the safety device with sham control.
brief_rationale: The safety device group had no primary-endpoint events versus 7 events in the control group and a significantly lower risk of reaching SpO2 below 80% (P<.001), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator-assessed event-free survival
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint did not show favorable superiority for atezolizumab versus placebo: median event-free survival was 59.5 vs 52.7 months (HR, 0.94; 95% CI, 0.70-1.26; P = .68).

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline through week 24 in ALS disease severity, assessed using a Bayesian shared-parameter model of function and survival and summarized by the disease rate ratio (DRR).
brief_rationale: The primary analysis yielded a DRR of 0.97 (95% credible interval, 0.783-1.175) with a posterior probability of benefit (DRR <1) of 0.65. The abstract explicitly states that the primary endpoint showed no benefit or harm, so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival and investigator-assessed progression-free survival
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary outcomes significantly favored sugemalimab plus CAPOX: overall survival HR 0.75 (95% CI, 0.61-0.92; P=.006) and progression-free survival HR 0.66 (95% CI, 0.54-0.81; P<.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Neuropsychiatric Inventory Questionnaire (NPI-Q) severity score through 24 months
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome showed no significant favorable difference between dementia palliative care and usual care; the group-by-time interaction was P = .87, and the 24-month between-group difference was -0.24 (95% CI, -2.33 to 1.84). Thus, superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary outcomes of caregiver-reported Neuropsychiatric Inventory Questionnaire severity score for persons with dementia and Modified Caregiver Strain Index for caregivers.
brief_rationale: Neither co-primary outcome differed significantly between the health system-based, community-based, and usual-care groups; therefore, the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: 3-year disease-free survival comparing transanal total mesorectal excision with laparoscopic total mesorectal excision
brief_rationale: The between-group difference in 3-year disease-free survival was 2.7% (97.5% CI, -3.0% to 8.1%); the lower confidence bound exceeded the prespecified noninferiority margin of -10%, meeting the primary endpoint success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Survival without disability, defined as a modified Rankin Scale score of 0 or 1, at 90 days.
brief_rationale: The primary efficacy outcome occurred in 45.1% with urokinase versus 40.2% with control (adjusted risk ratio, 1.13; 95% CI, 0.94-1.36; P=.19), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Pathological complete response, defined as no invasive tumor in the breast and lymph nodes (ypT0/Tis ypN0).
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored camrelizumab plus chemotherapy over placebo plus chemotherapy (56.8% vs 44.7%; rate difference, 12.2% [95% CI, 3.3%-21.2%]; 1-sided P = .004), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death and/or major respiratory complications within 30 days
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 16.1% of the restrictive-oxygen group and 16.7% of the liberal-oxygen group (odds ratio, 1.01; 95% CI, 0.75-1.37; P=.94). The restrictive strategy did not significantly reduce the primary composite outcome, so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary outcomes of total antibiotic duration (effectiveness) and all-cause mortality (safety) through 28 days for PCT- and CRP-guided protocols versus standard care.
brief_rationale: PCT guidance significantly reduced antibiotic duration and met the mortality noninferiority criterion, whereas CRP guidance did not reduce duration and its mortality result was inconclusive. The abstract does not state an overall success rule covering the multiple primary outcomes and intervention comparisons.

primary_endpoint_description: Placebo-adjusted percentage change from baseline in lipoprotein(a) molar concentration at week 12, measured using intact lipoprotein(a) and apolipoprotein(a)-based assays.
brief_rationale: All muvalaplin doses produced favorable placebo-adjusted reductions in lipoprotein(a) at week 12 with both assays, and all reported 95% confidence intervals excluded no reduction, supporting superiority over placebo for the primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Disease-free survival comparing 3 vs 6 cycles of CEV chemotherapy, with a noninferiority margin of 12%.
brief_rationale: Five-year disease-free survival was 90.4% with 3 cycles versus 89.2% with 6 cycles (difference, 1.2%; 95% CI, -7.5% to 9.8%), explicitly meeting the prespecified noninferiority criterion (P = .003 for noninferiority).

primary_endpoint_description: Time to successful extubation, defined as unsupported spontaneous breathing sustained for at least 48 hours after extubation.
brief_rationale: The main endpoint showed no statistically significant benefit for either screening frequency (HR, 0.88; 95% CI, 0.76-1.03; P=.12) or SBT technique (HR, 1.06; 95% CI, 0.91-1.23; P=.45). Thus, favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Improvement in 90-day functional outcome measured by the mean utility-weighted modified Rankin Scale score.
brief_rationale: The posterior probability of superiority for thrombectomy was 0.96, below the prespecified 1-sided threshold of 0.975; therefore, the primary efficacy endpoint did not meet the success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Daily mean fever burden, defined as the area under the temperature curve above 37.9 °C divided by total acute-phase hours and multiplied by 24 hours.
brief_rationale: The fever-prevention group had significantly lower daily mean fever burden than standard care (0.37 vs 0.73 °C-hour; difference, -0.35; 95% CI, -0.51 to -0.20; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion for the explicitly identified primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of patients with a modified Rankin Scale score of 0 or 1 at day 90
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 72.7% with tenecteplase versus 70.3% with alteplase (RR 1.03, 95% CI 0.97-1.09), and the abstract explicitly states that the prespecified noninferiority threshold (RR margin 0.937) was met.

primary_endpoint_description: Equivalence of video-visit versus in-person early palliative care for patient quality of life at week 24, measured by the Functional Assessment of Cancer Therapy-Lung questionnaire, with an equivalence margin of ±4 points.
brief_rationale: The week-24 quality-of-life difference was 2.0 points with a 90% CI of 0.1 to 3.9, entirely within the prespecified ±4-point equivalence margin; equivalence was therefore demonstrated (P = .04).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of any stroke or death within 30 days after enrollment or balloon angioplasty, or any ischemic stroke in the qualifying artery territory or revascularization of the qualifying artery after 30 days through 12 months
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary composite outcome occurred less often with balloon angioplasty plus aggressive medical management than with medical management alone (4.4% vs 13.5%; HR, 0.32 [95% CI, 0.16-0.63]; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Clinically detected and electrocardiographically confirmed new-onset atrial fibrillation after cardiac surgery within 120 hours after CABG or before hospital discharge, whichever occurred first.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 27.8% with relaxed control versus 26.2% with tight control, for a risk difference of 1.7% (95% CI, -2.6% to 5.9%). The upper confidence bound was below the prespecified 10% noninferiority margin, so relaxed potassium control met the noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Reduction in home mean systolic blood pressure from randomization to month 6; primary safety outcome was treatment discontinuation due to adverse events through month 6.
brief_rationale: The triple-pill protocol produced a significantly greater reduction in home systolic blood pressure than standard care (adjusted difference, -5.8 mm Hg; 95% CI, -8.0 to -3.6; P<.001), meeting favorable superiority. No participants in either group discontinued treatment because of adverse events.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of delirium during postoperative days 1 through 5
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 18.15% of the EEG-guided group and 18.10% of the usual-care group (difference, 0.05%; 95% CI, -4.57% to 4.67%). EEG-guided anesthesia did not produce the intended reduction in postoperative delirium, so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival in the intention-to-treat population, assessed by an independent radiographic review committee per RECIST version 1.1.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored ivonescimab plus chemotherapy: median progression-free survival was 7.1 vs 4.8 months (HR 0.46, 95% CI 0.34-0.62; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Two primary 12-month comparisons of within-participant weight change: text messaging plus financial incentives vs control, and text messaging alone vs control.
brief_rationale: The financial-incentive comparison met the stated P<.025 threshold (mean difference, -3.2%; P<.001), while text messaging alone did not (mean difference, -1.4%; P=.05). Because the two primary comparisons had mixed results and no overall success rule was stated, overall primary-endpoint success is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: Between-group difference in 6-month weight change for wireless feedback system versus wireless feedback system plus telephone coaching
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was -2.5 kg. The observed difference was -2.0 kg with a 90% CI of -2.9 to -1.1, which included/crossed the noninferiority margin; therefore, noninferiority was not established.

primary_endpoint_description: Biochemically verified 7-day point-prevalence abstinence at the end of treatment at 12 weeks.
brief_rationale: The main outcome was reported for several rerandomized rescue strategies. Some strategies showed greater abstinence than continuation with more than 99% posterior probability of benefit, while switching from varenicline to combined nicotine replacement did not. The abstract does not state an overall prespecified success rule across these multiple comparisons, so trial-level primary-endpoint success is indeterminable.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of days alive without life support (mechanical ventilation, circulatory support, or kidney replacement therapy) at 90 days
brief_rationale: The lower oxygenation group had significantly more days alive without life support than the higher oxygenation group (median 80.0 vs 72.0 days; P=.009), with an adjusted mean difference of 5.8 days (95% CI, 0.2-11.5; P=.04), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: All-cause mortality at 12 months after enrollment
brief_rationale: Mortality was 17.2% with the Daraja intervention versus 16.8% with enhanced standard care (HR, 1.01; 95% CI, 0.66-1.55; P = .96), so the intervention did not achieve favorable superiority on the primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Disability level at 90 days measured by the overall distribution of modified Rankin Scale scores.
brief_rationale: The primary efficacy outcome did not show significant favorable superiority for methylprednisolone versus placebo (adjusted generalized odds ratio for lower disability, 1.10; 95% CI, 0.96-1.25; P=.17).

primary_endpoint_description: Between-group difference in change in quality of life from baseline to 6 months, measured by the FACT-G score.
brief_rationale: The intervention improved the primary FACT-G outcome by 4.6 points versus usual care (95% CI, 1.8-7.4; P=.001), exceeding the stated clinically meaningful threshold of 4 points in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival time from randomization
brief_rationale: Sintilimab plus chemotherapy significantly improved the primary overall survival endpoint versus placebo plus chemotherapy in all randomized patients (median 15.2 vs 12.3 months; HR 0.77, 95% CI 0.63-0.94; P=.009), with a significant benefit also reported in the PD-L1 CPS ≥5 population.

primary_endpoint_description: Changes from baseline to 12 months in caregiver-reported BRIEF Global Executive Composite T score (executive function) and Go/No-go d-prime signal detection score (attention).
brief_rationale: The two explicitly identified primary outcomes showed no statistically significant between-group differences at 12 months: BRIEF difference −0.96 (95% CI, −2.66 to 0.74) and Go/No-go d-prime difference 0.05 (95% CI, −0.18 to 0.27). Thus, adenotonsillectomy did not demonstrate superiority for either primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to sustained recovery, defined as at least 3 consecutive days without symptoms
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed no favorable superiority benefit with fluvoxamine versus placebo (adjusted HR 0.99, 95% credible interval 0.89-1.09; P for efficacy=.40), with a median recovery time of 10 days in both groups.

primary_endpoint_description: Safety and tolerability of single ascending doses of lepodisiran
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was explicitly identified and the abstract reports one serious adverse event and states that lepodisiran was well tolerated, but it provides no prespecified criterion defining success for safety and tolerability.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (SOFA) score from randomization through 14 days
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint did not show favorable superiority: mean SOFA score was 8.8 with landiolol versus 8.1 with standard care (mean difference, 0.75; 95% CI, -0.49 to 2.0; P=.24). Thus, landiolol did not significantly reduce organ failure.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of organ support-free days through day 21 and survival to hospital discharge
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary composite outcome did not show favorable efficacy with intravenous vitamin C. In both critically ill and noncritically ill patients, adjusted ORs were below 1, efficacy probabilities were low (8.6% and 2.9%), and prespecified statistical triggers for harm and futility were met.

The abstract reports several outcomes under “Main Outcomes and Measures,” but does not explicitly identify any as the prespecified primary endpoint. Therefore, primary-endpoint success cannot be determined.

primary_endpoint_description: All-cause mortality at 28 days in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was 28-day all-cause mortality. Mortality was 25.3% with cryoprecipitate versus 26.1% with standard care (odds ratio 0.96, 95% CI 0.75-1.23; P=.74), so early high-dose cryoprecipitate did not demonstrate superior survival.

primary_endpoint_description: Red blood cell transfusion, measured as RBC units per patient per ICU stay
brief_rationale: In the primary analysis, small-volume tubes did not significantly reduce RBC units per patient per ICU stay versus standard-volume tubes (RR, 0.91; 95% CI, 0.79-1.05; P=.19), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Hospital Anxiety and Depression Scale (HADS) score at 12 months
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was significantly better with catheter ablation than with medical therapy at 12 months (7.6 vs 11.8; between-group difference, -4.17 [95% CI, -7.04 to -1.31]; P = .005), favoring ablation.

primary_endpoint_description: Follow-up infarct volume at 36 (±12) hours and utility-weighted modified Rankin Scale score at 90 (±14) days, assessed against prespecified futility boundaries.
brief_rationale: This was a phase 2 futility trial with explicitly identified multiple primary outcomes. The lower SBP targets did not meet the prespecified criteria for futility on the primary analysis, so the trial's stated futility success criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to failure of prolapse repair by 12 months after surgery, defined by anatomical/objective recurrence, subjective vaginal bulge symptoms, or repeated prolapse treatment.
brief_rationale: In this superiority trial, the primary outcome did not significantly favor vaginal estrogen over placebo; 12-month failure was 19% versus 9% (adjusted hazard ratio 1.97, 95% CI 0.92-4.22). Thus, the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Delivery or fetal death prior to 37 weeks
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 45.5% of the pessary group and 45.6% of the usual-care group (RR, 1.00; 95% CI, 0.83-1.20), so pessary placement did not achieve the intended reduction.

primary_endpoint_description: Biochemically verified continuous smoking abstinence during the last 4 weeks of cytisinicline treatment versus placebo.
brief_rationale: Both treatment schedules showed significantly higher primary-endpoint abstinence rates than placebo: 25.3% vs 4.4% for the 6-week course (OR 8.0; P<.001) and 32.6% vs 7.0% for the 12-week course (OR 6.3; P<.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Time to recovery from COVID-19 pneumonia by day 28, defined as the first day a participant scored at least 6 on the 8-point ordinal scale.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was not significantly different from placebo for abatacept (P=.09), cenicriviroc (P=.94), or infliximab (P=.08); therefore, none of the three superiority comparisons met the success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Time from randomization to the first occurrence of cardiovascular death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, nonfatal stroke, or coronary revascularization.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy endpoint occurred less often with bempedoic acid than placebo (5.3% vs 7.6%; adjusted HR 0.70, 95% CI 0.55-0.89; P=.002), demonstrating statistically significant benefit in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of patients with electronic health record-documented goals-of-care discussions within 30 days
brief_rationale: The intervention increased the primary outcome from 30.4% to 34.5%, with an adjusted difference of 4.1 percentage points (95% CI, 0.4 to 7.8), indicating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Two primary outcomes: parent-reported receipt of recommended anticipatory guidance during well-child visits and emergency department use (proportion with at least 2 ED visits).
brief_rationale: Anticipatory guidance improved favorably (adjusted difference 11.01; 95% CI, 6.44 to 15.59), whereas ED use did not differ (adjusted difference 1.2%; 95% CI, -5.5% to 8.0%). Because the co-primary outcomes had mixed results and no overall success rule is stated, trial success is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: Pregnancy of at least 22 weeks' duration during 2 years of follow-up
brief_rationale: The trial assessed superiority of hysteroscopy over vacuum aspiration. The primary outcome occurred in 62.8% versus 67.6%, respectively (difference, -4.8%; 95% CI, -13% to 3.0%; P=.23), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Ambulatory daytime systolic blood pressure measured at the end of each treatment period, assessing heterogeneity in individual responses across the four antihypertensive drugs.
brief_rationale: The main outcome showed significant between-individual heterogeneity in blood pressure response to the different treatments (P<.001), supporting the trial objective of demonstrating potential benefit from personalized drug selection.

primary_endpoint_description: Complete IUD expulsion by 6 months postpartum
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was 6 percentage points. The early-minus-interval difference in complete expulsion was 2.0 percentage points (95% CI, -0.5 to 5.7), with the upper confidence bound below the 6-point margin; the abstract explicitly concludes noninferiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Total all-blood-product consumption during the first 24 hours
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy outcome showed no statistically or clinically significant favorable difference with 4F-PCC versus placebo (12 vs 11 U; absolute difference 0.2 U, 95% CI -2.99 to 3.33; P=.72), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Three-year composite of death, myocardial infarction, stroke, or coronary revascularization.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 8.1% of the treat-to-target group and 8.7% of the high-intensity statin group. The upper boundary of the 1-sided 97.5% CI for the absolute difference was 1.1 percentage points, below the prespecified 3.0-point noninferiority margin (P<.001 for noninferiority).

primary_endpoint_description: Area under the curve for C-peptide level stimulated by a mixed-meal tolerance test at 52 weeks after type 1 diabetes diagnosis
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored verapamil, with an adjusted between-group difference of 0.14 pmol/mL (95% CI, 0.01 to 0.27; P = .04), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Excellent functional outcome, defined as a modified Rankin Scale score of 0 to 1 at 90 days.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 63.8% with argatroban plus alteplase versus 64.9% with alteplase alone (risk difference, -1.0%; 95% CI, -8.1% to 6.1%; P=.78), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Length of hospital stay, hypothesized to be reduced by early high-flow oxygen therapy versus standard oxygen therapy.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was significantly worse in the intervention group: median hospital stay was 1.77 days with high-flow oxygen versus 1.50 days with standard oxygen (adjusted hazard ratio, 0.83; 95% CI, 0.75-0.92; P<.001). Thus, the hypothesized favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: All-cause mortality in a time-to-event analysis
brief_rationale: The prespecified hypothesis was that torsemide would reduce all-cause mortality versus furosemide. Mortality was nearly identical (26.1% vs 26.2%; hazard ratio, 1.02 [95% CI, 0.89-1.18]), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Survival to hospital discharge
brief_rationale: The lower oxygen-saturation target did not improve the primary outcome versus standard care; survival was 38.3% vs 47.9% (difference, -9.6%; 95% CI, -18.9% to -0.2%; P=.05), favoring the control group rather than the intervention.

primary_endpoint_description: CRP PMR-AS less than 10 combined with either a prednisone dose of 5 mg/day or less or a decrease in prednisone dose of at least 10 mg from baseline at week 24.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was achieved by 67.3% of the tocilizumab group versus 31.4% of the placebo group, with an adjusted difference of 36.0% (95% CI, 19.4%-52.6%) and P<.001, demonstrating significant superiority favoring tocilizumab.

This observational 5-year follow-up reports a favorable composite outcome and notes that the original randomized trial demonstrated superiority at 2 years, but the abstract does not explicitly identify any endpoint as the prespecified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Symptomatic venous thromboembolism within 90 days, including pulmonary embolism and above- or below-knee deep venous thrombosis
brief_rationale: The symptomatic VTE rate was 3.45% with aspirin versus 1.82% with enoxaparin (estimated difference, 1.97%; 95% CI, 0.54%-3.41%). The abstract explicitly states that aspirin failed to meet the prespecified 1% noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: 3-year failure-free survival, defined as time from randomization to any disease relapse or death
brief_rationale: IMRT alone achieved 3-year failure-free survival of 90.5% versus 91.9% with concurrent chemoradiotherapy; the difference was -1.4% with a 1-sided 95% CI lower bound of -7.4%, within the prespecified 10% noninferiority margin (P<.001 for noninferiority).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite adverse birth outcome of preterm birth, low birth weight, small for gestational age, or perinatal mortality
brief_rationale: The reported primary composite occurred in 26.9% of the intervention group versus 26.1% of controls (adjusted difference, 0.5%; 95% CI, -2.1% to 3.1%) and was not significantly reduced by the intervention, so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: 30-day composite of all-cause mortality, hospital readmission, or serious postoperative complications
brief_rationale: The primary composite occurred in 30% of the handover group versus 33% of the no-handover group, with no significant favorable superiority (OR 0.89, 95% CI 0.72-1.10; P=.27).

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies overall survival as the primary outcome but states that its results are not yet available. The reported significant findings are prespecified secondary outcomes and cannot determine primary-endpoint success.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of 40% decline in estimated glomerular filtration rate, kidney failure (dialysis or transplant), or death due to kidney disease.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred less often with methylprednisolone than placebo (28.8% vs 43.1%; HR 0.53, 95% CI 0.39-0.72; P<.001), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: All-cause mortality at 1 year
brief_rationale: The adjusted mortality risk difference was -2.0%, with the upper limit of the 1-sided 97.5% CI at 1.2%, below the prespecified 5% noninferiority margin (P<.001 for noninferiority).

primary_endpoint_description: Disability at 90 days measured by the modified Rankin Scale in the target population of patients with ischemic stroke
brief_rationale: The primary outcome did not show favorable superiority for direct transport: median mRS was 3 in both groups, with an adjusted common OR of 1.03 (95% CI, 0.82-1.29). Enrollment was halted for futility.

primary_endpoint_description: Global primary outcome comprising rise-from-floor velocity, forced vital capacity, and treatment satisfaction, each averaged across postbaseline visits.
brief_rationale: Using the prespecified Bonferroni-adjusted significance level of .017, the global primary outcome favored both daily prednisone over intermittent prednisone (P<.001) and daily deflazacort over intermittent prednisone (P=.017). Thus, favorable superiority was demonstrated for the daily regimens.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in IVUS-derived percent atheroma volume from baseline to week 52.
brief_rationale: Alirocumab produced a significantly greater reduction in percent atheroma volume than placebo (-2.13% vs -0.92%; between-group difference, -1.21% [95% CI, -1.78% to -0.65%]; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Survival to hospital discharge with a favorable neurologic outcome, defined as a Pediatric Cerebral Performance Category score of 1 to 3 or no change from baseline.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome did not differ significantly between the intervention and control groups (53.8% vs 52.4%; adjusted OR, 1.08; 95% CI, 0.76-1.53), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to first nonfatal or fatal self-harm
brief_rationale: Neither intervention achieved favorable superiority over usual care for the primary endpoint: care management did not significantly reduce self-harm (HR 1.07; 97.5% CI, 0.84-1.37), and skills training significantly increased self-harm (HR 1.29; 97.5% CI, 1.02-1.64).

primary_endpoint_description: Percentage of eligible patients screened and referred to behavioral health based on PHQ-9 score at intervention versus control sites
brief_rationale: The tailored implementation group had a greater referral proportion than the education-only control group (7.9% vs 0.1%; difference, 7.8%; 95% CI, 5.8%-9.8%), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Two primary outcomes: 12-month change in overall average knee pain score and percentage change in medial tibial cartilage volume on MRI.
brief_rationale: PRP did not show favorable superiority over placebo for either primary outcome: pain difference −0.4 points (95% CI, −0.9 to 0.2; P=.17) and cartilage-volume difference −0.2% (95% CI, −1.9% to 1.5%; P=.81).

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in plasma NT-proBNP level at week 12 and change from baseline in 6-minute walk distance at week 24
brief_rationale: The two explicitly identified primary endpoints had mixed results: NT-proBNP decreased significantly more with sacubitril/valsartan (P<.001), whereas 6-minute walk distance did not differ significantly (P=.42). The abstract does not state the overall success rule for these multiple primary endpoints.

primary_endpoint_description: American Orthopaedic Foot and Ankle Society score over 26 weeks
brief_rationale: The adjusted between-group difference for the primary outcome was -1 point (95% CI, -6 to 3; P=.56), so PRP did not demonstrate favorable superiority over placebo.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of days alive without life support (invasive mechanical ventilation, circulatory support, or kidney replacement therapy) at 28 days
brief_rationale: The 12-mg group had an adjusted mean difference of 1.3 more days versus the 6-mg group (95% CI, 0 to 2.6), but the superiority result was not statistically significant (P=.07); therefore, the primary endpoint did not meet the success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Carbon monoxide-confirmed self-reported 7-day point-prevalence smoking abstinence at 52 weeks
brief_rationale: The primary outcome showed no significant benefit for either factorial comparison: 24 vs 12 weeks (OR 1.01, 95% CI 0.89-1.15) and varenicline plus nicotine patch vs varenicline alone (OR 0.99, 95% CI 0.87-1.12). Thus, favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of nonfatal symptomatic venous thromboembolism, readmission for COPD, or death within 90 days after randomization
brief_rationale: The primary composite outcome occurred in 29.7% of the intervention group versus 29.2% of the control group (relative risk, 1.02; 95% CI, 0.82-1.28; P=.86), so the active diagnostic strategy did not demonstrate favorable superiority over usual care.

primary_endpoint_description: All-cause mortality 90 days after randomization
brief_rationale: The primary outcome did not show favorable superiority: 90-day mortality was 41.5% with lower tidal volume ventilation facilitated by extracorporeal carbon dioxide removal versus 39.5% with standard care (risk ratio 1.05, 95% CI 0.83-1.33; P=.68).

primary_endpoint_description: 90-day survival
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was explicitly identified as 90-day survival. Mortality by day 90 was 26.4% with balanced solution versus 27.2% with saline (adjusted hazard ratio, 0.97; 95% CI, 0.90-1.05; P=.47), so balanced solution did not demonstrate significant superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Resolution of urinary tract infection symptoms by 14 days after completion of active antibiotic treatment.
brief_rationale: The prespecified primary outcome occurred in 93.1% of the 7-day group versus 90.2% of the 14-day group; the difference was 2.9% with a 1-sided 97.5% CI lower bound of -5.2%, which was within the prespecified 10% noninferiority margin and explicitly met the noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Carbon monoxide–verified 6-month continuous smoking abstinence at 7-month follow-up
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was 5%. The risk difference was -1.62%, with a 1-sided 97.5% CI lower bound of -5.02% and P=.03 for noninferiority, so cytisine failed to meet the noninferiority criterion versus varenicline.

primary_endpoint_description: Twenty-four-hour urinary excretion of NDMA after oral ranitidine compared with placebo, under noncured-meats and cured-meats diets.
brief_rationale: The main outcome showed no statistically significant difference between ranitidine and placebo with either diet (P=.54 and P=.71); therefore, the superiority criterion for an increase in NDMA excretion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Incident atrial fibrillation lasting more than 30 seconds through 12 months
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was AF detection through 12 months. Detection was significantly higher with insertable cardiac monitoring than with usual care (12.1% vs 1.8%; hazard ratio, 7.4; 95% CI, 2.6-21.3; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Remission rate at 6 months
brief_rationale: The reduced-dose regimen had a 6-month remission rate of 71.0% versus 69.2% with the high-dose regimen. The treatment difference was 1.8 percentage points, with a 1-sided 97.5% CI lower bound of -13.7%, which exceeded the prespecified noninferiority margin of -20 percentage points; the noninferiority criterion was met (P = .003).

primary_endpoint_description: Time to first nonelective respiratory hospitalization or all-cause mortality
brief_rationale: The antimicrobial group did not achieve favorable superiority over usual care for the explicitly identified primary endpoint (adjusted HR, 1.04; 95% CI, 0.71-1.53; P = .83), and the trial was terminated for futility.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of days free of respiratory support within 28 days after enrollment
brief_rationale: The primary outcome favored helmet noninvasive ventilation numerically (median 20 vs 18 days), but the difference was not statistically significant (mean difference, 2 days; 95% CI, -2 to 6; P=.26), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of venous or arterial thrombosis, extracorporeal membrane oxygenation treatment, or mortality within 30 days
brief_rationale: The primary efficacy outcome occurred in 45.7% with intermediate-dose and 44.1% with standard-dose prophylaxis (odds ratio 1.06, 95% CI 0.76-1.48; P=.70), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Incident atrial fibrillation confirmed by medical record review
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed no significant favorable difference versus placebo for either EPA-DHA (HR 1.09, 95% CI 0.96-1.24; P=.19) or vitamin D3 (HR 1.09, 95% CI 0.96-1.25; P=.19); therefore, the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Favorable functional outcome, defined as a modified Rankin Scale score of 0 to 2 at 90 days
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was an odds ratio of 0.74. The observed odds ratio was 1.09, but the 1-sided 97.5% CI lower bound was 0.63 and P=.18 for noninferiority; therefore, mechanical thrombectomy alone did not demonstrate noninferiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Patient-reported quality of life measured by the SF-36 physical component summary score at 6 months
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint showed no statistically significant difference between digoxin and bisoprolol (adjusted mean difference, 1.4; 95% CI, -1.1 to 3.8; P=.28), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Disease-free survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was disease-free survival. Capecitabine significantly improved estimated 5-year disease-free survival versus observation (82.8% vs 73.0%; HR for recurrence or death, 0.64 [95% CI, 0.42-0.95]; P=.03), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Hospitalization for asthma within 24 hours
brief_rationale: Hospitalization occurred in 43.5% of the magnesium group versus 47.7% of the placebo group, an absolute risk difference of -4.2% (95% CI, -11.0% to 2.8%; P=.26). Thus, nebulized magnesium did not significantly reduce the explicitly identified primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Biochemically validated 7-day point-prevalence smoking abstinence at 12 weeks, with participants missing data assumed to be smoking.
brief_rationale: Nicotine e-cigarettes plus counseling produced significantly greater 12-week abstinence than counseling alone (21.9% vs 9.1%; risk difference 12.8 percentage points, 95% CI 4.0 to 21.6), meeting the favorable superiority criterion for the explicitly identified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary outcomes of dialysis filter life span and 90-day mortality.
brief_rationale: Regional citrate significantly prolonged filter life span (47 vs 26 hours; P<.001), but did not significantly reduce 90-day mortality (primary adjusted P=.054). Because the coprimary outcomes had mixed results and no overall success rule is stated, trial success is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: Favorable neurologic function at 6 months, defined as Glasgow Outcome Scale-Extended score greater than 4, in the combined tranexamic acid group versus placebo
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 65% of tranexamic acid-treated patients versus 62% with placebo, but the prespecified benefit threshold was not met (P = .16; benefit significance threshold .10). Thus, tranexamic acid did not significantly improve the primary neurologic outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Organ support-free days (days alive and free of ICU-based respiratory or cardiovascular support) within 21 days, with death assigned -1 day.
brief_rationale: The prespecified superiority threshold was a posterior probability greater than 99%. The probabilities were 93% for fixed-dose and 80% for shock-dependent hydrocortisone versus no hydrocortisone; therefore, neither strategy met the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Death or disability at 24 months of corrected age, with disability defined as cognitive deficit, cerebral palsy, or severe visual or hearing impairment.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 44.4% with liberal thresholds versus 42.9% with restrictive thresholds (difference, 1.6%; 95% CI, -4.8% to 7.9%; P=.72). Liberal transfusion did not produce the intended reduction in death or disability, so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: One-year net adverse clinical events, a composite of major bleeding and adverse cardiac and cerebrovascular events (death, myocardial infarction, stent thrombosis, stroke, or target-vessel revascularization).
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was significantly less frequent with ticagrelor monotherapy after 3-month DAPT than with 12-month DAPT (3.9% vs 5.9%; HR 0.66, 95% CI 0.48-0.92; P=.01), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

The supplied title and abstract do not explicitly identify a prespecified primary endpoint or report its result; colorectal cancer screening and cancer detection cannot be assumed to be primary outcomes based on emphasis alone.

primary_endpoint_description: Dual primary end points of overall survival with doxorubicin plus olaratumab versus doxorubicin plus placebo in the total soft tissue sarcoma and leiomyosarcoma populations.
brief_rationale: Neither primary overall survival comparison showed favorable superiority: total STS HR 1.05 (95% CI, 0.84-1.30; P=.69) and LMS HR 0.95 (95% CI, 0.69-1.31; P=.76). Thus, the dual primary endpoints did not demonstrate a significant survival benefit.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite time to first cardiovascular death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, or stroke
brief_rationale: The primary composite endpoint occurred in 10.3% of apabetalone patients versus 12.4% of placebo patients (HR, 0.82; 95% CI, 0.65-1.04; P=.11), so the prespecified favorable superiority criterion was not met.
The title and abstract describe a 12-month analysis of MACE using SECURE-PCI trial data but do not explicitly identify a prespecified primary endpoint or report its success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Time-weighted average of intraoperative hypotension, calculated as hypotension depth below a mean arterial pressure of 65 mm Hg multiplied by time below 65 mm Hg and divided by operation duration.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was significantly lower in the early-warning intervention group than in the standard-care group (median 0.10 vs 0.44 mm Hg; median difference 0.38 mm Hg, 95% CI 0.14-0.43; P=.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of venous thromboembolism 10 to 13 days after knee arthroplasty, assessed by mandatory bilateral venography or confirmed symptomatic deep vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism.
brief_rationale: Using the prespecified 5% noninferiority margin versus enoxaparin, postoperative osocimab doses of 0.6, 1.2, and 1.8 mg/kg met noninferiority criteria for the primary outcome; preoperative 1.8 mg/kg also met superiority criteria. Although both 0.3-mg/kg regimens failed noninferiority, multiple tested osocimab regimens met the stated primary-endpoint criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Concordant Staphylococcus aureus colonization by 90 days, defined as neonatal acquisition of the same S aureus strain as a parental strain at screening.
brief_rationale: The intervention significantly reduced the primary endpoint versus placebo: 14.6% vs 28.7% (risk difference, -14.1% [95% CI, -30.8% to -3.9%]; HR, 0.43 [95.2% CI, 0.16 to 0.79]), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Pleurodesis failure up to 90 days after randomization
brief_rationale: The trial tested whether talc poudrage was superior to talc slurry. Pleurodesis failure was 22% versus 24%, respectively (adjusted OR 0.91, 95% CI 0.54-1.55; P=.74), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Hemostatic response, defined as effective if no hemostatic interventions occurred from 60 minutes to 24 hours after treatment initiation.
brief_rationale: PCC achieved hemostatic effectiveness in 77.9% versus 60.4% with frozen plasma (difference, 17.6%; 95% CI, 8.7%-26.4%; P<.001), satisfying the prespecified 10% noninferiority criterion; subsequent superiority testing was also significant.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of ventilator-free days through day 28
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored propofol rather than sevoflurane: median difference −2.1 days (95% CI, −3.6 to −0.7). Thus, sevoflurane did not meet a favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline through week 24 in ALS disease severity, assessed by a Bayesian shared parameter model integrating ALSFRS-R function and survival as the disease rate ratio (DRR).
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy endpoint did not significantly favor pridopidine: DRR 0.99 (95% credible interval, 0.80-1.21), with probability of DRR <1 of 0.55. The abstract states there was no significant difference between pridopidine and placebo.

primary_endpoint_description: Total coronary plaque volume measured by follow-up coronary computed tomography angiography at 3 years
brief_rationale: Plaque progression was significantly lower with CAC score-informed prevention than with usual care (15.4 vs 24.9 mm³; P = .009), meeting the favorable superiority criterion for the explicitly identified primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of severe complications of liver cirrhosis associated with organ failure meeting criteria for acute-on-chronic liver failure
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint did not favor simvastatin plus rifaximin: acute-on-chronic liver failure occurred in 17.9% versus 14.2% with placebo (HR, 1.23; 95% CI, 0.65-2.34; P = .52), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Endotracheal intubation or death within 7 days, assessed separately in 5 acute respiratory failure patient groups
brief_rationale: Noninferiority required a posterior probability of at least 0.992 for an OR below 1.55. This criterion was met in 4 patient groups but not in the immunocompromised group (NPP 0.989). The abstract does not specify an overall success rule for the mixed results across the 5 groups.

primary_endpoint_description: Refill adherence at 12 months, measured from pharmacy data as proportion of days covered.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed no significant overall difference among groups (P = .06). Although adjusted pairwise comparisons favored each messaging intervention, none remained statistically significant after correction for multiple comparisons; therefore, the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Freedom from any documented atrial arrhythmia lasting more than 30 seconds without antiarrhythmic drug use within 12 months
brief_rationale: The intervention improved the explicitly identified primary endpoint versus PVI alone (70.7% vs 61.5%; hazard ratio for recurrence, 0.73; 95% CI, 0.54-0.99; P=.045), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Child weight-for-length trajectory over 24 months
brief_rationale: The clinic plus digital intervention produced a favorable reduction in the primary weight-for-length trajectory at 24 months of 0.33 kg/m (95% CI, 0.09 to 0.57); the confidence interval excluded no difference, meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Occurrence of an unfavorable neurological outcome, defined as a Glasgow Outcome Scale Extended score of 1 to 5, at 180 days after randomization.
brief_rationale: The liberal transfusion strategy significantly reduced the explicitly identified primary outcome versus the restrictive strategy (62.6% vs 72.6%; adjusted relative risk, 0.86 [95% CI, 0.79-0.94]; P=.002), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Rate of cardiac surgery-associated acute kidney injury (CSA-AKI) within 7 days after randomization
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred less often with extracorporeal blood purification than with standard care (28.4% vs 39.7%; P=.03), a statistically significant difference in the intended favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of all-cause mortality, myocardial infarction, stroke, coronary revascularization, or hospitalization for unstable angina
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 35.6% of the chelation group and 35.7% of the placebo group (adjusted HR, 0.93; 95% CI, 0.76-1.16; P=.53), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Surgical site infection within 30 days after abdominal surgery and within 1 year after cardiac surgery
brief_rationale: The prespecified 2.5% noninferiority margin was satisfied: the SSI difference was 0.4% (95% CI, -1.1% to 2.0%), and the relevant CI limit did not cross the predefined margin. The abstract concludes that povidone iodine was noninferior to chlorhexidine gluconate.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in systolic blood pressure at 12 months and rate of recurrent stroke at 24 months
brief_rationale: The two explicitly identified primary outcomes had mixed results: systolic blood pressure reduction favored NCM plus HBPTM (adjusted difference, -8.1 mm Hg; P<.001), while recurrent stroke rates were identical (4.0% vs 4.0%; P>.99). The abstract does not state the overall success rule for these multiple primary outcomes.

primary_endpoint_description: Days alive and free of organ support (mechanical ventilation, vasopressors, and kidney replacement therapy) through day 28
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint did not significantly favor acetaminophen: 20.2 days versus 19.6 days with placebo (difference, 0.6 days; 95% CI, -1.4 to 2.6; P=.56). Thus, the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: MRD-negative complete remission (BCR::ABL1 ≤0.01% [MR4]), with complete remission maintained for at least 4 weeks at the end of cycle 3
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint rate was significantly higher with ponatinib than imatinib (34.4% vs 16.7%; risk difference 0.18, 95% CI 0.06-0.29; P=.002), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Invasive disease-free survival
brief_rationale: The trial was suspended after the primary endpoint crossed the prespecified futility bound. Invasive disease-free survival was not improved with aspirin versus placebo (HR, 1.27; 95% CI, 0.99-1.63; P=.06), with numerically more events in the aspirin group.

primary_endpoint_description: Prostate cancer mortality at a median 10-year follow-up
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies prostate cancer mortality at the median 10-year follow-up as the primary outcome and states that PSA screening had no effect on it. The favorable superiority criterion was therefore not met; the significant 15-year finding was a prespecified secondary outcome in this analysis.

primary_endpoint_description: Primary effectiveness: freedom from documented atrial arrhythmias longer than 30 seconds through 12 months; primary safety: 30-day composite of predefined serious adverse events versus a prespecified 10% performance goal.
brief_rationale: The primary effectiveness endpoint did not meet the prespecified superiority criterion, while the primary safety endpoint met its prespecified performance goal. The abstract does not state the overall success rule for these mixed primary-endpoint results.

primary_endpoint_description: Occurrence of any prespecified serious adverse event during the 10-month observation period, as determined by a blinded adjudication committee.
brief_rationale: Serious adverse events occurred in 28% of the early-repair group versus 18% of the late-repair group, with a 97% Bayesian posterior probability of benefit with late repair. The abstract concludes that late repair resulted in fewer infants having at least one serious adverse event.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean absolute change in hepatic fat content measured by proton magnetic resonance spectroscopy at 6 months
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored aspirin over placebo: mean absolute hepatic fat change was -6.6% versus 3.6%, with an adjusted difference of -10.2% (95% CI, -27.7% to -2.6%; P = .009), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

This is a secondary machine-learning analysis of two randomized trials. Although 28-day mortality is listed as the main outcome, the abstract does not explicitly identify and report an original prespecified trial primary endpoint or its success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: One-year target lesion failure, defined as the composite of ischemia-driven target lesion revascularization, target vessel-related myocardial infarction, or cardiac death.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 17.9% of the paclitaxel-coated balloon group versus 28.6% of the uncoated balloon group (HR, 0.59; 95% CI, 0.42-0.84; P=.003), explicitly meeting the superiority criterion in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) from baseline to 7 years for all participants
brief_rationale: At 7 years, HbA1c decreased by 1.6% with bariatric surgery versus 0.2% with medical/lifestyle management, yielding a favorable between-group difference of -1.4% (95% CI, -1.8% to -1.0%; P<.001). Thus, the explicitly identified primary superiority outcome favored bariatric surgery.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary outcomes of investigator-assessed event-free survival and blinded independent review-assessed major pathological response rate.
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary outcomes favored toripalimab plus chemotherapy: event-free survival improved (HR, 0.40; 95% CI, 0.28-0.57; P<.001) and major pathological response increased (48.5% vs 8.4%; P<.001).
The abstract reports clinician diagnostic accuracy under MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES but does not explicitly identify it, or any other measure, as the prespecified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to successful ECMO weaning within 60 days after randomization
brief_rationale: Successful ECMO weaning occurred in 44% of each group; the subdistribution hazard ratio was 1.11 (95% CI, 0.71-1.75; P=.64). Prone positioning therefore did not significantly reduce time to successful ECMO weaning versus supine positioning.

primary_endpoint_description: Hierarchical composite of in-hospital death, length of ICU stay, and length of hospital stay
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint showed a significant favorable benefit with the conservative intubation-withholding strategy (win ratio, 1.85; 95% CI, 1.33-2.58), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: 24-hour mean diastolic blood pressure at 9 months postpartum, adjusted for baseline postnatal blood pressure
brief_rationale: The intervention significantly lowered the explicitly identified primary endpoint versus usual care (between-group difference, -5.80 mm Hg; 95% CI, -7.40 to -4.20; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Highest stage of acute kidney injury or death by day 14, measured on a 5-level ordinal scale
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome did not significantly differ between cefepime and piperacillin-tazobactam (odds ratio, 0.95; 95% CI, 0.80-1.13; P=.56), so the superiority criterion was not met.

This follow-up publication explicitly identifies death or moderate to severe neurodevelopmental disability at 2 years as a key secondary outcome, not the original trial's primary endpoint. No prespecified primary endpoint is explicitly identified and reported.

The abstract lists safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and exploratory pharmacodynamic biomarkers as outcomes but does not explicitly identify a prespecified primary endpoint or an unambiguous equivalent.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite success at 2 years: absence of pelvic organ prolapse beyond the hymen in any compartment, bothersome bulge symptoms, and prolapse retreatment.
brief_rationale: Sacrospinous hysteropexy did not meet the prespecified 9% noninferiority margin versus the Manchester procedure (risk difference, -10.3%; 95% CI, -17.8% to -2.8%; P=.63 for noninferiority).

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of participants with an absolute LVEF decline of at least 10% from before chemotherapy to a final LVEF below 55% over 12 months.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred less often with atorvastatin than placebo (9% vs 22%; P=.002), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in HbA1c from baseline to week 26, with a noninferiority margin of 0.3 percentage points.
brief_rationale: The estimated treatment difference was -0.2 percentage points (95% CI, -0.3 to -0.1), and the abstract explicitly states that this confirmed noninferiority (P<.001), meeting the primary endpoint success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of all-cause mortality and emergence of pandrug-resistant or extensively drug-resistant bacteria at day 28
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 47% with continuous administration versus 49% with intermittent administration (RR, 0.96; 95% CI, 0.81-1.13; P=.60), so continuous administration did not demonstrate favorable superiority.

This follow-up summary mentions back pain–related disability at 6 months but does not explicitly identify it as the trial's prespecified primary endpoint or report a primary-endpoint success criterion and result.

primary_endpoint_description: All-cause mortality at 60 days
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed no significant favorable difference with amoxicillin-clavulanate versus placebo (17.3% vs 21.3%; P=.33; hazard ratio 0.77, 95% CI 0.45-1.31), so superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Oxygen-free days through day 28, an ordinal outcome based on mortality and duration of supplemental oxygen use
brief_rationale: In both randomized trials, superiority required an adjusted odds ratio greater than 1.0. Neither TXA-127 (adjusted OR 0.88, 95% CrI 0.59-1.30) nor TRV-027 (adjusted OR 0.74, 95% CrI 0.48-1.13) improved oxygen-free days versus placebo, and both trials stopped early for low probability of efficacy.

primary_endpoint_description: Clinical response at week 12, defined as at least a 3-point and 30% decrease in total Mayo score, with at least a 1-point decrease and a score of 1 or less for rectal bleeding.
brief_rationale: The 600-mg olamkicept group had a significantly higher clinical response rate than placebo (58.6% vs 34.5%; adjusted difference, 26.6%; 90% CI, 6.2%-47.1%; P=.03), meeting favorable superiority for the primary endpoint. The 300-mg dose was not superior.

primary_endpoint_description: Oxygen consumption at anaerobic threshold (V̇O₂,AT)
brief_rationale: Rate-adaptive atrial pacing did not significantly improve the primary endpoint versus no pacing (10.7 vs 10.4 mL/kg/min; difference, 0.3 [95% CI, -0.5 to 1.0]; P = .46), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Mixed-meal tolerance test-stimulated C-peptide area under the curve at 52 weeks from diagnosis
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint did not differ favorably with intensive management versus standard care (adjusted treatment-group difference, -0.01 pmol/mL; 95% CI, -0.11 to 0.10; P = .89), so superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of preterm preeclampsia with aspirin discontinuation at 24 to 28 weeks versus aspirin continuation
brief_rationale: Preterm preeclampsia occurred in 1.48% versus 1.73% of participants (difference, -0.25%; 95% CI, -1.86% to 1.36%). The upper 95% confidence limit of 1.36% was below the prespecified 1.9% noninferiority margin, so noninferiority was met.
