primary_endpoint_description: Two-year cumulative incidence of myopia and percentage of participants with fast myopic shift at 2 years.
brief_rationale: For both explicitly identified primary outcomes, 0.05% atropine was significantly superior to placebo, reducing myopia incidence and fast myopic shift. The 0.01% dose was not significantly different from placebo, but the 0.05% intervention met the favorable superiority criterion on both primary outcomes.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline to week 1 in worst breathlessness intensity (0-10 numerical rating scale) for extended-release morphine 8 mg/day and 16 mg/day versus placebo.
brief_rationale: Neither morphine dose significantly improved the primary outcome versus placebo: the mean difference was -0.3 for both 8 mg/day (95% CI, -0.9 to 0.4) and 16 mg/day (95% CI, -1.0 to 0.4). Thus, favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Hypercapnic ventilation at end-tidal carbon dioxide of 55 mm Hg for paroxetine or quetiapine combined with oxycodone versus placebo plus oxycodone on days 1 and 5.
brief_rationale: The primary comparisons had mixed results: paroxetine plus oxycodone significantly decreased hypercapnic ventilation on days 1 and 5, whereas quetiapine plus oxycodone did not. The abstract does not state an overall success rule for these multiple primary comparisons.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in 6-minute walk distance from baseline to 6 months, comparing the combined telmisartan groups with the combined placebo groups.
brief_rationale: Telmisartan did not significantly improve the primary outcome versus placebo; the adjusted between-group difference was -16.8 m (95% CI, -35.9 to 2.2; P=.08), with the point estimate unfavorable to telmisartan.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall treatment success, defined as clinical cure combined with microbiological eradication (<10^3 CFU/mL in urine), in the primary analysis set.
brief_rationale: Overall treatment success was 79.1% with cefepime/enmetazobactam versus 58.9% with piperacillin/tazobactam; the difference was 21.2% (95% CI, 14.3% to 27.9%). The lower confidence bound exceeded the prespecified noninferiority margin of -10%, so the primary endpoint met the noninferiority success criterion (and the prespecified superiority criterion).

primary_endpoint_description: Mortality at day 28
brief_rationale: Day-28 mortality was 10% with high-flow oxygen versus 11% with standard oxygen (absolute difference, -1.2%; 95% CI, -5.8% to 3.4%; P=.60), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Acute kidney injury after coronary angiography, percutaneous coronary intervention, or both
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was AKI. Its incidence was significantly lower during the intervention period than during the control period (7.2% vs 8.6%; time-adjusted OR, 0.72 [95% CI, 0.56-0.93]; P=.01), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Excellent functional outcome at 90 days, defined as a modified Rankin Scale score of 0 to 1.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred more often with remote ischemic conditioning than with usual care (67.4% vs 62.0%; risk difference 5.4%, 95% CI 1.0%-9.9%; odds ratio 1.27, 95% CI 1.05-1.54; P=.02), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in exercise capacity, measured by peak oxygen uptake (peak V̇o2), from baseline to week 20.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint did not significantly favor omecamtiv mecarbil over placebo (least-squares mean difference, -0.45 mL/kg/min; 95% CI, -1.02 to 0.13; P = .13), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Time from randomization to liberation from all respiratory support, defined as the start of a 48-hour period free from invasive or noninvasive respiratory support.
brief_rationale: The adjusted hazard ratio was 1.03 with a 1-sided 97.5% CI of 0.86 to infinity; the lower bound exceeded the prespecified noninferiority margin of 0.75, meeting the noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Invasive disease-free survival in patients with hormone receptor-positive (ER/PgR-positive) breast cancer
brief_rationale: The primary outcome showed no favorable superiority of metformin over placebo (HR, 1.01; 95% CI, 0.84-1.21; P = .93), so the success criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Endotracheal intubation within 30 days of randomization
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 34.1% of the prone-positioning group versus 40.5% of controls, but the favorable reduction was not statistically significant (hazard ratio 0.81, 95% CI 0.59-1.12; P=.20). Thus, the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: 6-minute walking distance at 3-month follow-up
brief_rationale: The intervention significantly improved the explicitly identified primary outcome versus usual care (adjusted mean between-group difference, 16.7 m; 95% CI, 4.2 to 29.2; P=.009), in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Time from randomization to liberation from respiratory support, defined as the start of a 48-hour period free from all invasive or noninvasive respiratory support.
brief_rationale: HFNC failed the prespecified noninferiority criterion versus CPAP. The adjusted hazard ratio was 0.83 with a 1-sided 97.5% CI of 0.70 to infinity, crossing the noninferiority margin of 0.75.

primary_endpoint_description: Neurosensory impairment at 2 years' corrected age
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome did not differ significantly between dextrose and placebo groups (20.8% vs 18.7%; adjusted risk ratio 1.13, 95% CI 0.90-1.41), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Organ support-free days within 21 days, defined as days alive and free of ICU-based respiratory or cardiovascular organ support.
brief_rationale: The prespecified efficacy criterion was greater than 99% posterior probability that the odds ratio was greater than 1. The pooled antiplatelet group had an adjusted OR of 1.02 (95% CrI, 0.86-1.23) and met the prespecified futility criterion (95.7% posterior probability), so the primary superiority endpoint did not meet the success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of patients with COVID-19 progression through day 29, defined as all-cause hospitalization lasting more than 24 hours for acute illness management or death.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was significantly reduced with sotrovimab versus placebo (1% vs 6%; adjusted RR, 0.21; 95% CI, 0.09-0.50; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean change from baseline in glycated hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) at week 40.
brief_rationale: All tirzepatide doses produced significantly greater HbA1c reductions than placebo at week 40 (between-group differences −1.24% to −1.53%; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion for the explicitly identified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Mortality at 30 days
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was 30-day mortality. Mortality was 42% with moderate hypothermia versus 51% with normothermia, but the adjusted odds ratio was 0.71 (95% CI, 0.45-1.13; P=.15), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of tracheal intubation or mortality within 30 days
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was significantly reduced with CPAP versus conventional oxygen therapy (36.3% vs 44.4%; absolute difference, -8% [95% CI, -15% to -1%]; P=.03), meeting the favorable superiority criterion. HFNO did not significantly improve the primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Successful tracheal intubation on the first attempt
brief_rationale: First-attempt intubation success was 80.4% with bougie versus 83.0% with stylet (absolute risk difference, -2.6 percentage points; 95% CI, -7.3 to 2.2; P=.27), so bougie did not achieve favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of all-cause mortality or poor neurologic outcome at 180 days, with poor neurologic outcome defined as a Disability Rating Scale score greater than 5.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 48.4% of the 31 °C group versus 45.4% of the 34 °C group (relative risk, 1.07; 95% CI, 0.86-1.33; P=.56). Thus, moderate hypothermia did not demonstrate favorable superiority over mild hypothermia.

primary_endpoint_description: Return of spontaneous circulation
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred in 42% of the vasopressin plus methylprednisolone group versus 33% of the placebo group (risk ratio 1.30, 95% CI 1.03-1.63; P=.03), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of asthma symptom-days during a 2-week period, assessed every 2 months during the 10 months after randomization
brief_rationale: Neither intervention significantly reduced the explicitly identified primary outcome: IPM vs no IPM had an incidence rate ratio of 0.71 (95% CI, 0.38-1.33), and HEPA vs sham had an incidence rate ratio of 1.47 (95% CI, 0.79-2.75). Thus, the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Duration of invasive mechanical ventilation from initiation of ventilation until first successful extubation.
brief_rationale: The protocol significantly shortened time to first successful extubation versus usual care (adjusted hazard ratio, 1.11; 95% CI, 1.02-1.20; P=.02), meeting the favorable superiority criterion for the explicitly identified primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Survival without invasive mechanical ventilation from day 3 to day 29
brief_rationale: The primary outcome favored canakinumab numerically (88.8% vs 85.7%) but did not demonstrate significant superiority over placebo (odds ratio 1.39, 95% CI 0.76-2.54; P=.29).

primary_endpoint_description: Absence of self-reported COVID-19 symptoms at day 14
brief_rationale: The symptom-free proportion at day 14 was 50% in both groups (difference, 0%; 95% CI, -14% to 15%; P > .99), so azithromycin did not demonstrate favorable superiority over placebo on the primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Efficacy against laboratory-confirmed symptomatic COVID-19 beginning 14 days after the second vaccine dose among participants without virologic evidence of SARS-CoV-2 infection at randomization.
brief_rationale: Both vaccines significantly reduced the primary endpoint versus alum-only control: efficacy was 72.8% for WIV04 and 78.1% for HB02, with P < .001 for both comparisons.

primary_endpoint_description: Extended Glasgow Outcome Scale (GOS-E) score at 6 months, analyzed using adjusted ordinal logistic regression
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint did not show favorable superiority of hypertonic saline over standard care (adjusted common OR 1.02, 95% CI 0.71-1.47; P=.92).

primary_endpoint_description: Clinical remission at week 30
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 50.5% of the TDM group versus 53.0% of the standard-therapy group (adjusted difference, 1.5%; 95% CI, -8.2% to 11.1%; P=.78). Proactive TDM did not demonstrate favorable superiority over standard therapy.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of patients with a disease flare between baseline and 12-month follow-up.
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was a 20% risk difference. Flares occurred in 25% with half-dose versus 6% with stable-dose csDMARDs, with a risk difference of 18% (95% CI, 7% to 29%). Because the confidence interval exceeded the 20% margin, noninferiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Time from randomization to the last dose of parenteral opioids
brief_rationale: The primary outcome showed no significant favorable difference: 81.8 hours with poloxamer 188 versus 77.8 hours with placebo (difference, 4.0 hours; 95% CI, -7.8 to 15.7; P = .09). Thus, poloxamer 188 did not significantly shorten the time to the last parenteral opioid dose.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean change in 6-minute walk distance at 12 months.
brief_rationale: Low-intensity exercise was significantly less effective than high-intensity exercise (between-group difference, -40.9 m; 97.5% CI, -61.7 to -20.0; P<.001) and was not significantly better than nonexercise control (difference, 8.7 m; 97.5% CI, -17.0 to 34.4; P=.44). Thus, the primary superiority outcome did not meet the intended favorable criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline to 1 year in the Short Form 36 physical component summary (SF-36 PCS) score
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint improvement did not significantly differ between ventral and dorsal surgery (5.9 vs 6.2 points; estimated mean difference, 0.3; 95% CI, -2.6 to 3.1; P = .86), so favorable superiority of the ventral approach was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary end points: percentage change in body weight and achievement of at least 5% loss of baseline body weight by week 68.
brief_rationale: Both co-primary endpoints significantly favored semaglutide over placebo: mean weight change was -16.0% vs -5.7% (difference -10.3 percentage points; 95% CI, -12.0 to -8.6; P<.001), and 86.6% vs 47.6% achieved at least 5% weight loss (P<.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Percentage of patients with at least 1 agitation-related event during the treatment period
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored baclofen over placebo (19.7% vs 29.7%; difference, -9.93% [95% CI, -19.45% to -0.42%]; adjusted odds ratio, 0.59 [95% CI, 0.35-0.99]), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of consecutive ventilator- and vasopressor-free days during the first 30 days after randomization
brief_rationale: The intervention did not significantly increase the primary outcome versus placebo: median 25 vs 26 days, median difference -1 day (95% CI, -4 to 2; P=.85). Thus, the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of patients achieving functional independence at 90 days, defined as a modified Rankin Scale score of 0 to 2.
brief_rationale: Endovascular thrombectomy alone achieved 90-day functional independence in 54.3% versus 46.6% with alteplase plus thrombectomy. The difference was 7.7%, with a 1-sided 97.5% CI lower bound of -5.1%, which exceeded the prespecified -10% noninferiority margin (P for noninferiority = .003).

primary_endpoint_description: Survival to hospital admission
brief_rationale: Neither sodium nitrite dose significantly improved the primary outcome versus placebo; survival was numerically lower with 45 mg (41%; P=.82) and 60 mg (43%; P=.66) than with placebo (44%).

primary_endpoint_description: Number of days alive and out of the hospital at 30 days
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint did not differ significantly between the care-bundle and usual-care groups (median 19 days in both groups; adjusted difference, -1.9 days [95% CI, -6.6 to 2.8]; adjusted ratio, 0.88 [95% CI, 0.64-1.21]), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Clinical deterioration within 15 days of randomization, defined by both shortness of breath or related hospitalization and oxygen saturation below 92% on room air or need for supplemental oxygen.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred in 0 of 80 fluvoxamine recipients versus 6 of 72 placebo recipients, favoring fluvoxamine (absolute difference 8.7%, 95% CI 1.8%-16.4%; log-rank P=.009), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Biochemically confirmed 7-day point-prevalence tobacco abstinence at 6-month follow-up
brief_rationale: The intensive-treatment group had a significantly higher 6-month biochemically confirmed quit rate than the standard-treatment group (34.5% vs 21.5%; difference, 13.0% [95% CI, 3.0%-23.3%]; P<.02), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Treatment failure at day 21, defined as death or persistent dependence on mechanical ventilation or high-flow oxygen therapy.
brief_rationale: Treatment failure occurred in 42.1% with hydrocortisone versus 50.7% with placebo, a difference of -8.6% (95.48% CI, -24.9% to 7.7%; P=.29). Thus, hydrocortisone did not significantly reduce the primary outcome and the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of postoperative pulmonary complications within the first 7 postoperative days
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 38% of the low-tidal-volume group and 39% of the conventional-tidal-volume group (risk ratio, 0.97; 95% CI, 0.84-1.11; P=.64), so low tidal volume did not achieve favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to a severe asthma exacerbation
brief_rationale: Vitamin D3 did not significantly improve the explicitly identified primary outcome versus placebo (adjusted hazard ratio, 1.13; 95% CI, 0.69-1.85; P=.63); the trial was also terminated early for futility.

primary_endpoint_description: Clinical status on day 11 measured on a 7-point ordinal scale from death to discharge.
brief_rationale: The 5-day remdesivir group had significantly better clinical status than standard care (OR 1.65, 95% CI 1.09-2.48; P=.02), whereas the 10-day group did not (P=.18). The abstract does not state the overall success rule for these mixed primary-endpoint comparisons.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (SOFA) score between enrollment and 72 hours
brief_rationale: The intervention did not produce a statistically significant favorable reduction in the primary endpoint versus placebo (adjusted mean difference, -0.8; 95% CI, -1.7 to 0.2; P=.12 for the time-by-treatment interaction), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Three-year change in cycloplegic spherical equivalent autorefraction.
brief_rationale: High add power multifocal lenses significantly reduced 3-year myopia progression versus both single-vision lenses (difference, 0.46 D; 95% CI, 0.29-0.63) and medium add power lenses (difference, 0.30 D; 95% CI, 0.13-0.47), meeting the favorable superiority criterion for the explicitly identified primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Total duration of postoperative hypoxemia (SpO2 <90%) per hour during the first 48 postoperative hours.
brief_rationale: The acetaminophen group did not have a statistically significant reduction in the primary outcome versus placebo (median 0.7 vs 1.1 minutes per hour; estimated median difference, -0.04 [95% CI, -0.18 to 0.11]; P=.29), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Breast cancer incidence, identified as the protocol-prespecified primary monitoring outcome for harm
brief_rationale: The same primary outcome was reported for 2 separate randomized trials with discordant results: CEE alone significantly lowered breast cancer incidence, whereas CEE plus MPA significantly increased it. No overall success rule for combining the 2 trial results is stated.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of cytomegalovirus disease by 12 months, defined as CMV syndrome or end-organ disease.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred significantly less often with preemptive therapy than with antiviral prophylaxis (9% vs 19%; difference, 10 percentage points; 95% CI, 0.5-19.6; P=.04), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Safety (laboratory parameters, adverse events, and CHIKV infection) and tolerability (local and systemic reactogenicity) of the CHIKV virus-like particle vaccine
brief_rationale: The primary safety and tolerability outcome was explicitly identified and descriptive results were favorable, but the abstract does not state a prespecified threshold or other success criterion by which this endpoint was to be judged.

primary_endpoint_description: All-cause mortality at 90 days
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was 90-day all-cause mortality. Mortality was 41.0% with permissive hypotension versus 43.8% with usual care, but the unadjusted difference was not statistically significant (absolute risk difference −2.85%; 95% CI, −6.75% to 1.05%; P=.15), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: 90-day composite of mortality, persistent bacteremia at day 5, microbiological relapse, and microbiological treatment failure
brief_rationale: The primary composite occurred in 35% with combination therapy versus 39% with standard therapy (absolute difference, -4.2%; 95% CI, -14.3% to 6.0%) and did not show a significant improvement. Thus, the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Deep surgical site infection at 30 days diagnosed according to US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention criteria.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 5.84% with incisional negative pressure wound therapy versus 6.68% with standard dressing (odds ratio 0.87, 95% CI 0.57–1.33; P=.52), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Duration of time alive and free of vasopressor administration up to day 7
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome did not significantly favor vitamin C, hydrocortisone, and thiamine over hydrocortisone alone (median paired difference, -0.6 hours; 95% CI, -8.3 to 7.2; P=.83), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: All-cause mortality within 90 days during the index hospitalization
brief_rationale: Hospital mortality was 18.3% with the PPI strategy versus 17.5% with the H2RB strategy (risk ratio 1.05, 95% CI 1.00-1.10; P=.054). The difference did not reach the significance threshold and numerically favored H2RBs, so favorable superiority of PPIs was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to prostate cancer progression, defined by PSA level of at least 10 ng/mL, PSA doubling time of less than 3 years, or upgrading in tumor volume or grade on follow-up biopsy.
brief_rationale: The intervention did not significantly improve the primary outcome of time to progression versus control (adjusted HR, 0.97; 95% CI, 0.76-1.25), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.
The supplied title and plain-language summary describe a comparison of prescreening efficiency but do not explicitly identify a primary endpoint or report its result and success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Invasive disease-free survival, defined as time from randomization to invasive breast cancer in the ipsilateral or contralateral breast, distant or other recurrence, or death from any cause.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint did not show favorable superiority for atezolizumab plus chemotherapy versus chemotherapy alone (stratified hazard ratio, 1.11; 95% CI, 0.87-1.42; P=.38); the abstract states that adding atezolizumab provided no benefit.

primary_endpoint_description: Surgical site infection up to 30 days after emergency laparotomy, assessed masked using US CDC criteria.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 28.4% with iNPWT versus 27.4% with the surgeon's preferred dressing (RR, 1.03; 95% CI, 0.83-1.28; P=.78). Thus, iNPWT did not demonstrate favorable superiority in preventing surgical site infection.

primary_endpoint_description: Between-group difference in the percentage of infants born large for gestational age (birth weight >90th percentile for gestational age and sex).
brief_rationale: Large-for-gestational-age infants occurred in 23.9% of the oral-agent group versus 19.9% of the insulin group (risk difference, 4.0%; 95% CI, -1.7% to 9.8%). The confidence interval exceeded the prespecified 8% noninferiority margin, so noninferiority was not established.

primary_endpoint_description: 90-day in-hospital mortality
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was significantly lower with electronic sepsis screening than with no screening (adjusted relative risk, 0.85; 95% CI, 0.77-0.93; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of patients with return of gut function at 72 hours after surgery, defined by the GI-3 composite of tolerating diet and passage of flatus or stool.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 57.3% of the intravenous lidocaine group versus 59.0% of the placebo group (adjusted absolute difference, -1.9%; 95% CI, -8.0% to 4.2%; RR, 0.97; 95% CI, 0.88 to 1.07). Lidocaine did not demonstrate favorable superiority over placebo.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite clinical endpoint at 1 year comprising change in New York Heart Association class, change in patient global assessment, or occurrence of major cardiovascular events.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary composite outcome favored T-TEER plus optimized medical therapy: 74.1% had an improved composite score versus 40.6% with optimized medical therapy alone, and the authors concluded that T-TEER improved the composite score.

primary_endpoint_description: Mother-to-child HBV transmission rate, defined as detectable HBV DNA greater than 20 IU/mL or hepatitis B surface antigen positivity in infants at age 28 weeks.
brief_rationale: Noninferiority required the upper limit of the 2-sided 90% CI for the absolute MTCT-rate difference to be no more than 3%. The upper limits were 1.74% among all live-born infants and 1.43% in the per-protocol analysis; both met the prespecified criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to first occurrence of the composite of all-cause death or unplanned aortic stenosis-related hospitalization in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: The primary composite endpoint occurred in 18% with early intervention versus 23% with conservative management (HR, 0.79; 95% CI, 0.44-1.43; P=.44), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of AKI progression to a higher stage, dialysis, or mortality during hospitalization and within 14 days after randomization.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 19.8% of the intervention group versus 18.4% with usual care (difference, 1.4%; 95% CI, -1.1% to 3.8%; P=.28). The intervention did not achieve a significant favorable reduction in the primary composite outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Receipt of influenza vaccination on or before January 1, 2024, assessed in 7 prespecified coprimary comparisons: all intervention groups pooled versus usual care and each of 6 individual intervention groups versus usual care.
brief_rationale: Vaccination uptake was significantly higher for the pooled intervention groups versus usual care and for each individual intervention letter versus usual care (all P<.001), so all 7 coprimary superiority comparisons favored the interventions.

primary_endpoint_description: Intensive care unit length of stay at the patient level
brief_rationale: The primary outcome did not show a significant favorable reduction with tele-critical care versus usual care (8.1 vs 7.1 days; percentage change, 8.2%; 95% CI, -5.4% to 23.8%; P=.24), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to first all-cause ICD shock
brief_rationale: The equivalence-design trial prespecified superiority testing if equivalence was not proven. ATP plus shock favorably prolonged time to first all-cause shock versus shock only (HR, 0.72; 95.9% CI, 0.57-0.92; P=.005 for superiority), meeting the stated superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Gastric cancer incidence and gastric cancer mortality
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary outcomes failed to show favorable superiority: gastric cancer incidence was not significantly reduced (mean difference, -0.005%; 95% CI, -0.013% to 0.003%; P=.23), and gastric cancer mortality was not reduced (mean difference, 0.002%; 95% CI, -0.004% to 0.007%; P=.57). The favorable post hoc adjusted incidence result does not change the primary-endpoint assessment.

primary_endpoint_description: Need for endotracheal intubation during hospitalization, defined by prespecified criteria
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 4.8% with high-intensity NPPV versus 13.7% with low-intensity NPPV (absolute difference, -9.0%; 95% CI, -15.4% to -2.5%; 1-sided P=.004), demonstrating favorable superiority. Actual intubation was a secondary outcome and does not alter this assessment.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of all-cause mortality and major postoperative complications within 28 days after surgery.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 22% of both groups (continuation vs discontinuation: risk ratio, 1.02; 95% CI, 0.87-1.19; P=.85), so continuation did not achieve the stated objective of decreasing 28-day complications.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean change from baseline in frequency and severity of moderate to severe vasomotor symptoms at weeks 4 and 12 in OASIS 1 and OASIS 2.
brief_rationale: All explicitly identified primary endpoints favored elinzanetant over placebo in both trials, with statistically significant improvements in vasomotor symptom frequency and severity at weeks 4 and 12 (all P<.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Emergency department visits during the intervention period
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was emergency department visits. Cash-benefit recipients had significantly fewer visits than controls (adjusted difference, -87.0 per 1000 persons; 95% CI, -160.2 to -13.8), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Clinical remission at week 12 in the induction trial and at week 52 in the maintenance trial.
brief_rationale: Both trials met their primary superiority endpoint. Clinical remission was significantly higher with risankizumab than placebo at week 12 in induction (20.3% vs 6.2%; P<.001) and at week 52 in maintenance for both 180 mg (40.2% vs 25.1%; P<.001) and 360 mg (37.6% vs 25.1%; P=.002).

primary_endpoint_description: Hierarchical composite of hospital mortality, initiation of kidney replacement therapy, and ICU length of stay through 28 days, analyzed using the win ratio method
brief_rationale: The primary outcome did not show favorable superiority with dapagliflozin: win ratio 1.01 (95% CI, 0.90-1.13; P=.89). Therefore, the addition of dapagliflozin did not significantly improve the prespecified primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: All-cause mortality within 90 days after randomization
brief_rationale: Continuous infusion yielded 24.9% mortality versus 26.8% with intermittent infusion, but the favorable difference was not statistically significant (odds ratio 0.91, 95% CI 0.81-1.01; P=.08), so the primary superiority endpoint did not meet its success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Noninferiority of stepped versus early palliative care for patient-reported quality of life measured by FACT-L at week 24, with a noninferiority margin of -4.5 points.
brief_rationale: The adjusted between-group difference was 2.9 points, with a lower 1-sided 95% confidence limit of -0.1, which exceeded the prespecified -4.5-point noninferiority margin (P<.001 for noninferiority).

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary endpoints were percent change in body weight from baseline and achievement of at least 5% body-weight reduction at week 52.
brief_rationale: Both tirzepatide doses produced significantly greater mean percentage weight loss than placebo and significantly higher proportions achieving at least 5% weight reduction (P<.001 for all comparisons), meeting the favorable superiority criterion for both co-primary endpoints.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in knee pain on a 0-100 visual analog scale over 24 weeks
brief_rationale: Krill oil did not improve the explicitly identified primary outcome versus placebo (mean changes, -19.9 vs -20.2; between-group mean difference, -0.3; 95% CI, -6.9 to 6.4), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: General Conceptual Ability score below 85 on the Differential Ability Scales, 2nd Edition, at age 6 years or older.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 17.1% of the betamethasone group versus 18.5% of the placebo group (adjusted relative risk, 0.94; 95% CI, 0.73-1.22). The confidence interval included no effect, so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Empiric extended-spectrum antibiotic days of therapy during the first 3 days of hospitalization
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was reduced by 28.4% with CPOE prompts versus routine stewardship (rate ratio, 0.72; 95% CI, 0.66-0.78; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Empiric extended-spectrum antibiotic days of therapy during the first 3 days of hospitalization
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was reduced favorably with CPOE prompts versus routine stewardship by 17.4% (rate ratio, 0.83; 95% CI, 0.77-0.89; P<.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: The study's primary mortality outcome
brief_rationale: This is a preliminary descriptive report of exploratory cancer-detection outcomes. The abstract explicitly notes that results of the study's primary mortality outcome are still pending, so primary-endpoint success cannot be assessed.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of operating room intubation attempts per surgical procedure
brief_rationale: Video laryngoscopy significantly reduced the primary outcome compared with direct laryngoscopy (proportional odds ratio, 0.20; 95% CI, 0.14-0.28; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Between-group difference in least-squares mean change from baseline to month 3 in 24-hour mean ambulatory systolic blood pressure.
brief_rationale: All zilebesiran regimens produced significantly greater reductions than placebo in the explicitly identified primary endpoint, with least-squares mean differences of -14.1 to -16.7 mm Hg and P<.001 for each comparison.

primary_endpoint_description: Recurrent stroke in a time-to-event analysis
brief_rationale: The primary efficacy outcome was recurrent stroke. Apixaban and aspirin each had 40 recurrent strokes (annualized rate 4.4%; hazard ratio 1.00, 95% CI 0.64-1.55), so apixaban did not demonstrate favorable superiority; the trial was stopped for futility.

primary_endpoint_description: Interaction between time from symptom onset to expected IV thrombolysis and allocated treatment on 90-day disability measured by the 7-level modified Rankin Scale.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome analysis found a statistically significant treatment-by-time interaction in the hypothesized direction: the benefit of IV thrombolysis plus thrombectomy decreased with each hour of delay (ratio of adjusted common OR, 0.84; 95% CI, 0.72-0.97; P=.02).

primary_endpoint_description: Preterm births and childhood growth
brief_rationale: The abstract identifies preterm birth and childhood growth as the trial's primary outcome(s), but this secondary-outcome publication reports only neurodevelopmental results and does not report the primary-endpoint results.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite adverse neonatal outcome including perinatal death, preterm birth, large or small for gestational age, and hyperbilirubinemia requiring phototherapy.
brief_rationale: The primary composite outcome occurred in 71% of the metformin group versus 74% of the placebo group (adjusted OR, 0.86; 95% CI, 0.63-1.19). The trial was stopped for futility, and metformin did not significantly reduce the primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean percent change in body weight from week 36 (randomization) to week 88.
brief_rationale: Continued tirzepatide produced a favorable mean weight change of -5.5% versus a 14.0% increase with placebo, with a between-group difference of -19.4 percentage points (95% CI, -21.2 to -17.7; P<.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: 30-day major adverse cardiac and cerebrovascular events, a composite of cardiac death, myocardial reinfarction, emergent coronary revascularization, and stroke
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred less often with Tongxinluo than placebo (3.4% vs 5.2%; RR, 0.64; 95% CI, 0.47-0.88), demonstrating statistically significant favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: All-cause mortality at 90 days
brief_rationale: Mortality was higher with REBOA plus standard care than with standard care alone (54% vs 42%; OR 1.58, 95% credible interval 0.72-3.52), with an 86.9% posterior probability of increased odds of death. Thus, the primary endpoint did not demonstrate a favorable mortality reduction.

primary_endpoint_description: ICU-attributable Staphylococcus aureus clinical cultures
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was 10%, and nasal iodophor plus CHG did not meet noninferiority to nasal mupirocin plus CHG for the primary outcome; results were also consistent with iodophor being inferior.

primary_endpoint_description: Completion of recommended follow-up for an overdue abnormal cancer screening result within 120 days of study enrollment.
brief_rationale: The intervention including EHR reminders, outreach, and navigation increased primary-outcome completion versus usual care by an adjusted absolute 8.5 percentage points (95% CI, 4.8%-12.0%; P<.001), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Improvement in functional outcome measured as a shift across the modified Rankin Scale score at 90 days among patients with a final diagnosis of ischemic or hemorrhagic stroke.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint did not show favorable superiority for remote ischemic conditioning versus sham (OR, 0.95; 95% CI, 0.75-1.20; P=.67).

primary_endpoint_description: Noninferiority of pooled tirzepatide versus insulin lispro for change from baseline in HbA1c at week 52, with a 0.3-percentage-point noninferiority margin.
brief_rationale: The HbA1c treatment difference was -0.98 percentage points (95% CI, -1.17 to -0.79) in favor of tirzepatide, and the abstract explicitly states that the prespecified noninferiority criterion was met; statistical superiority was also achieved.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of insulin initiation or fasting glucose level of at least 5.1 mmol/L at gestational week 32 or 38
brief_rationale: The primary composite outcome occurred in 56.8% of metformin pregnancies versus 63.7% with placebo (RR, 0.89; 95% CI, 0.78-1.02; P=.13). The favorable difference was not statistically significant, and the abstract states that metformin was not superior to placebo for the primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in automated office systolic blood pressure from baseline to study week 8.
brief_rationale: Lorundrostat produced significantly greater reductions in systolic blood pressure than placebo at 50 mg once daily (difference, -9.6 mm Hg; P=.01) and 100 mg once daily (difference, -7.8 mm Hg; P=.04), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Functional independence at 3 months, defined as a modified Rankin Scale score of 0 to 2.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome favored conventional rather than intensive blood pressure management: functional independence occurred in 39.4% vs 54.4% (risk difference, -15.1%; 95% CI, -26.2% to -3.9%; adjusted OR, 0.56; P=.03). Thus, intensive management did not achieve favorable superiority and was significantly worse.

primary_endpoint_description: Symptom burden based on daily symptom scores (0-40 scale) during the 10 days after diagnosis.
brief_rationale: Mean symptom scores were significantly lower with amoxicillin-clavulanate than with placebo (9.04 vs 10.60; between-group difference, -1.69 [95% CI, -2.07 to -1.31]), demonstrating favorable superiority on the explicitly identified primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Child's change from baseline to 24 months in percentage above the median BMI for the general US population, normalized for age and sex.
brief_rationale: At 24 months, family-based treatment produced a favorable between-group difference in the explicitly identified primary outcome versus usual care (-6.21 percentage points; 95% CI, -10.14 to -2.29), with the confidence interval excluding no difference.

primary_endpoint_description: Independent committee-confirmed CMV disease through posttransplant week 52
brief_rationale: Letermovir was noninferior to valganciclovir for the primary endpoint: CMV disease occurred in 10.4% versus 11.8%, with an adjusted difference of -1.4% (95% CI, -6.5% to 3.8%), satisfying the prespecified 10% noninferiority margin.

primary_endpoint_description: Recurrent venous thromboembolism rate at 6 months
brief_rationale: The upper limit of the 1-sided 95% CI for the DOAC-vs-LMWH difference was 0.7%, below the prespecified 3% noninferiority margin; therefore, the primary endpoint met the success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Two primary outcomes at 12 months: PROMIS Pain Interference Short Form 8a score and the proportion of participants who discontinued opioids.
brief_rationale: The opioid-discontinuation outcome favored the intervention significantly (29% vs 7%; P<.001), whereas pain interference did not differ significantly (P=.15). Because the co-primary outcomes had mixed results and no overall success rule is stated, trial success is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: Live birth, defined as delivery of any number of neonates born at 28 or more weeks' gestation with signs of life.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 37.8% of the prednisone group versus 38.8% of the placebo group (RR, 0.97; 95% CI, 0.81-1.17; P=.78). Prednisone did not demonstrate favorable superiority over placebo for live birth.

primary_endpoint_description: Development of postoperative surgical site infection within 30 days
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred less often with piperacillin-tazobactam than with cefoxitin (19.8% vs 32.8%; absolute difference, -13.0% [95% CI, -19.1% to -6.9%]; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion. The trial was stopped at interim analysis under a predefined stopping rule.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival, tested first in participants with left-sided tumors and then in the overall population.
brief_rationale: Panitumumab significantly improved the primary endpoint of overall survival versus bevacizumab in the first-tested left-sided tumor population (HR 0.82; 95.798% CI 0.68-0.99; P=.03), with a favorable significant result also reported in the overall population.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of participants with recurrent Clostridioides difficile infection through 8 weeks, using a combined clinical and laboratory definition.
brief_rationale: Using prespecified efficacy analysis 3, recurrence was lower with high-dose VE303 than placebo (13.8% vs 45.5%; P=.006), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Organ support-free days through 21 days, a composite of hospital survival and days alive without cardiovascular or respiratory organ support.
brief_rationale: Neither ACE inhibitor nor ARB initiation improved the primary outcome versus control; adjusted odds ratios were 0.77 and 0.76, respectively, with high posterior probabilities of worse outcomes.

The supplied abstract summary describes assessment of 12-month disease activity flare risk but does not explicitly identify it as the prespecified primary endpoint or provide a stated success criterion and result.

This is an exploratory heterogeneity-of-treatment-effect analysis. Although organ support-free days and hospital survival are listed as main outcomes, the abstract does not explicitly identify a prespecified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of neonatal sepsis or mortality during 4-week follow-up
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred at similar rates with azithromycin and placebo (2.0% vs 1.9%; risk difference, 0.09 percentage points; 95% CI, -0.39 to 0.57), so azithromycin did not demonstrate the intended reduction.

primary_endpoint_description: The primary 4-year outcomes were development of proliferative diabetic retinopathy or center-involved diabetic macular edema with vision loss, and change in best-corrected ETDRS visual acuity from baseline to 4 years.
brief_rationale: Aflibercept significantly reduced vision-threatening complications versus sham, but did not improve visual acuity. Because the primary outcomes had mixed results and no overall success rule for the multiple primary outcomes is stated, trial success is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: Freedom from any documented atrial arrhythmia lasting more than 30 seconds without antiarrhythmic medication at 12 months after a single ablation procedure.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 52.4% with PVI plus posterior wall isolation versus 53.6% with PVI alone (difference, -1.2%; HR, 0.99; 95% CI, 0.73-1.36; P=.98), so adding posterior wall isolation did not demonstrate favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in Oswestry Disability Index score at 3 months and spine-related health care spending at 1 year
brief_rationale: Both interventions significantly improved the disability primary outcome versus usual care at the prespecified .025 threshold. For spending, ICE did not reach that threshold (P=.04), while IPT significantly increased spending. Because the co-primary results were mixed and no overall success rule is stated, trial success is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to sustained recovery, defined as at least 3 consecutive days without symptoms
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed an HR for improvement of 1.07 (95% CrI, 0.96-1.17; posterior probability HR >1 = 0.91), and the abstract states that ivermectin did not significantly improve time to recovery versus placebo.

This extended follow-up report examines adverse events and durability of response, but the supplied title and abstract do not explicitly identify or report the randomized trial's prespecified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Difference between burst and placebo stimulation periods in change from baseline in self-reported Oswestry Disability Index score
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed a mean between-group difference of -1.3 ODI points (95% CI, -3.9 to 1.3; P=.32), so burst stimulation did not demonstrate significant superiority over placebo.

primary_endpoint_description: Postoperative oral morphine equivalent consumption at 6 weeks after surgery
brief_rationale: The opioid-sparing group had significantly lower 6-week opioid consumption than standard care (median 0 mg vs 40.0 mg; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion for the explicitly identified primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Disability level at 90 days measured by the overall distribution of modified Rankin Scale scores (0-6).
brief_rationale: The adjusted common odds ratio for lower disability with tirofiban versus placebo was 1.08 (95% CI, 0.86-1.36), indicating no significant favorable superiority; therefore, the primary endpoint did not meet the success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of patients with at least 1 major adverse event within 90 days (death, myocardial injury, acute heart failure, resternotomy, stroke, arrhythmia, bleeding, infection, or acute kidney injury).
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 37.1% of the albumin group versus 33.8% of the Ringer group (RR, 1.10; 95% CI, 0.95-1.27; P=.20). Albumin did not achieve the intended significant reduction in major adverse events.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of ventilator-free days from commencement of cardiopulmonary bypass through day 28
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint did not differ significantly between nitric oxide and standard care (median 26.6 vs 26.4 days; absolute difference, -0.01 days; 95% CI, -0.25 to 0.22; P=.92), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of days alive and out of the hospital within 90 days of surgery
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored robot-assisted surgery (median 82 vs 80 days; adjusted difference, 2.2 days [95% CI, 0.50-3.85]; P=.01), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Functional outcome at 6 months, measured by the modified Rankin Scale and dichotomized as scores 0-4 (survival without severe disability) versus 5-6 (severe disability or death).
brief_rationale: The primary outcome favored neither early tracheostomy nor superiority: survival without severe disability was 43.5% with early tracheostomy versus 47.1% with the standard strategy (adjusted OR, 0.93; 95% CI, 0.60-1.42; P=.73). Thus, early tracheostomy did not significantly improve the prespecified primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to first recorded hypertension measured by a health care professional
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint did not show significantly earlier hypertension detection with self-monitoring versus usual care (mean difference, -1.6 days; 95% CI, -8.1 to 4.9; P = .64), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Difference in mean systolic blood pressure recorded by health care professionals between randomization and birth
brief_rationale: The primary maternal outcome showed no statistically significant benefit from self-monitoring in either the chronic hypertension cohort (adjusted mean difference, 0.03 mm Hg; 95% CI, -1.73 to 1.79) or the gestational hypertension cohort (-0.03 mm Hg; 95% CI, -2.29 to 2.24), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean change from baseline at 2 hours in Positive and Negative Syndrome Scale-Excited Component (PEC) total score.
brief_rationale: Both dexmedetomidine doses produced significantly greater reductions in PEC score than placebo at 2 hours (least-square mean differences, -5.4 and -4.1; both P<.001), meeting the multiplicity-adjusted two-sided significance threshold of .025 in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Survival with a good neurologic outcome (Cerebral Performance Category 1-2) at 180 days after randomization
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 31.5% with the invasive strategy versus 22.0% with standard care, but the favorable difference did not reach statistical significance (OR 1.63, 95% CI 0.93-2.85; P=.09). The trial was also stopped after meeting prespecified futility criteria; therefore, superiority was not established.

primary_endpoint_description: Difference between groups in the proportion of patients achieving a modified Rankin Scale score of 0 or 1 at 90 days among patients treated as randomized.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome favored intra-arterial alteplase (59.0% vs 40.4%), with an adjusted risk difference of 18.4% (95% CI, 0.3% to 36.4%; P=.047), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Organ support-free days through day 21, an ordinal composite of in-hospital death and days free of respiratory or cardiovascular organ support
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome did not show favorable superiority with P2Y12 inhibition (adjusted odds ratio 0.83, 95% credible interval 0.55-1.25). Enrollment stopped after the prespecified futility criterion was met (96% posterior probability of an odds ratio <1.2).

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of baseline-seronegative participants who developed symptomatic COVID-19 during the 28-day efficacy assessment period.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored casirivimab and imdevimab over placebo: 29.0% vs 42.3% developed symptomatic COVID-19 (odds ratio 0.54, 95% CI 0.30-0.97; P=.04), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Centrally adjudicated symptomatic recurrent venous thromboembolism and clinically relevant bleeding events within 1 year, assessed using a bivariate noninferiority trade-off
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies the primary efficacy and safety endpoints and states that 6 weeks of anticoagulation met the prespecified bivariate noninferiority criteria versus 3 months based on absolute risk differences in recurrence and bleeding.

primary_endpoint_description: Prespecified coprimary outcomes were risk of depression or clinically relevant depressive symptoms and mean change in PHQ-8 mood score.
brief_rationale: Neither coprimary outcome showed favorable superiority for omega-3: depression risk was significantly higher versus placebo (HR 1.13; 95% CI, 1.01-1.26; P=.03), and change in PHQ-8 score did not differ significantly (P=.19).

primary_endpoint_description: Sustained disease control without disease worsening during the 52-week study period.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 73.6% of the proactive TDM group versus 55.9% of the standard therapy group, with an adjusted difference of 17.6% (95% CI, 9.0%-26.2%; P<.001) favoring TDM, meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death or physiological bronchopulmonary dysplasia at 36 weeks' postmenstrual age
brief_rationale: The primary composite occurred in 43.6% with MIST versus 49.6% with sham, but the favorable difference was not statistically significant (RR 0.87, 95% CI 0.74-1.03; P=.10), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Percentage of newborns who were small for gestational age at delivery, defined as birth weight below the 10th percentile.
brief_rationale: Both interventions significantly reduced the explicitly identified primary endpoint versus usual care: 14.0% with Mediterranean diet versus 21.9% with control (OR 0.58, 95% CI 0.40-0.84; P=.004) and 15.6% with stress reduction versus 21.9% with control (OR 0.66, 95% CI 0.46-0.94; P=.02).

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary outcomes of need for intubation and time to clinical recovery through day 28
brief_rationale: Both co-primary outcomes favored high-flow oxygen and were statistically significant: intubation was reduced (HR, 0.62; 95% CI, 0.39-0.96; P=.03), and clinical recovery was faster (HR, 1.39; 95% CI, 1.00-1.92; P=.047).

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary outcomes of vaginal symptom severity at 12 months, assessed by the visual analog scale (VAS) and Vulvovaginal Symptom Questionnaire (VSQ), with a minimal clinically important difference specified as a 50% decrease in both scores.
brief_rationale: The laser group did not show a significant improvement versus sham in either co-primary symptom-severity measure at 12 months, and the specified clinically important improvement in both VAS and VSQ scores was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Occurrence of a grade 2 or higher death rattle at 2 consecutive time points 4 hours apart
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred less often with prophylactic scopolamine butylbromide than with placebo (13% vs 27%; difference, 14%; 95% CI, 2%-27%; P=.02), demonstrating statistically significant benefit in the intended direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Organ support-free days (days alive and free of ICU-based organ support) through day 21, with death assigned -1 day.
brief_rationale: The prespecified superiority threshold was a greater than 99% posterior probability that the OR exceeded 1. The adjusted OR was 0.97 (95% credible interval, 0.83-1.15), and the trial met its prespecified futility criterion rather than superiority (99.4% posterior probability that OR <1.2).

primary_endpoint_description: Ventilator-associated pneumonia determined by duplicate blinded central adjudication
brief_rationale: VAP occurred in 21.9% of the probiotic group versus 21.3% of controls (HR, 1.03; 95% CI, 0.87-1.22; P=.73), so the primary superiority endpoint did not show a significant benefit.

primary_endpoint_description: Rate of change in the Movement Disorder Society Unified Parkinson Disease Rating Scale (MDS-UPDRS parts I-III) total score before initiation of dopaminergic drug therapy
brief_rationale: Clinical progression did not differ significantly between inosine and placebo (difference, 1.26 points/year; 95% CI, -0.59 to 3.11; P=.18), and the study was stopped early after a prespecified futility analysis. Thus, favorable superiority on the primary outcome was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: SOFARANK, a ranked measure of nonrespiratory organ failure based on nonrespiratory SOFA components summed over the first 14 study days
brief_rationale: The low-normal oxygenation target did not significantly improve the primary endpoint versus the high-normal target (median difference, 10 points; 95% CI, 0 to 21; P = .06), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Successful resolution of the pregnancy without change from the initial management strategy.
brief_rationale: The primary superiority comparison favored active over expectant management: 51.5% versus 36.0% achieved successful resolution, with a difference of 15.4% (95% CI, 2.8% to 28.1%) and rate ratio of 1.43 (95% CI, 1.04 to 1.96).

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary efficacy endpoints: time to headache pain freedom and time to absence of the most bothersome symptom (nausea, photophobia, or phonophobia).
brief_rationale: Both co-primary endpoints favored eptinezumab over placebo and were statistically significant: headache pain freedom occurred faster (median 4 vs 9 hours; HR 1.54; P<.001), as did absence of the most bothersome symptom (median 2 vs 3 hours; HR 1.75; P<.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) level at 8 months
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored CGM over blood glucose meter monitoring at 8 months (adjusted HbA1c difference, -0.4%; 95% CI, -0.8% to -0.1%; P=.02), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Development of definite or highly probable new atrial fibrillation lasting at least 2 minutes within 12 months of randomization
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 15.3% with implantable monitoring versus 4.7% with external monitoring, favoring implantable monitoring (risk ratio 3.29, 95% CI 1.45-7.42; P=.003), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite cardiovascular event comprising cardiovascular death, nonfatal myocardial infarction or stroke, unstable angina, transient ischemic attack, or hospitalization for heart failure or ventricular arrhythmia.
brief_rationale: Lanthanum carbonate did not significantly reduce the primary composite cardiovascular outcome versus calcium carbonate (HR, 1.11; 95% CI, 0.88-1.41; P=.37), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Masked assessor-rated Children's Yale-Brown Obsessive-Compulsive Scale (CY-BOCS) score at the 6-month follow-up
brief_rationale: The predefined noninferiority margin was 4 CY-BOCS points. The estimated mean difference was 0.91 points, with a 1-sided 97.5% CI upper bound of 3.28, which was below the margin (P for noninferiority = .02); therefore, the primary endpoint met the noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Disease-free survival from randomization until documented recurrence or death from any cause
brief_rationale: Celecoxib did not significantly improve the explicitly identified primary endpoint versus placebo (HR 0.89, 95% CI 0.76-1.03; P=.12), so the superiority criterion was not met.
The abstract reports humoral and cellular immune-response outcomes but does not explicitly identify any outcome as the prespecified primary endpoint or provide a corresponding success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Disease-free survival from the time of randomization
brief_rationale: The prespecified primary endpoint did not meet the stated 1-sided significance threshold of P<.025: hazard ratio 0.70 (95% CI, 0.47-1.03), 1-sided P=.03. Thus, favorable superiority of blinatumomab was not established.

primary_endpoint_description: WOMAC knee pain and maximal tibiofemoral knee joint compressive force during walking at 18 months
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary outcomes showed no statistically significant benefit of high-intensity strength training versus either low-intensity training or attention control at 18 months.

primary_endpoint_description: Major adverse cardiovascular events at 30 days, defined as a composite of all-cause death, stroke, recurrent myocardial infarction, or emergency revascularization prompted by ischemia.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome relative risk was 0.79 with a 1-sided 97.5% CI upper bound of 1.19, below the prespecified noninferiority margin of 1.25; therefore, the restrictive strategy met the noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in peak oxygen consumption (peak V̇o2) after 3 months, with a prespecified minimal clinically important difference of 2.5 mL/kg/min.
brief_rationale: Neither high-intensity interval training nor moderate continuous training achieved the prespecified 2.5 mL/kg/min improvement versus guideline control, and there was no significant difference between the exercise regimens. Thus, the primary endpoint did not meet the stated superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Weight change at 24 months
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was explicitly identified, but the two intervention comparisons were mixed: in-clinic group visits showed significantly greater weight loss than individual visits, whereas telephone group visits did not. The abstract does not state an overall success rule for these comparisons, and the significant difference was also smaller than the stated 2.75-kg minimum clinically important difference.

primary_endpoint_description: Treatment success at 1 year, defined as discharge without surgery and no recurrent appendicitis, assessing whether oral moxifloxacin was noninferior to intravenous ertapenem followed by oral levofloxacin/metronidazole using a 6% margin.
brief_rationale: Although treatment success exceeded 65% in both groups, the between-group difference was -3.6% with a 1-sided 95% confidence limit of -9.7%, crossing the -6% noninferiority margin; thus, noninferiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to all-cause death, lung transplant, or first nonelective hospital admission
brief_rationale: The primary composite endpoint was evaluated and did not favor co-trimoxazole significantly versus placebo (hazard ratio 1.2, 95% CI 0.9-1.6; P=.32); therefore, the superiority criterion was not met.

The supplied title and abstract describe 5-year neurodevelopmental outcomes but do not explicitly identify any outcome as the trial's prespecified primary endpoint or report a corresponding success criterion and result.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to the composite of all-cause death or cardiopulmonary hospitalization during each enrolling influenza season
brief_rationale: The high-dose vaccine did not significantly reduce the primary composite outcome versus standard-dose vaccine (hazard ratio, 1.06; 95% CI, 0.97-1.17; P=.21), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Standard deviation of lateral position (lane weaving) during 100-km on-road driving tests beginning 40 and 240 minutes after cannabis consumption.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was explicitly identified and reported, but results varied by cannabis formulation and assessment time. The abstract does not specify an overall success criterion for these multiple comparisons, so trial-level primary-endpoint success cannot be determined.

primary_endpoint_description: Six primary outcomes over 3 years: changes in systolic and diastolic blood pressure, Short Physical Performance Battery score, and Montreal Cognitive Assessment score, plus incidence rates of nonvertebral fractures and infections.
brief_rationale: The prespecified threshold was P < .01 after accounting for six primary endpoints. No intervention, alone or in combination, produced a statistically significant benefit on any primary endpoint at 3 years.

primary_endpoint_description: Weight change at 12 months based on measured weights recorded in the electronic health record.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome differed significantly among groups (P<.001). The combined intervention produced greater 12-month weight loss than both usual care (-1.9 kg difference; P<.001) and the online program alone (-1.2 kg difference; P=.01), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline to week 12 in peak rate of oxygen consumption (peak V̇o2) among patients who completed at least 8 weeks of assigned dosing
brief_rationale: The primary efficacy endpoint did not show favorable superiority for praliciguat versus placebo. The placebo-adjusted between-group difference was -0.30 mL/kg/min (95% CI, -0.95 to 0.35; P = .37), indicating no significant improvement.

primary_endpoint_description: Between-group difference in the percentage of patients at 24 months achieving both at least a 50% reduction in SCL-20 depression score and improvement in at least one cardiometabolic measure (HbA1c reduction ≥0.5 percentage points, systolic blood pressure reduction ≥5 mm Hg, or LDL cholesterol reduction ≥10 mg/dL).
brief_rationale: The intervention group had a significantly greater percentage meeting the explicitly identified primary composite outcome than usual care (71.6% vs 57.4%; risk difference, 16.9% [95% CI, 8.5%-25.2%]), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: CGM-measured percentage of time with sensor glucose values below 70 mg/dL during 6 months of follow-up
brief_rationale: The CGM group had significantly less time below 70 mg/dL than the standard BGM group (adjusted difference, -1.9 percentage points; 95% CI, -2.8 to -1.1; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Rate of trial of labor after previous cesarean delivery
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was trial of labor. The intervention did not significantly improve this outcome versus usual care (43.3% vs 46.2%; adjusted risk difference, -2.78% [95% CI, -7.80% to 2.25%]; adjusted relative risk, 0.94 [95% CI, 0.84-1.05]), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in abdominal aortic aneurysm maximum transverse diameter from baseline to 2 years, analyzed using normal scores incorporating diameter, aneurysm repair, and death.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome did not differ significantly between doxycycline and placebo (mean change in normal scores, 0.0262 vs -0.0258; 1-sided P=.71), so doxycycline did not demonstrate favorable superiority in reducing aneurysm growth.

primary_endpoint_description: Disabilities of Arm, Shoulder and Hand (DASH) score at 12 months
brief_rationale: The primary outcome showed no significant favorable superiority of surgery over functional bracing: mean DASH scores were 8.9 vs 12.0, with a between-group difference of -3.1 points (95% CI, -9.6 to 3.3; P=.34).

primary_endpoint_description: Reperfusion of greater than 50% of the involved ischemic territory prior to thrombectomy, assessed by 2 blinded neuroradiologists
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 19.3% of each dose group (adjusted risk ratio, 1.03; 95% CI, 0.66-1.61; P=.89). Thus, tenecteplase 0.40 mg/kg did not demonstrate superior reperfusion versus 0.25 mg/kg.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite score combining death and number of ventilator-free days at day 28
brief_rationale: The primary composite score did not differ significantly between IFN-β-1a and placebo (median 10 vs 8.5; P=.82), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of hypophosphatemia (serum phosphate <2.0 mg/dL) between baseline and day 35
brief_rationale: In both identically designed trials, the primary endpoint favored iron isomaltoside, with significantly lower hypophosphatemia incidence than ferric carboxymaltose (7.9% vs 75.0% and 8.1% vs 73.7%; both P<.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Freedom from atrial fibrillation, atrial flutter, or atrial tachycardia at 12 months
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 72.1% with pulmonary vein isolation plus renal denervation versus 56.5% with pulmonary vein isolation alone (hazard ratio, 0.57; 95% CI, 0.38-0.85; P=.006), demonstrating significant benefit in the intended direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Pain measured by the Izbicki pain score and integrated over 18 months
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored early surgery: integrated Izbicki pain score was 37 versus 49 with endoscopy first (between-group difference, -12 points; 95% CI, -22 to -2; P=.02). Because lower scores indicate less pain, the superiority endpoint was met in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death or major postoperative complications at 14 days after surgery
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 36% of the HES group versus 32% of the saline group (relative risk, 1.10; 95% CI, 0.91-1.34; P=.33), so HES did not demonstrate favorable superiority over saline.

primary_endpoint_description: Maximum plasma concentration of avobenzone over days 1 through 21
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was avobenzone maximum plasma concentration. Geometric mean maxima ranged from 3.3 to 7.1 ng/mL across formulations, exceeding the stated FDA threshold of 0.5 ng/mL.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary outcomes of live birth from pregnancies occurring within 9 months of randomization and semen quality parameters at 6 months (sperm concentration, motility, morphology, volume, DNA fragmentation, and total motile sperm count).
brief_rationale: Folic acid plus zinc did not significantly improve live birth or most semen quality parameters versus placebo; DNA fragmentation was significantly increased, an unfavorable direction. Thus, the co-primary superiority outcomes did not meet a favorable success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Hospital admission
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was hospital admission. The adjusted odds ratio was 1.03 (95% CI, 0.93-1.14), and the abstract concludes that the intervention had no effect on admission; thus, favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Freedom from disability, defined as a modified Rankin Scale score of 0 or 1 at 90 days.
brief_rationale: The primary efficacy outcome occurred in 49.1% with intra-arterial tenecteplase versus 44.1% with control (adjusted risk ratio, 1.15; 95% CI, 0.97-1.36; P=.11), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Two-year cumulative risk of ipsilateral invasive breast cancer diagnosis
brief_rationale: The active-monitoring rate was 4.2% versus 5.9% with guideline-concordant care; the risk difference was -1.7%, with the upper 95% CI limit of 0.95%, below the prespecified 5% noninferiority bound. Thus, the primary endpoint met the noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Seroprotection response (anti-HBs titer ≥10 mIU/mL) at week 12 for the 2-dose HepB-CpG regimen and week 28 for the 3-dose regimens.
brief_rationale: The 2-dose HepB-CpG regimen met the prespecified 10% noninferiority criterion versus 3-dose HepB-alum and also showed superiority; the 3-dose HepB-CpG regimen was superior to 3-dose HepB-alum. Thus, the reported primary outcome met the applicable success criteria.

primary_endpoint_description: Time-averaged percent change in serum lipoprotein(a) concentration from baseline to 36 weeks.
brief_rationale: All zerlasiran regimens produced large favorable reductions versus pooled placebo in the primary endpoint (least-squares mean differences, -81.3% to -85.6%), with 95% confidence intervals entirely below zero, demonstrating superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Self-reported total Symptom Screening in Pediatrics Tool (SSPedi) score at week 8
brief_rationale: The intervention produced significantly better (lower) 8-week total SSPedi scores than usual care, with an adjusted mean difference of -3.8 (95% CI, -6.4 to -1.2), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Survival free of bronchopulmonary dysplasia at 36 weeks' postmenstrual age
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 25.6% with budesonide plus surfactant versus 22.6% with surfactant alone; the adjusted risk difference was 2.7% (95% CI, -2.1% to 7.4%). Because the confidence interval included no difference, favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Atrial fibrillation burden at 6 months, excluding a 3-month blanking period, measured by an implantable loop recorder.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint showed a significantly greater favorable reduction with pulmonary vein isolation than with sham (geometric mean difference, 0.25; 95% CI, 0.15-0.42; P<.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Receipt of red blood cell transfusion within 7 days of liver resection
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 16.3% of the tranexamic acid group versus 14.5% of the placebo group (odds ratio, 1.15; 95% CI, 0.84-1.56; P=.38). Tranexamic acid therefore did not achieve the intended superior reduction in transfusion.

primary_endpoint_description: Self-reported 30-day point-prevalence abstinence from vaping at 7 months, analyzed by intention to treat with missing participants coded as vaping
brief_rationale: The intervention produced a significantly higher primary-outcome abstinence rate than control (37.8% vs 28.0%; relative risk, 1.35 [95% CI, 1.17-1.57]; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of patient-reported COPD exacerbations treated with oral corticosteroids, antibiotics, or both during the 1-year treatment period.
brief_rationale: Bisoprolol did not favorably reduce the explicitly identified primary outcome versus placebo (adjusted incidence rate ratio, 0.97; 95% CI, 0.84-1.13; P=.72), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Absolute change in forced vital capacity (FVC) from baseline to week 48.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed no significant between-group difference: pamrevlumab versus placebo mean difference was 70 mL (95% CI, -60 to 190 mL; P=.29). Thus, the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Safety and tolerability of zerlasiran
brief_rationale: The primary outcome is explicitly identified as safety and tolerability. Although no serious adverse events occurred and zerlasiran was described as well tolerated, the abstract does not state a prespecified criterion defining success for this endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Hepatitis C virus cure
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was hepatitis C virus cure. Intention-to-treat cure rates were 90.3% with facilitated telemedicine versus 39.4% with off-site referral, with a favorable significant intervention effect (log odds ratio, 2.9; 95% CI, 2.0-3.5; P<.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Bayley Scales of Infant and Toddler Development cognitive score at 22 to 26 months' corrected age, with a score of 54 assigned to infants who died before assessment
brief_rationale: The donor milk group did not have a significantly better primary cognitive score than the preterm formula group (adjusted mean difference, -0.77; 95% CI, -3.93 to 2.39). Thus, the intended superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: All-cause childhood mortality among children aged 1 to 59 months, measured during twice-yearly enumerative censuses.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored azithromycin numerically, but the superiority criterion was not met: mortality incidence rate ratio 0.82 (95% CI, 0.67-1.02; P=.07), which was not statistically significant.

primary_endpoint_description: Functional outcome at 90 days measured by the modified Rankin Scale score (0-6), analyzed using an adjusted generalized odds ratio.
brief_rationale: This exploratory SELECT2 analysis explicitly identifies 90-day mRS as the primary outcome but reports treatment effects only across imaging-defined categories and thresholds, rather than an overall primary-endpoint result sufficient to determine whether the original trial's prespecified superiority criterion was met.

primary_endpoint_description: Hospital length of stay, with deaths coded as the longest length of stay
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome did not differ between the default palliative care order and usual care groups (percent difference in median length of stay, -0.53%; 95% CI, -3.51% to 2.53%), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival assessed by blinded independent central review
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified main outcome was progression-free survival by blinded independent central review. Toripalimab plus chemotherapy significantly prolonged progression-free survival versus placebo plus chemotherapy (median 21.4 vs 8.2 months; HR 0.52, 95% CI 0.37-0.73), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Cervical cancer screening completion within 6 months.
brief_rationale: The primary analyses showed significantly greater 6-month screening completion for each self-sampling strategy versus education alone in the relevant screening-history strata, with all reported 95% confidence intervals for absolute differences excluding zero in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Survival free of major nonsurgical hemocompatibility-related adverse events (stroke, pump thrombosis, major bleeding, or arterial peripheral thromboembolism) at 12 months, assessed for noninferiority of placebo with a -10% margin.
brief_rationale: Placebo achieved 74% event-free survival versus 68% with aspirin. The lower bound of the 1-sided 97.5% CI for the absolute difference was -1.6%, above the prespecified -10% noninferiority margin; noninferiority was therefore demonstrated (P<.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Ventilator-free days
brief_rationale: The prespecified primary outcome was ventilator-free days. The adjusted mean difference was 1.4 days (95% CI, -0.2 to 3.0), and the abstract states that sigh breaths did not significantly increase ventilator-free days; therefore, the superiority criterion was not met.
The supplied title and plain-language summary do not explicitly identify a prespecified primary endpoint or report its result.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in central rater-assessed Montgomery-Asberg Depression Rating Scale (MADRS) score from baseline to day 43.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored psilocybin over niacin at day 43, with a mean difference of -12.3 points (95% CI, -17.5 to -7.2; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.
