primary_endpoint_description: Composite of stroke or death within 30 days or ipsilateral ischemic stroke beyond 30 days through 2 years after randomization
brief_rationale: The primary composite outcome occurred in 8.6% of the surgical group versus 12.3% of the medical group, but the favorable difference was not statistically significant (HR, 0.71; 95% CI, 0.33-1.54; P=.39), so superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death or cerebral palsy at 2 years' corrected age
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was not significantly reduced with magnesium versus placebo (3.3% vs 2.7%; adjusted RR, 1.19 [95% CI, 0.65-2.18]); therefore, the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Ratio of tumor volume at 4 years to baseline tumor volume (V4:V0).
brief_rationale: Upfront radiosurgery produced significantly greater tumor volume reduction than wait-and-scan for the explicitly identified primary outcome (between-group ratio, 1.73; 95% CI, 1.23-2.44; P=.002), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in integrated Alzheimer Disease Rating Scale (iADRS) score from baseline to 76 weeks.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored donanemab in both tested populations: low/medium tau difference 3.25 (95% CI, 1.88-4.62; P<.001) and combined population difference 2.92 (95% CI, 1.51-4.33; P<.001), indicating significantly less decline than with placebo.

primary_endpoint_description: Excellent functional outcome, defined as a modified Rankin Scale score of 0 or 1, at 90 days.
brief_rationale: The lower bound of the 1-sided 97.5% confidence interval for the risk difference was -1.5%, exceeding the prespecified noninferiority margin of -4.5% (P for noninferiority <.001); therefore, DAPT met the primary endpoint criterion for noninferiority to alteplase.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in the SF-36 version 2 physical functioning scale at 12 weeks after surgery, reflecting physical functioning and return to usual activities.
brief_rationale: The trial explicitly identified this as the primary outcome and was designed for superiority. The between-group difference was 0.68 (95% CI, -1.89 to 3.26), and the abstract states that minithoracotomy was not superior to sternotomy for physical-function recovery at 12 weeks.

primary_endpoint_description: Annual rate of decline in forced vital capacity (FVC) at week 52
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was evaluated in both ISABELA trials. Neither ziritaxestat dose improved the annual rate of FVC decline versus placebo; all between-group 95% confidence intervals included no difference, so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of participants prescribed all 3 groups of recommended therapies at 6 to 12 months after enrollment
brief_rationale: The intervention significantly increased the explicitly identified primary outcome versus usual care (37.9% vs 14.5%; adjusted OR, 4.38 [95% CI, 2.49-7.71]; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean change in daytime ambulatory systolic blood pressure at 2 months (primary efficacy outcome).
brief_rationale: Ultrasound renal denervation produced a significantly greater reduction in daytime ambulatory systolic blood pressure than sham (baseline-adjusted difference, -6.3 mm Hg; 95% CI, -9.3 to -3.2; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to sustained recovery, defined as at least 3 consecutive days without symptoms.
brief_rationale: Median time to sustained recovery was 11 days in both groups. Ivermectin did not favorably improve the primary outcome versus placebo (hazard ratio 1.02, 95% credible interval 0.92-1.13; posterior probability of benefit P = .68), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to sustained recovery, defined as the third day of 3 consecutive days without symptoms
brief_rationale: The primary outcome did not show favorable superiority for fluvoxamine versus placebo (HR 0.96, 95% credible interval 0.86-1.06; posterior probability of benefit P=.21, with benefit defined as HR >1). The authors concluded that fluvoxamine did not improve time to sustained recovery.

primary_endpoint_description: Successful tracheal intubation on the first attempt without major complications
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was 7.0%. Remifentanil did not meet the noninferiority criterion versus neuromuscular blockers in either the as-randomized analysis (adjusted difference −6.1%; 95% CI, −11.6% to −0.5%; P=.37 for noninferiority) or the per-protocol analysis (−5.7%; 95% CI, −11.3% to −0.1%; P=.32).

primary_endpoint_description: Change in self-perceived communication function, measured by the Hearing Handicap Inventory for the Elderly-Screening Version (HHIE-S), from baseline to 3 months postrandomization.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome improved significantly in the intervention group versus the wait-list control. The estimated treatment effect was a favorable -12.98-point change in HHIE-S score (95% CI, -15.51 to -10.42), with lower scores indicating better function.

primary_endpoint_description: Subjective patient-reported improvement at 24 months on the Patient Global Impression of Improvement scale, dichotomized as successful (much better or very much better) versus nonsuccessful treatment.
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was 10 percentage points. In the analysis as randomized, the risk difference was -6.1% with a 1-sided 95% CI lower bound of -12.7%, crossing the -10% margin (P for noninferiority=.16); therefore, pessary therapy did not meet the noninferiority criterion versus surgery.

This is a prespecified secondary, long-term analysis that identifies 180-day survival only as the publication's main outcome. The abstract does not explicitly identify and report the original trial's prespecified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary outcomes were EHR-recorded weight and self-reported general health status measured by the SF-12 physical component score at 12 months.
brief_rationale: Weight favored the intervention and met the stated multiplicity-adjusted significance threshold (P=.001), whereas SF-12 physical health did not (P=.39). The abstract does not specify the overall success rule for these mixed coprimary outcomes.

primary_endpoint_description: Episodic memory and executive function composite scores at 6 months
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies both cognitive composites at 6 months as the primary outcomes/end point. Neither mindfulness training nor exercise produced a statistically significant favorable improvement in episodic memory or executive function at 6 months.

primary_endpoint_description: Between-group difference in WOMAC knee pain score over 18 months.
brief_rationale: The diet and exercise group had significantly lower WOMAC pain than the attention control group at 18 months (adjusted difference, -0.6; 95% CI, -1.0 to -0.1; P=.02), meeting the stated statistical superiority criterion, although the effect was small and of uncertain clinical importance.

primary_endpoint_description: Live birth following single euploid frozen embryo transfer
brief_rationale: Live birth occurred in 58.5% with receptivity-guided timing versus 61.9% with standard timing (difference, -3.4%; 95% CI, -10.3% to 3.5%; P=.38). The intervention did not achieve favorable superiority on the explicitly identified primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: In-hospital mortality within 90 days
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 27.0% of the SDD group versus 29.1% of the standard-care group, but the favorable difference was not statistically significant (odds ratio 0.91, 95% CI 0.82-1.02; P=.12); therefore, the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival
brief_rationale: Overall survival was explicitly identified as the primary outcome. Serplulimab plus chemotherapy significantly improved overall survival versus placebo plus chemotherapy (hazard ratio, 0.63; 95% CI, 0.49-0.82; P<.001), meeting the prespecified interim significance threshold of 2-sided P<.012.

primary_endpoint_description: 28-day all-cause mortality
brief_rationale: Mortality was 27.0% with helmet noninvasive ventilation versus 26.1% with usual respiratory support (relative risk 1.04, 95% CI 0.72-1.49; P=.85), so the intervention did not achieve favorable superiority on the primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator Global Assessment (IGA) success at week 8, defined as clear or almost clear status plus at least a 2-grade improvement from baseline.
brief_rationale: In both trials, significantly more roflumilast-treated patients achieved the primary endpoint than vehicle-treated patients (DERMIS-1: 42.4% vs 6.1%; DERMIS-2: 37.5% vs 6.9%; P<.001 for both), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall rate of requests for the 11 targeted musculoskeletal imaging tests per 1000 patient consultations over 12 months
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was significantly reduced by audit and feedback versus control (adjusted means 27.7 vs 30.4; adjusted mean difference, -2.66 [95% CI, -3.24 to -2.07]; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of stroke or death within 30 days, or stroke in the qualifying artery territory beyond 30 days through 1 year.
brief_rationale: Stenting plus medical therapy did not significantly improve the primary outcome versus medical therapy alone (8.0% vs 7.2%; HR 1.10, 95% CI 0.52-2.35; P=.82), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Pain intensity at 18 weeks, measured on an 11-point numerical rating scale.
brief_rationale: The intervention significantly reduced the explicitly identified primary outcome versus control (between-group mean difference, -1.0 point; 95% CI, -1.5 to -0.4; P=.001), favoring the intervention.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of infants without active retinopathy of prematurity and unfavorable structural outcomes 24 weeks after starting treatment, with rescue treatment considered failure
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority criterion required the lower limit of the 1-sided 95% Bayesian credible interval for the treatment difference to exceed -5%. The observed lower limit was -8.0%, so aflibercept did not meet noninferiority for the primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Primary efficacy endpoint: rate of allogeneic red blood cell transfusion after surgery began; primary safety endpoint: 30-day composite of mortality, seizure, KDIGO stage 2 or 3 kidney dysfunction, and thrombotic events.
brief_rationale: Both primary endpoints met their stated criteria. High-dose tranexamic acid significantly reduced red blood cell transfusion versus low dose (21.8% vs 26.0%; P=.004 for superiority), and the upper confidence bound for the safety risk difference was 3.9%, within the prespecified 5% noninferiority margin (P=.003 for noninferiority).

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary outcomes: proportion of prescriptions with a predicted drug-gene interaction within 30 days and PHQ-9-defined remission analyzed repeatedly across 24 weeks.
brief_rationale: Both co-primary outcomes favored pharmacogenomic-guided care: prescriptions had significantly lower predicted drug-gene interaction potential (overall P<.001), and remission across 24 weeks was significantly higher (OR 1.28, 95% CI 1.05-1.57; P=.02). The nonsignificant week-24 remission comparison was not the specified repeated-measures primary analysis.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to first atrial arrhythmia recurrence after a 90-day postablation blanking period.
brief_rationale: MRI-guided fibrosis ablation plus pulmonary vein isolation did not significantly reduce recurrence versus pulmonary vein isolation alone (43.0% vs 46.1%; HR, 0.95; 95% CI, 0.77-1.17; P=.63), so the superiority endpoint was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Cardiovascular collapse between induction of anesthesia and 1 hour after tracheal intubation, defined by severe hypotension or increased vasopressor receipt shortly after intubation, cardiac arrest, or death.
brief_rationale: Cardiovascular collapse occurred in 21.0% with fluid bolus versus 18.2% with no bolus (absolute difference, 2.8%; 95% CI, -2.2% to 7.7%; P=.25). The fluid bolus did not significantly reduce the explicitly identified primary outcome, so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Salivary cotinine-verified 7-day point-prevalence smoking abstinence at week 26
brief_rationale: The varenicline group had significantly greater week-26 abstinence than the placebo group (15.7% vs 6.5%; difference 9.2%, 95% CI 3.8%-14.5%; OR 2.7, 95% CI 1.4-5.1; P=.002), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Safety and tolerability of a single ascending dose of SLN360
brief_rationale: The primary outcome is explicitly identified as safety and tolerability. Although the abstract reports that SLN360 was well tolerated and that the serious adverse events were unrelated to study drug, it does not state a prespecified criterion defining primary-endpoint success.

primary_endpoint_description: Percentage change in body weight from baseline to week 68 for semaglutide versus liraglutide.
brief_rationale: Mean body weight changed by -15.8% with semaglutide versus -6.4% with liraglutide, a favorable difference of -9.4 percentage points (95% CI, -12.0 to -6.8; P<.001), demonstrating significantly greater weight loss with semaglutide.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of delirium during the first 7 postoperative days
brief_rationale: Postoperative delirium occurred in 6.2% with regional anesthesia versus 5.1% with general anesthesia (risk difference, 1.1%; 95% CI, -1.7% to 3.8%; P=.48). Regional anesthesia did not significantly reduce delirium, so the superiority endpoint was not met.

This pooled individual-patient-data heterogeneity analysis identifies ischemic stroke as the main outcome but does not explicitly identify it as the prespecified primary endpoint of the pooled analysis or the original trials.

primary_endpoint_description: Venous thromboembolism at 3 months
brief_rationale: The adjusted between-group difference was -0.64%, with a 1-sided 97.5% CI upper bound of 0.21%, which was within the prespecified 1.35% noninferiority margin; therefore, the primary endpoint met the noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Sustained return of spontaneous circulation
brief_rationale: Calcium did not significantly improve the explicitly identified primary outcome versus saline (19% vs 27%; risk ratio 0.72, 95% CI 0.49-1.03; P=.09), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Clinically indicated antibiotic re-treatment for respiratory infection within 28 days after randomization
brief_rationale: With an 8% noninferiority margin, the upper 1-sided 95% CI bounds were 4.0% for lower vs higher dose and 3.9% for 3-day vs 7-day treatment. Both comparisons therefore met the prespecified noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of all-cause mortality, symptomatic venous or arterial thromboembolism, myocardial infarction, stroke, or hospitalization for a cardiovascular or pulmonary cause
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary composite endpoint occurred at similarly low rates across aspirin, both apixaban doses, and placebo. None of the active therapies reduced the endpoint versus placebo, so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Rate of near-total or total reperfusion (expanded Thrombolysis In Cerebral Infarction score 2c or 3) at the end of the procedure.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was not significantly improved with combined contact aspiration and stent retriever versus stent retriever alone (64.5% vs 57.9%; adjusted OR 1.33, 95% CI 0.88-1.99; P=.17), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: 90-day survival
brief_rationale: The slower infusion rate did not improve the primary endpoint of 90-day survival versus the faster control rate; 90-day mortality was 26.6% vs 27.0% (adjusted HR, 1.03; 95% CI, 0.96-1.11; P=.46), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary endpoints of overall survival and progression-free survival.
brief_rationale: Both coprimary endpoints favored camrelizumab plus chemotherapy and met their stated significance thresholds: overall survival HR 0.70 with 1-sided P=.001 (threshold <.02), and progression-free survival HR 0.56 with 1-sided P<.001 (threshold <.005).
The abstract describes a prespecified composite of death and neurodevelopmental impairment at 2 years but does not explicitly identify it as the trial's primary endpoint or report its result.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary outcomes of first heart failure rehospitalization or all-cause mortality and change in an opportunity-based composite heart failure quality-of-care score
brief_rationale: Neither coprimary outcome showed significant favorable superiority versus usual care: the clinical composite had an adjusted hazard ratio of 0.92 (95% CI, 0.81-1.05), and the quality score analyses also showed no significant difference.

primary_endpoint_description: VISA-A composite score 6 months after treatment allocation
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed no favorable superiority of platelet-rich plasma over sham injection: adjusted mean difference −2.7 points (95% CI, −8.8 to 3.3), and the authors concluded that platelet-rich plasma did not reduce Achilles tendon dysfunction at 6 months.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of COVID-19 within 8 weeks of randomization, defined as SARS-CoV-2 detection by RT-PCR with mild or worse disease severity within 21 days of detection.
brief_rationale: Bamlanivimab significantly reduced the primary outcome versus placebo (8.5% vs 15.2%; odds ratio 0.43, 95% CI 0.28-0.68; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Reduction of at least 50% from baseline in PHQ-9 score at 3 months
brief_rationale: In both randomized trials, the explicitly identified primary outcome favored the digital intervention and met the superiority criterion: Brazil, adjusted OR 1.6 (95% CI, 1.2-2.2; P=.001); Peru, adjusted OR 2.1 (95% CI, 1.4-3.2; P<.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Percent change in body weight from week 20 to week 68
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored continued semaglutide: mean body weight changed by -7.9% versus +6.9% with placebo, a between-group difference of -14.8 percentage points (95% CI, -16.0 to -13.5; P<.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to resolution of symptoms within the 21-day follow-up period
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint did not show favorable superiority for ivermectin versus placebo: median symptom-resolution time was 10 versus 12 days, with a hazard ratio of 1.07 (95% CI, 0.87-1.32; P=.53).

primary_endpoint_description: Event-free survival, with events defined as relapse, death, second malignancy, or failure to achieve complete remission.
brief_rationale: Blinatumomab significantly improved the explicitly identified primary endpoint versus consolidation chemotherapy (31% vs 57% incidence of events; HR, 0.33 [95% CI, 0.18-0.61]; log-rank P<.001). Enrollment was terminated early for benefit according to a prespecified stopping rule.

primary_endpoint_description: Hospital length of stay, defined as time from randomization to hospital discharge.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome did not significantly favor high-dose vitamin D3: median hospital stay was 7.0 days in both groups (log-rank P = .59; hazard ratio for discharge, 1.07 [95% CI, 0.82-1.39]). Thus, the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in SARS-CoV-2 log viral load at day 11 (±4 days).
brief_rationale: For the explicitly identified primary endpoint, bamlanivimab plus etesevimab produced a significantly greater viral-load reduction than placebo (difference, -0.57 log; 95% CI, -1.00 to -0.14; P=.01), meeting the favorable superiority criterion. Bamlanivimab monotherapy doses were not significant.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of days alive and out of the hospital through 30 days
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome did not differ significantly between discontinuation and continuation (mean 21.9 vs 22.9 days; mean ratio 0.95, 95% CI 0.90-1.01), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean visual acuity letter score over 24 weeks, assessed as area under the curve
brief_rationale: The primary outcome showed no statistically significant difference between aflibercept and vitrectomy with panretinal photocoagulation (adjusted difference, -5.0 letters; 95% CI, -10.2 to 0.3; P=.06), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of ventilator-free days at day 28
brief_rationale: The lower PEEP strategy met the prespecified noninferiority criterion versus higher PEEP: the lower bound of the 95% CI was within the -10% noninferiority margin (mean ratio, 1.04; 95% CI, 0.95 to infinity; P=.007 for noninferiority).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of cardiovascular death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, nonfatal stroke, coronary revascularization, or unstable angina requiring hospitalization.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 12.0% of the omega-3 CA group and 12.2% of the corn oil group (HR 0.99, 95% CI 0.90-1.09; P=.84), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Clinical status 14 days after randomization, assessed using a 7-category ordinal scale
brief_rationale: The primary outcome did not significantly differ between hydroxychloroquine and placebo (median score 6 vs 6; adjusted odds ratio 1.02, 95% CI 0.73-1.42). Thus, favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Freedom from atrial fibrillation or atrial tachycardia lasting longer than 30 seconds after a single procedure, without antiarrhythmic drugs, at both 6 and 12 months
brief_rationale: The primary outcome favored catheter ablation plus vein of Marshall ethanol infusion over ablation alone (49.2% vs 38.0%; difference, 11.2 percentage points; 95% CI, 0.8-21.7; P=.04), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in the Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire physical limitation score after 24 weeks of treatment
brief_rationale: Neither vericiguat dose improved the primary outcome versus placebo: the least-squares mean differences were -1.5 points for 15 mg (95% CI, -5.5 to 2.5; P=.47) and -0.5 points for 10 mg (95% CI, -4.6 to 3.5; P=.80). Thus, favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Superficial or deep surgical-site infection according to Centers for Disease Control and Prevention definitions
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 3.6% of the negative-pressure group and 3.4% of the standard-dressing group (difference, 0.36%; 95% CI, -1.46% to 2.19%; P=.70), so prophylactic negative-pressure wound therapy did not achieve favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Baseline-adjusted between-group differences at 6 months in apnea-hypopnea index (AHI) and Epworth Sleepiness Scale (ESS).
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary outcomes favored surgery: AHI difference −17.6 events/h (95% CI, −26.8 to −8.4; P<.001) and ESS difference −6.7 (95% CI, −8.2 to −5.2; P<.001). These effects were statistically significant and exceeded the stated minimal clinically important differences.

primary_endpoint_description: Ventilator-free days during the first 28 days, defined as days alive and free from mechanical ventilation
brief_rationale: Dexamethasone increased the explicitly identified primary outcome versus standard care (mean 6.6 vs 4.0 ventilator-free days; difference 2.26 days, 95% CI 0.20 to 4.38; P=.04), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, stroke, stent thrombosis, and severe recurrent ischemia at 12 months in CYP2C19 loss-of-function variant carriers
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored genotype-guided therapy numerically (4.0% vs 5.9%; HR 0.66, 95% CI 0.43-1.02) but did not meet the superiority criterion (P=.06).

primary_endpoint_description: Primary safety outcome: combined adverse reactions within 7 days after each injection; primary immunogenicity outcome: neutralizing antibody response 14 days after whole-course vaccination.
brief_rationale: Both primary outcomes are explicitly identified and their results are reported, but the abstract does not state prespecified thresholds or an overall success rule for safety and immunogenicity. Thus, whether the primary endpoints formally met trial success criteria cannot be determined.

primary_endpoint_description: Risk of depression or clinically relevant depressive symptoms and mean difference in PHQ-8 mood scores
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary outcomes failed to show favorable superiority: depression risk did not differ significantly (HR 0.97, 95% CI 0.87-1.09; P=.62), and change in PHQ-8 mood scores did not differ significantly (mean difference 0.01, 95% CI -0.04 to 0.05).

primary_endpoint_description: Left ventricular ejection fraction at 52 weeks assessed by magnetic resonance imaging
brief_rationale: Levothyroxine did not significantly improve the explicitly identified primary outcome versus placebo (adjusted between-group difference, 0.76 percentage points; 95% CI, -0.93 to 2.46; P = .37), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Bronchopulmonary dysplasia-free survival in infants at 36 weeks' postmenstrual age
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred in 54.9% of infants in the DHA group versus 61.6% with placebo (RR 0.91, 95% CI 0.80-1.04; P=.18). DHA did not demonstrate favorable superiority, so the primary endpoint did not meet the success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Cumulative antibiotic administration days for all-cause infections from randomization for up to 1 year
brief_rationale: The probiotic group did not have fewer antibiotic administration days than placebo (adjusted incidence rate ratio, 1.13; 95% CI, 0.79-1.63; P=.50), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite within 30 days after surgery of death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, extracorporeal membrane oxygenation, cardiopulmonary resuscitation, acute kidney injury, prolonged mechanical ventilation, or neurological complications.
brief_rationale: The primary composite endpoint occurred in 38.1% of the dexamethasone group versus 45.5% of the placebo group, but the favorable reduction was not statistically significant (HR 0.82, 95% CI 0.60-1.10; P=.20). Thus, dexamethasone did not meet the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) from baseline to 26 weeks
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored CGM, with an adjusted between-group HbA1c difference of -0.37% (95% CI, -0.66% to -0.08%; P=.01), demonstrating statistically significant superiority over usual blood glucose monitoring.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to clinical improvement within 28 days, defined as discharge alive or a 2-point reduction on a 6-point disease-severity scale.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint did not show significant favorable superiority with convalescent plasma versus control (HR, 1.40; 95% CI, 0.79-2.49; P=.26).

primary_endpoint_description: Clinical failure rate at day 30, using a 10% noninferiority margin
brief_rationale: The 30-day clinical failure rates for both CRP-guided treatment and fixed 7-day treatment were noninferior to fixed 14-day treatment; the upper bounds of the 1-sided 97.5% CIs (1.1% and 6.3%) were below the prespecified 10% margin.

primary_endpoint_description: Systolic blood pressure lower than 150 mm Hg at 12-week follow-up
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was an RR of 0.90. The adjusted RR was 0.98 with a 97.5% 1-sided CI lower bound of 0.92, exceeding the margin; therefore, medication reduction was noninferior to usual care for the primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Knee pain at 24 weeks assessed using the standardized WOMAC pain subscore (0=no symptoms to 10=extreme symptoms).
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored biomechanical footwear, with a between-group difference of -1.3 points (95% CI, -1.8 to -0.9; P<.001). This met the statistical superiority criterion, although the abstract notes uncertain clinical importance.

primary_endpoint_description: Absolute change in tibiofemoral cartilage volume assessed by MRI over 24 months.
brief_rationale: Cartilage volume change did not differ significantly between zoledronic acid and placebo (-878 vs -919 mm³; between-group difference, 41 mm³; 95% CI, -79 to 161; P=.50), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of worsening heart failure or cardiovascular death
brief_rationale: Dapagliflozin significantly reduced the explicitly identified primary outcome versus placebo in patients both without diabetes (HR 0.73, 95% CI 0.60-0.88) and with diabetes (HR 0.75, 95% CI 0.63-0.90), with effects in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Invasive disease-free survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored T-DXd over T-DM1, with fewer invasive-disease events or deaths (6.2% vs 12.5%; hazard ratio 0.47, 95% CI 0.34–0.66; P<0.001), demonstrating significant superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Freedom from treatment failure in a time-to-event analysis.
brief_rationale: Both ianalumab doses significantly prolonged time to treatment failure versus placebo in the favorable direction (hazard ratios 0.55, P=0.04, and 0.58, P=0.045), meeting the superiority criterion for the primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Log-transformed ratio of the urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio at week 26 compared with baseline.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint showed a significantly greater favorable reduction in proteinuria with pegcetacoplan than with placebo, corresponding to a 68.1% relative reduction versus placebo (95% CI, 57.3% to 76.2%).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of infection-related maternal death, infection-related near-miss event, or severe infection-related illness among women who were pregnant or recently pregnant
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 1.4% of patients in the intervention group versus 1.9% with usual care (risk ratio, 0.68; 95% CI, 0.55–0.83; P<0.001), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Two primary endpoints: 3-point MACE (coronary heart disease death, myocardial infarction, or ischemic stroke) and 4-point MACE (3-point MACE or ischemia-driven arterial revascularization).
brief_rationale: Both primary endpoints significantly favored evolocumab over placebo: 3-point MACE HR 0.75 (95% CI, 0.65–0.86; P<0.001) and 4-point MACE HR 0.81 (95% CI, 0.73–0.89; P<0.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of all serious cardiovascular events, including sudden and nonsudden cardiac death, fatal and nonfatal myocardial infarction, peripheral vascular disease leading to amputation, and fatal and nonfatal stroke.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred at a significantly lower rate with fish oil than placebo (0.31 vs 0.61 per 1000 patient-days; hazard ratio 0.57, 95% CI 0.47–0.70; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Diagnosis of Salmonella Paratyphi A infection within 14 days after challenge
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 21% of vaccine recipients versus 75% of placebo recipients in the intention-to-treat population (P<0.001), corresponding to 73% vaccine efficacy (95% CI, 46% to 86%), demonstrating significant protection in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Death from any cause at day 28
brief_rationale: The prespecified 5-percentage-point noninferiority margin was met: 28-day mortality was 34.3% with the noninvasive strategy versus 36.9% with the invasive strategy (adjusted risk difference, -3.2 percentage points; 95% CI, -8.9 to 2.5; P=0.006 for noninferiority).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death from any cause, recurrent myocardial infarction, or hospitalization for heart failure at 3-year follow-up.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 9.3% of the immediate iFR-guided PCI group and 9.8% of the deferred MRI-guided PCI group (hazard ratio 0.95, 95% CI 0.65–1.40; P=0.81). Immediate iFR-guided PCI did not demonstrate superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival as assessed by blinded independent review
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored sacituzumab tirumotecan over chemotherapy (median 8.3 vs 4.3 months; hazard ratio for progression or death, 0.49; 95% CI, 0.39–0.62), and the abstract states that the prespecified significance criterion was met (two-sided P<0.0001).

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator-assessed disease-free survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored atezolizumab: median disease-free survival was 9.9 versus 4.8 months with placebo (hazard ratio, 0.64; 95% CI, 0.47–0.87; P=0.005), meeting the superiority criterion.

This follow-up report explicitly identifies overall survival as a key secondary endpoint. It states that a prior primary analysis showed significantly longer progression-free survival, but does not explicitly identify progression-free survival as the prespecified primary endpoint; therefore primary-endpoint success cannot be assessed under the stated rules.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of pulmonary exacerbations over a 52-week period
brief_rationale: Neither factorial comparison met favorable superiority for the primary outcome: hypertonic saline versus no hypertonic saline had an adjusted mean difference of -0.25 (95% CI, -0.57 to 0.07; P=0.12), and carbocisteine versus no carbocisteine had a difference of -0.04 (95% CI, -0.36 to 0.28; P=0.81).

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of clinical malaria in children, defined by fever and a positive malaria rapid diagnostic test
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored permethrin-treated wraps: 0.73 versus 2.14 cases per 100 person-weeks (incidence rate ratio, 0.34; 95% CI, 0.23–0.51; P<0.001), demonstrating statistically significant superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Percent change in body weight from baseline to week 72, assessed using the treatment-regimen estimand in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: All three orforglipron doses produced significantly greater reductions in body weight than placebo for the explicitly identified primary endpoint (P<0.001 for each comparison), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary endpoints at week 64: percent change in body weight and achievement of a body-weight reduction of at least 5%.
brief_rationale: Both coprimary endpoints favored oral semaglutide over placebo: mean weight change was −13.6% versus −2.2% (difference, −11.4 percentage points; 95% CI, −13.9 to −9.0; P<0.001), and significantly more participants achieved at least 5% weight loss (P<0.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Serologic response at 6 months, defined as seroreversion to nonreactive status or a decrease in rapid plasma reagin titer by at least two dilutions.
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was 10 percentage points. The primary endpoint occurred in 76% with one dose and 70% with three doses; the reported difference and 90% CI were stated to indicate noninferiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Systolic blood pressure at 6 months
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was systolic blood pressure at 6 months. Both home-based care groups had significantly lower systolic blood pressure than standard care (CHW difference, -7.9 mm Hg; enhanced CHW difference, -9.1 mm Hg; both P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Least-squares mean percent change in triglyceride level from baseline to 6 months among patients with moderate hypertriglyceridemia, assessed as the placebo-adjusted difference for each olezarsen dose.
brief_rationale: Both olezarsen doses produced significantly greater triglyceride reductions than placebo at 6 months: placebo-adjusted changes were -58.4 percentage points and -60.6 percentage points, with P<0.001 for both comparisons.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death from any cause or major adverse cardiovascular events (new myocardial infarction, unplanned coronary revascularization, ischemic stroke, heart failure, or malignant ventricular arrhythmias).
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred less often with beta-blocker therapy than with no beta-blocker therapy (14.2% vs. 16.3%; hazard ratio 0.85, 95% CI 0.75–0.98; P=0.03), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Moderate-to-severe gastroenteritis, defined as a modified Vesikari scale score of 9 or higher, during the 7 days after enrollment.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred less often with ondansetron than placebo (5.1% vs. 12.5%; risk difference, -7.4 percentage points; 95% CI, -11.2 to -3.7), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Two primary end points at week 68: percent change in body weight and the percentage of patients achieving at least 5% weight reduction.
brief_rationale: Both primary end points significantly favored cagrilintide-semaglutide over placebo: mean body-weight change was -13.7% versus -3.4% (difference, -10.4 percentage points; 95% CI, -11.2 to -9.5; P<0.001), and significantly more patients achieved at least 5% weight reduction (P<0.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival by blinded independent central review in patients with ESR1 mutations and in the full randomized population.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was significant in the ESR1-mutated population (HR 0.58; P<0.001) but not in the full population (HR 0.83; P=0.07). Because the abstract does not state the overall success rule for these two primary analyses, overall primary-endpoint success is indeterminable.

primary_endpoint_description: Absolute change from baseline in forced vital capacity (FVC), measured in milliliters, at week 52.
brief_rationale: Both nerandomilast doses produced significantly smaller FVC declines than placebo at week 52: adjusted differences of 67.2 ml for 18 mg and 81.1 ml for 9 mg, each favoring nerandomilast with P<0.001.

primary_endpoint_description: Absolute change from baseline in forced vital capacity (FVC), measured in milliliters, at week 52.
brief_rationale: Both nerandomilast doses produced significantly smaller FVC declines than placebo at week 52: adjusted differences were 68.8 ml for 18 mg (P<0.001) and 44.9 ml for 9 mg (P=0.02), meeting the favorable superiority criterion for the explicitly identified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Percent change in body weight from baseline to week 72
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored tirzepatide: least-squares mean weight change was -20.2% with tirzepatide versus -13.7% with semaglutide (P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Prevention of sustained QuantiFERON-TB (QFT) test conversion, indicating sustained Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 62 of 871 BCG recipients and 59 of 849 placebo recipients (hazard ratio, 1.04; 95% CI, 0.73–1.48), corresponding to vaccine efficacy of -3.8% (95% CI, -48.3 to 27.4). Thus, BCG revaccination did not demonstrate superior protection against sustained QFT conversion.

primary_endpoint_description: The part 1 primary endpoints were resolution of steatohepatitis without worsening of liver fibrosis and reduction in liver fibrosis without worsening of steatohepatitis at week 72.
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary endpoints favored semaglutide over placebo and were statistically significant: 62.9% versus 34.3% for steatohepatitis resolution and 36.8% versus 22.4% for fibrosis reduction, with P<0.001 for each.

primary_endpoint_description: Transmission of influenza virus from an index patient to a household contact by day 5
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred significantly less often with baloxavir than placebo (adjusted incidence 9.5% vs. 13.4%; adjusted odds ratio 0.68, 95.38% CI 0.50–0.93; P=0.01), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to first event in the composite of death from any cause, lung transplantation, or hospitalization lasting at least 24 hours for worsening pulmonary arterial hypertension.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary composite endpoint favored sotatercept over placebo (17.4% vs 54.7%; hazard ratio 0.24, 95% CI 0.13–0.43; P<0.001), and the trial was stopped early for efficacy at a prespecified interim analysis.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death from any cause or worsening heart failure (hospitalization or an urgent visit) at 1 year
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred in 15.0% with dapagliflozin versus 20.1% with standard care (hazard ratio 0.72, 95% CI 0.55–0.95; P=0.02), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Glycated hemoglobin level at 13 weeks
brief_rationale: At 13 weeks, glycated hemoglobin decreased more with AID than with control, with a favorable adjusted difference of -0.6 percentage points (95% CI, -0.8 to -0.4; P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Recurrence of bacterial vaginosis within 12 weeks
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored partner treatment: recurrence was 35% with partner treatment versus 63% with standard care, with an absolute recurrence-rate difference of -2.6 per person-year (95% CI, -4.0 to -1.2; P<0.001). Thus, favorable superiority was demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival for acalabrutinib-venetoclax versus chemoimmunotherapy in the intention-to-treat population, assessed by blinded independent central review.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored acalabrutinib-venetoclax over chemoimmunotherapy (hazard ratio for progression or death, 0.65; 95% CI, 0.49–0.87; P=0.004), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Complete renal response at week 76, defined by urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio below 0.5, estimated glomerular filtration rate at least 85% of baseline, and no intercurrent event.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 46.4% of patients receiving obinutuzumab versus 33.1% receiving placebo, with a favorable adjusted difference of 13.4 percentage points (95% CI, 2.0 to 24.8; P=0.02), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: New morphometric vertebral fracture over 10 years, defined as at least a 20% change in vertebral height from baseline.
brief_rationale: The zoledronate-at-baseline-and-5-years group had fewer primary-endpoint fractures than placebo (6.3% vs 11.1%; relative risk 0.56, 95% CI 0.34–0.92; P=0.04), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss, defined as HBsAg below 0.05 IU/mL, at 24 weeks after the end of treatment.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint event rates are reported for all five groups, but the abstract does not state a prespecified comparison, statistical threshold, or other criterion defining trial success; therefore, whether the primary endpoint met its success criterion cannot be determined.

primary_endpoint_description: Primary efficacy endpoint: incident tuberculosis, including death from tuberculosis, by week 48; primary safety endpoint: grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events during treatment.
brief_rationale: Incident tuberculosis was less frequent with levofloxacin, but superiority was not established (HR 0.44, 95% CI 0.15–1.25; difference not significant). The primary safety endpoint also showed no significant between-group difference (HR 0.52, 95% CI 0.16–1.71).

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator-assessed progression-free survival for imlunestrant versus standard endocrine therapy in patients with ESR1 mutations and in the overall population, and for imlunestrant-abemaciclib versus imlunestrant in concurrently randomized patients.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was favorable for imlunestrant in the ESR1-mutated population (P<0.001) and for imlunestrant-abemaciclib versus imlunestrant (P<0.001), but not for imlunestrant versus standard therapy in the overall population (P=0.12). Because the primary endpoints had mixed results and the abstract does not state the overall success rule, overall primary-endpoint success is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: Unfavorable neurologic outcome at 12 months, defined as a modified Rankin scale score of 4 or higher.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 33.5% with the liberal strategy versus 37.7% with the restrictive strategy (risk ratio 0.88, 95% CI 0.72–1.09; P=0.22). The liberal strategy therefore did not demonstrate favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Protection against carriage of PCV10 vaccine serotypes with the 1p+1 schedule versus the 2p+1 and 3p+0 schedules at 3.5 years after vaccine introduction.
brief_rationale: The prespecified 5-percentage-point noninferiority margin was satisfied. The 1p+1 schedule was noninferior to both 2p+1 and 3p+0 for vaccine-serotype carriage among infants, with confidence intervals within the margin, and was likewise noninferior among toddlers.

primary_endpoint_description: Disease-free survival
brief_rationale: Extended lymphadenectomy did not improve the primary outcome of disease-free survival versus standard lymphadenectomy (5-year estimates, 56% vs. 60%; hazard ratio for recurrence or death, 1.10; 95% CI, 0.86–1.40; P=0.45), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to the composite of cardiovascular death, recurrent myocardial infarction, stroke, or unplanned ischemia-driven coronary revascularization.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 9.1% of the colchicine group and 9.3% of the placebo group (hazard ratio 0.99, 95% CI 0.85–1.16; P=0.93), so colchicine did not demonstrate favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Dual primary endpoints: (1) non-procedure-related major or clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding, tested for superiority; and (2) composite of death from any cause, stroke, or systemic embolism at 36 months, tested for noninferiority.
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary endpoints met their respective criteria: bleeding was significantly lower with left atrial appendage closure (8.5% vs. 18.1%; P<0.001 for superiority), and the composite efficacy endpoint satisfied noninferiority (5.3% vs. 5.8%; P<0.001 for noninferiority).

primary_endpoint_description: First treated, adjudicated disease flare during the 52-week treatment period, assessed in a time-to-event analysis.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored inebilizumab: 10% had at least one flare versus 60% with placebo, with a hazard ratio of 0.13 (95% CI, 0.06–0.28; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Freedom from biochemical or clinical failure
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was explicitly identified, with a critical hazard ratio for noninferiority of 1.45. The observed hazard ratio was 0.73 (90% CI, 0.48 to 1.12; P=0.004 for noninferiority); the upper confidence bound was below 1.45, meeting the prespecified noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Patient Evaluation Measure–Hand Health Profile (PEM) score at 1 year after treatment
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was 6 points. The estimated collagenase-minus-fasciectomy difference was 5.9 points, but the 95% CI extended to 8.8 and the one-sided P value for noninferiority was 0.49; therefore, collagenase did not meet the noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival assessed by blinded independent central review in the independent extrapancreatic and pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor cohorts.
brief_rationale: Cabozantinib significantly improved the primary endpoint versus placebo in both cohorts: hazard ratio 0.38 (95% CI, 0.25–0.59; P<0.001) for extrapancreatic tumors and 0.23 (95% CI, 0.12–0.42; P<0.001) for pancreatic tumors.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in glycated hemoglobin level from baseline to week 52
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was 0.4 percentage points. The estimated treatment difference for efsitora versus degludec was -0.09 percentage points (95% CI, -0.22 to 0.04), which satisfied the noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival
brief_rationale: Progression-free survival was explicitly identified as the primary endpoint and favored doxorubicin-trabectedin with maintenance: median 12 versus 6 months, with an adjusted hazard ratio for progression or death of 0.37 (95% CI, 0.26 to 0.53), meeting a favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death from any cause, myocardial infarction, stroke, systemic embolism, unplanned urgent revascularization, and major or clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding at 12 months.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred less often with edoxaban monotherapy than with dual antithrombotic therapy (6.8% vs 16.2%; hazard ratio 0.44, 95% CI 0.30–0.65; P<0.001), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Primary efficacy composite of death, heart-failure hospitalization, mitral-valve reintervention, assist-device implantation, or stroke within 1 year; and primary safety composite of major adverse events within 30 days.
brief_rationale: The primary efficacy composite occurred in 16.7% versus 22.5%, meeting the prespecified noninferiority criterion (P<0.001 for noninferiority). The primary safety composite also favored transcatheter repair (14.9% vs. 54.8%; P<0.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death from any cause and recurrent cardiovascular events
brief_rationale: Vutrisiran significantly lowered the risk of the explicitly identified primary composite endpoint versus placebo in the overall population (hazard ratio, 0.72; 95% CI, 0.56–0.93; P=0.01), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, nonfatal stroke, or hospitalization for cardiovascular reasons at the longest follow-up (minimum 1 year).
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority criterion required the upper boundary of the two-sided 95% CI for the between-group risk difference to be below 3 percentage points. The observed risk difference was 2.8 percentage points with a 95% CI extending to 5.5, and P=0.44 for noninferiority; therefore, interruption was not shown to be noninferior to continuation.

primary_endpoint_description: Dual primary end points of progression-free survival and overall survival
brief_rationale: Progression-free survival met its prespecified significance criterion (P=0.002), whereas overall survival did not (hazard ratio 0.88; 95% CI, 0.73–1.07; P=0.20). The abstract does not state the overall success rule for the mixed dual-primary results.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival with amivantamab plus lazertinib versus osimertinib, assessed by blinded independent central review.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored amivantamab-lazertinib, with median progression-free survival of 23.7 versus 16.6 months (hazard ratio for progression or death, 0.70; 95% CI, 0.58–0.85; P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in the apnea-hypopnea index (AHI) from baseline to week 52
brief_rationale: In both placebo-controlled trials, tirzepatide produced a significantly greater favorable reduction in the explicitly identified primary endpoint: estimated treatment differences in AHI were -20.0 and -23.8 events per hour, respectively, with P<0.001.

primary_endpoint_description: Unfavorable neurologic outcome at 6 months assessed by the Glasgow Outcome Scale-Extended using a prognosis-based sliding dichotomy
brief_rationale: The liberal strategy did not significantly reduce the primary outcome versus the restrictive strategy: 68.4% versus 73.5%, with an adjusted absolute difference (restrictive minus liberal) of 5.4 percentage points (95% CI, -2.9 to 13.7). The confidence interval included no difference, so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Occurrence of acute kidney injury, defined according to the Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes creatinine criteria
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred less often with amino acids than with placebo (26.9% vs. 31.7%; relative risk 0.85, 95% CI 0.77–0.94; P=0.002), demonstrating statistically significant benefit in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Major molecular response (BCR::ABL1 transcript level ≤0.1% IS) at week 48 for asciminib versus investigator-selected TKIs overall and versus investigator-selected TKIs within the prerandomization-selected imatinib stratum.
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary comparisons favored asciminib and were statistically significant: 67.7% versus 49.0% overall (adjusted P<0.001) and 69.3% versus 40.2% in the imatinib stratum (adjusted P<0.001), establishing superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Time-normalized number of investigator-confirmed hereditary angioedema attacks per 4 weeks from week 1 through week 25
brief_rationale: Both donidalorsen regimens significantly reduced the primary-endpoint attack rate versus placebo: by 81% with dosing every 4 weeks (P<0.001) and by 55% with dosing every 8 weeks (P=0.004), in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Percent change in fasting triglyceride level at week 24
brief_rationale: All plozasiran regimens produced significantly greater reductions in fasting triglycerides than placebo at week 24, with favorable between-group differences from -44.2 to -62.4 percentage points and P<0.001 for every comparison.

primary_endpoint_description: Acute thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (TTP) events during prophylaxis
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was explicitly identified and was evaluated: no acute TTP events occurred with recombinant ADAMTS13 versus one with standard therapy. However, the abstract provides no prespecified superiority, noninferiority, equivalence, or other success criterion, so trial success on the primary endpoint cannot be determined.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean utility-weighted modified Rankin Scale score at 180 days
brief_rationale: The surgery group had a higher mean score than the control group (0.458 vs 0.374; difference 0.084), with a posterior probability of superiority of 0.981, exceeding the prespecified success threshold of 0.975.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to sustained alleviation of all targeted Covid-19 signs and symptoms
brief_rationale: The median time was 12 days with nirmatrelvir-ritonavir versus 13 days with placebo, with no significant difference (P=0.60); therefore, the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Invasive disease-free survival
brief_rationale: At the prespecified interim analysis, ribociclib plus an NSAI improved the primary endpoint versus NSAI alone (hazard ratio 0.75, 95% CI 0.62–0.91; one-sided P=0.003), crossing the protocol-specified superiority boundary of P<0.0128.

primary_endpoint_description: Biochemically validated continuous abstinence from smoking at 6 months
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 28.9% of the e-cigarette intervention group versus 16.3% of the control group (relative risk 1.77, 95% CI 1.43–2.20), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Ordinal modified Rankin scale score at day 90
brief_rationale: The primary outcome did not show favorable superiority of tenecteplase over placebo: adjusted common odds ratio 1.13 (95% CI, 0.82 to 1.57; P=0.45), with a median score of 3 in both groups.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall vaccine efficacy against symptomatic, virologically confirmed dengue of any serotype occurring more than 28 days after vaccination, regardless of baseline serostatus
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy endpoint showed 79.6% vaccine efficacy at 2 years (95% CI, 70.0% to 86.3%), a favorable result with the confidence interval excluding no efficacy.

primary_endpoint_description: Death before 6 months of age
brief_rationale: Mortality was not reduced with azithromycin versus placebo (82 vs. 75 deaths; hazard ratio 1.09, 95% CI 0.80–1.49; P=0.58), so the primary superiority endpoint did not meet the favorable success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Death from any cause
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was all-cause death. Death occurred in 71.2% with CRT-D versus 76.4% with ICD, and time to death favored CRT-D (acceleration factor 0.80, 95% CI 0.69–0.92; P=0.002), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Stunting at 12 months of age, defined as a length-for-age z score more than 2 standard deviations below the growth-standard median.
brief_rationale: This explicitly identified primary outcome occurred in 27.4% of the LPG group versus 25.2% of the biomass-control group (relative risk 1.10; 98.75% CI, 0.94–1.29; P=0.12). The intervention did not demonstrate a significant reduction in stunting.

primary_endpoint_description: Severe pneumonia in the first year of life, identified through facility surveillance or verbal autopsy
brief_rationale: This explicitly identified primary outcome did not differ significantly between the LPG and biomass groups (incidence rate ratio, 0.96; 98.75% CI, 0.64–1.44; P=0.81), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was progression-free survival. D-VRd significantly reduced the risk of progression or death versus VRd (hazard ratio 0.42, 95% CI 0.30–0.59; P<0.001), crossing the prespecified stopping boundary of P=0.0126 in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator-assessed progression-free survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored mirvetuximab soravtansine: median progression-free survival was 5.62 months versus 3.98 months with chemotherapy (P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean C-peptide level determined from the area under the concentration-time curve during a 2-hour mixed-meal tolerance test at week 48
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored baricitinib: median stimulated mean C-peptide was 0.65 versus 0.43 nmol/L/min with placebo (P=0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Transplantation of the donor heart
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 54.9% of donors receiving levothyroxine and 53.2% receiving saline (adjusted risk ratio 1.01, 95% CI 0.97–1.07; P=0.57), so levothyroxine did not demonstrate favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Angina symptom score at 12 weeks, calculated from daily angina episodes, prescribed antianginal medications, and clinical events, with higher scores indicating worse angina-related health status.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored PCI: mean angina symptom score was 2.9 with PCI versus 5.6 with placebo (odds ratio, 2.21; 95% CI, 1.41–3.47; P<0.001). The significantly lower score indicates superior angina-related health status with PCI.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in the Clinical Dementia Rating scale–Sum of Boxes (CDR-SB) score at week 116
brief_rationale: In both GRADUATE I and II, gantenerumab did not significantly improve the primary endpoint versus placebo: differences were -0.31 (95% CI, -0.66 to 0.05; P=0.10) and -0.19 (95% CI, -0.55 to 0.17; P=0.30), respectively. Thus, favorable superiority was not established.

primary_endpoint_description: Death by day 28
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was death by day 28. Mortality was significantly lower with convalescent plasma than with standard care (35.4% vs. 45.0%; P=0.03), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary endpoints at week 16: itch response (≥4-point reduction on the PP-NRS) and IGA response (IGA score of 0 or 1 with a ≥2-point reduction from baseline).
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary endpoints favored nemolizumab over placebo and were statistically significant: itch response was 56.3% versus 20.9%, and IGA response was 37.7% versus 11.0% (P<0.001 for both).

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival according to blinded independent central review
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was significantly improved with amivantamab plus chemotherapy versus chemotherapy alone (median 11.4 vs 6.7 months; hazard ratio for progression or death, 0.40; 95% CI, 0.30–0.53; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival assessed by blinded independent central review in the intention-to-treat-pembrolizumab and overall intention-to-treat populations.
brief_rationale: Selpercatinib significantly prolonged progression-free survival versus control in the intention-to-treat-pembrolizumab population (median 24.8 vs 11.2 months; HR 0.46, 95% CI 0.31–0.70; P<0.001), with similar efficacy results in the overall intention-to-treat population.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was overall survival. Tebentafusp reduced the hazard of death versus control (HR 0.68, 95% CI 0.54–0.87), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival and progression-free survival
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary outcomes favored nivolumab plus gemcitabine-cisplatin and were statistically significant: overall survival HR 0.78 (95% CI, 0.63–0.96; P=0.02) and progression-free survival HR 0.72 (95% CI, 0.59–0.88; P=0.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was overall survival. Erdafitinib significantly improved median overall survival versus chemotherapy (12.1 vs. 7.8 months; hazard ratio for death, 0.64; 95% CI, 0.47–0.88; P=0.005), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Transfer to a hospital due to infection
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored universal decolonization over routine care, with a 16.6% difference in risk ratio (95% CI, 11.0 to 21.8; P<0.001), indicating statistically significant superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Length of time that ICU care was needed, calculated from time to discharge alive from the ICU with death treated as a competing risk
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was similar between tight and liberal glucose control (hazard ratio for earlier discharge alive, 1.00; 95% CI, 0.96–1.04; P=0.94), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall treatment success 70 days after randomization, defined as survival, bacteremia clearance, symptom improvement, no new S. aureus bacteremia-related complications, and no receipt of other potentially effective antibiotics.
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was 15%. The adjusted difference in treatment success was 2.0 percentage points (95% CI, -7.1 to 11.1), so the lower confidence bound remained above -15%; the abstract concludes that ceftobiprole was noninferior to daptomycin.

primary_endpoint_description: Independently assessed overall response (complete or partial response) according to Response Assessment in Neuro-Oncology criteria.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome favored dabrafenib plus trametinib: overall response was 47% versus 11% with standard chemotherapy (risk ratio 4.31, 95% CI 1.7–11.2; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to sustained recovery, defined as the third of 3 consecutive days without symptoms.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome showed no evidence of a shorter recovery time with fluticasone furoate versus placebo (hazard ratio 1.01, 95% credible interval 0.91–1.12; posterior probability of benefit 0.56), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Velopharyngeal insufficiency at 5 years of age, defined as a velopharyngeal composite summary score of at least 4.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred less often with surgery at 6 months than at 12 months (8.9% vs. 15.0%; risk ratio 0.59, 95% CI 0.36–0.99; P=0.04), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Treated spontaneous and traumatic bleeding episodes, compared between randomized no-prophylaxis and concizumab-prophylaxis groups
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored concizumab: estimated mean annualized bleeding rates were 1.7 versus 11.8 episodes, with a rate ratio of 0.14 (95% CI, 0.07–0.29; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death from any cause, nonfatal myocardial infarction, stroke, unplanned ischemia-driven revascularization, or hospitalization for heart failure at 1 year after randomization
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 8.5% of the immediate-PCI group versus 16.3% of the staged-PCI group (risk ratio 0.52, 95% CI 0.38–0.72), with P<0.001 for noninferiority; thus, the prespecified noninferiority criterion was met.

primary_endpoint_description: Two primary efficacy endpoints: minimum stent area after PCI assessed by OCT and target-vessel failure at 2 years.
brief_rationale: Minimum stent area favored OCT guidance significantly (mean difference 0.36 mm²; 95% CI, 0.21–0.51; P<0.001), whereas target-vessel failure did not differ significantly (HR 0.90; 95% CI, 0.67–1.19; P=0.45). Because the primary endpoints had mixed results and no overall success rule is stated, trial success is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death, myocardial infarction, stroke, or any revascularization at 1 year
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred less often with complete revascularization than with culprit-only PCI (15.7% vs 21.0%; hazard ratio 0.73, 95% CI 0.57–0.93; P=0.01), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary efficacy endpoint of freedom at 1 year from a composite of procedural failure, atrial tachyarrhythmia, antiarrhythmic drug use, cardioversion, or repeat ablation, and primary safety endpoint of device- or procedure-related serious adverse events.
brief_rationale: Pulsed field ablation met noninferiority criteria versus thermal ablation for both the primary efficacy and primary safety endpoints, with posterior probabilities of noninferiority greater than 0.999.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death from any cause, implantation of a left ventricular assist device, or urgent heart transplantation.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary composite endpoint occurred less often with catheter ablation plus medical therapy than with medical therapy alone (8% vs. 30%; hazard ratio 0.24, 95% CI 0.11–0.52; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Hierarchical composite of death within 12 months, heart-failure hospitalizations within 12 months, or change from baseline to 6 months in 6-minute walk distance
brief_rationale: The prespecified significance level was 0.01. The primary hierarchical composite yielded P=0.02 (unmatched win ratio 1.10; 99% CI, 0.99 to 1.23), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Time-weighted sum of pain-intensity difference over 48 hours (SPID48) after abdominoplasty or bunionectomy
brief_rationale: The prespecified primary endpoint favored high-dose VX-548 over placebo in both trials: least-squares mean differences in SPID48 were 37.8 (95% CI, 9.2 to 66.4) after abdominoplasty and 36.8 (95% CI, 4.6 to 69.0) after bunionectomy. Both confidence intervals excluded no difference in the favorable direction, although lower doses did not outperform placebo.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean change from baseline to week 8 in average sleep latency on the Maintenance of Wakefulness Test.
brief_rationale: All TAK-994 dose groups had substantially greater increases in sleep latency than placebo, with P<0.001 for each comparison, meeting the favorable superiority criterion for the explicitly identified primary endpoint.
The abstract reports safety, immunogenicity, antibody transfer, and seroepidemiologic findings but does not explicitly identify any endpoint as the prespecified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: GVHD-free, relapse-free survival at 1 year, with events defined as grade III or IV acute GVHD, chronic GVHD warranting systemic immunosuppression, disease relapse or progression, or death from any cause
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored experimental prophylaxis: adjusted 1-year GVHD-free, relapse-free survival was 52.7% versus 34.9%, with an event hazard ratio of 0.64 (95% CI, 0.49–0.83; P=0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: First occurrence of cardiovascular death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, or nonfatal stroke in a time-to-event analysis
brief_rationale: The hazard ratio was 0.96 (95% CI, 0.78 to 1.17). Because the CI upper limit was below the prespecified noninferiority margin of 1.5, the primary endpoint met the success criterion (P<0.001 for noninferiority).

primary_endpoint_description: Functional outcome at 3 months after randomization, assessed by the modified Rankin scale score.
brief_rationale: Noninferiority required the lower limit of the 95% confidence interval for the odds ratio of a better functional outcome with dexamethasone versus surgery to be at least 0.9. The adjusted common odds ratio was 0.55 (95% CI, 0.34 to 0.90), so the prespecified noninferiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Risk-adjusted survival at 6 months in the as-treated circulatory-death group compared with the brain-death group
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint met the prespecified noninferiority criterion: the least-squares mean difference was -3 percentage points (90% CI, -10 to 3), within the 20-percentage-point noninferiority margin, with P<0.001 for noninferiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator-assessed disease-free survival among patients with stage II to IIIA disease
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies disease-free survival in patients with stage II to IIIA disease as the primary endpoint and states that adjuvant osimertinib resulted in significantly longer disease-free survival than placebo.

primary_endpoint_description: Disease-free survival
brief_rationale: The upper bound of the 90.2% confidence interval for the hazard ratio for disease recurrence or death was 1.14, below the prespecified noninferiority margin of 1.29; therefore, FOLFOX met the primary endpoint's noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Dual primary end points of event-free survival and overall survival.
brief_rationale: Event-free survival significantly favored pembrolizumab (HR 0.58; P<0.001), whereas overall survival did not meet its significance criterion (P=0.02). Because the dual primary endpoints had mixed results and the abstract does not state the overall success rule, trial success is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: Physical function of the affected arm at 4 weeks, assessed using the Pediatric Upper Extremity Short PROMIS score
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was 5 points. Ultrasonography was noninferior to radiography for the primary outcome (mean difference, 0.1 point; 95% CI, -1.3 to 1.4), satisfying the noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Response to treatment, defined as a decrease of at least 50% from baseline in the 16-item Quick Inventory of Depressive Symptomatology–Self-Report score.
brief_rationale: Response occurred in 55.4% of the ketamine group versus 41.2% of the ECT group, a difference of 14.2 percentage points (95% CI, 3.9 to 24.2). The confidence interval remained above the prespecified noninferiority margin of -10 percentage points, meeting the noninferiority criterion (P<0.001).
The abstract reports safety, pharmacokinetic, biomarker, and imaging assessments but does not explicitly identify any endpoint as the prespecified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival determined by blinded independent review according to RECIST version 1.1 in the first 550 randomized patients
brief_rationale: The experimental regimen significantly prolonged the explicitly identified primary endpoint versus control (hazard ratio for progression or death, 0.73; 95% CI, 0.57–0.94; P=0.01), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Three primary outcomes: a composite of adverse neonatal outcomes, pregnancy-related hypertension, and neonatal lean body mass.
brief_rationale: The adverse-neonatal-outcome composite favored immediate treatment, whereas pregnancy-related hypertension and neonatal lean body mass did not materially differ. Because the abstract does not specify the overall success rule for the three primary outcomes, overall primary-endpoint success is indeterminable.

primary_endpoint_description: Symptomatic Covid-19 and severe Covid-19 assessed at 6 months
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary outcomes failed to show favorable superiority of BCG over placebo. Symptomatic Covid-19 was 14.7% versus 12.3% (risk difference 2.4 percentage points; 95% CI, -0.7 to 5.5; P=0.13), and severe Covid-19 was 7.6% versus 6.5% (risk difference 1.1 percentage points; 95% CI, -1.2 to 3.5; P=0.34).

primary_endpoint_description: Extended Glasgow Outcome Scale (GOSE) rating at 12 months
brief_rationale: The primary outcome did not show favorable superiority for decompressive craniectomy versus craniotomy (common odds ratio 0.85, 95% CI 0.60–1.18; P=0.32).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death or severe brain injury on cerebral ultrasonography at 36 weeks' postmenstrual age
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 35.2% of infants receiving cerebral oximetry-guided treatment versus 34.0% receiving usual care (RR 1.03, 95% CI 0.90–1.18; P=0.64), so the intervention did not achieve favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of maternal death or blood transfusion by hospital discharge or 7 days postpartum, whichever came first.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 3.6% with tranexamic acid versus 4.3% with placebo (adjusted relative risk 0.89, 95.26% CI 0.74–1.07; P=0.19), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of at least one sexually transmitted infection per follow-up quarter
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored doxycycline postexposure prophylaxis over standard care in both cohorts: 10.7% vs 31.9% per quarterly visit in the PrEP cohort (RR 0.34, 95% CI 0.24–0.46; P<0.001) and 11.8% vs 30.5% in the PLWH cohort (RR 0.38, 95% CI 0.24–0.60; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Two primary efficacy endpoints: medically attended severe RSV-associated lower respiratory tract illness and medically attended RSV-associated lower respiratory tract illness in infants through 90, 120, 150, and 180 days after birth.
brief_rationale: The severe-illness primary endpoint met the stated efficacy criterion, whereas the other RSV-associated lower respiratory tract illness primary endpoint did not. The abstract does not specify the overall success rule for these mixed primary-endpoint results.

primary_endpoint_description: Modified Pouchitis Disease Activity Index (mPDAI)-defined remission at week 14, defined as an mPDAI score of ≤4 and a reduction from baseline of ≥2 points.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 31% of patients receiving vedolizumab versus 10% receiving placebo, a favorable difference of 21 percentage points (95% CI, 5 to 38; P=0.01), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Percentage of time that glucose was in the target range of 70 to 180 mg/dL, measured by continuous glucose monitoring
brief_rationale: The closed-loop group had a significantly greater percentage of time in the target glucose range than the standard-care group (adjusted difference, 12.4 percentage points; 95% CI, 9.5 to 15.3; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Hierarchical composite of all-cause death or tricuspid-valve surgery, hospitalization for heart failure, and improvement of at least 15 points in KCCQ score at 1 year.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary hierarchical composite favored TEER over medical therapy, with a win ratio of 1.48 (95% CI, 1.06 to 2.13; P=0.02), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Event-free survival in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: The neoadjuvant-adjuvant group had significantly longer event-free survival than the adjuvant-only group (log-rank P=0.004), meeting the favorable superiority criterion for the explicitly identified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: First occurrence of RSV-mediated lower respiratory tract disease meeting each of three prespecified case definitions.
brief_rationale: The vaccine reduced primary-endpoint events versus placebo under all three case definitions, with vaccine efficacies of 80.0%, 75.0%, and 69.8%; all corresponding 94.2% confidence intervals excluded no efficacy and favored vaccination.
