brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary endpoints significantly favored enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab over chemotherapy: progression-free survival HR 0.45 (95% CI, 0.38–0.54; P<0.001) and overall survival HR 0.47 (95% CI, 0.38–0.58; P<0.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Cancer recurrence in the pelvic area (pelvic recurrence) at 3 years
brief_rationale: The 3-year pelvic recurrence difference was 0.35 percentage points (90% CI, -1.62 to 2.32), with the upper confidence bound below the prespecified 4-percentage-point noninferiority margin; simple hysterectomy therefore met the noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Ingestion of peanut protein in a single dose of at least 600 mg without dose-limiting symptoms.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was achieved by 67% of participants receiving omalizumab versus 7% receiving placebo (P<0.001), demonstrating favorable superiority of omalizumab.

primary_endpoint_description: Remission at both weeks 36 and 48
brief_rationale: The adjusted remission rates were 59% with benralizumab and 56% with mepolizumab, for a difference of 3 percentage points (95% CI, -13 to 18). The lower confidence bound exceeded the prespecified noninferiority margin of -25 percentage points, so the primary noninferiority criterion was met.

primary_endpoint_description: Response during part 2, defined by hematocrit control, absence of phlebotomy, and completion of the trial regimen
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy endpoint occurred in 60% of patients receiving rusfertide versus 17% receiving placebo during the randomized withdrawal period (P=0.002), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: PASI 75 response at week 16, defined as a reduction from baseline of at least 75% in the Psoriasis Area and Severity Index score.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint showed higher PASI 75 response rates with JNJ-77242113 (37% to 79% across doses) than with placebo (9%), with a significant favorable dose-response relationship (P<0.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Time to sustained resolution of 11 Covid-19-related symptoms, defined as their absence for 2 consecutive days
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy endpoint favored simnotrelvir plus ritonavir: median time to sustained symptom resolution was 180.1 versus 216.0 hours with placebo, a difference of -35.8 hours (95% CI, -60.1 to -12.4; P=0.006), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

The abstract reports clinical fracture incidence in a subtrial but does not explicitly identify clinical fracture—or any other outcome—as the prespecified primary endpoint. Therefore, the reported unfavorable fracture result cannot be classified as the trial's primary-endpoint result.

primary_endpoint_description: Hospitalization for RSV-associated lower respiratory tract infection, defined as hospital admission with an RSV-positive test result.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred in 0.3% of infants receiving nirsevimab versus 1.5% receiving standard care, corresponding to 83.2% efficacy (95% CI, 67.8–92.0; P<0.001), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of myocardial infarction or death at 30 days
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 16.9% with the restrictive strategy and 14.5% with the liberal strategy (risk ratio 1.15, 95% CI 0.99–1.34; P=0.07). The liberal strategy did not achieve statistically significant superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to first occurrence of the composite of cardiovascular death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, or nonfatal stroke.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary cardiovascular endpoint occurred in 6.5% of the semaglutide group versus 8.0% of the placebo group (hazard ratio 0.80, 95% CI 0.72–0.90; P<0.001), demonstrating favorable superiority of semaglutide.

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator-assessed progression-free survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was significantly improved with osimertinib plus chemotherapy versus osimertinib alone (hazard ratio for progression or death, 0.62; 95% CI, 0.49–0.79; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) slope at the final analysis at week 108
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy endpoint was eGFR slope at final analysis. There were no significant between-group differences in either total or chronic eGFR slope at week 108, so favorable superiority of sparsentan over irbesartan was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in distance covered on the 6-minute walk test at 12 months
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored patisiran over placebo, with an estimated median difference of 14.69 m (95% CI, 0.69 to 28.69; P=0.02), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in β-cell function, measured by stimulated C-peptide levels at week 78
brief_rationale: Teplizumab produced significantly higher stimulated C-peptide levels than placebo at week 78 (least-squares mean difference, 0.13 pmol/mL; 95% CI, 0.09 to 0.17; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion for the explicitly identified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Occurrence of the first urinary tract infection during the 24-month trial period
brief_rationale: The primary outcome favored continuous antibiotic prophylaxis: first UTI occurred in 21.2% versus 35.6% with no treatment (hazard ratio 0.55, 95% CI 0.35–0.86; P=0.008), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Percentage change in body weight from baseline to 24 weeks
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint is explicit, and 24-week mean weight changes were numerically more favorable with retatrutide than placebo. However, the abstract provides no statistical comparisons, confidence intervals, or prespecified success threshold for this endpoint, so superiority cannot be confirmed.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in glycated hemoglobin level from baseline to week 52
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored icodec, with an estimated between-group difference of -0.19 percentage points (95% CI, -0.36 to -0.03); the abstract explicitly states that this confirmed prespecified noninferiority (P<0.001), and superiority was also demonstrated (P=0.02).

primary_endpoint_description: Successful tracheal intubation on the first attempt
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred more often with video laryngoscopy than with direct laryngoscopy (85.1% vs. 70.8%; absolute risk difference, 14.3 percentage points; 95% CI, 9.9 to 18.7; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Death from any cause
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was all-cause mortality. Death occurred in 17.3% with high-dose hemodiafiltration versus 21.9% with high-flux hemodialysis (hazard ratio 0.77, 95% CI 0.65–0.93), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Favorable neurologic outcome at 6 months, defined as a Glasgow Outcome Scale–Extended score of 5 or higher
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 43.5% of the mild hypercapnia group versus 44.6% of the normocapnia group (relative risk 0.98, 95% CI 0.87–1.11; P=0.76), so mild hypercapnia did not demonstrate favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Imaging-based progression-free survival according to blinded assessment by an independent review committee
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored vorasidenib over placebo: median progression-free survival was 27.7 versus 11.1 months, with a hazard ratio for progression or death of 0.39 (95% CI, 0.27–0.56; P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was progression-free survival. Cilta-cel significantly reduced the risk of progression or death versus standard care (hazard ratio, 0.26; 95% CI, 0.18 to 0.38; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary endpoints of clinical remission and endoscopic response at week 12 in the two induction trials and at week 52 in the maintenance trial.
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary endpoints favored upadacitinib over placebo in U-EXCEL, U-EXCEED, and U-ENDURE, with P<0.001 for every comparison; the abstract concludes that induction and maintenance therapy was superior to placebo.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of recurrent ischemic stroke, systemic embolism, major extracranial bleeding, symptomatic intracranial hemorrhage, or vascular death within 30 days after randomization.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 2.9% with early versus 4.1% with later anticoagulation. The risk difference was -1.18 percentage points, but the 95% CI (-2.84 to 0.47) crossed the null, so favorable superiority was not established.

primary_endpoint_description: Cure rate for T. trichiura or hookworm infection with emodepside 14–21 days after treatment, measured using the Kato-Katz thick-smear technique.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome is explicitly identified and cure rates are reported for both dose-ranging trials. However, the abstract does not state the prespecified success criterion, including which emodepside dose or control comparison had to meet what statistical threshold, so overall primary-endpoint success cannot be determined.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline to week 12 in DAS28-CRP, with the primary comparison between 700 mg peresolimab and placebo
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored 700 mg peresolimab over placebo (least-squares mean changes, -2.09 vs. -0.99; difference, -1.09; 95% CI, -1.73 to -0.46; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Undetectable minimal residual disease in peripheral blood at month 15 and progression-free survival
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary endpoints favored venetoclax-obinutuzumab with or without ibrutinib over chemoimmunotherapy: undetectable minimal residual disease rates were significantly higher and progression-free survival was significantly improved (P<0.001 for these comparisons).

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was overall survival. FTD-TPI plus bevacizumab significantly improved median overall survival versus FTD-TPI alone (10.8 vs 7.5 months; hazard ratio for death, 0.61; 95% CI, 0.49–0.77; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival, with the male-donor group as the reference group
brief_rationale: The primary analysis found no significant survival difference between recipients of red cells from female versus male donors (adjusted hazard ratio for death, 0.98; 95% CI, 0.91–1.06), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline to week 16 in the time to the first prodromal symptom associated with sunlight exposure
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint improved significantly versus placebo at both dersimelagon doses: least-squares mean differences of 53.8 minutes for 100 mg (P=0.008) and 62.5 minutes for 300 mg (P=0.003), in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean number of daily premature atrial contractions
brief_rationale: Caffeinated coffee resulted in 58 versus 53 daily premature atrial contractions with caffeine avoidance (rate ratio 1.09, 95% CI 0.98–1.20; P=0.10), so the primary superiority endpoint did not reach statistical significance.

primary_endpoint_description: Death at 28 days
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was 28-day mortality. Death occurred in 6.2% of the hydrocortisone group versus 11.9% of the placebo group, an absolute difference of -5.6 percentage points (95% CI, -9.6 to -1.7; P=0.006), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: All hospitalizations for heart failure through 2 years of follow-up
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies the 2-year hospitalization endpoint as primary, but this follow-up report provides hospitalization results through 5 years rather than the prespecified 2-year primary-endpoint result.

primary_endpoint_description: Four-component composite of death from cardiovascular causes, nonfatal myocardial infarction, nonfatal stroke, or coronary revascularization.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred significantly less often with bempedoic acid than placebo (11.7% vs 13.3%; hazard ratio 0.87, 95% CI 0.79–0.96; P=0.004), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in psychological well-being, assessed with the NIH Toolbox Positive Affect and General Life Satisfaction subscales, over approximately 10 weeks.
brief_rationale: In step 1, aripiprazole augmentation improved the primary outcome significantly more than switching to bupropion (difference 2.79 points; 95% CI, 0.56 to 5.02; P=0.014), meeting the prespecified P-value threshold of 0.017 in the favorable direction.

The abstract reports that immunobridging success criteria were met and provides vaccine efficacy results, but it does not explicitly identify any endpoint as the prespecified primary endpoint or primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Local breast cancer recurrence
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was local breast cancer recurrence. At 10 years, recurrence was significantly higher with omission of radiotherapy than with radiotherapy (9.5% vs. 0.9%; hazard ratio 10.4, 95% CI 4.1–26.1; P<0.001), an unfavorable result for the omission strategy.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline at week 8 in the weekly mean daily Worst Itch Numeric Rating Scale (WI-NRS) score.
brief_rationale: Difelikefalin produced a significantly greater reduction in the primary WI-NRS endpoint than placebo (between-group difference in change, -1.6 points; 95% CI, -2.6 to -0.6; P=0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Delayed graft function, defined as initiation of dialysis during the first 7 days after kidney transplantation.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was evaluated under both noninferiority and superiority hypotheses. Hypothermia alone was inferior rather than noninferior to machine perfusion (adjusted risk ratio 1.72, 95% CI 1.35–2.17), and combination therapy was not superior to machine perfusion (risk ratio 1.09, 95% CI 0.85–1.40). Thus, the stated primary-endpoint objectives were not met.

primary_endpoint_description: At week 24, histologic remission (≤6 eosinophils per high-power field) and change from baseline in Dysphagia Symptom Questionnaire score.
brief_rationale: Weekly dupilumab met both explicitly identified primary superiority endpoints versus placebo: histologic remission was substantially higher and DSQ scores improved significantly in Parts A and B (all P<0.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Complete wound healing of B-VEC-treated versus placebo-treated wounds at 6 months
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored B-VEC: complete healing occurred in 67% of B-VEC-treated wounds versus 22% of placebo-treated wounds, a 46-percentage-point difference (95% CI, 24 to 68; P=0.002), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Antibody response at 12 months, defined as an antibody concentration of at least 200 EU/mL and at least a fourfold increase from baseline.
brief_rationale: In both adults and children, all three vaccine regimens produced significantly higher 12-month response rates than placebo (P<0.001 for every vaccine-versus-placebo comparison), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Diagnosis of clinically insignificant prostate cancer, defined as Gleason score 3+3
brief_rationale: The experimental MRI-targeted-biopsy-only strategy significantly reduced the primary outcome versus the reference strategy (0.6% vs 1.2%; relative risk 0.46, 95% CI 0.33–0.64; P<0.001), meeting favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was progression-free survival. TIL therapy significantly prolonged progression-free survival versus ipilimumab (median 7.2 vs 3.1 months; hazard ratio for progression or death, 0.50; 95% CI, 0.35–0.72; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of HBsAg below the limit of detection and HBV DNA below the limit of quantification, maintained for 24 weeks after planned bepirovirsen treatment without newly initiated antiviral medication.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome is explicitly identified and event rates are reported, including 9% to 10% with 300 mg weekly for 24 weeks. However, the abstract does not state a prespecified threshold, comparative criterion, or other rule defining primary-endpoint success, so the reported rates cannot be classified as meeting or failing that criterion.

This 3-year follow-up reports several outcomes, but the abstract does not explicitly identify any as the prespecified primary endpoint. Therefore, trial success cannot be assessed under the stated rules.

primary_endpoint_description: Percent change in lipoprotein(a) concentration from baseline to week 36, reported as the placebo-adjusted mean percent change.
brief_rationale: Olpasiran produced large, dose-dependent placebo-adjusted reductions in lipoprotein(a) at week 36, with statistically significant results for all dose groups (P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Ranked composite of death, heart transplantation, or any of 13 major complications, with event-free patients ranked by postoperative length of stay
brief_rationale: The adjusted primary analysis found no significant reduction in the likelihood of a worse outcome with methylprednisolone versus placebo (adjusted odds ratio 0.86, 95% CI 0.71–1.05; P=0.14), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) at 3 years, excluding values obtained after initiation of renal-replacement therapy
brief_rationale: The primary outcome did not show favorable superiority for discontinuing RAS inhibitors: least-squares mean eGFR was 12.6 versus 13.3 ml/min/1.73 m² (difference −0.7; 95% CI, −2.5 to 1.0; P=0.42).

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline to week 3 in the Montgomery-Åsberg Depression Rating Scale (MADRS) total score.
brief_rationale: The 25-mg group had a significantly greater favorable reduction in MADRS score than the 1-mg control group (between-group difference, -6.6; 95% CI, -10.2 to -2.9; P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion for the primary endpoint. The 10-mg comparison was not significant.

This is a follow-up report of a previous randomized trial conducted to prevent bronchopulmonary dysplasia. Although FSIQ is called the primary outcome of the follow-up assessment, the abstract does not explicitly identify or report the original trial’s prespecified primary endpoint and its success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of days alive and free of mechanical ventilation (ventilator-free days) through day 28
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome did not differ among the lower-, intermediate-, and higher-oxygen-saturation target groups (medians 20, 21, and 21 days, respectively; P=0.81), so superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Noninferiority of the day-57 neutralizing-antibody immune response in children 6 months to 5 years of age versus young adults, alongside safety and reactogenicity evaluation.
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies immune-response noninferiority as a primary objective and states that the prespecified noninferiority criteria were met in both pediatric age cohorts. It also reports no new safety concerns.

primary_endpoint_description: Good functional status at 90 days, defined as a modified Rankin Scale score of 0 to 3
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred in 46% of the thrombectomy group versus 24% of controls (adjusted rate ratio 1.81, 95% CI 1.26–2.60; P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Birth weight measured within 24 hours after birth
brief_rationale: Birth weight was explicitly identified as the primary outcome for this report. The adjusted mean difference was 19.6 g (95% CI, -10.1 to 49.2), and birth weight did not differ significantly between the LPG and biomass groups; therefore, favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Glycated hemoglobin level at 13 weeks
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored the bionic pancreas, with an adjusted between-group difference of -0.5 percentage points (95% CI, -0.6 to -0.3; P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline to week 28 in the ALS Functional Rating Scale-Revised total score among participants predicted to have faster-progressing disease.
brief_rationale: The primary analysis showed changes of -6.98 with tofersen and -8.14 with placebo, a difference of 1.2 points (95% CI, -3.2 to 5.5; P=0.97). Thus, tofersen did not demonstrate favorable superiority on the prespecified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of hypoxemia (oxygen saturation ≤93% on home oximetry), emergency department visit, hospitalization, or death
brief_rationale: For the explicitly identified primary composite endpoint, none of the three drugs showed favorable superiority versus placebo: metformin OR 0.84 (95% CI 0.66–1.09; P=0.19), ivermectin OR 1.05 (95% CI 0.76–1.45; P=0.78), and fluvoxamine OR 0.94 (95% CI 0.66–1.36; P=0.75).

primary_endpoint_description: Area under the curve for plasma C-peptide level after a mixed-meal tolerance test at 12 months after diagnosis
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint did not differ significantly between hybrid closed-loop and standard insulin therapy (adjusted difference, -0.06 pmol/mL; 95% CI, -0.14 to 0.03), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Percentage of time in the target glucose range of 70–180 mg/dL between days 155 and 168
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored open-source AID over control by an adjusted 14 percentage points (95% CI, 9.2–18.8; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death from any cause or hospitalization for heart failure
brief_rationale: The primary composite outcome occurred in 37.2% of the PCI group and 38.0% of the optimal-medical-therapy group (hazard ratio 0.99, 95% CI 0.78–1.27; P=0.96). PCI therefore did not demonstrate favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Death from any cause
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was all-cause death. Screening did not significantly reduce mortality versus control (hazard ratio 0.95, 95% CI 0.90 to 1.00; P=0.06), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Successful decongestion within 3 days after randomization, defined as absence of signs of volume overload without an indication for escalation of decongestive therapy.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred more often with acetazolamide than placebo (42.2% vs 30.5%; risk ratio 1.46, 95% CI 1.17–1.82; P<0.001), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Changes from baseline in the MDS-UPDRS total score at weeks 52 and 72
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoints showed no favorable superiority over control at either week 52 or week 72; all reported confidence intervals included no difference, week 52 P values were nonsignificant, and the trial was stopped for lack of efficacy.

primary_endpoint_description: Death from any cause within 90 days after randomization
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 42.3% of the restrictive-fluid group and 42.1% of the standard-fluid group (adjusted absolute difference, 0.1 percentage points; 95% CI, -4.7 to 4.9; P=0.96). Restrictive fluid therapy therefore did not demonstrate favorable superiority in reducing 90-day mortality.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression to anal cancer in a time-to-event analysis
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored HSIL treatment: 9 anal cancer cases occurred with treatment versus 21 with active monitoring, corresponding to a 57% lower progression rate (95% CI, 6% to 80%; log-rank P=0.03). Thus, the favorable superiority criterion was met.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival in the hormone receptor-positive cohort
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored trastuzumab deruxtecan: median progression-free survival was 10.1 versus 5.4 months with physician's-choice chemotherapy (hazard ratio for progression or death, 0.51; P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in forced vital capacity (FVC) at 12 weeks, analyzed separately by background nonuse or use of an antifibrotic agent.
brief_rationale: BI 1015550 showed favorable FVC differences versus placebo in both background-treatment strata; the 95% credible intervals excluded zero and the probabilities of superiority were 0.998 and 0.986, supporting superiority on the primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Percentage of patients in cohort 1 with a decrease of at least 0.5 log10 copies/mL in viral load by day 15
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 88% of lenacapavir-treated patients versus 17% receiving placebo, an absolute difference of 71 percentage points (95% CI, 35 to 90), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Successful intubation on the first attempt without physiological instability in the infant
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred in 50.0% of high-flow intubations versus 31.5% with standard care, with an adjusted risk difference of 17.6 percentage points (95% CI, 6.0 to 29.2), demonstrating favorable superiority.
The abstract reports safety and immunogenicity endpoints but does not explicitly identify any endpoint as the prespecified primary endpoint; therefore, primary-endpoint success cannot be assessed.

primary_endpoint_description: Event-free survival, defined as time from randomization to treatment failure (no complete remission by week 24), relapse from remission, or death from any cause, whichever occurred first.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was significantly improved with ivosidenib plus azacitidine versus placebo plus azacitidine (hazard ratio 0.33, 95% CI 0.16–0.69; P=0.002), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall response, defined as the composite of clinical cure and favorable microbiologic response, at the test-of-cure visit in the microbiologic intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: The tebipenem group had an overall response of 58.8% versus 61.6% with ertapenem; the weighted difference was -3.3 percentage points (95% CI, -9.7 to 3.2). The lower confidence bound remained above the prespecified -12.5% noninferiority margin, so the primary endpoint met the noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary outcomes at 30 days: a composite bleeding outcome (life-threatening, major, or critical-organ bleeding) and a composite cardiovascular safety outcome (myocardial injury, nonhemorrhagic stroke, peripheral arterial thrombosis, or symptomatic proximal venous thromboembolism).
brief_rationale: The primary efficacy outcome met superiority (HR 0.76; P<0.001), but the primary safety outcome did not meet the prespecified noninferiority criterion (upper one-sided 97.5% CI 1.14, exceeding 1.125; P=0.04). Because the primary outcomes had mixed results and no overall success rule is stated, the trial-level primary-endpoint result is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: Covid-19-related hospitalization within 28 days after transfusion
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred less often with convalescent plasma than with control plasma (2.9% vs 6.3%; absolute risk reduction 3.4 percentage points, 95% CI 1.0 to 5.8; P=0.005), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.
The abstract reports vaccine efficacy against Covid-19 but does not explicitly identify this or any other measure as the prespecified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Death from any cause at 10 weeks
brief_rationale: The upper boundary of the one-sided 95% CI for the mortality difference was 1.2 percentage points, within the prespecified 10-percentage-point noninferiority margin (P<0.001 for noninferiority); therefore, the primary endpoint met the success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: SLE Responder Index-4 (SRI-4) response at week 24
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was met for iberdomide 0.45 mg: SRI-4 response was 54% versus 35% with placebo, an adjusted difference of 19.4 percentage points (95% CI, 4.1 to 33.4; P=0.01), favoring iberdomide.

primary_endpoint_description: Area under the curve for RSV viral load measured by reverse-transcriptase quantitative PCR
brief_rationale: All EDP-938 regimens produced substantially lower viral-load AUCs than placebo, and the abstract explicitly concludes that all regimens were superior to placebo for lowering viral load.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was overall survival. Cemiplimab significantly improved median overall survival versus chemotherapy (12.0 vs. 8.5 months; hazard ratio for death, 0.69; 95% CI, 0.56–0.84; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Health-related quality of life measured by the EQ-5D utility score at 4 months after randomization.
brief_rationale: The cemented group had a significantly higher mean EQ-5D utility score than the uncemented group at 4 months (adjusted difference, 0.055; 95% CI, 0.009 to 0.101; P=0.02), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Modified Rankin scale score of 0 to 3 at 90 days
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred in 31.0% of the endovascular-therapy group versus 12.7% of the medical-care group (relative risk 2.43, 95% CI 1.35–4.37; P=0.002), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Level of SARS-CoV-2 spike protein–specific binding antibodies 28 days after booster vaccination.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was S-specific binding-antibody level. All booster regimens produced higher binding-antibody levels than no booster, with significantly larger increases for heterologous mRNA boosters than for the homologous booster, supporting favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Death from any cause within 90 days after randomization
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 21.8% of the BMES group and 22.0% of the saline group (difference, -0.15 percentage points; 95% CI, -3.60 to 3.30; P=0.90), so BMES did not demonstrate favorable superiority over saline.

primary_endpoint_description: Hematologic complete response at 3 months
brief_rationale: The complete response rate at 3 months was significantly higher with eltrombopag plus immunosuppressive therapy than with immunosuppressive therapy alone (22% vs 10%; odds ratio 3.2, 95% CI 1.3–7.8; P=0.01), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Vaccine efficacy against RT-PCR-confirmed Covid-19 occurring at least 7 days after the second dose
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy endpoint favored NVX-CoV2373: 14 cases occurred among vaccine recipients versus 63 with placebo, corresponding to 90.4% vaccine efficacy (95% CI, 82.9% to 94.6%; P<0.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Annualized rate of severe asthma exacerbations
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored dupilumab in the type 2 inflammatory phenotype population: 0.31 versus 0.75 severe exacerbations per year, corresponding to a 59.3% relative risk reduction (95% CI, 39.5% to 72.6%; P<0.001). Thus, the favorable superiority criterion was met.

primary_endpoint_description: Cumulative live-birth rate after up to three embryo-transfer procedures within 1 year after randomization
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred in 81.8% with conventional IVF versus 77.2% with PGT-A. The abstract states that conventional IVF was noninferior to PGT-A under the prespecified 7-percentage-point margin (P<0.001), so the primary endpoint met the trial's success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Two-year composite of reoperation for tricuspid regurgitation, progression of tricuspid regurgitation by two grades from baseline or presence of severe tricuspid regurgitation, or death.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary composite endpoint occurred less often with concomitant tricuspid annuloplasty than with mitral-valve surgery alone (3.9% vs 10.2%; relative risk 0.37, 95% CI 0.16–0.86; P=0.02), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Two primary outcomes: mean change in hemoglobin from baseline to weeks 28–52 and first occurrence of a major adverse cardiovascular event (all-cause death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, or nonfatal stroke).
brief_rationale: Both primary outcomes met their prespecified noninferiority margins: the hemoglobin difference was 0.18 g/dL (95% CI, 0.12 to 0.24) against a margin of -0.75, and the cardiovascular-event hazard ratio was 0.93 (95% CI, 0.81 to 1.07) against a margin of 1.25.

primary_endpoint_description: New stroke within 90 days (primary efficacy outcome).
brief_rationale: The primary efficacy outcome occurred in 6.0% with ticagrelor versus 7.6% with clopidogrel (hazard ratio 0.77, 95% CI 0.64–0.94; P=0.008), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Hospitalization for more than 24 hours for any cause or death within 29 days after randomization.
brief_rationale: The primary efficacy outcome occurred in 3/291 patients (1%) receiving sotrovimab versus 21/292 (7%) receiving placebo, an 85% relative risk reduction (97.24% CI, 44% to 96%; P=0.002), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Event indicating loss of asthma control by week 12, assessed for itepekimab monotherapy and itepekimab-plus-dupilumab combination therapy versus placebo.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored itepekimab monotherapy versus placebo (22% vs 41%; OR 0.42, 95% CI 0.20–0.88; P=0.02), but the combination comparison did not meet conventional statistical significance (27% vs 41%; OR 0.52, 95% CI 0.26–1.06; P=0.07). Because these primary comparisons had mixed results and no overall success rule is stated, trial-level primary-endpoint success is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: Decrease of at least 2 points in the SAF-A score without worsening of fibrosis at 24 weeks.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred significantly more often with lanifibranor 1200 mg than with placebo (55% vs. 33%; P=0.007), meeting the favorable superiority criterion. The 800-mg comparison was not significant.

primary_endpoint_description: Comprehensive Complication Index score incorporating all complications over 6 months of follow-up
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was nearly identical between immediate and postponed drainage (mean 57 vs 58; mean difference −1, 95% CI −12 to 10; P=0.90), so immediate drainage did not demonstrate superiority.

The abstract reports vaccine efficacy against symptomatic Covid-19 and other outcomes, but it does not explicitly identify any endpoint as the prespecified primary endpoint; therefore, the reported efficacy result cannot be assigned as the primary-endpoint result.
The abstract reports efficacy against laboratory-confirmed Covid-19 and safety as trial endpoints but does not explicitly identify either as the prespecified primary endpoint or primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Three ranked primary outcomes at 335 days: net adverse clinical events; major adverse cardiac or cerebral events; and major or clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding.
brief_rationale: Both clinical-event primary outcomes met their noninferiority criteria (P<0.001 and P=0.001), and the bleeding primary outcome favored abbreviated therapy and met the superiority criterion (P<0.001). Thus, all three ranked primary outcomes met their respective success criteria.

primary_endpoint_description: Absolute change from baseline through week 8 in percentage of predicted FEV1 in the elexacaftor-tezacaftor-ivacaftor group.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint improved by 3.7 percentage points from baseline (95% CI, 2.8 to 4.6; P<0.001), demonstrating a statistically significant favorable effect.

primary_endpoint_description: Disease-free survival according to the investigator's assessment
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was significantly improved with pembrolizumab versus placebo (hazard ratio for recurrence or death, 0.68; 95% CI, 0.53–0.87; two-sided P=0.002), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Disease progression within 15 days after randomization, defined as a composite of hospital admission for any reason, seeking emergency or urgent care, or death without hospitalization.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 30.0% of the convalescent-plasma group versus 31.9% of the placebo group, with a posterior probability of superiority of 0.68. The abstract concludes that convalescent plasma did not prevent disease progression, so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Incident HIV infection
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored cabotegravir: 13 infections versus 39 with TDF-FTC (hazard ratio 0.34, 95% CI 0.18–0.62). The trial was stopped early for efficacy and concluded that cabotegravir was superior, thereby meeting the noninferiority objective.

primary_endpoint_description: Primary objectives were vaccine safety in adolescents and noninferiority of adolescents' immune response compared with young adults.
brief_rationale: The neutralizing-antibody geometric mean titer ratio was 1.08 (95% CI, 0.94–1.24), and the serologic-response difference was 0.2 percentage points (95% CI, −1.8 to 2.4); the abstract explicitly states that the noninferiority criterion was met. Safety was reported as acceptable, with no related serious adverse events.

primary_endpoint_description: Organ support-free days through day 21, measured on an ordinal scale combining in-hospital death and days free of cardiovascular or respiratory organ support among survivors to discharge.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome did not favor therapeutic-dose anticoagulation: median organ support-free days were 1 versus 4 with usual-care thromboprophylaxis (adjusted proportional odds ratio 0.83; 95% credible interval 0.67–1.03). The trial met its prespecified futility criterion rather than demonstrating superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Reduction of at least 30% in the Oswestry Disability Index score during the 2 years after surgery
brief_rationale: Decompression alone achieved the primary outcome in 71.4% versus 72.9% with fusion; the difference was -1.4 percentage points (95% CI, -12.2 to 9.4), with the lower bound above the prespecified -15-point noninferiority margin. The per-protocol analysis also demonstrated noninferiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Venous thromboembolism detected by mandatory venography of the operated leg or objective confirmation of symptomatic events.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy outcome occurred in 13%, 5%, and 4% of patients receiving abelacimab 30, 75, and 150 mg, respectively, versus 22% with enoxaparin. The 30-mg regimen met noninferiority and the 75-mg and 150-mg regimens met superiority criteria (P<0.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Week 48 HIV-1 viral load below 400 copies/mL, assessed with the FDA snapshot algorithm, for both factorial treatment comparisons.
brief_rationale: Both factorial comparisons met the prespecified 12-percentage-point noninferiority criterion: dolutegravir was noninferior to darunavir (difference −1.5 percentage points; 95% CI, −6.7 to 3.7), and tenofovir was noninferior to zidovudine (difference 2.7 percentage points; 95% CI, −2.6 to 7.9).

primary_endpoint_description: Covid-19-related hospitalization or death from any cause by day 29
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred in 2.1% of the bamlanivimab-etesevimab group versus 7.0% of the placebo group (absolute risk difference, -4.8 percentage points; 95% CI, -7.4 to -2.3; P<0.001), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Virologically confirmed mild, moderate, or severe SARS-CoV-2 infection beginning at least 7 days after the second injection among participants seronegative at baseline.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 10 vaccine recipients versus 96 placebo recipients, yielding 89.7% vaccine efficacy (95% CI, 80.2% to 94.6%), demonstrating favorable superiority over placebo.

primary_endpoint_description: Alternate primary endpoints of imaging-based progression-free survival and overall survival
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified alternate primary endpoints significantly favored 177Lu-PSMA-617 plus standard care: imaging-based progression-free survival (HR 0.40; 99.2% CI 0.29–0.57; P<0.001) and overall survival (HR 0.62; 95% CI 0.52–0.74; P<0.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Occurrence of death or respiratory failure through day 28
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 18.1% of the tofacitinib group versus 29.0% of the placebo group (risk ratio 0.63, 95% CI 0.41–0.97; P=0.04), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Persistent infection with the initial causative bacteria within 2 years after completion of antibiotic therapy
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority criterion required the upper bound of the 95% CI for the absolute risk difference (6 weeks minus 12 weeks) to be no greater than 10 percentage points. The observed difference was 8.7 points with a 95% CI of 1.8 to 15.6; because the upper bound exceeded 10, noninferiority was not shown.

primary_endpoint_description: Death during the neonatal period (first 28 days of life) and death during the first 72 hours of life.
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies two primary outcomes. Immediate kangaroo mother care significantly reduced 28-day mortality (RR 0.75, 95% CI 0.64–0.89; P=0.001), but the reduction in 72-hour mortality was not significant (RR 0.77, 95% CI 0.58–1.04; P=0.09). Because results were mixed and the overall success rule for the two primary outcomes is not stated, trial success is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: Occurrence of ischemic stroke (including transient ischemic attack with positive neuroimaging) or systemic embolism
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred less often with left atrial appendage occlusion than without occlusion (4.8% vs 7.0%; hazard ratio 0.67, 95% CI 0.53–0.85; P=0.001), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary week-16 endpoints: PASI 90 response and Investigator's Global Assessment score of 0 or 1.
brief_rationale: Both primary endpoints met the prespecified -10 percentage-point noninferiority criterion and subsequently demonstrated superiority of bimekizumab over adalimumab (P<0.001 for both noninferiority and superiority).

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival by blinded independent central review among patients without brain metastases
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored sacituzumab govitecan: median progression-free survival was 5.6 versus 1.7 months, with a hazard ratio for progression or death of 0.41 (95% CI, 0.32–0.52; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline to week 24 in pulmonary vascular resistance
brief_rationale: Both sotatercept doses produced statistically significant favorable reductions in pulmonary vascular resistance versus placebo at week 24 (0.3 mg/kg: difference −145.8 dyn·sec·cm⁻5, P=0.003; 0.7 mg/kg: difference −239.5 dyn·sec·cm⁻5, P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of new infection, kidney dysfunction, or death between days 3 and 15 after treatment initiation
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 29.7% of the targeted-albumin group and 30.2% of the standard-care group, with no significant favorable difference (adjusted odds ratio 0.98, 95% CI 0.71–1.33; P=0.87). Thus, superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Clinical status at day 28 on a 7-category ordinal scale ranging from discharged or ready for discharge to death
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome did not show significantly better clinical status with tocilizumab versus placebo (between-group difference −1.0, 95% CI −2.5 to 0; P=0.31), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline to week 5 in the Positive and Negative Syndrome Scale (PANSS) total score
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored xanomeline-trospium over placebo: mean changes were -17.4 versus -5.9 points, with a least-squares mean difference of -11.6 points (95% CI, -16.1 to -7.1; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of nonanastomotic biliary strictures within 6 months after transplantation
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred less often with hypothermic oxygenated machine perfusion than with static cold storage (6% vs 18%; risk ratio 0.36, 95% CI 0.14–0.94; P=0.03), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival assessed by an independent review committee according to RECIST version 1.1
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored both experimental regimens over sunitinib: lenvatinib plus pembrolizumab (HR 0.39; P<0.001) and lenvatinib plus everolimus (HR 0.65; P<0.001), demonstrating significantly longer progression-free survival.

primary_endpoint_description: Two primary endpoints: remission at week 26 (BVAS 0 with no glucocorticoid use in the previous 4 weeks) and sustained remission at both weeks 26 and 52.
brief_rationale: Both primary endpoints met the prespecified 20-percentage-point noninferiority criterion (P<0.001 for each). Week-26 remission was not superior, while sustained remission at week 52 was also superior (P=0.007).

primary_endpoint_description: Primary safety endpoints were vaccine-related serious adverse events, severe local or systemic adverse events, and laboratory adverse events; the primary efficacy endpoint was chronic HCV infection (persistent viremia for 6 months).
brief_rationale: The primary efficacy endpoint was negative: chronic HCV infection was not reduced versus placebo. However, several primary safety endpoints were also specified, not all were fully reported, and no overall rule for success across the safety and efficacy endpoints was stated.

primary_endpoint_description: Difference between inhaled treprostinil and placebo in change from baseline to week 16 in peak 6-minute walk distance
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy endpoint favored inhaled treprostinil, with a least-squares mean between-group difference of 31.12 m (95% CI, 16.85 to 45.39; P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Severe respiratory disease, defined as a respiratory rate of at least 30 breaths per minute, oxygen saturation below 93% on ambient air, or both.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred less often with convalescent plasma than placebo (16% vs 31%; relative risk 0.52, 95% CI 0.29–0.94; P=0.03), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death or neurodevelopmental impairment at 22 to 26 months of age, corrected for prematurity
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 50.1% of the higher-threshold group and 49.8% of the lower-threshold group (adjusted relative risk 1.00, 95% CI 0.92–1.10; P=0.93). Thus, the higher transfusion threshold did not demonstrate favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival from the time of randomization
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was overall survival. Median overall survival was significantly longer with CC-486 than with placebo (24.7 vs. 14.8 months; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Treatment success at 12 months, defined as freedom from initial procedure failure or atrial arrhythmia recurrence after a 90-day blanking period.
brief_rationale: The primary efficacy endpoint favored cryoballoon ablation: 12-month treatment success was 74.6% versus 45.0% with drug therapy (P<0.001, log-rank test), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: For polypill alone and polypill plus aspirin: composite of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, stroke, resuscitated cardiac arrest, heart failure, or revascularization; for aspirin alone: composite of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, or stroke.
brief_rationale: Three primary comparisons had mixed results: polypill plus aspirin favored treatment (HR 0.69, 95% CI 0.50–0.97), aspirin alone did not (HR 0.86, 95% CI 0.67–1.10), and polypill alone was borderline (HR 0.79, 95% CI 0.63–1.00). The abstract does not state an overall success rule across these primary comparisons.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of a first heart-failure event (hospitalization or urgent visit for heart failure) or death from cardiovascular causes
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred less often with omecamtiv mecarbil than with placebo (37.0% vs 39.1%; hazard ratio 0.92, 95% CI 0.86–0.99; P=0.03), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Neonatal death alone; stillbirth or neonatal death; and possible maternal bacterial infection.
brief_rationale: Both mortality primary outcomes showed significant favorable superiority with dexamethasone (RR 0.84, P=0.03; RR 0.88, P=0.04). For maternal bacterial infection, the 95% CI upper bound for the relative risk was 1.03, below the prespecified noninferiority margin of 1.25. Thus, all three primary outcomes met their stated criteria.

primary_endpoint_description: 90-day all-cause mortality
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored interferon beta-1b plus lopinavir-ritonavir over placebo: 28% versus 44% mortality, with an adaptive-design-adjusted risk difference of -19 percentage points and one-sided P=0.024, meeting the prespecified one-sided threshold of 0.025.

primary_endpoint_description: Three primary outcomes: diarrhea lasting more than 5 days and number of diarrheal stools (noninferiority), and vomiting within 30 minutes after zinc administration (superiority).
brief_rationale: Both lower zinc doses met the prespecified noninferiority margins for prolonged diarrhea and stool count versus 20 mg, and each significantly reduced vomiting within 30 minutes. Thus, all three primary outcomes met their respective success criteria.

The abstract explicitly identifies overall survival as a key secondary endpoint and states that the primary endpoint was reported previously, but it does not explicitly identify that primary endpoint. Imaging-based progression-free survival cannot be assumed to be primary from its prominence.

primary_endpoint_description: Rate of decline in the total ALS Functional Rating Scale–Revised (ALSFRS-R) score through 24 weeks
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored sodium phenylbutyrate-taurursodiol: mean ALSFRS-R change was -1.24 versus -1.66 points per month with placebo, a favorable difference of 0.42 points per month (95% CI, 0.03 to 0.81; P=0.03), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of cardiovascular death or hospitalization for worsening heart failure
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred less often with empagliflozin than placebo (19.4% vs 24.7%; hazard ratio 0.75, 95% CI 0.65–0.86; P<0.001), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Two primary outcomes: (1) a composite of cardiovascular death, stroke, or hospitalization for worsening heart failure or acute coronary syndrome; and (2) number of nights spent in the hospital per year.
brief_rationale: The first primary outcome favored early rhythm control significantly (HR 0.79, 96% CI 0.66–0.94; P=0.005), whereas the second primary outcome did not differ significantly (P=0.23). Because the abstract does not specify the overall success rule for these mixed primary-outcome results, overall primary-endpoint success is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: Primary efficacy endpoint: composite of stroke or systemic embolism; primary safety endpoint: ISTH-defined major bleeding.
brief_rationale: Edoxaban showed favorable superiority for the primary efficacy endpoint (HR 0.34, 95% CI 0.19–0.61; P<0.001), while major bleeding was numerically higher for the primary safety endpoint (HR 1.87, 95% CI 0.90–3.89; P=0.09). The abstract does not state an overall success rule combining these two primary endpoints or a prespecified criterion for safety.

primary_endpoint_description: Percentage of time that glucose was in the target range of 70 to 180 mg/dL, measured by continuous glucose monitoring
brief_rationale: The closed-loop group had a favorably greater percentage of time in the target glucose range than the control group, with an adjusted difference of 11 percentage points (95% CI, 7 to 14; P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Primary effectiveness endpoint: target-lesion primary patency through 6 months. Primary safety endpoint: serious adverse events involving the arteriovenous access circuit within 30 days.
brief_rationale: The drug-coated balloon was superior for 6-month target-lesion primary patency (82.2% vs 59.5%; difference 22.8 percentage points, 95% CI 12.8 to 32.8; P<0.001) and met the 7.5-percentage-point noninferiority criterion for the primary safety endpoint (difference -0.2 percentage points, 95% CI -5.5 to 5.0; P=0.002 for noninferiority). Both explicitly identified primary endpoints met their success criteria.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was overall survival. Median overall survival was significantly longer with azacitidine plus venetoclax than with control (14.7 vs 9.6 months; hazard ratio for death, 0.66; 95% CI, 0.52–0.85; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator's global assessment (IGA) status of clear or almost clear at week 6
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy outcome occurred in 28% and 23% of patients receiving roflumilast 0.3% and 0.15%, respectively, versus 8% with vehicle; both comparisons favored roflumilast and were statistically significant (P<0.001 and P=0.004).

primary_endpoint_description: Treatment failure during the 3-day course of placebo or amoxicillin
brief_rationale: The placebo test regimen had a treatment-failure rate 2.3 percentage points higher than amoxicillin (95% CI, 0.9 to 3.7), and the abstract explicitly states that this did not meet the prespecified 1.75-percentage-point noninferiority margin.

primary_endpoint_description: Baseline-adjusted iohexol-measured GFR after 3 years of treatment plus a 2-month washout period
brief_rationale: The primary outcome showed essentially no favorable difference between allopurinol and placebo after washout (between-group difference, 0.001 ml/min/1.73 m²; 95% CI, -1.9 to 1.9; P=0.99), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death from any cause or invasive bacterial disease within 24 weeks (primary analysis), also assessed within 48 weeks after randomization
brief_rationale: Systematic empirical tuberculosis treatment was not superior to test-guided treatment for the primary composite endpoint at 24 weeks (adjusted hazard ratio 0.95, 95% CI 0.63–1.44); no superiority was seen at 48 weeks either.

The abstract reports a favorable final overall-survival analysis and mentions earlier metastasis-free survival results, but it does not explicitly identify either measure as the prespecified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Clinical status on day 14, assessed on a 7-point ordinal scale.
brief_rationale: After adjustment for baseline clinical status, the day-14 clinical-status distribution was similar between the 10-day and 5-day remdesivir groups (P=0.14); thus, the primary superiority endpoint did not show a significant difference.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to recovery, defined as hospital discharge or hospitalization for infection-control purposes only
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored remdesivir: median recovery was 10 versus 15 days with placebo, with a recovery rate ratio of 1.29 (95% CI, 1.12–1.49; P<0.001). The abstract concludes that remdesivir was superior to placebo in shortening recovery time.

primary_endpoint_description: Death from any cause within 30 days after randomization
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 8.9% with urgent endoscopy versus 6.6% with early endoscopy (difference 2.3 percentage points; 95% CI, -2.3 to 6.9). Urgent endoscopy did not achieve favorable superiority in reducing 30-day mortality.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, or hospitalization for unstable angina, heart failure, or resuscitated cardiac arrest
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary composite outcome was evaluated, but the invasive strategy did not demonstrate a favorable reduction versus the conservative strategy; the 5-year difference was -1.8 percentage points (95% CI, -4.7 to 1.0), and the authors found no evidence of reduced ischemic cardiovascular events.

primary_endpoint_description: Risk of death or myocardial infarction
brief_rationale: The abstract identifies the trial's primary analysis as death or myocardial infarction and reports no significant difference between invasive and conservative strategies; therefore, favorable superiority was not demonstrated. The SAQ outcome was a secondary trial objective and does not alter this assessment.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of acute limb ischemia, major amputation for vascular causes, myocardial infarction, ischemic stroke, or death from cardiovascular causes
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy outcome was significantly less frequent with rivaroxaban plus aspirin than with placebo plus aspirin (3-year incidence 17.3% vs 19.9%; hazard ratio 0.85, 95% CI 0.76–0.96; P=0.009), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Percentage of patients with at least a 33% reduction from baseline in transfusion burden during weeks 13–24 and a reduction of at least 2 red-cell units over that 12-week interval.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored luspatercept over placebo (21.4% vs. 4.5%) with P<0.001, meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Death from any cause at 28 days
brief_rationale: The hypothesized conservative-oxygen strategy did not improve the primary outcome: 28-day mortality was 34.3% with conservative oxygen versus 26.5% with liberal oxygen (difference 7.8 percentage points; 95% CI, -4.8 to 20.6). The trial was stopped early for safety concerns and low likelihood of a significant primary-outcome difference.

primary_endpoint_description: Reduction in systolic blood pressure at 24 months
brief_rationale: The intervention produced a 5.2 mm Hg greater reduction in systolic blood pressure than usual care at 24 months (95% CI, 3.2 to 7.1; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion for the explicitly identified primary outcome.

The abstract reports significantly lower lung-cancer mortality with CT screening, but it does not explicitly identify lung-cancer mortality—or any other outcome—as the prespecified primary endpoint. The phrase “primary analysis” refers to the male analysis population, not to an endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Two primary endpoints: freedom from recurrence of atrial fibrillation after a 2-week blanking period and total atrial fibrillation burden during 6 months of follow-up.
brief_rationale: Both primary endpoints favored abstinence and were statistically significant: recurrence was less frequent and time to recurrence longer (hazard ratio 0.55, 95% CI 0.36–0.84; P=0.005), and atrial fibrillation burden was lower (0.5% vs 1.2%; P=0.01).

primary_endpoint_description: BILAG-based Composite Lupus Assessment (BICLA) response at week 52
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred in 47.8% of patients receiving anifrolumab versus 31.5% receiving placebo, a favorable difference of 16.3 percentage points (95% CI, 6.3 to 26.3; P=0.001), demonstrating superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival among the first 480 patients who underwent randomization
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored the tucatinib combination, with a hazard ratio for progression or death of 0.54 (95% CI, 0.42–0.71; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of major cardiovascular events: ischemic stroke, myocardial infarction, new symptoms leading to urgent coronary or carotid revascularization, or cardiovascular death.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified composite primary endpoint occurred less often with the lower LDL target than with the higher target (8.5% vs 10.9%; adjusted hazard ratio 0.78, 95% CI 0.61–0.98; P=0.04), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Percentage of patients achieving at least a 3-point decrease from baseline at week 12 in the weekly mean 24-hour Worst Itching Intensity Numerical Rating Scale score.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored difelikefalin: the imputed response rate was 49.1% versus 27.9% with placebo (P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator-assessed progression-free survival for each fixed-duration regimen versus continuous ibrutinib
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies investigator-assessed progression-free survival as the primary endpoint and specifies a hazard-ratio noninferiority margin of 1.608. Both fixed-duration comparisons met the noninferiority criterion, with upper confidence limits of 1.41 and 1.32, respectively.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of any stroke or death from randomization through 44 days, or ipsilateral ischemic stroke during subsequent follow-up through 4 years
brief_rationale: The publication reports two parallel superiority trials using the same primary outcome. Stenting significantly reduced primary-outcome events versus medical therapy (2.8% vs 6.0%; P=0.02), whereas endarterectomy did not (3.7% vs 5.3%; P=0.24). Because the two trial-specific primary results are mixed and no combined success rule is stated, a single overall label is indeterminable.

primary_endpoint_description: Combined virologic response (HDV RNA below detection or decrease of at least 2 log10 IU/mL from baseline) and normalization of ALT at week 24.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was reported in 47% of the combination group and 70% of the monotherapy group, but the abstract provides no prespecified threshold, comparison criterion, or statistical test defining trial success.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of stroke, systemic embolism, or new covert embolic stroke (at least one new infarct measuring ≥15 mm on MRI) at 3 years
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 5 patients receiving rivaroxaban and 9 receiving aspirin (relative risk 0.56, 95% CI 0.19–1.65; P=0.28). Rivaroxaban therefore did not achieve statistically significant superiority over aspirin.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of solicited and unsolicited adverse events (side-effect profile).
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was explicitly identified and safety findings were reported descriptively, including transient reactogenicity and no serious vaccine-related adverse events. However, the abstract does not state a prespecified criterion or threshold defining success for this safety endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary endpoints of IGA 0/1 response and PASI 90 response at week 16
brief_rationale: Both coprimary endpoints favored icotrokinra over placebo at week 16: IGA 0/1 response was 65% versus 8%, and PASI 90 response was 50% versus 4% (P<0.001 for both comparisons).

primary_endpoint_description: Change in the KOOS pain subscore from baseline to 3 months, adjusted for trial site, baseline KOOS pain subscore, and radiographic grade
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was explicitly identified. The reported between-group 98.3% confidence intervals all included 0, and the conclusion states that adding physical therapy or adherence-promoting text messages was not superior to home exercise alone; therefore, the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Two primary endpoints at 7 years: (1) a nonhierarchical composite of death, stroke, or procedure-, valve-, or heart-failure-related rehospitalization; and (2) a hierarchical composite of death, disabling stroke, nondisabling stroke, and related rehospitalization days analyzed by win ratio.
brief_rationale: Neither primary endpoint showed significant superiority of TAVR over surgery: the first endpoint difference was -2.6 percentage points (95% CI, -9.0 to 3.7), and the second endpoint win ratio was 1.04 (95% CI, 0.84 to 1.30).

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival assessed by blinded independent central review
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored sacituzumab govitecan: median progression-free survival was 9.7 versus 6.9 months, with a hazard ratio for progression or death of 0.62 (95% CI, 0.50–0.77; P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Dual primary end points of blinded-independent-review-assessed progression-free survival and overall survival.
brief_rationale: Both dual primary end points significantly favored disitamab vedotin plus toripalimab over chemotherapy: progression-free survival HR 0.36 (95% CI, 0.28–0.46; P<0.001) and overall survival HR 0.54 (95% CI, 0.41–0.73; P<0.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Metastasis-free survival in the enzalutamide-plus-leuprolide group compared with the leuprolide-alone group.
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies metastasis-free survival as the primary endpoint but only refers generally to previously observed longer metastasis-free survival; it does not provide the primary analysis estimate, statistical result, or stated success criterion needed to assess it definitively.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to first clinical-worsening event, defined as a composite of death from any cause, unplanned hospitalization for worsening pulmonary arterial hypertension, atrial septostomy, lung transplantation, or deterioration in exercise-testing performance due to pulmonary arterial hypertension.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored sotatercept: events occurred in 10.6% versus 36.9% with placebo, with a hazard ratio of 0.24 (95% CI, 0.14–0.41; P<0.001), demonstrating significant favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: RSV-associated medically attended lower respiratory infection through 150 days after injection
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy endpoint occurred less often with clesrovimab than placebo (2.6% vs 6.5%), corresponding to 60.4% efficacy (95% CI, 44.1% to 71.9%; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in seated systolic blood pressure from baseline to week 12
brief_rationale: Both baxdrostat doses produced significantly greater reductions in the explicitly identified primary endpoint versus placebo: placebo-corrected differences were -8.7 mm Hg and -9.8 mm Hg, with P<0.001 for both comparisons.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, stroke, systemic embolism, coronary revascularization, or acute limb ischemia.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy outcome occurred more often with aspirin than placebo (16.9% vs. 12.1%; adjusted hazard ratio 1.53, 95% CI 1.07–2.18; P=0.02). This statistically significant result favored placebo and indicated harm from aspirin, so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of hospitalization for influenza or pneumonia from 14 days after vaccination through May 31 of the following year.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred less often with high-dose vaccine than with standard-dose vaccine (0.26% vs 0.34%), with relative vaccine effectiveness of 23.7% (95% CI, 6.6% to 37.7%); the confidence interval excluded no benefit and favored high-dose vaccination.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline to week 24 in hemoglobin-adjusted diffusing capacity of the lungs for carbon monoxide (DLCO), expressed as a percentage of predicted value.
brief_rationale: At week 24, DLCO increased by 9.8 percentage points with molgramostim versus 3.8 with placebo, for a favorable treatment difference of 6.0 percentage points (95% CI, 2.5 to 9.4; P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Excellent functional outcome, defined as a modified Rankin scale score of 0 to 1 at 90 days.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy outcome favored tirofiban over placebo (65.9% vs 54.9%; risk ratio 1.20, 95% CI 1.07–1.34; P=0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in glycated hemoglobin level at 52 weeks
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was tested for noninferiority with a margin of 0.4 percentage points. The estimated efsitora–glargine difference was -0.03 percentage points (95% CI, -0.18 to 0.12), satisfying the noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline to week 40 in glycated hemoglobin level
brief_rationale: All three orforglipron doses were superior to placebo for the explicitly identified primary endpoint, with placebo-adjusted reductions of 0.83 to 1.07 percentage points and P<0.001 for all comparisons.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary endpoints were relative change in body weight and achievement of at least 5% body-weight reduction from baseline to week 68 with cagrilintide–semaglutide versus placebo.
brief_rationale: Both coprimary endpoints favored cagrilintide–semaglutide over placebo: mean weight change was −20.4% versus −3.0% (difference, −17.3 percentage points; 95% CI, −18.1 to −16.6; P<0.001), and significantly more participants achieved at least 5% weight loss (P<0.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Graft-versus-host disease–free, relapse-free survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was significantly longer with experimental prophylaxis than with standard prophylaxis (median 26.2 vs 6.4 months; hazard ratio for GVHD, relapse, or death, 0.42; 95% CI, 0.27–0.66; log-rank P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Infant birth weight
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was birth weight. Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole did not significantly increase birth weight versus placebo (mean difference, 20 g; 95% CI, -43 to 83; P=0.53), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was overall survival. Tarlatamab significantly prolonged survival versus chemotherapy (median 13.6 vs. 8.3 months; hazard ratio for death, 0.60; 95% CI, 0.47–0.77; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was overall survival. Trastuzumab deruxtecan significantly prolonged overall survival versus ramucirumab plus paclitaxel (median 14.7 vs. 11.4 months; hazard ratio for death, 0.70; 95% CI, 0.55–0.90; P=0.004), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Disease-free survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint, disease-free survival, was significantly longer with structured exercise than with health education (hazard ratio 0.72, 95% CI 0.55–0.94; P=0.02), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Two primary endpoints: objective response and progression-free survival by blinded independent central review for EC+mFOLFOX6 versus standard care.
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary endpoints favored EC+mFOLFOX6: objective response was previously significant (odds ratio 2.44; one-sided P<0.001), and progression-free survival was significantly longer (hazard ratio 0.53; 95% CI 0.41–0.68; P<0.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Two primary endpoints at week 32: percentage change in body weight from baseline and the proportion of participants achieving at least 5% weight reduction.
brief_rationale: Both mazdutide doses produced greater mean percentage weight loss and higher rates of at least 5% weight reduction than placebo at week 32, with P<0.001 for all comparisons. Thus, both explicitly identified primary superiority endpoints were met in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean change from baseline to week 24 in percentage of predicted forced vital capacity (FVC).
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was 5 percentage points. Methotrexate was reported as noninferior to prednisone, with an adjusted between-group difference of -1.17 percentage points (95% CI, -4.27 to 1.93), satisfying the margin.

primary_endpoint_description: Annualized rate of adjudicated pulmonary exacerbations over 52 weeks
brief_rationale: Both brensocatib doses significantly reduced the explicitly identified primary endpoint versus placebo: rate ratios were 0.79 (adjusted P=0.004) for 10 mg and 0.81 (adjusted P=0.005) for 25 mg, with both 95% confidence intervals excluding 1 in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Resolution of mpox lesions, measured as the number of days after randomization
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed a median time to lesion resolution of 7 days with tecovirimat versus 8 days with placebo, but the favorable difference was not statistically significant (hazard ratio 1.13; 95% CI, 0.97–1.31; P=0.14). Thus, superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: First recurrence of an atrial tachyarrhythmia between day 91 and day 365 after ablation
brief_rationale: PFA met the prespecified noninferiority criterion versus cryoballoon ablation: recurrence was 37.1% versus 50.7%, with a between-group difference of -13.6 percentage points (95% CI, -26.9 to -0.3) against a 20-percentage-point noninferiority margin (P<0.001 for noninferiority).

primary_endpoint_description: Placebo-adjusted time-averaged percent change from baseline in serum lipoprotein(a) concentration from day 60 to day 180.
brief_rationale: The pooled 400-mg lepodisiran groups had a placebo-adjusted reduction of 93.9 percentage points (95% CI, 92.5 to 95.1 percentage points lower); the confidence interval excluded no difference and favored lepodisiran.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to first major adverse cardiovascular event, defined as a composite of cardiovascular death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, or nonfatal stroke.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored oral semaglutide over placebo (12.0% vs 13.8%; hazard ratio 0.86, 95% CI 0.77–0.96; P=0.006), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Major or clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding
brief_rationale: Both abelacimab doses significantly reduced the primary bleeding endpoint versus rivaroxaban (hazard ratios 0.38 and 0.31; P<0.001 for both), meeting favorable superiority criteria.

primary_endpoint_description: Device failure, defined as a composite of infectious (bloodstream or local) or noninfectious (thrombosis, breakage, or occlusion) complications over 8 weeks.
brief_rationale: Neither experimental PICC demonstrated favorable superiority over standard polyurethane for the primary outcome: hydrophobic versus standard risk difference −0.2 percentage points (95% CI, −3.7 to 3.2; P=0.89) and chlorhexidine versus standard 3.8 percentage points (95% CI, −0.1 to 7.8; P=0.06), with the latter numerically favoring standard polyurethane.

primary_endpoint_description: Per-protocol invasive disease-free survival comparing omission of axillary surgery with sentinel-lymph-node biopsy
brief_rationale: The 5-year invasive disease-free survival rate with surgery omission was 91.9%, exceeding the required 85%, and the hazard ratio was 0.91 with an upper 95% CI limit of 1.14, below the prespecified noninferiority margin of 1.271. The primary noninferiority criterion was met.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival, defined by progression to active multiple myeloma or death
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored daratumumab: the risk of progression or death was 51% lower than with active monitoring (hazard ratio 0.49, 95% CI 0.36–0.67; P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Number and severity of adverse events in stages A and B, and blood-stage parasitemia greater than 100 P. falciparum parasites/mL after GA2-infected mosquito bites in stage A and after controlled human malaria infection in stage B.
brief_rationale: The abstract identifies several primary safety and parasitemia endpoints, but does not state an overall success rule.
