It reports similar adverse events and favorable stage B protection with GA2, while not adequately reporting the stage A parasitemia result or a prespecified statistical criterion for overall success.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of nonfatal stroke, nonfatal myocardial infarction, treatment or hospitalization for heart failure, or death from cardiovascular causes
brief_rationale: The primary composite outcome occurred less often with intensive treatment than with standard treatment (hazard ratio 0.79, 95% CI 0.69–0.90; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Complete abortion
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was 3.0 percentage points. Complete abortion occurred in 95.2% of the early-start group and 95.3% of the standard group, with an absolute difference of -0.1 percentage points (95% CI, -2.4 to 2.1); the lower confidence bound remained above the -3.0-point margin, satisfying noninferiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline to 6 months in patient-reported hip pain and function assessed by the Oxford Hip Score
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome improved by 15.9 points with total hip replacement versus 4.5 points with resistance training, for a favorable between-group difference of 11.4 points (95% CI, 8.9 to 14.0; P<0.001), demonstrating superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary endpoints: percentage change in body weight and change in WOMAC pain score from baseline to week 68.
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary endpoints significantly favored semaglutide over placebo: body weight changed by -13.7% versus -3.2%, and WOMAC pain score by -41.7 versus -27.5 points (P<0.001 for both).

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in the 24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio at month 9.
brief_rationale: At month 9, the adjusted geometric mean urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio was 38.3% lower with iptacopan than with placebo (95% CI, 26.0% to 48.6%; two-sided P<0.001), demonstrating significant benefit on the explicitly identified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of angioedema attacks per month from week 1 through week 16
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint numerically favored both NTLA-2002 doses over placebo, with estimated attack-rate reductions of 75% and 77%. However, the abstract does not report a prespecified superiority threshold, hypothesis-test result, or treatment-effect confidence interval sufficient to determine whether the primary endpoint met the trial's success criterion.

The abstract reports prespecified noninferiority criteria for immunogenicity and their results, but it does not explicitly identify an endpoint as the trial's primary endpoint or primary outcome. References to the 'primary series' describe the vaccination schedule, not endpoint status.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline to day 3 in the Wang bronchiolitis clinical score
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored ziresovir: the score reduction was significantly greater than with placebo (between-group difference, -0.8 points; 95% CI, -1.3 to -0.3; P=0.002), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Pathological complete response and event-free survival
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies pathological complete response and event-free survival as the primary endpoints and states that adding pembrolizumab produced significant improvements in both. Although this publication focuses on secondary overall survival, both identified primary endpoints met favorable superiority criteria.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary end points of disease-free survival and overall survival in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: The prespecified success rule required either disease-free survival or overall survival to be significantly longer with pembrolizumab. Disease-free survival was significantly longer with pembrolizumab than with observation (hazard ratio, 0.73; 95% CI, 0.59 to 0.90; P=0.003), so the trial met its success criterion.
The abstract reports final 10-year overall-survival and melanoma-specific-survival results but does not explicitly identify any endpoint as the prespecified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: The two primary endpoints were overall survival and blinded independent central review–assessed progression-free survival for durvalumab versus placebo.
brief_rationale: Durvalumab significantly improved both primary endpoints versus placebo: overall survival (HR 0.73, 98.321% CI 0.54–0.98; P=0.01) and progression-free survival (HR 0.76, 97.195% CI 0.59–0.98; P=0.02).

primary_endpoint_description: Percentage change from baseline in body-mass index (BMI) at week 56
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored liraglutide: mean BMI changed by -5.8% with liraglutide versus +1.6% with placebo, an estimated difference of -7.4 percentage points (95% CI, -11.6 to -3.2; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean change from baseline in monthly migraine days during weeks 1 through 4 for Lu AG09222 750 mg versus placebo
brief_rationale: The 750-mg group had a greater reduction in monthly migraine days than placebo (between-group difference, -2.0 days; 95% CI, -3.8 to -0.3; P=0.02), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Time-to-event composite of cardiovascular death or nonfatal myocardial infarction
brief_rationale: The invasive strategy did not significantly reduce the explicitly identified composite primary outcome versus the conservative strategy (25.6% vs 26.3%; hazard ratio 0.94, 95% CI 0.77–1.14; P=0.53), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Three primary end points: the 24-month rate of first or recurrent heart-failure hospitalization or cardiovascular death; the 24-month rate of first or recurrent heart-failure hospitalization; and change in KCCQ-OS score from baseline to 12 months.
brief_rationale: All three explicitly identified primary end points significantly favored transcatheter mitral-valve repair: rate ratios were 0.64 (P=0.002) and 0.59 (P=0.002) for the two event-rate outcomes, and the between-group KCCQ-OS difference was 10.9 points (P<0.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was overall survival. Blinatumomab plus consolidation chemotherapy significantly improved overall survival versus chemotherapy alone (3-year survival, 85% vs. 68%; hazard ratio for death, 0.41; 95% CI, 0.23–0.73; P=0.002), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Two primary efficacy endpoints at week 24: histologic response (≤6 eosinophils per high-power field) and change from baseline in Dysphagia Symptom Questionnaire score.
brief_rationale: The histologic primary endpoint significantly favored benralizumab (87.4% vs 6.5%; P<0.001), but the dysphagia symptom primary endpoint did not differ significantly (P=0.18). Because the abstract does not specify the overall success rule for these mixed primary-endpoint results, trial success is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: Resolution of MASH without worsening of fibrosis at 52 weeks
brief_rationale: All three tirzepatide doses produced significantly higher primary-endpoint response rates than placebo (44%, 56%, and 62% vs. 10%; P<0.001 for each comparison), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Histologic improvement (reduction) in MASH with no worsening of fibrosis at 48 weeks
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred in 47%, 62%, and 43% of the survodutide dose groups versus 14% with placebo, with P<0.001 for the dose-response analysis. The abstract concludes that survodutide was superior to placebo for this endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Undetectable hepatitis D virus (HDV) RNA at 24 weeks after the end of treatment, with the primary comparison between 10-mg bulevirtide plus peginterferon alfa-2a and 10-mg bulevirtide monotherapy.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 46% with 10-mg bulevirtide plus peginterferon alfa-2a versus 12% with 10-mg bulevirtide monotherapy, a favorable difference of 34 percentage points (95% CI, 15 to 50; P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival as assessed by blinded independent central review
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored osimertinib over placebo: median progression-free survival was 39.1 versus 5.6 months (hazard ratio for progression or death, 0.16; 95% CI, 0.10–0.24; P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in androstenedione level from baseline to week 4
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored crinecerfont: androstenedione decreased by 197 ng/dL versus an increase of 71 ng/dL with placebo (least-squares mean difference, −268 ng/dL; P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored BVd over DVd: median progression-free survival was 36.6 versus 13.4 months (hazard ratio for progression or death, 0.41; 95% CI, 0.31–0.53; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Percent change in triglyceride level from baseline to week 24
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint showed significant, dose-dependent favorable reductions versus placebo at week 24: differences of -51, -57, and -63 percentage points for the 50-, 100-, and 200-mg doses, respectively (P<0.001 for all comparisons).

primary_endpoint_description: Annualized rate of moderate or severe COPD exacerbations
brief_rationale: Dupilumab significantly reduced the explicitly identified primary endpoint versus placebo (annualized rates 0.86 vs 1.30; rate ratio 0.66, 95% CI 0.54–0.82; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Event-free survival according to blinded independent review
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored perioperative nivolumab, with an event-free survival hazard ratio of 0.58 (97.36% CI, 0.42 to 0.81; P<0.001), demonstrating significantly longer event-free survival than chemotherapy.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline to week 24 in peak oxygen uptake assessed by cardiopulmonary exercise testing
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored aficamten: the least-squares mean between-group difference in peak oxygen uptake was 1.7 ml/kg/min (95% CI, 1.0 to 2.4; P<0.001), demonstrating statistically significant superiority over placebo.

primary_endpoint_description: Successful intubation on the first attempt, as determined by exhaled carbon dioxide detection
brief_rationale: First-attempt intubation success was significantly higher with video laryngoscopy than with direct laryngoscopy (74% vs. 45%; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion for the explicitly identified primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Disease-free survival according to investigator assessment
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies investigator-assessed disease-free survival as the primary endpoint and states that a significant improvement was shown previously. The updated result remained favorable for pembrolizumab (hazard ratio for recurrence or death, 0.72; 95% CI, 0.59–0.87), supporting successful superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary 12-month endpoints: (1) composite of death, disabling stroke, or rehospitalization for heart failure, tested for noninferiority; and (2) composite bioprosthetic-valve dysfunction, tested for superiority.
brief_rationale: Both coprimary endpoints met their stated criteria: the self-expanding valve was noninferior for the clinical composite (9.4% vs 10.6%; P<0.001 for noninferiority) and superior for bioprosthetic-valve dysfunction (9.4% vs 41.6%; P<0.001 for superiority).

primary_endpoint_description: Percent change in triglyceride level from baseline to 6 months, expressed as the difference between each olezarsen dose group and placebo.
brief_rationale: Both olezarsen doses produced favorable placebo-adjusted triglyceride reductions (49.3 and 53.1 percentage points), with P<0.001 for both comparisons, meeting the superiority criterion for the explicitly identified primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death from any cause or new myocardial infarction
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 7.9% with beta-blocker treatment versus 8.3% without beta-blocker treatment (hazard ratio 0.96, 95% CI 0.79–1.16; P=0.64), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Death from any cause at 180 days
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred less often with the microaxial flow pump plus standard care than with standard care alone (45.8% vs. 58.5%; hazard ratio 0.74, 95% CI 0.55–0.99; P=0.04), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary endpoints: change from baseline to 52 weeks in the Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire clinical summary score (KCCQ-CSS) and change in body weight.
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary endpoints significantly favored semaglutide over placebo: KCCQ-CSS improved by an estimated 7.3 points more, and body weight decreased by 6.4 percentage points more (P<0.001 for both).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite microbiologic and clinical success on trial days 19 to 23 in the microbiologic intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: The prespecified superiority analysis showed greater primary-outcome success with cefepime-taniborbactam than with meropenem (70.6% vs. 58.0%; difference 12.6 percentage points, 95% CI 3.1 to 22.2; P=0.009), meeting the favorable superiority criterion after confirmation of noninferiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary outcomes of preeclampsia and preterm birth in each of the India and Tanzania trials.
brief_rationale: Preeclampsia met the noninferiority criterion in both trials, and preterm birth met it in India but not Tanzania. Because the co-primary results were mixed and no overall success rule is stated, overall primary-endpoint success is indeterminable.

primary_endpoint_description: Prevention of RSV-associated lower respiratory tract disease with at least two signs or symptoms and with at least three signs or symptoms.
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary efficacy endpoints favored mRNA-1345 over placebo: vaccine efficacy was 83.7% (95.88% CI, 66.0 to 92.2) for disease with at least two signs or symptoms and 82.4% (96.36% CI, 34.8 to 95.3) for disease with at least three signs or symptoms. Both confidence intervals excluded no efficacy.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival with MRD-directed ibrutinib-venetoclax compared with fludarabine-cyclophosphamide-rituximab (FCR).
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored ibrutinib-venetoclax, with a hazard ratio for progression or death of 0.13 (95% CI, 0.07–0.24; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Primary efficacy outcome: stroke or systemic embolism; primary safety outcome: major bleeding.
brief_rationale: Apixaban significantly reduced the primary efficacy outcome versus aspirin (HR 0.63, 95% CI 0.45–0.88; P=0.007) but significantly increased the primary safety outcome (HR 1.80, 95% CI 1.26–2.57; P=0.001). The abstract does not specify an overall success rule for these mixed primary outcomes.

primary_endpoint_description: First episode of ventilator-associated pneumonia during 28 days of follow-up
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored inhaled amikacin: ventilator-associated pneumonia occurred in 15% versus 22% with placebo, with a favorable restricted mean survival-time difference of 1.5 days (95% CI, 0.6 to 2.5; P=0.004), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary end points of event-free survival and centrally evaluated pathological complete response
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary end points favored durvalumab and met superiority criteria: event-free survival improved (HR 0.68; 95% CI, 0.53–0.88; P=0.004), and pathological complete response was higher (17.2% vs 4.3%; P<0.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Surgical-site infection within 90 days after arthroplasty
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred in 4.5% of the vancomycin group versus 3.5% of the placebo group (relative risk 1.28, 95% CI 0.94–1.73; P=0.11). Vancomycin was not superior to placebo, so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Percentage of time in the pregnancy-specific target glucose range (63–140 mg/dL) measured by continuous glucose monitoring from 16 weeks' gestation until delivery
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored hybrid closed-loop therapy: 68.2% versus 55.6% with standard care, with an adjusted difference of 10.5 percentage points (95% CI, 7.0–14.0; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Sustained remission at 52 weeks, defined as resolution of polymyalgia rheumatica signs and symptoms by week 12 plus sustained C-reactive protein normalization, absence of disease flare, and adherence to the prednisone taper from weeks 12 through 52.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred in 28% of the sarilumab group versus 10% of the placebo group, a favorable difference of 18 percentage points (95% CI, 4 to 32; P=0.02), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Death from any cause at 30 days
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 47.8% of the ECLS group versus 49.0% of the control group (relative risk 0.98, 95% CI 0.80–1.19; P=0.81), so ECLS did not demonstrate superior reduction in 30-day all-cause mortality.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to any mood episode through 52 weeks, defined by mood-symptom scale scores, additional treatment or hospitalization for mood symptoms, or attempted or completed suicide.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome did not show significant superiority for 52-week antidepressant continuation versus switching to placebo at 8 weeks (hazard ratio 0.68, 95% CI 0.43–1.10; P=0.12).
The abstract lists safety, pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic measures, and blood-pressure changes as endpoints but does not explicitly identify any endpoint as the prespecified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline through 3 years in the global cognition score and four cognitive domain scores derived from a 12-test battery.
brief_rationale: The global cognition change did not differ significantly between the MIND-diet and control groups (mean difference 0.035 standardized units; 95% CI, -0.022 to 0.092; P=0.23), and the abstract concludes that cognition changes did not significantly differ between groups. Thus, favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Event-free survival
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies event-free survival as the primary outcome and states that the primary analysis showed significantly longer event-free survival with axi-cel than with standard care, meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Dual primary endpoint of investigator-assessed progression-free survival in the overall population and in patients with AKT pathway-altered tumors.
brief_rationale: Capivasertib plus fulvestrant significantly improved progression-free survival versus placebo plus fulvestrant in both primary populations: overall HR 0.60 (95% CI, 0.51–0.71; P<0.001) and AKT pathway-altered HR 0.50 (95% CI, 0.38–0.65; P<0.001). Both components of the dual primary endpoint favored capivasertib.
The abstract reports prespecified noninferiority analyses for seroresponse percentages and GMT ratios, but it does not explicitly identify either measure as the primary endpoint or primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: 4-year cumulative incidence of leprosy among household contacts
brief_rationale: Rifapentine significantly reduced the primary outcome versus no intervention (cumulative incidence ratio 0.16; multiplicity-adjusted 95% CI, 0.03–0.87; P=0.02), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Treatment response measured by the eliciting dose of peanut protein at 12 months
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy endpoint occurred in 67.0% of the epicutaneous-immunotherapy group versus 33.5% of the placebo group (risk difference, 33.4 percentage points; 95% CI, 22.4 to 44.5; P<0.001), demonstrating favorable superiority over placebo.

primary_endpoint_description: Time from birth until medical readiness for discharge as defined by the trial
brief_rationale: The Eat, Sleep, Console approach significantly shortened the explicitly identified primary outcome versus usual care (8.2 vs 14.9 days; rate ratio 0.55, 95% CI 0.46–0.65; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator-assessed progression-free survival according to RECIST version 1.1 and overall survival.
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies progression-free survival and overall survival as primary endpoints. Progression-free survival significantly favored dostarlimab, but the abstract does not report whether overall survival met a prespecified statistical boundary or state the overall success rule for the two primary endpoints.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival in the mismatch repair-deficient (dMMR) and mismatch repair-proficient (pMMR) cohorts
brief_rationale: Pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy significantly improved the primary outcome in both cohorts versus placebo plus chemotherapy: dMMR HR 0.30 (95% CI, 0.19–0.48; P<0.001) and pMMR HR 0.54 (95% CI, 0.41–0.71; P<0.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator's Global Assessment score of 0 or 1 with an improvement of at least 2 points from baseline at week 16
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored lebrikizumab in both placebo-controlled trials: 43.1% versus 12.7% in trial 1 and 33.2% versus 10.8% in trial 2, with P<0.001 for both comparisons.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was progression-free survival. Nirogacestat showed a significant favorable benefit over placebo (hazard ratio for disease progression or death, 0.29; 95% CI, 0.15–0.55; P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of new keratinocyte cancers during the 12-month intervention period
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed no favorable superiority of nicotinamide over placebo: 207 versus 210 new keratinocyte cancers (rate ratio 1.0, 95% CI 0.8–1.3; P=0.96).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death from any cause at day 28, persistent complications at day 7, and persistent fever at day 5.
brief_rationale: Combination therapy significantly reduced the primary composite outcome versus doxycycline (33% vs 47%; P=0.002) and azithromycin (33% vs 48%; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of symptomatic or radiologic recurrence of kidney stones, assessed for a hydrochlorothiazide dose-response effect
brief_rationale: The prespecified primary endpoint showed no favorable dose-response relationship with hydrochlorothiazide (P=0.66), and none of the dose groups demonstrated significant superiority over placebo.

primary_endpoint_description: Response at 3 months, defined as a decrease of at least 3 points from baseline in either treated-side off-medication MDS-UPDRS III score or on-medication UDysRS score.
brief_rationale: The primary response occurred in 69% of the active-treatment group versus 32% of the sham group, a favorable difference of 37 percentage points (95% CI, 15 to 60; P=0.003), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death, ongoing treatment, or active disease at week 96
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was assessed for two fully enrolled strategy groups against standard treatment. Noninferiority was met for the bedaquiline-linezolid strategy but not for the rifampin-linezolid strategy, and the abstract does not state an overall success rule for these mixed results.

primary_endpoint_description: Vaccine efficacy of one dose of RSVPreF3 OA against RT-PCR-confirmed RSV-related lower respiratory tract disease during one RSV season
brief_rationale: The prespecified success criterion required the lower confidence-interval bound for vaccine efficacy to exceed 20%. Efficacy was 82.6% with a 96.95% CI of 57.9% to 94.1%; the lower bound exceeded 20%, so the primary objective was met.

primary_endpoint_description: Disease-free survival, defined as time from randomization to disease recurrence or death from any cause.
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies disease-free survival as the primary endpoint and reports that sublobar resection was noninferior to lobar resection (hazard ratio 1.01; 90% CI, 0.83 to 1.24), satisfying the stated noninferiority objective.

primary_endpoint_description: Modified Rankin scale score at 90 days, analyzed as a shift in the score distribution toward better functional outcomes
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored thrombectomy, with a generalized odds ratio of 1.51 (95% CI, 1.20–1.89; P<0.001); the trial was stopped early for efficacy. Thus, the favorable superiority criterion was met.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was progression-free survival. Ide-cel significantly prolonged progression-free survival versus standard regimens (median 13.3 vs 4.4 months; hazard ratio for progression or death, 0.49; 95% CI, 0.38–0.65; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to sustained clinical recovery through day 28
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority criterion required the lower bound of the two-sided 95% CI for the hazard ratio to exceed 0.8. The primary analysis yielded a hazard ratio of 1.17 (95% CI, 1.01 to 1.35), satisfying this criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary composites of death from any cause or hospitalization for cardiovascular causes within 30 days and within 20 months after presentation.
brief_rationale: Both coprimary outcomes favored the intervention: at 30 days, adjusted HR 0.88 (95% CI 0.78–0.99; P=0.04), and at 20 months, adjusted HR 0.95 (95% CI 0.92–0.99). Both confidence intervals excluded 1 in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Survival free from neurodisability at 2 years, corrected for gestational age at birth
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 47.8% of the intervention group versus 49.8% of the placebo group (adjusted relative risk 0.95, 95% CI 0.79–1.14; P=0.56), so extra amino acids did not demonstrate favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Total time without exposure to invasive ventilation, reported as ventilator-free days at day 28 after the initial spontaneous-breathing trial
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed a median of 27 ventilator-free days in both groups (difference, 0 days; 95% CI, -0.5 to 1; P=0.31). PSV therefore did not demonstrate favorable superiority over a T-piece.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of days alive and out of the hospital at 180 days after randomization
brief_rationale: The early-mobilization group did not have significantly more days alive and out of the hospital than the usual-care group (median 143 vs. 145 days; absolute difference, -2.0 days; 95% CI, -10 to 6; P=0.62), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Stroke within 72 hours after TAVR or before discharge, whichever came first, in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 2.3% of the CEP group versus 2.9% of the control group, a nonsignificant difference (P=0.30; 95% CI for the difference, -1.7 to 0.5 percentage points). Thus, CEP did not meet the superiority criterion for reducing periprocedural stroke.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to discharge alive from the hospital, with data censored at 90 days
brief_rationale: The primary outcome did not show favorable superiority for glutamine: median time to discharge alive was 40 versus 38 days, with a subdistribution hazard ratio of 0.91 (95% CI, 0.80 to 1.04; P=0.17).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of stroke, systemic embolism, myocardial infarction, or death from vascular or unknown causes
brief_rationale: The primary efficacy outcome occurred more often with rivaroxaban than with vitamin K antagonist therapy, with significantly shorter restricted mean event-free survival. Thus, rivaroxaban did not meet the intended noninferiority criterion and was unfavorable to control.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death from any cause, myocardial infarction, or hospitalization for unstable angina at 2 years
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 5.5% of the routine functional-testing group and 6.0% of the standard-care group (hazard ratio 0.90, 95% CI 0.61–1.35; P=0.62). Routine functional testing did not demonstrate favorable superiority over standard care.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death from any cause or hospital discharge with severe disability or coma (CPC 3 or 4), whichever occurred first within 90 days after randomization
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 32.0% with the restrictive target versus 33.9% with the liberal target (hazard ratio 0.95, 95% CI 0.75–1.21; P=0.69), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death from any cause or hospital discharge with severe disability or coma (CPC 3 or 4) within 90 days.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 34% of the 77-mm Hg target group and 32% of the 63-mm Hg target group (hazard ratio 1.08, 95% CI 0.84–1.37; P=0.56), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of cardiovascular death, nonfatal type 1 myocardial infarction, nonfatal ischemic stroke, or urgent revascularization.
brief_rationale: The primary composite outcome was significantly less frequent with the polypill strategy than with usual care (9.5% vs 12.7%; hazard ratio 0.76, 95% CI 0.60–0.96; P=0.02), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Percent change from baseline to week 16 in the Cutaneous Lupus Erythematosus Disease Area and Severity Index–Activity (CLASI-A) score, assessed using a dose-response model across the litifilimab dose groups and placebo.
brief_rationale: The primary dose-response analysis showed a significant favorable effect across the litifilimab dose levels and placebo, and the abstract concludes that litifilimab was superior to placebo for skin disease activity at 16 weeks.

primary_endpoint_description: Three prespecified primary endpoints: RT-qPCR-confirmed symptomatic RSV infection; total symptom score from day 1 to discharge; and AUC for nasal-wash RSV viral load from day 2 after challenge to discharge.
brief_rationale: The abstract reports favorable vaccine efficacy for symptomatic RSV infection and descriptive viral-load AUC results, but does not report the total symptom-score result or state the overall success rule for the three primary endpoints. Overall primary-endpoint success is therefore indeterminable.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary endpoints: percentage change in body weight from baseline at week 72 and achievement of at least 5% weight reduction.
brief_rationale: All tirzepatide doses produced significantly greater mean percentage weight reductions than placebo and significantly higher proportions achieving at least 5% weight loss (P<0.001 for all comparisons), so both coprimary superiority endpoints were met.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in glycated hemoglobin level at 26 weeks.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored both dulaglutide doses: glycated hemoglobin decreased by 0.6 and 0.9 percentage points with 0.75 mg and 1.5 mg, respectively, versus a 0.6-point increase with placebo; both comparisons had P<0.001, meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Safety of two 50-μg mRNA-1273 doses and noninferiority of the immune response in children aged 6–11 years versus young adults aged 18–25 years
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies safety and immune-response noninferiority as primary objectives. The immune-response findings met the prespecified noninferiority success criterion, and no vaccine-related serious safety events were reported.

primary_endpoint_description: Occurrence of PCR-confirmed symptomatic Covid-19 at least 7 days after the third dose
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 158 of 12,625 ZF2001 recipients versus 580 of 12,568 placebo recipients, corresponding to 75.7% vaccine efficacy (95% CI, 71.0% to 79.8%), demonstrating favorable superiority over placebo.

primary_endpoint_description: Between-group difference in change from baseline in body weight at 12 months
brief_rationale: The primary outcome showed no significant favorable superiority of time-restricted eating plus calorie restriction over calorie restriction alone (net difference, -1.8 kg; 95% CI, -4.0 to 0.4; P=0.11).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of hospitalization due to Covid-19 or an emergency department visit with more than 6 hours of observation due to clinical worsening, within 28 days after randomization.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 14.7% of the ivermectin group versus 16.3% of the placebo group (relative risk 0.90; 95% Bayesian credible interval 0.70–1.16). The interval included no effect, and the abstract concludes that ivermectin did not lower the incidence of the primary composite outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Time-normalized number of investigator-confirmed angioedema attacks per month between week 1 (baseline) and week 17
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored donidalorsen, with a mean monthly attack rate of 0.23 versus 2.21 with placebo, corresponding to a 90% reduction (95% CI, 76% to 96%; P<0.001). Thus, favorable superiority over placebo was demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Primary efficacy outcome of unfavorable status by 72 weeks, a composite of treatment failure, loss to follow-up during treatment, or death, in the modified intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was 6 percentage points. Unfavorable status occurred in 3% with 4-month treatment and 3% with 6-month treatment; the adjusted difference was -0.4 percentage points (95% CI, -2.2 to 1.5). Because the upper confidence bound was below the 6-point margin, the primary efficacy criterion for noninferiority was met.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival and blinded-independent-central-review progression-free survival
brief_rationale: The co-primary overall-survival endpoint favored both nivolumab combinations, and progression-free survival favored nivolumab plus chemotherapy, but progression-free survival did not favor nivolumab plus ipilimumab. The abstract does not state the overall success rule for these mixed co-primary results.

primary_endpoint_description: Between-treatment difference in the percentage of time sensor glucose was in the target range (70–180 mg/dL) during each 16-week period.
brief_rationale: Time in the target glucose range was 8.7 percentage points higher with closed-loop therapy than with control (95% CI, 7.4 to 9.9; P<0.001), demonstrating favorable superiority on the explicitly identified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary endpoints of blinded independent central review-assessed progression-free survival and overall survival, evaluated in the pMMR population and in all patients.
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary endpoints favored lenvatinib plus pembrolizumab over chemotherapy and were statistically significant in the pMMR and overall populations: progression-free survival HRs 0.60 and 0.56, and overall survival HRs 0.68 and 0.62, all P<0.001.

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator-assessed progression-free survival
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored pola-R-CHP over R-CHOP: 2-year progression-free survival was 76.7% versus 70.2%, with a hazard ratio for progression, relapse, or death of 0.73 (95% CI, 0.57–0.95; P=0.02), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Event-free survival, defined as time from randomization to stable or progressive disease at or after the week 12 assessment or death.
brief_rationale: Median event-free survival was 3.0 months in both groups (hazard ratio, 1.07; 95% CI, 0.82–1.40; P=0.61), so tisagenlecleucel did not demonstrate superiority over standard care on the primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in 24-hour ambulatory systolic blood pressure from baseline to 12 weeks
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored chlorthalidone over placebo: the adjusted between-group difference was -10.5 mm Hg (95% CI, -14.6 to -6.4; P<0.001), demonstrating significant improvement in blood-pressure control.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary outcomes: mean change in hemoglobin level from baseline to weeks 28 through 52 and first occurrence of a major adverse cardiovascular event (MACE).
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary outcomes met their prespecified noninferiority margins: the hemoglobin difference was 0.08 g/dL (95% CI, 0.03 to 0.13), exceeding the -0.75 g/dL margin, and the MACE hazard ratio was 1.03 (95% CI, 0.89 to 1.19), with the upper bound below the 1.25 margin.

primary_endpoint_description: First relapse of depression during the 52-week trial period, evaluated in a time-to-event analysis
brief_rationale: Relapse was significantly less frequent with antidepressant maintenance than discontinuation (39% vs 56%); the hazard ratio for discontinuation versus maintenance was 2.06 (95% CI, 1.56–2.70; P<0.001), demonstrating favorable superiority of maintenance therapy on the primary endpoint.

The abstract reports a prespecified hierarchical analysis of hospitalization or death and time to symptom resolution, but it does not explicitly identify either as the primary endpoint or state an unambiguous equivalent designation.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was overall survival. Tebentafusp significantly reduced the hazard of death versus control (HR 0.51, 95% CI 0.37–0.71; P<0.001), with 1-year overall survival of 73% versus 59%, meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Prevention of Covid-19 illness beginning at least 14 days after the second injection among participants without prior SARS-CoV-2 infection.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored mRNA-1273, with vaccine efficacy of 93.2% (95% CI, 91.0% to 94.8%) and 55 cases versus 744 with placebo, demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Cognitive development measured by the Bayley Scales of Infant and Toddler Development, third edition, cognitive composite score immediately after the 3-month regimen.
brief_rationale: Neither intervention showed favorable superiority over placebo for the primary outcome: iron syrup had a mean between-group difference in change of -0.30 points (95% CI, -1.08 to 0.48), and multiple micronutrient powders had a difference of 0.23 points (95% CI, -0.55 to 1.00). Both confidence intervals included no effect.

primary_endpoint_description: Death from any cause at 30 days
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred in 54.0% with immediate angiography versus 46.0% with delayed/selective angiography (hazard ratio 1.28, 95% CI 1.00–1.63; P=0.06). Immediate angiography did not demonstrate favorable superiority and numerically had higher mortality.

primary_endpoint_description: Primary efficacy composite of all-cause death, myocardial infarction, ischemic stroke, systemic thromboembolism, valve thrombosis, or major bleeding; and primary safety outcome of major bleeding.
brief_rationale: The primary efficacy composite met noninferiority (HR 1.05, 95% CI 0.85–1.31; upper bound below 1.38), whereas the primary safety outcome of major bleeding did not (HR 1.40, 95% CI 1.03–1.91). Although testing was hierarchical, the abstract does not clearly state the overall success rule for these mixed primary outcomes.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to relapse of psychosis during the double-blind discontinuation phase, with relapse defined by prespecified clinical worsening, hospitalization, treatment discontinuation or withdrawal for lack of efficacy, or antipsychotic use.
brief_rationale: Relapse occurred less often with continued pimavanserin than with placebo (13% vs. 28%; hazard ratio 0.35, 95% CI 0.17–0.73; P=0.005). The trial was stopped early for efficacy, indicating that the primary superiority endpoint met its success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of men in the intention-to-treat population diagnosed with clinically significant prostate cancer (Gleason score ≥7).
brief_rationale: Clinically significant cancer was detected in 21% of the experimental biopsy group versus 18% of the standard biopsy group, with P<0.001 for noninferiority; the abstract explicitly concludes that the experimental strategy was noninferior.

primary_endpoint_description: First major adverse cardiovascular event (MACE), a composite of nonfatal myocardial infarction, nonfatal stroke, or death from cardiovascular or undetermined causes.
brief_rationale: The primary MACE outcome occurred less often with efpeglenatide than placebo (hazard ratio 0.73, 95% CI 0.58–0.92), meeting the prespecified noninferiority criterion (P<0.001) and also demonstrating superiority (P=0.007).

primary_endpoint_description: Sustained complete remission at week 52: healing of lesions with no new active lesions (PDAI activity score 0) for at least 16 weeks without glucocorticoids.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 40% of the rituximab group versus 10% of the mycophenolate mofetil group (difference 31 percentage points, 95% CI 15 to 45; P<0.001), demonstrating favorable superiority of rituximab.

primary_endpoint_description: Primary effectiveness outcome: composite of all-cause death, hospitalization for myocardial infarction, or hospitalization for stroke; primary safety outcome: hospitalization for major bleeding, both assessed by time to event.
brief_rationale: Neither explicitly identified primary outcome showed a significant difference between 81 mg and 325 mg aspirin: effectiveness HR 1.02 (95% CI, 0.91–1.14) and major bleeding HR 1.18 (95% CI, 0.79–1.77). Thus, favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death from any cause, nonfatal myocardial infarction, or unplanned hospitalization leading to urgent revascularization at 1 year
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred in 5.5% of the FFR-guided group and 4.2% of the angiography-guided group (hazard ratio 1.32, 95% CI 0.78–2.23; P=0.31). Thus, FFR guidance did not demonstrate the intended superiority over angiography guidance.

primary_endpoint_description: Surgical-site infection within 30 days after surgery
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was 2.0 percentage points. Surgical-site infection occurred in 8.1% with dexamethasone versus 9.1% with placebo (adjusted risk difference, -0.9 percentage points; 95.6% CI, -2.1 to 0.3; P<0.001 for noninferiority), satisfying the noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Primary safety endpoint: first occurrence of MACE, pooled across trials; primary efficacy endpoint: mean change in hemoglobin from baseline to weeks 24–36 in each trial.
brief_rationale: Both primary endpoints met their noninferiority criteria. For MACE, the hazard ratio was 0.96 (95% CI, 0.83–1.11), below the 1.25 margin. For hemoglobin change, the lower confidence bounds in both trials (-0.53 and -0.23 g/dL) were above the -0.75 g/dL margin.

primary_endpoint_description: 100% reduction from baseline in the Psoriasis Area and Severity Index (PASI 100) score at week 16
brief_rationale: The primary analysis hierarchically tested noninferiority and then superiority of bimekizumab versus secukinumab. PASI 100 occurred in 61.7% versus 48.9% of patients, with an adjusted risk difference of 12.7 percentage points (95% CI, 5.8 to 19.6); both noninferiority at the prespecified -10-point margin and superiority were met (P<0.001 for both).

primary_endpoint_description: Percent change in 24-hour urinary oxalate excretion from baseline to month 6, assessed as the mean percent change across months 3 through 6
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored lumasiran: the least-squares mean difference versus placebo was -53.5 percentage points (P<0.001), indicating a significant reduction in urinary oxalate excretion.

primary_endpoint_description: Disease-free survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was disease-free survival. Nivolumab significantly prolonged disease-free survival versus placebo (median 22.4 vs 11.0 months; hazard ratio for recurrence or death, 0.69; 96.4% CI, 0.56–0.86; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator's Global Assessment (IGA) response and Eczema Area and Severity Index-75 (EASI-75) response at week 12
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary endpoints favored each abrocitinib dose over placebo at week 12: IGA responses were 48.4% and 36.6% versus 14.0%, and EASI-75 responses were 70.3% and 58.7% versus 27.1%; P<0.001 for both doses versus placebo on both endpoints.

primary_endpoint_description: Occurrence of HIV-1 infection from randomization to 24 months
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy outcome did not favor the vaccine: HIV-1 infection occurred in 138 vaccine recipients versus 133 placebo recipients (hazard ratio 1.02, 95% CI 0.81–1.30; P=0.84), and prespecified nonefficacy criteria were met.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean change in hemoglobin level from baseline to week 16
brief_rationale: Pegcetacoplan was superior to eculizumab for the explicitly identified primary endpoint, with an adjusted mean between-group difference of 3.84 g/dL in the favorable direction (P<0.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival as determined by blinded independent central review
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored nivolumab plus cabozantinib over sunitinib: median progression-free survival was 16.6 versus 8.3 months (hazard ratio for progression or death, 0.51; 95% CI, 0.41–0.64; P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Days alive without delirium or coma during the 14-day intervention period
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint did not differ favorably between dexmedetomidine and propofol (adjusted median 10.7 vs 10.8 days; odds ratio 0.96, 95% CI 0.74–1.26), so superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Safety and reactogenicity of each Ad26.COV2.S dose schedule
brief_rationale: The primary endpoints are explicitly identified and safety/reactogenicity findings are described, but the abstract provides no prespecified criterion or threshold defining primary-endpoint success.

primary_endpoint_description: Sustained recovery during a 90-day period, assessed in a time-to-event analysis
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint rate ratio for sustained recovery was 1.06 (95% CI, 0.77 to 1.47), which did not demonstrate favorable superiority of LY-CoV555 over placebo; enrollment was stopped for futility.

primary_endpoint_description: Mechanical ventilation or death by day 28
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary composite outcome occurred less often with tocilizumab than placebo (12.0% vs 19.3%; hazard ratio 0.56, 95% CI 0.33–0.97; P=0.04), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to recovery
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was time to recovery. Baricitinib plus remdesivir reduced median recovery time from 8 to 7 days versus control, with a favorable recovery rate ratio of 1.16 (95% CI, 1.01–1.32; P=0.03), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Vaccine efficacy against laboratory-confirmed Covid-19 and safety
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoints were efficacy and safety. BNT162b2 showed 95% efficacy versus placebo (95% credible interval, 90.3% to 97.6%), while serious adverse events were uncommon and similar between groups, supporting favorable primary-endpoint results.

primary_endpoint_description: One or more hospital readmissions for any reason or death from randomization to 6 months after discharge
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored chemoprevention over placebo, with 184 versus 316 readmission-or-death events (hazard ratio 0.65, 95% CI 0.54–0.78; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death within 7 days or NICU admission with moderate-to-severe hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy at day 1 to 5 during hospitalization
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 27.4% of the LMA group versus 24.4% of the face-mask group (adjusted relative risk 1.16, 95% CI 0.90–1.51; P=0.26). The prespecified favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Total number of deaths from cardiovascular causes and hospitalizations and urgent visits for heart failure, including first and subsequent events.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred at a significantly lower rate with sotagliflozin than placebo (51.0 vs 76.3 events per 100 patient-years; hazard ratio 0.67, 95% CI 0.52–0.85; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death, major cardiovascular events, or major bleeding at 12 months, assessed as mean time until the event
brief_rationale: The primary-outcome restricted mean survival time difference was 7.4 days (95% CI, -1.4 to 16.3), with P<0.001 for noninferiority; the abstract explicitly concludes that rivaroxaban was noninferior to warfarin.

primary_endpoint_description: Ratio of macrolide-resistance determinants in the azithromycin group to the placebo group at 48 months.
brief_rationale: At 48 months, macrolide-resistance determinants were 7.5 times as high with azithromycin as with placebo (95% CI, 3.8–23.1). Although the groups differed significantly, the explicitly identified primary outcome favored placebo and indicated harm from azithromycin, so it did not meet a favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Safety, including local and systemic reactions and adverse events
brief_rationale: Safety is explicitly identified as the primary outcome, and safety findings are summarized, but the abstract does not state a prespecified criterion for primary-endpoint success.

primary_endpoint_description: 28-day mortality
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was 28-day mortality. Mortality was 27.0% with hydroxychloroquine versus 25.0% with usual care (rate ratio 1.09, 95% CI 0.97–1.23; P=0.15), so hydroxychloroquine did not demonstrate favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival, tested hierarchically according to PD-L1 expression status in the EGFR/ALK wild-type intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: In the highest PD-L1-expression subgroup, atezolizumab significantly improved the primary endpoint of overall survival versus chemotherapy (median 20.2 vs 13.1 months; hazard ratio 0.59; P=0.01), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of sustained decline in estimated GFR of at least 50%, end-stage kidney disease, or death from renal or cardiovascular causes
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred in 9.2% of the dapagliflozin group versus 14.5% of the placebo group, favoring dapagliflozin (hazard ratio 0.61, 95% CI 0.51–0.72; P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death from any cause or requirement for long-term oxygen therapy according to NOTT criteria in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: At 3 years, the primary composite occurred in 39.0% with nocturnal oxygen versus 42.0% with placebo (difference −3.0 percentage points; 95% CI, −15.1 to 9.1). The confidence interval included no effect, so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Metastasis-free survival
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies metastasis-free survival as the primary endpoint and states that the primary analysis was positive: median metastasis-free survival was significantly longer with darolutamide than placebo (40.4 vs 18.4 months).

primary_endpoint_description: Percent change from baseline in body weight at 24 months
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored the intensive lifestyle intervention: the between-group difference was -4.51 percentage points (95% CI, -5.93 to -3.10; P<0.001), demonstrating significantly greater weight loss than usual care.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of device-related complications and inappropriate shocks
brief_rationale: The upper bound of the 95% CI for the hazard ratio was 1.39, below the prespecified noninferiority margin of 1.45 (P=0.01 for noninferiority), so the primary endpoint met the success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Positive QuantiFERON-TB Gold In-Tube assay result at the 3-year follow-up, expressed as a proportion of children
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 3.6% of the vitamin D group versus 3.3% of the placebo group (adjusted risk ratio 1.10, 95% CI 0.87–1.38; P=0.42). Vitamin D did not produce the intended favorable reduction in tuberculosis infection.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of stroke or death within 30 days
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred in 5.5% with ticagrelor plus aspirin versus 6.6% with aspirin alone (hazard ratio 0.83, 95% CI 0.71–0.96; P=0.02), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Safety and pharmacokinetics of ascending intrathecal tofersen doses
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies safety and pharmacokinetics as the primary outcomes. It reports adverse events but does not state a prespecified success criterion, and pharmacokinetic results are not provided, so primary-endpoint success cannot be determined.

primary_endpoint_description: Treatment failure by day 6
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies treatment failure by day 6 as the primary outcome and states that the observed result satisfied the prespecified criterion for noninferiority of the 3-day amoxicillin regimen versus the 5-day regimen.

primary_endpoint_description: Serious medical errors made by resident physicians, assessed by intensive surveillance including direct observation and chart review
brief_rationale: The intervention was intended to reduce serious medical errors, but errors were significantly more frequent with schedules eliminating extended shifts than with control schedules (97.1 vs 79.0 per 1000 patient-days; relative risk 1.53, 95% CI 1.37–1.72; P<0.001). The primary endpoint therefore favored control rather than meeting the intended favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Sustained testosterone suppression to castrate levels (<50 ng/dL) through 48 weeks
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint rate was 96.7% (95% CI, 94.9%–97.9%) with relugolix, but the abstract does not state the prespecified success threshold for this primary endpoint. Noninferiority and superiority versus leuprolide are explicitly described as secondary analyses, so they do not establish that the primary endpoint's own success criterion was met.

primary_endpoint_description: Objective response according to independent central review
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was objective response. Response was 51% with trastuzumab deruxtecan versus 14% with physician's-choice chemotherapy (P<0.001), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Between-group difference in the distribution of modified Rankin Scale scores at 90 days, assessed by the adjusted common odds ratio
brief_rationale: Thrombectomy alone met the prespecified noninferiority criterion: the adjusted common odds ratio was 1.07 with a 95% CI of 0.81 to 1.40, and the lower bound exceeded the margin of 0.80 (P=0.04 for noninferiority).

primary_endpoint_description: Overall response (complete or partial response) at day 28
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was significantly better with ruxolitinib than control (62% vs 39%; odds ratio 2.64, 95% CI 1.65–4.22; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: All bleeding and non-procedure-related bleeding over 12 months.
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary outcomes favored oral anticoagulation alone: all bleeding was 21.7% versus 34.6% (risk ratio 0.63; P=0.01), and non-procedure-related bleeding was 21.7% versus 34.0% (risk ratio 0.64; P=0.02).

primary_endpoint_description: Objectively confirmed recurrent venous thromboembolism during the 6-month trial period
brief_rationale: Recurrent venous thromboembolism occurred in 5.6% of the apixaban group versus 7.9% of the dalteparin group (hazard ratio 0.63, 95% CI 0.37–1.07), with P<0.001 for noninferiority; thus, the primary endpoint met the trial's noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean change in HIV-1 RNA level from day 1 through day 8 in the randomized cohort
brief_rationale: The fostemsavir group had a significantly greater mean decrease in HIV-1 RNA than placebo by day 8 (0.79 vs 0.17 log10 copies/mL; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion for the explicitly identified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Percentage of participants with an HIV-1 RNA level of 50 copies/mL or higher at week 48, determined using the FDA snapshot algorithm.
brief_rationale: The adjusted between-group difference was 0.6 percentage points (95% CI, -1.2 to 2.5), satisfying the prespecified 6-percentage-point noninferiority margin for the primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Psychomotor development at 18 months, assessed using Bayley-III-NL cognitive and motor scores
brief_rationale: The trial specified a noninferiority margin of 7.5 Bayley-III-NL points. The prespecified inferiority limit was not crossed, and the lower treatment threshold was reported as noninferior to the traditional threshold.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death from any cause or disabling stroke at 5 years
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was reported (47.9% with TAVR vs 43.4% with surgery; HR 1.09, 95% CI 0.95–1.25; P=0.21), but the abstract does not state whether the intended criterion was superiority, noninferiority, or another framework, nor any applicable margin. Therefore, trial success cannot be determined from the supplied information.

primary_endpoint_description: Hospital readmission within 180 days after discharge
brief_rationale: The primary outcome showed a 180-day readmission rate of 62.3% with the intervention versus 61.7% with usual care. The adjusted difference was not significant (0.82 percentage points; 95% CI, -5.97 to 7.61), so the intervention did not achieve favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Percent change in lipoprotein(a) level from baseline to month 6 of exposure
brief_rationale: All APO(a)-LRx regimens produced greater mean reductions in lipoprotein(a) than placebo (35% to 80% vs 6%), with statistically significant placebo comparisons (P=0.003 to <0.001), demonstrating favorable superiority on the explicitly identified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Percentage of patients with at least one prosthetic valve leaflet with grade 3 or higher motion reduction (>50% of the leaflet) on four-dimensional CT.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 2.1% of the rivaroxaban group versus 10.9% of the antiplatelet group, a favorable difference of -8.8 percentage points (95% CI, -16.5 to -1.9; P=0.01), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death from cardiovascular causes, myocardial infarction, or stroke
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority criterion required the upper limit of the 95.3% confidence interval for the hazard ratio to be below 1.05. The observed hazard ratio was 0.92 (95.3% CI, 0.83 to 1.01; P=0.003 for noninferiority), so the primary endpoint met the noninferiority success criterion, although superiority was not established.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival as assessed by an independent review committee
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was significantly improved with teclistamab-daratumumab versus DPd or DVd (hazard ratio 0.17, 95% CI 0.12–0.23; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: New HPV type 16 or 18 infection occurring from month 12 to month 60 and persisting for at least 6 months.
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was 1.25 infections per 100 participants. For both bivalent and nonavalent vaccines, the reported confidence intervals for the one-dose versus two-dose rate differences remained below this margin, with P<0.001 for noninferiority; thus, one dose was noninferior to two doses on the primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: DENV-3 RNA load, measured as the log10 area under the concentration-time curve from day 1 through day 29 (AUC D1-29), comparing high-dose mosnodenvir with placebo.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy endpoint was significantly lower in the favorable direction with high-dose mosnodenvir than with placebo (two-sided P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Relative efficacy in reducing laboratory-confirmed influenza associated with influenza-like illness at least 14 days after vaccination, comparing the modRNA vaccine with the control vaccine
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint had a relative efficacy of 34.5% (95% CI, 7.4 to 53.9), and the abstract states that this met the prespecified criteria for both noninferiority and superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Net adverse clinical events at 12 months, a composite of all-cause death, myocardial infarction, stent thrombosis, stroke, systemic embolism, or major or clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred in 9.6% with NOAC monotherapy versus 17.2% with combination therapy. The absolute difference was -7.6 percentage points (95.2% CI, -11.9 to -3.3), satisfying the prespecified 3.0-percentage-point noninferiority margin (P<0.001 for noninferiority).

primary_endpoint_description: Percentage change from baseline in the 24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio at week 36.
brief_rationale: At week 36, atacicept produced a significantly greater reduction in the primary endpoint than placebo (45.7% vs 6.8%; geometric mean between-group difference, 41.8 percentage points; 95% CI, 28.9 to 52.3; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival at 10 years
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was overall survival. Ten-year overall survival was 81.4% with chest-wall irradiation versus 81.9% without irradiation (hazard ratio for death, 1.04; 95% CI, 0.82–1.30; P=0.80), so irradiation did not demonstrate favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: In-hospital death from any cause at 90 days
brief_rationale: Mortality was 27.9% with SDD versus 29.5% with standard care (odds ratio, 0.94; 95% CI, 0.84–1.05; P=0.27), so SDD did not achieve favorable superiority on the primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Response on the modified SLE Responder Index 4 (SRI-4) at week 52
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored telitacicept over placebo (67.1% vs 32.7%; adjusted difference 34.5 percentage points, 95% CI 24.3 to 44.7; P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Disease-free survival at 3 years
brief_rationale: The upper limit of the 95% CI for the lymphadenectomy-minus-biopsy-only difference was 0.5 percentage points, below the prespecified 5-point noninferiority margin; noninferiority was significant (P<0.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Change in gait velocity 3 months after surgery
brief_rationale: The open-shunt group had a significantly greater improvement in the explicitly identified primary outcome than the placebo group (treatment difference, 0.21 m/s; 95% CI, 0.12 to 0.31; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

Overall survival is explicitly identified as a key secondary endpoint. Although prior progression-free survival results are mentioned, the abstract does not explicitly identify progression-free survival or any other outcome as the prespecified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death, myocardial infarction, stroke, or repeat revascularization at 1 year
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 4.8% with ticagrelor plus aspirin versus 4.6% with aspirin alone (hazard ratio 1.06, 95% CI 0.72–1.56; P=0.77), so the addition of ticagrelor did not demonstrate favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: First symptomatic recurrent venous thromboembolism during 12 months of treatment
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy outcome occurred in 1.3% of the apixaban group versus 10.0% of the placebo group (hazard ratio 0.13, 95% CI 0.04–0.36; P<0.001), demonstrating favorable superiority of apixaban.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death from any cause, myocardial infarction, stent thrombosis, stroke, or BARC type 3 or 5 major bleeding at 11 months after randomization.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 2.1% with P2Y12-inhibitor monotherapy and 2.2% with continued dual antiplatelet therapy. The between-group difference was -0.09 percentage points (95% CI, -1.39 to 1.20), satisfying the prespecified 1.25-percentage-point noninferiority margin (P=0.02 for noninferiority).

primary_endpoint_description: Hospitalization for influenza or pneumonia from 14 days after vaccination through May 31 of the following year
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 0.68% of the high-dose group and 0.73% of the standard-dose group, but the favorable difference was not statistically significant (relative vaccine effectiveness, 5.9%; 95.2% CI, -2.1 to 13.4; P=0.14). Thus, superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline to week 48 in peak oxygen uptake and in the 23-item Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire clinical summary score (KCCQ-CSS).
brief_rationale: Neither primary endpoint showed statistically significant superiority over placebo: peak oxygen uptake had a between-group difference of 0.47 ml/kg/min (95% CI, -0.03 to 0.98; P=0.07), and KCCQ-CSS had a difference of 2.7 points (95% CI, -0.1 to 5.6; P=0.06).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death from any cause, reinfarction, or hospitalization for heart failure.
brief_rationale: The primary composite outcome did not show favorable superiority with beta-blocker therapy: 316 versus 307 events (hazard ratio 1.04, 95% CI 0.89–1.22; P=0.63).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death from any cause or first hospital admission for worsening heart failure
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred less often with digitoxin than placebo (39.5% vs 44.1%; hazard ratio 0.82, 95% CI 0.69–0.98; P=0.03), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of cardiovascular death or unplanned hospitalization for cardiovascular causes within 1 year
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred less often with multidomain rehabilitation than with usual care (12.6% vs. 20.6%; hazard ratio 0.57, 95% CI 0.36–0.89; P=0.01), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Death from any cause
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was all-cause mortality. Mortality was 61.7% with treatment step-down versus 60.2% with usual care (adjusted hazard ratio, 1.02; 95% CI, 0.86–1.21; P=0.78), so the step-down strategy did not demonstrate favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Treatment failure on day 11, defined as death, fever, secondary pneumonic plague, or alternative or prolonged plague treatment.
brief_rationale: Among patients with confirmed or probable infection, treatment failure was 9.0% with ciprofloxacin monotherapy versus 8.1% with aminoglycoside-ciprofloxacin. The risk difference was 0.9 percentage points (95% CI, -6.0 to 7.8), whose upper bound was below the prespecified 15-percentage-point noninferiority margin.

primary_endpoint_description: Cumulative incidence of malaria infection in children aged 5–15 years and cumulative incidence of adverse events among all eligible participants.
brief_rationale: The malaria-incidence primary outcome favored ivermectin significantly (adjusted incidence rate ratio 0.74; 95% CI, 0.58–0.95; P=0.02). However, adverse events were also designated a primary outcome, and the abstract reports only serious adverse events without stating a prespecified safety success criterion or an overall rule governing success across the two primary outcomes.

primary_endpoint_description: Percent change in body weight from baseline to week 52.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint is explicit and favorable weight-loss estimates are reported for maridebart cafraglutide versus placebo, but the abstract does not report a prespecified superiority criterion, between-group statistical tests, or whether that criterion was met.

primary_endpoint_description: Event-free survival, sequentially assessed in the PD-L1 CPS-10 population, the CPS-1 population, and all participants.
brief_rationale: Pembrolizumab significantly improved the explicitly identified primary endpoint of event-free survival at the first interim analysis in each sequential population, with favorable hazard ratios and two-sided P values of 0.004, 0.003, and 0.008, respectively.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death or hospital readmission within 90 days after the index admission
brief_rationale: The primary outcome incidence was 20.3% with lactated Ringer's solution versus 21.4% with normal saline; the adjusted difference was -0.53 percentage points (95% CI, -1.85 to 0.79; P=0.35). Thus, lactated Ringer's solution did not achieve statistically significant superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Interval of freedom from invasive breast cancer recurrence or death from breast cancer (invasive breast cancer recurrence-free interval)
brief_rationale: Regional nodal irradiation did not significantly improve the explicitly identified primary endpoint versus no irradiation (hazard ratio 0.88, 95% CI 0.60–1.28; P=0.51), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Event-free survival and pathological complete response
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies event-free survival and pathological complete response as the primary endpoints and states that neoadjuvant nivolumab plus chemotherapy significantly improved both versus chemotherapy alone.

The abstract reports a final overall-survival analysis and references an earlier progression-free-survival benefit, but it does not explicitly identify either outcome as the trial's prespecified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator-assessed progression-free survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored camizestrant: median progression-free survival was 16.0 versus 9.2 months, with a hazard ratio for progression or death of 0.44 (95% CI, 0.31–0.60; P<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in mean daily frequency of moderate-to-severe vasomotor symptoms at weeks 4 and 12
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary endpoints favored elinzanetant over placebo, with significant reductions at week 4 (least-squares mean difference, -3.5; P<0.001) and week 12 (-3.4; P<0.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Time to first severe asthma exacerbation in the on-treatment efficacy population
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored as-needed albuterol-budesonide: severe exacerbations occurred in 5.1% versus 9.1% with albuterol alone (hazard ratio, 0.53; 95% CI, 0.39–0.73; P<0.001). The trial was stopped for efficacy at a prespecified interim analysis.

primary_endpoint_description: Diagnostic accuracy, defined as the percentage of patients whose biopsy yielded a specific diagnosis confirmed as accurate through 12 months of clinical follow-up.
brief_rationale: Navigational bronchoscopy had diagnostic accuracy of 79.0% versus 73.6% with transthoracic needle biopsy; the absolute difference was 5.4 percentage points (95% CI, -6.5 to 17.2), satisfying the prespecified 10-percentage-point noninferiority margin (P=0.003 for noninferiority).

primary_endpoint_description: Percent change in LDL cholesterol level from baseline to day 84.
brief_rationale: Obicetrapib produced a significantly greater favorable reduction in LDL cholesterol than placebo at day 84: between-group difference, -32.6 percentage points (95% CI, -35.8 to -29.5; P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Annualized rate of moderate or severe COPD exacerbations
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was significantly lower with mepolizumab than placebo (0.80 vs. 1.01 events per year; rate ratio 0.79, 95% CI 0.66–0.94; P=0.01), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Annualized relapse rate in GEMINI 1 and GEMINI 2
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was annualized relapse rate. Tolebrutinib was not superior to teriflunomide in either trial (GEMINI 1: rate ratio 1.06, P=0.67; GEMINI 2: rate ratio 1.00, P=0.98), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in the Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) score at week 26 in the combined antibody-positive populations.
brief_rationale: Inebilizumab produced a significantly greater favorable reduction in MG-ADL score than placebo at week 26 (least-squares mean change, -4.2 vs. -2.2; adjusted difference, -1.9; 95% CI, -2.9 to -1.0; P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Functional independence at 90 days, defined as a modified Rankin scale score of 0 to 2.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored alteplase over standard treatment (89.6% vs 72.6%; adjusted risk ratio 1.16, 95% CI 1.03–1.30; P=0.01), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Stroke within 72 hours after TAVI or before hospital discharge, if discharge occurred sooner
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 2.1% of the CEP group and 2.2% of the control group (difference, -0.02 percentage points; 95% CI, -0.68 to 0.63; P=0.94). Routine CEP therefore did not demonstrate a significant reduction in stroke.

primary_endpoint_description: Centrally adjudicated fatal or nonfatal recurrent venous thromboembolism during 12 months of reduced-dose versus full-dose apixaban.
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority criterion required the upper boundary of the 95% CI for the subhazard ratio to be below 2.00. The adjusted subhazard ratio was 0.76 (95% CI, 0.41–1.41; P=0.001 for noninferiority), so the primary endpoint met the noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary changes from baseline in total nasal-polyp score and mean nasal-congestion score at week 52.
brief_rationale: Both coprimary endpoints significantly favored tezepelumab over placebo at week 52: nasal-polyp score mean difference −2.07 (95% CI, −2.39 to −1.74) and nasal-congestion score mean difference −1.03 (95% CI, −1.20 to −0.86), with P<0.001 for both.

primary_endpoint_description: Perinatal death, comprising intrapartum stillbirth and neonatal death within the first 24 hours after birth
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome decreased after program implementation (12.5 vs 15.3 deaths per 1000 births; adjusted relative risk 0.82, 95% CI 0.73–0.92; P=0.001), demonstrating statistically significant benefit in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Level of disability at 90 days, assessed by the modified Rankin scale score
brief_rationale: The primary outcome showed no significant favorable difference with EVT plus best medical treatment versus best medical treatment alone (common odds ratio for improvement, 0.90; 95% CI, 0.67–1.22; P=0.50), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was overall survival. FLOT significantly reduced the hazard of death versus preoperative chemoradiotherapy (HR 0.70, 95% CI 0.53–0.92; P=0.01), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

The abstract reports a prespecified final analysis of invasive disease-free survival and an interim overall-survival analysis, but it does not explicitly identify either outcome as the trial's prespecified primary endpoint. The phrase “primary analysis” refers to an earlier analysis rather than explicitly designating the endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival with nivolumab plus ipilimumab versus chemotherapy as first-line therapy in patients with centrally confirmed MSI-H or dMMR metastatic colorectal cancer.
brief_rationale: At the prespecified interim analysis, the first dual primary endpoint was evaluated and progression-free survival was significantly better with nivolumab plus ipilimumab than with chemotherapy (P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Hematoma recurrence or progression leading to repeat surgery within 90 days after the index treatment.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred less often with embolization plus surgery than with surgery alone (4.1% vs 11.3%; relative risk 0.36, 95% CI 0.11–0.80; P=0.008), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.
