brief_rationale: Physicians sat in 38/60 chair-placement encounters versus 5/65 control encounters (odds ratio 20.7, 95% CI 7.2-59.4; P<0.001), demonstrating significant superiority in the favorable direction for the explicitly identified primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Three-year composite of all-cause death, myocardial infarction, stroke, or any coronary revascularisation
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 8.7% with rosuvastatin versus 8.2% with atorvastatin (HR 1.06, 95% CI 0.86-1.30; P=0.58), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Patient-reported Sino-Nasal Outcome Test-22 (SNOT-22) score at six months
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored septoplasty by an adjusted 20.0 points (lower/better) versus medical management (95% CI, 16.4 to 23.6; P<0.001), exceeding the stated 9-point minimal clinically important difference.

primary_endpoint_description: Combination of functional dependency or death (modified Rankin Scale score ≥3) at 90 days
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 12.0% of the early-treatment group versus 10.5% of the delayed-treatment group (odds ratio 1.18, 95% CI 0.98 to 1.41; P=0.08). Early treatment did not demonstrate favorable superiority and therefore did not meet the primary endpoint success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Attendance at BreastScreen Norway during the study period
brief_rationale: The main outcome was screening attendance. Attendance was 46.5% with bilingual invitations versus 47.4% with Norwegian-only invitations, with no statistically significant difference; therefore, the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

The abstract identifies major cardiovascular events only as the “main outcome for this analysis,” not as the trial’s prespecified primary endpoint or an unambiguous equivalent. Therefore, the original trial primary endpoint cannot be assessed from the supplied information.

primary_endpoint_description: Fall rate per person at six months, analyzed by intention to treat and adjusted for prognostic variables
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint did not show favorable superiority: the adjusted fall-rate risk ratio was 0.91 (95% CI 0.66 to 1.26) and was not statistically significant.

primary_endpoint_description: Three-year local relapse-free survival with medial retropharyngeal lymph node region-sparing radiotherapy versus standard radiotherapy
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority criterion required the lower limit of the one-sided 97.5% confidence interval for the absolute difference to exceed -8%. The observed difference was -0.2%, with a lower limit of -3.6% and P for noninferiority <0.001, so the criterion was met.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of survival without cerebral injury at term equivalent age or before discharge, with cerebral injury defined as intraventricular haemorrhage or cystic periventricular leukomalacia, or both.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 82.9% of the near-infrared spectroscopy group versus 78.5% of controls (relative risk 1.06, 95% CI 0.98-1.14). The favorable 4.3% increase was not statistically significant, so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: COVID-19 disease severity on the modified WHO Clinical Progression Scale at day 14
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed no evidence of benefit from angiotensin receptor blockers, and the trial was stopped after meeting its prespecified futility rule; therefore, favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Patient-level rate of buprenorphine initiation (administration or prescription) in the emergency department among patients with opioid use disorder.
brief_rationale: Buprenorphine initiation occurred in 12.5% of intervention patients versus 12.0% with usual care (adjusted odds ratio 1.22, 95% CI 0.61-2.43; P=0.58), so the clinical decision support tool did not demonstrate favorable superiority on the main endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Clinician Administered PTSD Scale for DSM-5 (CAPS-5) at 16 weeks after randomisation
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies CAPS-5 at 16 weeks as the primary outcome and reports that guided internet-based CBT-TF met noninferiority versus face-to-face CBT-TF (mean difference 1.01, one-sided 95% CI −∞ to 3.90; noninferiority P=0.012).

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival in all randomized patients and in patients with PD-L1 combined positive scores of ≥10.
brief_rationale: Sintilimab plus chemotherapy significantly improved overall survival versus placebo plus chemotherapy in both primary populations: all patients (HR 0.63, 95% CI 0.51-0.78; P<0.001) and patients with PD-L1 combined positive scores ≥10 (HR 0.64, 95% CI 0.48-0.85; P=0.002).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of in-hospital death, mechanical ventilation, or worsening respiratory failure requiring at least 60% inspired oxygen for at least 24 hours
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 14% of each group (odds ratio 0.92, 95% CI 0.44-1.92), and the trial was stopped early for futility. Prone positioning therefore did not demonstrate favorable superiority over standard care.

primary_endpoint_description: Patient Rated Wrist Evaluation (PRWE) score at 12 months
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint showed no statistically significant difference between K-wire fixation and casting (adjusted mean difference -0.34, 95% CI -4.33 to 3.66; P=0.87), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of participants completing their next host-trial follow-up (retention rate).
brief_rationale: Retention was 85.3% with Christmas cards versus 85.4% without cards (odds ratio 0.96, 95% CI 0.71–1.29; P=0.77), so the intervention did not demonstrate favorable superiority on the main outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean difference in standardized mathematics examination scores at age 16 years between participants randomized to modified versus standard infant formula.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was explicitly identified. None of the evaluable modified-formula comparisons showed a favorable significant benefit; all reported 95% confidence intervals included zero. The nucleotide trial participants had not yet reached the examination age.

primary_endpoint_description: Days alive at home during 31 days of follow-up
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was 29.7 days with virtual care versus 29.5 days with standard care (relative risk 1.01, 95% CI 0.99 to 1.02; absolute difference 0.2%, 95% CI -0.5% to 0.9%). The confidence intervals included no difference, so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

The abstract reports major thromboembolism and major bleeding as “main outcome measures” but does not explicitly identify either as the prespecified primary endpoint or distinguish their endpoint hierarchy.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of patients who completed hepatitis C virus testing within four months
brief_rationale: The main outcome was reported for several randomized intervention comparisons: letter plus order improved screening, behavioral-science content did not, and mailed letters outperformed portal messages. With mixed results and no stated overall trial-level success rule across these comparisons, overall primary-endpoint success is indeterminable.

primary_endpoint_description: 30-day all-cause mortality among patients presenting with suspected acute coronary syndrome
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified main outcome showed 3.0% mortality with high-flow oxygen versus 3.1% with low-flow oxygen (odds ratio 0.97, 95% CI 0.86-1.08). The confidence interval included no effect, so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Adjusted between-group difference in systolic blood pressure after one year
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored the digital intervention, with an adjusted mean systolic blood pressure difference of -3.4 mm Hg versus usual care (95% CI, -6.1 to -0.8), demonstrating statistically significant superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: All-cause mortality over five years
brief_rationale: The main outcome was all-cause mortality. Combined moderate- and high-intensity exercise training did not reduce mortality compared with recommended physical activity, so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Imaging-confirmed lower-limb deep vein thrombosis, with or without symptoms, or symptomatic pulmonary embolism within 90 days of surgery
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 1.7% with LMWH alone versus 1.4% with LMWH plus graduated compression stockings. The risk difference was 0.30% (95% CI, -0.65% to 1.26%); the confidence interval did not cross the prespecified 3.5% noninferiority margin (P<0.001), confirming noninferiority of LMWH alone.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in migraine days and migraine attacks per four weeks during weeks 1-20 after randomisation.
brief_rationale: The main outcomes both favored manual acupuncture over sham: migraine days were significantly reduced at weeks 13-20, and migraine attacks were significantly reduced at weeks 17-20. The trial concluded that manual acupuncture was superior to sham acupuncture and usual care.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall wound complications four to 14 days postpartum
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome showed no significant favorable superiority effect: 22% with antibiotics versus 29% with placebo (P=0.10; risk difference -7.2%, 95% CI -15.4% to 0.8%). The significant result concerned the secondary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Two-hour plasma glucose level during an oral glucose tolerance test at gestational week 28
brief_rationale: The intervention did not significantly improve the explicitly identified primary outcome (mean difference 0.48 mmol/L, 95% CI -0.05 to 1.01; P=0.08), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Total alcohol consumption during the four weeks preceding the 24-week follow-up
brief_rationale: The intervention did not favorably reduce the explicitly identified primary outcome versus control: the between-group difference was 27.8 g/4 weeks (95% CI -149.7 to 205.4; P=0.75). Thus, the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean change in predicted 10-year risk of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease from baseline to 12 months.
brief_rationale: The intervention produced a significantly greater reduction in predicted 10-year ASCVD risk than control (between-group absolute difference −1.88 percentage points, 95% CI −2.57 to −1.19; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Freedom from disability, defined as a modified Rankin Scale score of 0 or 1, at 90 days after randomisation.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 34.6% of the tenecteplase group versus 26.0% of controls, but the favorable difference was not statistically significant (adjusted risk ratio 1.36, 95% CI 0.92 to 2.02; P=0.12), so superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in hand function on the AUSCAN function subscale (0-100 points) at six weeks.
brief_rationale: The between-group difference was 3.0 points in favor of heated mittens (95% CI, -0.4 to 6.3; P=0.09), so the primary superiority endpoint did not show a statistically significant favorable effect.

primary_endpoint_description: Postoperative infection within 30 days of randomisation
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 23.2% of intervention patients versus 22.7% with usual care (adjusted odds ratio 1.03, 95% CI 0.84 to 1.25; P=0.81), so the intervention did not demonstrate favorable superiority.

This is a secondary analysis focused on heterogeneous treatment effects. The abstract lists main outcome measures but does not explicitly identify or sufficiently report the original trial's prespecified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Any new stroke within 90 days after randomisation (primary efficacy outcome).
brief_rationale: Stroke occurred in 6.3% of the colchicine group versus 6.5% of the placebo group (hazard ratio 0.98, 95% CI 0.83 to 1.16; P=0.79), so colchicine did not demonstrate favorable superiority over placebo for the primary efficacy endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Independent review committee-assessed progression-free survival in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored nab-TPC: median progression-free survival was 11.3 versus 7.7 months, with a hazard ratio of 0.43 (95% CI 0.25 to 0.73; P=0.002), demonstrating statistically significant superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival in patients with PD-L1 tumour area positivity score ≥5% and in all randomized patients.
brief_rationale: Tislelizumab plus chemotherapy significantly improved the primary endpoint of overall survival versus placebo plus chemotherapy in both prespecified populations: PD-L1 TAP ≥5% (HR 0.74, 95% CI 0.59-0.94; P=0.006) and all randomized patients (HR 0.80, 95% CI 0.70-0.92; P=0.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Oxford Shoulder Score (48-point scale) at four-month follow-up
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome showed no significant differences between any treatment groups at four months; therefore, the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

The abstract lists several main outcome measures and reports efficacy against symptomatic, severe, and critical COVID-19, but it does not explicitly identify any one of these as the prespecified primary endpoint or state an overall rule for multiple primary endpoints.

primary_endpoint_description: Between-group difference in change in salt intake, measured by 24-hour urinary sodium, during 12 months of follow-up.
brief_rationale: The intervention produced a significantly greater reduction in 24-hour urinary sodium than control: adjusted between-group reduction 336.8 mg/24 h (95% CI 127.9 to 545.7; P=0.002), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of standard drinks consumed per week at six months
brief_rationale: The smartphone intervention significantly reduced standard drinks per week versus control (incidence rate ratio 0.90, 95% CI 0.85 to 0.96), in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Use of guideline-recommended management and time to the composite of cardiovascular death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, new-onset heart failure admission, or readmission for a cardiovascular event.
brief_rationale: Neither primary outcome showed favorable superiority: guideline-recommended management was similar between groups (OR 1.16, 95% CI 0.70-1.92; P=0.56), and time to the first composite cardiac event was not significantly improved (HR 0.89, 95% CI 0.68-1.16; P=0.37).

primary_endpoint_description: Improvement in the Medication Appropriateness Index and Assessment of Underutilisation at 12 months.
brief_rationale: Neither primary outcome showed favorable superiority: the odds ratios for improved medication appropriateness (1.05, 95% CI 0.59-1.87) and prescribing omissions (0.90, 95% CI 0.41-1.96) had confidence intervals crossing 1.

primary_endpoint_description: Recurrent venous thromboembolism after randomisation, a composite of distal DVT progression or recurrence, proximal DVT, symptomatic pulmonary embolism, or fatal pulmonary embolism.
brief_rationale: The primary efficacy outcome was less frequent with six additional weeks of rivaroxaban than with placebo (11% vs 19%; relative risk 0.59, 95% CI 0.36-0.95; P=0.03), demonstrating favorable superiority. The separately designated primary safety outcome had no major bleeding events in either group.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of patients with surgical site infection within 30 days after surgery
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 13% of patients receiving oral ornidazole versus 22% receiving placebo (absolute difference -8.6%, 95% CI -13.5% to -3.8%; RR 0.60, 95% CI 0.45 to 0.80), demonstrating a statistically significant reduction favoring ornidazole.

primary_endpoint_description: Pain, stiffness, and functional limitations at 18 months after randomisation, measured by the WOMAC score in the intention-to-treat analysis.
brief_rationale: The primary WOMAC outcome did not differ between single-stage and two-stage revision at 18 months (mean difference 0.13, 95% CI -8.20 to 8.46; P=0.98), so superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Low birth weight, small for gestational age, preterm birth, and mean birth weight
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies four primary birth outcomes but reports detailed results only for low birth weight. It does not state the overall success rule for the multiple primary outcomes or adequately report the other three, so overall primary-endpoint success cannot be determined.

primary_endpoint_description: Disease-free survival at three years, defined as survival without locoregional recurrence, distant metastases, a second primary cancer, or death.
brief_rationale: Three-year disease-free survival was 77% with extended-duration tinzaparin versus 79% with in-hospital prophylaxis (hazard ratio 1.10, 95% CI 0.90-1.33; P=0.4). The trial stopped early for futility, and favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of diabetes during three years of treatment
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint did not show significant favorable superiority: diabetes developed in 12.5% with eldecalcitol versus 14.2% with placebo (hazard ratio 0.87, 95% CI 0.67 to 1.17; P=0.39). The significant adjusted analysis was explicitly designated a secondary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Self-reported current hip pain intensity on a 0-10 Numerical Rating Scale over six months.
brief_rationale: BCT plus ultrasound-guided triamcinolone-lidocaine produced greater improvement in the primary outcome than BCT alone (mean difference -1.43, 95% CI -2.15 to -0.72; P<0.001), favoring the intervention.

primary_endpoint_description: Absolute difference between groups in the incidence of symptomatic, antibiotic-treated urinary tract infections during the 12-month treatment period.
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was one urinary tract infection episode per person-year. The absolute difference was 0.49 episodes per person-year, with a 90% CI of 0.15 to 0.84; the upper bound remained below the margin of 1.0, confirming noninferiority of methenamine hippurate.

primary_endpoint_description: Self-reported leg pain on a 0-100 visual analogue scale at 12 months, with a non-inferiority margin of 5.0.
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies 12-month leg pain as the primary outcome and concludes that PTED was non-inferior to open microdiscectomy; the observed result also favored PTED.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in self-reported COPD Assessment Test (CAT) symptom severity score from baseline to day 30, adjusted for baseline values and stratification factors.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored PEP flute self-care, with an adjusted between-group difference in CAT score change of -1.2 points (95% CI -2.1 to -0.2; P=0.017). This met the statistical superiority criterion, although the clinical effect was described as marginal and uncertain.

primary_endpoint_description: Upper limb disability/function measured by the Disability of Arm, Hand and Shoulder (DASH) questionnaire at 12 months
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified main outcome, 12-month DASH score, favored structured exercise over usual care (mean 16.3 vs 23.7; adjusted mean difference 7.81, 95% CI 3.17 to 12.44; P=0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of all-cause death or subsequent type 1 or type 4b myocardial infarction at one year
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 5.8% with early CT coronary angiography versus 6.1% with standard care (adjusted hazard ratio 0.91, 95% CI 0.62-1.35; P=0.65), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Antibiotic prescribing at the initial consultation
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored CRP point-of-care testing: antibiotics were prescribed to 53.5% of intervention patients versus 82.3% of controls, with significantly higher odds of not receiving antibiotics (OR 4.93, 95% CI 1.91-12.73).

primary_endpoint_description: First drug-related hospital admission within 12 months
brief_rationale: The primary outcome showed no favorable superiority effect: 21.9% in the intervention group versus 22.4% in control, with an intention-to-treat hazard ratio of 0.95 (95% CI 0.77 to 1.17). The confidence interval included no effect, and the abstract concluded that the intervention had no effect on drug-related hospital admissions.

primary_endpoint_description: Vision-specific quality of life measured by the VFQ-25 at 24 months
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed no significant favorable difference between trabeculectomy and medical management (mean difference 1.06, 95% CI -1.32 to 3.43; P=0.38), so superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: International Knee Documentation Committee score reflecting symptoms, knee function, and ability to participate in sports at 24 months
brief_rationale: The main endpoint favored early reconstruction at 24 months (difference 5.3 points, 95% CI 0.6 to 9.9; P=0.026), but the abstract explicitly states that this difference was not clinically relevant. Therefore, the stated objective of demonstrating a clinically relevant superiority difference was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of progression to severe COVID-19 (PaO2/FiO2 <100 mm Hg) or all-cause mortality at 28 days after enrolment
brief_rationale: The primary composite outcome occurred in 19% of the convalescent plasma group and 18% of controls (risk ratio 1.04, 95% CI 0.71 to 1.54), showing no significant favorable reduction with convalescent plasma.

primary_endpoint_description: Biochemically verified seven-day point-prevalence smoking abstinence at 12 months.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored the $40 bonus programmes, with significantly higher 12-month abstinence than programmes with no bonus (adjusted difference 5.9 percentage points, 95% CI 2.1 to 9.7; P=0.002); the abstract also states that the $40 individual bonus increased long-term abstinence versus usual care.

primary_endpoint_description: Ongoing pregnancy rate, defined as a detectable fetal heartbeat after eight weeks of gestation
brief_rationale: The freeze-all strategy did not show favorable superiority over fresh transfer for the primary endpoint: ongoing pregnancy rates were 27.8% versus 29.6% (risk ratio 0.98, 95% CI 0.87-1.10; P=0.76).

primary_endpoint_description: Uptake of hepatitis C virus testing among flagged patients
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was HCV testing uptake. Uptake was higher with the intervention (16% versus 10%), with an adjusted rate ratio of 1.59 (95% CI 1.21 to 2.08; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Treatment failure, defined as the need for invasive mechanical ventilation within 72 hours after birth.
brief_rationale: Treatment failure was significantly lower with NHFOV than with NCPAP (15.9% vs 27.9%; risk difference −12.0 percentage points, 95% CI −20.7 to −3.4; P=0.007), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: All-cause neonatal mortality through age 28 days
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored early BCG-OPV vaccination: 8.8% versus 10.1% mortality, with an adjusted hazard ratio of 0.83 (95% CI 0.69 to 0.98; P=0.03), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in 60-item Boston Naming Test score after the intervention period (approximately one month).
brief_rationale: The neurotomy plus intensive speech and language therapy group had a significantly greater improvement in the primary outcome than the therapy-only group (between-group difference 8.51 points, 95% CI 5.31 to 11.71; P<0.001), favoring the intervention.

primary_endpoint_description: Objective response rate assessed by a blinded independent review committee (BIRC)
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored sacituzumab tirumotecan over docetaxel: BIRC-assessed objective response rate was 45% versus 16%, a difference of 29% (95% CI 15% to 43%; one-sided P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: MASH improvement (decrease of at least 2 points in NAS or NAS ≤3) without worsening of liver fibrosis at 48 weeks
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred in 53% of participants receiving dapagliflozin versus 30% receiving placebo (risk ratio 1.73, 95% CI 1.16 to 2.58; P=0.006), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of a composite of 30-day postoperative cerebral, cardiac, respiratory, renal, infectious, and mortality complications
brief_rationale: The primary composite outcome occurred in 47.3% of the guided-care group versus 47.8% of the usual-care group (risk ratio 0.99, 95% CI 0.90 to 1.08; P=0.83), so guided care did not demonstrate favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite incidence of ischaemic stroke, transient ischaemic attack, and death within 30 days
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred less often with sonolysis than with sham (2.2% vs 7.6%; risk difference -5.5%, 95% CI -8.3% to -2.8%; P<0.001), demonstrating significant benefit in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean change in daily frequency of moderate-severe vasomotor symptoms from baseline to week 24.
brief_rationale: At week 24, fezolinetant produced a significantly greater reduction than placebo in daily vasomotor symptom frequency (least-squares mean difference -1.93, 95% CI -2.64 to -1.22; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Absolute change in mean depressive and anxiety symptom severity measured by the PHQ-ADS at six months in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: The PROVIDE model produced a significantly greater favorable reduction in the primary outcome than usual care at six months (adjusted mean change difference −2.4 points, 95% CI −4.5 to −0.4; P=0.02), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean change in ocular surface disease index score from baseline to eight weeks in the per-protocol population
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was 6 points. The between-group mean difference was -1.45 points (95% CI, -5.08 to 2.19), and the upper confidence bound was below the margin, satisfying the noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Self-reported respiratory symptoms consistent with a respiratory infection over 14 days
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred less often with surgical face masks than with no masks (8.9% vs 12.2%; marginal odds ratio 0.71, 95% CI 0.58 to 0.87; P=0.001), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of hypertension-related visits during which appropriate (guideline-accordant) treatment was provided.
brief_rationale: The intervention increased the primary outcome from 62.2% to 77.8%, an absolute difference of 15.2 percentage points (95% CI, 10.7 to 19.8; P<0.001), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Total self-reported Voice Handicap Index score at three months
brief_rationale: For the explicitly identified primary outcome, LSVT LOUD produced significantly lower (better) Voice Handicap Index scores than no speech and language therapy at three months (difference -8.0 points, 99% CI -13.3 to -2.6; P<0.001), demonstrating favorable superiority. NHS speech and language therapy did not differ from control.

primary_endpoint_description: Improvement of oesophageal food bolus obstruction (aggregate of complete and partial passage), with evaluation of complete passage.
brief_rationale: The main efficacy outcome showed identical improvement rates with cola and control (61% vs 61%; OR 1.00, 95% CI 0.33-3.1; P>0.99). Complete passage also was not significantly improved (43% vs 35%; P=0.58), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Patient-reported International Prostate Symptom Score (IPSS) at 12 months
brief_rationale: The intervention produced a significantly lower 12-month IPSS than usual care (adjusted mean difference -1.81, 95% CI -2.66 to -0.95), meeting the favorable superiority criterion because the confidence interval excludes no difference. The effect was smaller than the 2.0-point target used for powering.

primary_endpoint_description: Carer (informant)-reported Disability Assessment for Dementia scale score 12 months after randomisation
brief_rationale: The primary outcome did not differ between the intervention and usual-care groups (adjusted mean difference −1.3, 95% CI −5.2 to 2.6; P=0.51), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of antibiotic prescriptions for suspected urinary tract infections per person-year
brief_rationale: The intervention significantly reduced the explicitly identified primary outcome versus usual care: 0.27 versus 0.58 prescriptions per person-year, with a rate ratio of 0.42 (95% CI 0.26 to 0.68), in the intended favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Eczema symptoms measured by the Patient-Oriented Eczema Measure (POEM) every four weeks over 24 weeks, reported by parents/carers in trial 1 and by young people in trial 2.
brief_rationale: Both independent trials showed statistically significant, favorable reductions in POEM scores versus usual care over 24 weeks: adjusted mean difference −1.5 (95% CI −2.5 to −0.6; P=0.002) in trial 1 and −1.9 (95% CI −3.0 to −0.8; P<0.001) in trial 2.

primary_endpoint_description: Major adverse cardiovascular events (cardiovascular death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, or non-fatal stroke).
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was MACE. Its rate did not differ significantly between initial computed tomography and invasive coronary angiography in either women or men, so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Self-reported smoking cessation in late pregnancy (34-38 weeks’ gestation), corroborated by saliva cotinine and anabasine when using nicotine replacement products.
brief_rationale: Validated late-pregnancy smoking cessation occurred in 27% of the intervention group versus 12% of controls (adjusted odds ratio 2.78, 95% CI 1.94-3.97; P<0.001), demonstrating significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of participants with at least one swab test or doctor confirmed acute respiratory tract infection of any cause during six months of follow-up
brief_rationale: The primary outcome did not favor either vitamin D test-and-treat group versus no offer: lower dose 5.7% vs 4.6% (OR 1.26, 95% CI 0.96-1.66) and higher dose 5.0% vs 4.6% (OR 1.09, 95% CI 0.82-1.46). Thus, the intended reduction in acute respiratory tract infection was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Four predefined co-primary endpoints: positive SARS-CoV-2 RT-qPCR test; serious COVID-19 (self-reported dyspnoea, hospital admission, or death); negative SARS-CoV-2 test indicating another acute respiratory infection; and self-reported acute respiratory infection symptoms.
brief_rationale: Using a fallback procedure for multiple comparisons, cod liver oil did not reduce the risk of any of the four co-primary endpoints versus placebo; all adjusted confidence intervals included the null. The favorable superiority criterion was therefore not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Daily sitting time assessed by accelerometry at 12-month follow-up
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was significantly lower versus control for both SWAL (-22.2 min/day; 95% CI, -38.8 to -5.7; P=0.003) and SWAL plus desk (-63.7 min/day; 95% CI, -80.1 to -47.4; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Mobility disability, defined as inability to independently walk 400 m in less than 15 minutes, in participants with baseline SPPB scores of 3-7.
brief_rationale: The intervention significantly reduced the primary outcome versus control (46.8% vs 52.7%; hazard ratio 0.78, 95% CI 0.67-0.92; P=0.005), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Rate of catheter related bloodstream infection (CRBSI) in the baseline phase compared with the intervention phase at the renal service level, using intention-to-treat analysis.
brief_rationale: The intervention did not reduce the primary endpoint: CRBSI rates were 0.21 versus 0.29 per 1000 catheter-days in the baseline and intervention phases, respectively (incidence rate ratio 1.37, 95% CI 0.85 to 2.21; P=0.20). Thus, favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Between-group difference in change in salt intake, measured by 24-hour urinary sodium excretion, at 12 months in schoolchildren and their adult family members.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was reported separately for children and adults. The favorable effect was not statistically significant in children (−0.25 g/day, P=0.18) but was significant in adults (−0.82 g/day, P<0.001). The abstract does not state how these mixed population-specific results determine overall primary-endpoint success.

primary_endpoint_description: Fall rate at 91-180 days after randomisation.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored GtACH, with an incidence rate ratio of 0.57 (95% CI 0.45-0.71; P<0.001), demonstrating a statistically significant reduction in falls versus usual care.

primary_endpoint_description: Resolution of symptoms at day 7
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome did not show significant superiority: symptom resolution by day 7 was 40% with ciclesonide versus 35% with placebo (adjusted risk difference 5.5%, 95% CI −7.8% to 18.8%).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death, invasive mechanical ventilation, non-invasive mechanical ventilation, or intensive care unit admission through 28 days
brief_rationale: The primary composite occurred in 16.2% with therapeutic heparin versus 21.9% with prophylactic heparin, but the difference did not meet the superiority criterion (odds ratio 0.69, 95% CI 0.43-1.10; P=0.12).

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of patients in each group prescribed an antibiotic by day 28.
brief_rationale: For the explicitly identified primary outcome, procalcitonin-guided care significantly reduced 28-day antibiotic prescribing versus usual care (0.40 vs 0.70; cluster-corrected difference −0.26, 95% CI −0.41 to −0.10), meeting the favorable superiority criterion. Lung ultrasonography did not provide an additional significant reduction versus procalcitonin alone.

primary_endpoint_description: Week 16 circulating 17-hydroxydocosahexaenoic acid (17-HDHA) and Headache Impact Test (HIT-6) score
brief_rationale: The diets significantly increased the primary 17-HDHA endpoint versus control, but improvements in the co-primary HIT-6 endpoint were not statistically significant. Because the abstract does not state the overall success rule for these mixed co-primary results, trial success is indeterminable.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary outcomes of composite maternal morbidity and composite neonatal morbidity.
brief_rationale: Point-of-care PlGF testing did not reduce maternal morbidity (adjusted RR 1.01, 95% CI 0.76–1.36; P=0.92), and there was no evidence of a difference in neonatal morbidity (adjusted RR 1.03, 95% CI 0.89–1.21; P=0.67). Thus, the intended co-primary objective of reducing maternal morbidity without increasing neonatal morbidity was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Symptom burden measured by the Memorial Symptom Assessment Scale (MSAS).
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored ASyMS, with lower symptom burden than standard care (least-squares mean difference −0.15, 95% CI −0.19 to −0.12; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Olerud Molander ankle score at 16 weeks, analyzed by intention to treat
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed no statistically significant difference between removable brace and cast (difference favoring brace 1.8, 95% CI -2.0 to 5.6), so superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Cumulative incidence of surgical site infection
brief_rationale: In the prespecified primary intention-to-treat analysis, surgical site infection occurred in 7.4% with NPWT versus 9.7% with standard dressing (risk ratio 0.76, 95% CI 0.57 to 1.01; P=0.06). The favorable superiority criterion was not met.

The abstract lists downstaging at diagnosis and breast cancer mortality as “main outcome measures,” but does not explicitly identify either as the prespecified primary endpoint or define them as co-primary endpoints. Therefore, primary-endpoint success cannot be assessed.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of acute kidney injury progression, receipt of dialysis, or death within 14 days after randomization.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 21.3% of the alert group and 20.9% of the usual-care group (relative risk 1.02, 95% CI 0.93 to 1.13; P=0.67). The alert therefore did not achieve favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of major adverse events (inpatient death, intensive care stay, reoperation, and severe complications) within 30 days after surgery
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored the intervention: major adverse events decreased by an absolute 0.9% versus control (95% CI, 0.4% to 1.4%), with an adjusted ratio of odds ratios of 0.89 (95% CI, 0.83 to 0.96), demonstrating statistically significant superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Noninferiority of TARGIT-IORT versus EBRT for the absolute difference in five-year local recurrence rates, with a 2.5% margin.
brief_rationale: Five-year local recurrence was 2.11% with TARGIT-IORT versus 0.95% with EBRT; the absolute difference was 1.16% (90% CI, 0.32% to 1.99%). The upper confidence bound was below the prespecified 2.5% noninferiority margin, so the criterion was met.

primary_endpoint_description: Working memory in children younger than 4 years, the primary population
brief_rationale: NEWSUP significantly improved the explicitly identified primary outcome of working memory versus the control meal in the primary population (rate ratio 1.20, 95% CI 1.02-1.41; P=0.03), meeting a favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of days in hospital within 90 days after surgery
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed no evidence of fewer hospital days with robotic versus laparoscopic repair (median 0 vs 0 days; relative rate 0.90, 95% CI 0.37-2.19; P=0.82), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of unplanned hospital admission or death by 24 months
brief_rationale: In the intention-to-treat analysis, the primary composite outcome did not show significant favorable superiority with the decision support tool (odds ratio 0.88, 95% CI 0.73 to 1.07; P=0.19). Therefore, the primary endpoint did not meet the success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary outcomes were completion of cardiac rehabilitation and adherence to recommended medication at 12 months.
brief_rationale: The intervention increased cardiac rehabilitation completion (adjusted OR 1.55, 95% CI 1.18–2.03) but did not improve medication adherence (full intervention vs usual care OR 0.99, 95% CI 0.82–1.20). Because the co-primary outcomes were mixed and no overall success rule is stated, trial success is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: Negative conversion of SARS-CoV-2 by 28 days in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: Negative conversion by day 28 was 85.4% with hydroxychloroquine plus standard care versus 81.3% with standard care alone; the between-group difference was 4.1% (95% CI, -10.3% to 18.5%), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

The abstract lists several psychological and health-service-use measures as “main outcome measures,” but does not explicitly identify any as the prespecified primary endpoint or state an overall success rule for them.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in perceived insomnia severity measured by the Insomnia Severity Index at month 3 and month 15.
brief_rationale: Tai chi failed the four-point noninferiority criterion at month 3 but met it at month 15. Because the two primary timepoint results were mixed and no overall success rule for them is stated, overall primary-endpoint success is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of heart failure after acute myocardial infarction
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was significantly reduced with mesenchymal stem cell infusion versus standard care (2.77 vs 6.48 per 100 person-years; hazard ratio 0.43, 95% CI 0.21-0.89; P=0.024), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Repetition of self-harm at 12 months after randomisation
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored YCMAP: self-harm repetition at 12 months was significantly less likely with YCMAP than with enhanced treatment as usual (odds ratio 0.20, 95% CI 0.06 to 0.70; P=0.006), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of hypoxaemia (SpO2 ≤90%) within the first 10 minutes after positioning.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred significantly less often with lateral versus supine positioning (5.4% vs 15.0%; adjusted risk ratio 0.36, 95% CI 0.27-0.49; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Pessary continuation rate with satisfaction at 12 months, defined as continued pessary use plus a Patient Global Impression of Improvement response of very much better or much better.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was similar with vaginal oestrogen and placebo (87.0% vs 86.7%; risk difference 0.3%, 95% CI -6.2% to 6.9%; P=0.92), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

The abstract reports five-year distant metastasis-free survival and overall survival as “main outcome measures,” but does not explicitly identify either as the prespecified primary endpoint or clarify whether they were co-primary endpoints. Therefore, primary-endpoint success cannot be determined under the stated rules.

primary_endpoint_description: Net adverse clinical events at 12 months, comprising all-cause death, stroke, myocardial infarction, revascularisation, and BARC type 3 or 5 bleeding, in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: The absolute risk difference was 0.36%, with the upper boundary of the one-sided 95% CI at 2.47%, below the prespecified 3.2% noninferiority margin (P for noninferiority=0.013). Thus, the primary endpoint met the stated noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Amputation-free survival, defined as time to first major amputation or death from any cause.
brief_rationale: Neither drug-coated balloon angioplasty with or without bare metal stenting nor drug-eluting stenting significantly improved the primary outcome versus plain balloon angioplasty with or without bare metal stenting (adjusted HR 0.84, P=0.22; and HR 0.83, P=0.20, respectively). Thus, the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Live birth, defined as delivery of a neonate with heartbeat and respiration at ≥28 weeks' gestation.
brief_rationale: The trial hypothesized that freeze-all would increase live birth versus fresh transfer, but the primary outcome was significantly lower with frozen transfer (32% vs 40%; relative risk 0.79, 95% CI 0.65-0.94; P=0.009), favoring the control strategy rather than the intended direction.

primary_endpoint_description: First-attempt success rate of intraoperative infant orotracheal intubation
brief_rationale: The intervention significantly improved the explicitly identified primary outcome: first-attempt success was 91.4% with just-in-time coaching versus 81.6% with standard practice (odds ratio 2.42, 95% CI 1.45 to 4.04; P=0.001).

primary_endpoint_description: Disease-free survival in the intention-to-treat comparison of intensive chemotherapy (arm A) versus standard chemotherapy (arm B).
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored arm A: three-year disease-free survival was 90.9% versus 80.6% in arm B (hazard ratio 0.51, 95% CI 0.28-0.95; P=0.03), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Percentage of participants achieving HbA1c <7.0% at week 48 after short-term intensive insulin therapy
brief_rationale: The primary outcome differed significantly across groups (overall P=0.02) in the favorable direction. The linagliptin-plus-metformin group achieved 80% versus 60% with control (OR 2.78, 95% CI 1.37 to 5.65; P=0.005), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Cumulative live birth rate per oocyte retrieval, including all frozen-thawed embryo transfers within one year after randomisation.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was similar with blastocyst-stage versus cleavage-stage transfer (58.9% vs 58.4%; risk ratio 1.01, 95% CI 0.84 to 1.22), so the intended superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: At least a 30% reduction in Oswestry Disability Index from baseline to five-year follow-up
brief_rationale: The between-group differences were 0.4 percentage points (95% CI, -11.2 to 11.9) in the modified intention-to-treat analysis and -1.3 points (95% CI, -14.5 to 12.2) per protocol. Both confidence interval lower bounds exceeded the prespecified -15 percentage-point noninferiority margin, establishing noninferiority of decompression alone.

primary_endpoint_description: Obstetric anal sphincter injury, clinically diagnosed by combined visual inspection and digital rectal and vaginal examination
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 6% with lateral episiotomy versus 13% with no episiotomy (P=0.002; risk difference -7.0%, 96% CI -11.7% to -2.5%). This met the adjusted 4% significance criterion in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Five-year major adverse cardiovascular events, defined as a composite of all-cause death, myocardial infarction, stroke, and coronary revascularisation.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred significantly less often with one year of ticagrelor plus aspirin than with aspirin monotherapy (HR 0.65, 95% CI 0.43-0.99; P=0.04) and ticagrelor monotherapy (HR 0.66, 95% CI 0.44-1.00; P=0.05), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Antibiotic prescribing rate per 1000 patient visits among patients aged 65 years or older at six months after intervention.
brief_rationale: The main outcome was lower with peer-comparison feedback than with control (56.0 vs 59.4 prescriptions per 1000 visits; relative rate 0.95, 95% CI 0.94 to 0.96), demonstrating statistically significant benefit in the intended direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Prevalence of a major depressive episode at 42 days postpartum, diagnosed using the Mini-International Neuropsychiatric Interview
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred in 6.7% of the esketamine group versus 25.4% of the placebo group (relative risk 0.26, 95% CI 0.14 to 0.48; P<0.001), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Pain three years after randomisation, measured using the pain domain of the Endometriosis Health Profile-30 questionnaire.
brief_rationale: The primary pain outcome did not differ between long-acting progestogens and the combined oral contraceptive pill (adjusted mean difference −0.8, 95% CI −5.7 to 4.2; P=0.76), so superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Health-related quality of life measured by the PROMIS preference (PROPr) score at three months
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored REGAIN over usual care at three months (adjusted mean difference 0.03, 95% CI 0.01 to 0.05; P=0.02), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Oxford Shoulder Instability Score, a composite measure of shoulder function, at six months after treatment allocation
brief_rationale: The primary intention-to-treat analysis found no significant benefit from additional physiotherapy versus advice alone (adjusted between-group difference favoring physiotherapy 1.5, 95% CI -0.3 to 3.5). Thus, the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Quality of life over 18 months, measured by area under the curve for the SF-36 bodily pain domain
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint did not differ between conservative management and laparoscopic cholecystectomy (mean difference 0.0, 95% CI -1.7 to 1.7; P=1.00), so the superiority criterion was not met.

This is explicitly a secondary observational analysis of a stepped-wedge randomized trial. Although myocardial infarction or death at five years is called the current analysis's main outcome, the abstract does not explicitly identify it as the trial's prespecified primary endpoint or report the original trial primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of second-line antibiotics among all antibiotics prescribed by general practices for uncomplicated urinary tract infections after one year, comparing intervention with control.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored the intervention: mean proportions were 0.19 versus 0.35, with an adjusted mean difference of -0.13 (95% CI -0.21 to -0.06; P<0.001), demonstrating a significant reduction in second-line prescribing.

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator-assessed progression-free survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was significantly improved with pyrotinib versus placebo: median progression-free survival 24.3 versus 10.4 months (hazard ratio 0.41, 95% CI 0.32 to 0.53; one-sided P<0.001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Rate of infection-related hospitalisations, analysed as recurrent events, from randomisation at age 5-7 months to age 12 months.
brief_rationale: The main outcome did not favor early MMR vaccination: hazard ratio 1.03 (95% CI 0.91 to 1.18) versus placebo. Thus, the hypothesised reduction in infection-related hospitalisations was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Acne-Specific Quality of Life (Acne-QoL) symptom subscale score at week 12
brief_rationale: At week 12, the primary endpoint favored spironolactone over placebo by an adjusted mean difference of 1.27 points (95% CI 0.07 to 2.46); the confidence interval excluded no difference in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Rates over 12 months of dispensed amoxicillin and macrolide antibiotics (superiority) and hospital admissions for respiratory tract infection (noninferiority) among children aged 0-9 years.
brief_rationale: The trial aimed to reduce antibiotic dispensing without increasing respiratory tract infection admissions. Antibiotic dispensing was not significantly reduced (rate ratio 1.011, 95% CI 0.992 to 1.029; P=0.25), although hospital admissions met noninferiority. Because the required favorable reduction in dispensing was not achieved, the primary objective was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Recruitment rate, retention, and weekly minutes of self-reported moderate-to-vigorous physical activity
brief_rationale: The recruitment target was met, 21% were lost to follow-up, and the intervention-control difference in physical activity at week 3 had a confidence interval crossing zero. The abstract does not specify retention criteria or an overall success rule for these mixed primary outcomes.

primary_endpoint_description: Cumulative incidence of chlamydia or gonorrhoea reinfection at one year, assessed by nucleic acid amplification tests.
brief_rationale: The intervention was hypothesized to reduce reinfection, but incidence was higher with safetxt than control (22.2% vs 20.3%; OR 1.13, 95% CI 0.98-1.31). Thus, favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Rate of patients in full suicidal remission at day 3, defined as a Scale for Suicidal Ideation total score ≤3
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored ketamine: 63.0% versus 31.6% with placebo (odds ratio 3.7, 95% CI 1.9 to 7.3; P<0.001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: All incident autoimmune diseases confirmed by medical record review
brief_rationale: The factorial trial evaluated the primary endpoint for both vitamin D and omega-3 supplementation. Vitamin D showed a favorable result (HR 0.78, 95% CI 0.61-0.99; P=0.05), whereas omega-3 did not (HR 0.85, 95% CI 0.67-1.08; P=0.19). Because these primary treatment comparisons were mixed and no overall trial success rule was stated, the overall primary-endpoint result is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of venous or arterial thrombosis, treatment with extracorporeal membrane oxygenation, or all-cause mortality within 30 days of randomization
brief_rationale: The primary efficacy outcome occurred in 33% of the atorvastatin group versus 36% of the placebo group (odds ratio 0.84, 95% CI 0.58 to 1.21), which did not show a statistically significant favorable superiority effect.

primary_endpoint_description: Total intravenous morphine consumption from 0 to 48 hours postoperatively.
brief_rationale: The two-dose dexamethasone group had significantly lower 0-48-hour morphine consumption than placebo (median difference 10.7 mg, P<0.001), meeting the multiplicity-adjusted significance threshold of P<0.017 and reaching the stated 10 mg minimal important difference.

primary_endpoint_description: Cluster-level mean number of emergency department visits or hospital admissions per patient during the full course of chemotherapy
brief_rationale: The intervention did not favorably improve the explicitly identified primary outcome: the mean was 0.91 in the intervention arm versus 0.94 in the control arm (P=0.94), and the authors concluded that the intervention did not reduce emergency department visits or hospital admissions.

primary_endpoint_description: Continuous smoking abstinence from the first post-quit-date visit through visit 6 before delivery
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified main outcome was significantly more favorable with financial incentives than control (16% vs 7%; odds ratio 2.45, 95% CI 1.34-4.49; P=0.004), meeting the superiority criterion.

The abstract reports fractures, falls, and all-cause mortality as 'main outcome measures' but does not explicitly identify any endpoint as the prespecified primary endpoint or state an overall success rule.

primary_endpoint_description: Prolongation of gestation, measured as time from randomisation to delivery
brief_rationale: The primary outcome favored metformin numerically (median difference 7.6 days), but the superiority result was not statistically significant (geometric mean ratio 1.39, 95% CI 0.99-1.95; P=0.057). Significant adherence-based analyses do not change the primary-endpoint assessment.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of postoperative complications or all-cause mortality within 14 days after surgery in the modified intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 17.0% of the dexamethasone group versus 19.9% of the placebo group (adjusted odds ratio 0.81, 95% CI 0.60-1.08; P=0.15), so dexamethasone did not achieve statistically significant superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Delivery by caesarean section
brief_rationale: The caesarean section rate was 16.6% with oxytocin discontinuation versus 14.2% with continuation (RR 1.17, 95% CI 0.90-1.53). Discontinuation did not achieve the intended favorable superiority of a lower caesarean rate.

primary_endpoint_description: Rate of falls per person-year and proportion of participants who had a fall over 12 months
brief_rationale: Neither primary outcome significantly favored StandingTall at 12 months: fall rate IRR 0.84 (95% CI 0.62–1.13; P=0.071) and proportion who fell RR 0.90 (95% CI 0.67–1.20; P=0.461). Thus, the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Difference in participant-rated muscle symptom scores on a 0-10 visual analogue scale between atorvastatin and placebo treatment periods
brief_rationale: The primary analysis found no significant difference in muscle symptom scores between statin and placebo periods (mean difference −0.11, 95% CI −0.36 to 0.14; P=0.40), so superiority on the primary endpoint was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Clinical status at 15 days on a seven-level ordinal scale, analyzed as the composite of death or mechanical ventilation
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 28% of the tocilizumab group versus 20% of the standard-care group (OR 1.54, 95% CI 0.66-3.66; P=0.32). Tocilizumab was not superior and the numerical direction favored standard care.

primary_endpoint_description: Symptomatic response at 16 weeks measured by the total Reflux Symptom Index (RSI) score.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed no statistically significant benefit of lansoprazole over placebo (adjusted difference 1.9 points, 95% CI -0.3 to 4.2; P=0.096), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Pain and function assessed by the Victorian Institute of Sports Assessment-Achilles (VISA-A) questionnaire at 24 weeks
brief_rationale: The adjusted between-group difference in VISA-A score at 24 weeks was 0.5 points (95% CI, -17.8 to 18.8), showing no favorable superiority of high-volume injection over placebo.

primary_endpoint_description: Dose of opioid administered by patient- or nurse-controlled analgesia within the first 24 hours after surgery.
brief_rationale: The intervention significantly reduced the main outcome: median opioid use was 4.0 mg versus 5.3 mg morphine equivalents in the control group (P=0.002), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Adjusted Clinical Disease Activity Index remission (CDAI ≤2.8) at 24 weeks, comparing each biological treatment with active conventional treatment as the reference.
brief_rationale: For the primary outcome, abatacept had a favorable difference versus conventional treatment (9.4%, 95% CI 0.1% to 18.7%), whereas certolizumab and tocilizumab did not. The abstract does not state the overall success rule for these multiple primary treatment comparisons, and describes the abatacept result as nominally better.

primary_endpoint_description: Self-reported severity of urinary incontinence at 24 months, measured by the ICIQ-UI SF score
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed no favorable superiority of PFMT plus electromyographic biofeedback over PFMT alone (mean difference -0.09, 95% CI -0.92 to 0.75; P=0.84), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Oxford Knee Score at 52 weeks after total knee arthroplasty
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed a between-group difference of 1.91 points favoring outpatient rehabilitation (95% CI, -0.18 to 3.99; P=0.07), below the 4-point clinically meaningful threshold and not statistically significant. Thus, superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Difference in the one-year detection rate of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation between intention-to-screen and usual-care practices.
brief_rationale: New atrial fibrillation was detected in 1.62% versus 1.53% of patients (adjusted odds ratio 1.06, 95% CI 0.84 to 1.35). Opportunistic screening did not significantly increase detection, so the superiority endpoint was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival, assessed in the intention-to-treat population, with a 9-percentage-point noninferiority margin at 3 years
brief_rationale: IMPT met the prespecified noninferiority criterion versus IMRT for progression-free survival (HR 0.88, 95% CI 0.57–1.35; p=0.005 for noninferiority).

primary_endpoint_description: Birth with pre-eclampsia according to International Society for the Study of Hypertension in Pregnancy criteria
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 3.9% of the intervention group versus 5.6% of the control group (adjusted risk ratio 0.70, 95% CI 0.58–0.86), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Event-free survival (EFS) in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: The trial aimed to establish superiority of PAXG over mFOLFIRINOX. PAXG significantly prolonged the explicitly identified primary endpoint of EFS (median 16.0 vs 10.2 months; HR 0.63, 95% CI 0.47-0.84; p=0.0018), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Dual primary endpoints at 24 weeks: MASH resolution without worsening of fibrosis, and at least one-stage liver fibrosis improvement without worsening of MASH.
brief_rationale: Pemvidutide met the MASH-resolution primary endpoint but did not meet the fibrosis-improvement primary endpoint. Because the abstract does not specify the overall success rule for these mixed dual-primary results, overall primary-endpoint success is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: Development of two or more islet autoantibodies or diabetes during follow-up to a maximum age of 6.5 years.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 10% of the oral insulin group versus 9% of the placebo group (hazard ratio 1.12, 95% CI 0.76–1.67; p=0.57), providing no evidence of favorable superiority for oral insulin.

primary_endpoint_description: Relative change in urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (UACR) from baseline to week 12
brief_rationale: Both balcinrenone-plus-dapagliflozin doses produced significantly greater UACR reductions than dapagliflozin plus placebo at week 12: differences of -22.8% (90% CI -33.3 to -10.7; p=0.0038) and -32.8% (90% CI -42.0 to -22.1; p<0.0001). The explicitly identified primary efficacy endpoint therefore met the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Dual primary endpoints of overall survival in the intention-to-treat population and overall survival in the subset of patients without liver metastases.
brief_rationale: Overall survival significantly favored zanzalintinib plus atezolizumab in the ITT population (HR 0.80; p=0.0045), whereas the interim result in patients without liver metastases was not significant (HR 0.79; p=0.087) and awaits final analysis. The abstract does not state the overall success rule for the mixed dual-primary results.

primary_endpoint_description: Dual primary efficacy endpoints: objective response rate assessed by masked independent central review per RECIST 1.1 and overall survival.
brief_rationale: Objective response rate significantly favored iza-bren (54.6% vs 27.0%; p<0.0001), but overall survival data were not mature. The abstract does not state the overall success rule for the dual primary endpoints, so overall primary-endpoint success cannot be determined.

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator-assessed disease-free survival for durvalumab plus BCG induction and maintenance versus BCG induction and maintenance alone in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored durvalumab plus BCG, with a hazard ratio of 0.68 (95% CI 0.50–0.93) and log-rank p=0.015, demonstrating a statistically significant improvement in disease-free survival.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to 6-month EDSS-confirmed disability progression
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed no favorable superiority effect for simvastatin versus placebo: adjusted hazard ratio 1.13 (95% CI 0.91–1.39), p=0.26. Disability progression occurred in 40% of the simvastatin group versus 36% of the placebo group.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary outcomes: antibiotic prescribing at the index consultation (superiority), and recovery time, additional testing, follow-up visits, and antibiotic prescribing after the index consultation (noninferiority).
brief_rationale: Index-consultation antibiotic prescribing was significantly reduced (adjusted OR 0.72, 95% CI 0.55–0.94; p=0.017), meeting superiority, and each of the other four coprimary outcomes met its prespecified noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Relative reduction in proteinuria at 6 months, measured by the log-transformed ratio to baseline in 24-hour urine protein-creatinine ratio (UPCR).
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was met: iptacopan produced a 35.1% relative reduction in 24-hour UPCR versus placebo at 6 months (95% CI 13.8% to 51.1%; p=0.0014), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Area under the curve of stimulated C-peptide concentration during a 2-hour mixed-meal tolerance test at 12 months, measured as ln(AUC C-peptide + 1).
brief_rationale: The prespecified criterion required a statistically significant difference at p<0.05 for 2.5 mg/kg ATG versus placebo. The primary endpoint favored ATG, with a mean difference of 0.124 (95% CI 0.043–0.205; p=0.0028), meeting that criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death from any cause, non-fatal myocardial infarction, or any unplanned revascularisation at 1 year in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 13% versus 11% (HR 1.24, 95% CI 0.86–1.79; p for non-inferiority=0.24). The upper confidence bound exceeded the prespecified non-inferiority margin of 1.42, so non-inferiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of all-cause mortality or any hospital readmission over 12 months, with the prespecified event exclusions described in the abstract
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was less frequent with influenza vaccination than usual care (41.2% vs 47.0%; OR 0.83, 95% CI 0.72–0.97; p=0.019), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Changes from baseline at months 6 and 12 in depression and anxiety symptoms (HSCL-25), functioning (WHODAS 2.0), and perceived quality of care (PoC-OP Global Evaluation of Care) in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: All explicitly identified primary outcomes showed significantly greater improvement with SM-SC than usual care at 6 months, and the favorable effects remained significant at 12 months, with all reported 95% confidence intervals excluding no effect.

primary_endpoint_description: At week 51, a ≥2-point reduction in Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease Activity Score (NAS), with ≥1-point improvement in hepatocellular ballooning or lobular inflammation and no worsening of fibrosis.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred significantly more often with ION224 than placebo in both assessed doses: 46% with 90 mg versus 19% with placebo (risk difference 27.4%, p=0.0094) and 59% with 120 mg versus 19% (risk difference 40.1%, p=0.0002). Thus, the favorable superiority criterion was met.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary composite endpoints comparing each guselkumab regimen with placebo: (1) clinical response at week 12 plus clinical remission at week 48, and (2) clinical response at week 12 plus endoscopic response at week 48.
brief_rationale: In both GALAXI-2 and GALAXI-3, both guselkumab regimens were superior to placebo on each coprimary composite endpoint, with favorable treatment differences and p<0.0001.

primary_endpoint_description: Haemoglobin response, defined as a ≥1.0 g/dL increase from baseline in mean haemoglobin concentration from week 12 through week 24.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 42% (55/130) of mitapivat-treated patients versus 2% (1/64) receiving placebo, with a least-squares mean difference of 41% (95% CI 32–50; two-sided p<0.0001), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of maternal and perinatal deaths, including stillbirths and neonatal deaths
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary composite outcome was significantly lower with 2YoungLives than control (6% vs 13%; adjusted risk ratio 0.52, 95% CI 0.34–0.81; p=0.0034), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Independently assessed progression-free survival from randomisation to first documented disease progression or death from any cause, per RECIST version 1.1.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored retifanlimab plus chemotherapy: median progression-free survival was 9.3 versus 7.4 months, with a hazard ratio of 0.63 (95% CI 0.47–0.84) and one-sided p=0.0006, meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Two primary endpoints: independent review facility-assessed progression-free survival and overall survival, both measured from maintenance-phase randomisation.
brief_rationale: Both primary endpoints significantly favored lurbinectedin plus atezolizumab over atezolizumab alone: progression-free survival HR 0.54 (95% CI 0.43–0.67; p<0.0001) and overall survival HR 0.73 (95% CI 0.57–0.95; p=0.017).

primary_endpoint_description: Dual primary endpoints of blinded independent central review-assessed progression-free survival and overall survival.
brief_rationale: Relacorilant plus nab-paclitaxel improved both primary endpoints versus nab-paclitaxel alone: progression-free survival HR 0.70 (95% CI 0.54–0.91; p=0.0076) and interim overall survival HR 0.69 (95% CI 0.52–0.92; p=0.0121), both in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of participants with an unfavourable functional outcome (modified Rankin Scale score 2–6) at 90 days.
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was an RR of 1.15. The observed RR was 1.03 with a 95% CI of 0.92–1.15 and p for noninferiority=0.057, so the noninferiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Survival at 640 days (21 months)
brief_rationale: The primary unadjusted analysis found a non-significant reduction in mortality with low-dose IL-2 (HR 0.81, 95% CI 0.54–1.22; p=0.33) and explicitly failed to demonstrate the expected two-fold decrease in risk of death. Although a covariate-adjusted analysis was significant, the stated primary unadjusted analysis did not meet the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of shoulder dystocia, assessed by a masked independent expert adjudication panel
brief_rationale: In the intention-to-treat analysis, shoulder dystocia occurred in 2.3% with induction versus 3.1% with standard care (RR 0.75, 95% CI 0.51–1.09; p=0.14), so the primary superiority endpoint did not show a statistically significant favorable reduction. The significant per-protocol analysis does not change the primary ITT result.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in Hand Eczema Severity Index (HECSI) score from baseline to week 12
brief_rationale: Delgocitinib produced a significantly greater favorable reduction in HECSI score than alitretinoin at week 12 (least-squares mean difference -16.1, 95% CI -23.3 to -8.9; p<0.0001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Microbiological success, defined as culture-confirmed eradication of Neisseria gonorrhoeae from the urogenital site at test-of-cure (days 4–8), in the microbiological intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was -10%. The adjusted treatment difference was -0.1% (95% CI -5.6% to 5.5%); because the lower confidence bound remained above -10%, gepotidacin met the noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Cumulative incidence of the composite of death from any cause, myocardial infarction, or stroke
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred less often with clopidogrel than aspirin (3-year incidence 4.4% vs 6.6%; HR 0.71, 95% CI 0.54–0.93; p=0.013), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary day-22 endpoints: vaccine-minus-placebo serum neutralising antibody seroresponse-rate difference; serum neutralising antibody GMT for vaccine versus placebo; and GMT ratios for all three vaccine-lot pairs in adults aged 18–45 years.
brief_rationale: The vaccine-placebo coprimary endpoints were strongly favorable (seroresponse-rate difference 96.6%, p<0.0001; GMT 1618 vs 7.9, p<0.0001). Lot-pair GMT ratios and 95% CIs were also reported, but the prespecified lot-consistency/equivalence bounds and overall coprimary success rule were not stated, so success on all coprimary endpoints cannot be confirmed.

primary_endpoint_description: Participant-reported success at 15 months after randomisation, measured by the Patient Global Impression of Improvement.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was explicitly identified and did not show superiority for urodynamics plus comprehensive clinical assessment versus comprehensive clinical assessment alone (23.6% vs 22.7%; adjusted OR 1.12, 95% CI 0.73–1.74; p=0.60).

primary_endpoint_description: Seroprotective response 28 days after vaccination, defined as a rabbit-complement serum bactericidal antibody titre of at least 8, compared between NmCV-5 and MenACWY-TT for all five meningococcal serogroups in both age groups.
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was -10% for all five serogroups in both age groups. Every reported 95% CI had a lower bound above -10%, and the abstract explicitly states that NmCV-5 responses were noninferior for all five serogroups in both age groups.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite poor end-of-treatment outcome: documented treatment failure, loss to follow-up, switch to a multidrug-resistant regimen more than 28 days after treatment initiation, or death.
brief_rationale: Across all four country trials, digital adherence technologies did not significantly reduce the explicitly identified primary composite outcome versus standard care; all effect estimates were non-significant and did not favor the intervention.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary outcomes of breast cancer-specific survival and cost-effectiveness.
brief_rationale: Breast cancer-specific survival met the prespecified 3% noninferiority margin (p<0.0001), but the co-primary cost-effectiveness outcome was not reported and was stated to be reported elsewhere; therefore, overall co-primary endpoint success cannot be determined.

primary_endpoint_description: Treatment failure within 1 year of random assignment
brief_rationale: Failure was 34% with antibiotics versus 7% with appendicectomy, a difference of 26.7% (90% CI 22.4%–30.9%). This exceeded the prespecified 20% noninferiority margin, so antibiotics were inferior and the primary endpoint did not meet the noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of all-cause mortality, myocardial infarction, disabling stroke, clinically driven target-vessel revascularisation, valve reintervention, and life-threatening or disabling bleeding at 1 year post-treatment.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 4% with FFR-guided PCI plus TAVI versus 23% with SAVR plus CABG. The risk difference was -18.5% (90% CI -27.8 to -9.7), satisfying the prespecified 15% noninferiority margin (p<0.001); subsequent superiority testing was also significant.

primary_endpoint_description: Functional recovery assessed by change in modified Rankin Scale scores at 90 days in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome significantly favored the conventional guide catheter rather than the balloon guide catheter (adjusted common odds ratio 0.66, 95% CI 0.45–0.98; p=0.037). Because the result was in the unfavorable direction for the intervention, the superiority endpoint was negative.

primary_endpoint_description: Changes over 27 months in depressive symptom severity (PHQ-9), current depressive episode (PHQ-9 >10), and functioning (WHO Disability Assessment Schedule 2.0).
brief_rationale: All explicitly identified primary outcomes favored integrated care: depressive symptoms decreased by 2.60 points (95% CI, -3.35 to -1.86), functioning improved by 1.69 points (95% CI, -2.73 to -0.65), and odds of current depression decreased (adjusted OR 0.62, 95% CI, 0.51 to 0.74). All confidence intervals excluded the null.

primary_endpoint_description: Clinical diagnosis of primary postpartum haemorrhage within 24 hours of randomisation, defined as estimated blood loss greater than 500 mL or any blood loss sufficient to compromise haemodynamic stability.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 7.0% of the tranexamic acid group versus 6.6% of the placebo group (RR 1.05, 95% CI 0.94–1.19). Tranexamic acid did not produce the intended reduction in postpartum haemorrhage, so the superiority endpoint was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of blood culture-confirmed typhoid in children vaccinated with TCV in 2018–19 versus those vaccinated in 2021, assessing decline in protection over time.
brief_rationale: The previous-TCV group had significantly higher typhoid incidence than the recent-TCV group (adjusted incidence rate ratio 3.10, 95% CI 1.53–6.29; p<0.0001), meeting the study objective of demonstrating waning vaccine protection.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival from randomisation to RECIST 1.1 objective progression or death, assessed by independent radiology review
brief_rationale: The combination did not improve the primary endpoint versus tivozanib monotherapy: median PFS was 5.7 versus 7.4 months (HR 1.10, 95% CI 0.84–1.43; p=0.49). Thus, favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in HbA1c from baseline to week 26, with a non-inferiority margin of 0.4%.
brief_rationale: The estimated treatment difference was 0.052% (95% CI -0.077 to 0.181); the upper confidence limit was below the prespecified 0.4% margin, confirming non-inferiority of efsitora to degludec.

primary_endpoint_description: Device-oriented composite endpoint at 24 months, comprising cardiovascular death, target vessel myocardial infarction, and clinically and physiologically indicated target lesion revascularisation, in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority criterion required the upper limit of the one-sided 95% CI for the absolute risk difference to be below 2.68%. The observed risk difference was 3.04%, with an upper limit of 4.52% (p for noninferiority=0.65), so noninferiority was not established.
