primary_endpoint_description: Two primary objectives: dose-response in change from baseline to week 24 in ESSDAI in cohort 1, and the effect of iscalimab 600 mg on ESSPRI at week 24 in cohort 2.
brief_rationale: The cohort 1 primary objective was met with a significant dose-response relationship, whereas the cohort 2 ESSPRI result was not significant (p=0.12). Because the primary objectives had mixed results and no overall success rule is stated, overall primary-endpoint success is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator's Global Assessment for Chronic Hand Eczema (IGA-CHE) treatment success at week 16, defined as an IGA-CHE score of 0 (clear) or 1 (almost clear).
brief_rationale: In both DELTA 1 and DELTA 2, significantly more delgocitinib-treated patients achieved the explicitly identified primary endpoint than vehicle-treated patients (20% vs 10% and 29% vs 7%, respectively; both p≤0.0055), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Live birth
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was live birth. Neither time-lapse strategy significantly improved live birth versus standard care: adjusted OR 1.04 (97.5% CI 0.73–1.47) for time-lapse imaging with embryo selection and 1.20 (0.85–1.70) for undisturbed culture alone.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of myocardial infarction, revascularisation, hospitalisation for heart failure, stroke, or death from cardiovascular causes
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary composite outcome occurred less often with intensive treatment than with standard treatment (9.7% vs 11.1%; HR 0.88, 95% CI 0.78–0.99; p=0.028), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Livebirth after one frozen embryo transfer
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was explicitly identified. Neither natural-cycle nor modified-natural-cycle preparation showed favorable superiority over artificial-cycle preparation: relative risks were 1.07 (95% CI 0.87–1.33) and 0.98 (95% CI 0.79–1.22), respectively.

primary_endpoint_description: Ferritin and haemoglobin concentrations, iron deficiency, and haemoglobin-based deferrals, assessed by sex and menopausal status
brief_rationale: Several primary outcomes were explicitly identified. Ferritin, haemoglobin, and iron deficiency improved significantly, whereas haemoglobin-based deferrals did not improve significantly in premenopausal or postmenopausal female donors. The abstract does not specify an overall success rule for these mixed primary-outcome results.

primary_endpoint_description: Patient Health Questionnaire-15 (PHQ-15) score at 52 weeks after randomisation
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored the intervention: adjusted between-group difference -1.82 (95% CI -2.67 to -0.97; p<0.0001). This met the stated superiority objective in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival, analyzed by intention to treat
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was overall survival. NeoCF+D produced a statistically significant favorable survival benefit versus NeoCF (HR 0.68, 95% CI 0.50–0.92; p=0.006), meeting the superiority criterion, although NeoCF+RT did not significantly improve survival.
This extended post-trial follow-up reports seven prespecified aggregate clinical outcomes but does not explicitly identify any as the primary endpoint or state an overall success rule.

primary_endpoint_description: Return to baseline functioning on the pre-morbid modified Rankin Scale at 90 days in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 72% of the tenecteplase group versus 75% of controls (RR 0.96, 95% CI 0.88–1.04; p=0.29), so tenecteplase did not demonstrate the prespecified favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: All-cause neonatal mortality at 7 days
brief_rationale: The primary outcome showed no favorable superiority: mortality was 7.5% in both groups (adjusted RR 0.97, 95% CI 0.74-1.28; p=0.85), and the abstract states that KMC before stabilisation did not reduce early neonatal mortality.

primary_endpoint_description: Failure-free survival assessed through three pairwise comparisons among groups A, A+I, and I
brief_rationale: For the primary outcome, A+I was superior to A, A was not superior to I, and the A+I versus I comparison remained ongoing. The abstract does not specify an overall success rule for these multiple comparisons, so overall primary-endpoint success is indeterminable.

primary_endpoint_description: Successful treatment, defined as an interocular difference in best corrected visual acuity of ≤0.20 logMAR, after 12 weeks of patching.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored early patching: successful treatment occurred in 107/159 (67%) participants with early patching versus 86/158 (54%) with extended optical treatment, a 13% difference (p=0.019), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Health-related quality of life in patients at 6 months
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored stepped collaborative care, with greater improvement in health-related quality of life from baseline to 6 months versus standard care (p=0.013), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Infant HIV infection at age 12 months, assessed by modified intention to treat
brief_rationale: The intervention had fewer HIV transmissions than control (1 vs 6), but the primary-outcome difference did not reach statistical significance (p=0.066); therefore, favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Per-protocol vaccine efficacy in preventing confirmed hepatitis E occurring at least 30 days after the third dose
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome showed 86.6% per-protocol vaccine efficacy versus placebo (95% CI 73.0% to 94.1%). The confidence interval was entirely favorable and excluded no efficacy, supporting successful superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Mortality within 48 hours of detection of hypoxaemia
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was significantly lower after installation of solar-powered oxygen systems: 2.9% versus 5.1% before randomisation (adjusted odds ratio 0.50, 95% CI 0.27–0.91; p=0.023), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Therapeutic response (combined clinical and microbiological success) at the test-of-cure visit on day 10–13 in the specified microbiological analysis population.
brief_rationale: With a prespecified 10% noninferiority margin, gepotidacin was explicitly reported as noninferior to nitrofurantoin for the primary endpoint in both EAGLE-2 and EAGLE-3; EAGLE-3 also showed superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Poor monthly adherence, defined as missing at least 20% of planned doses in a treatment month
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred in 10% of intervention treatment months versus 37% of control months. The adjusted risk difference was -29.2 percentage points (95% CI -35.3 to -22.2; p<0.0001), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of patients in the reduction group who reduced their ICS-formoterol dose by week 32.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was explicitly identified and 110 patients (92%) reduced their dose by week 32, but the abstract does not state a prespecified threshold, comparison, or other success criterion for this endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Independence in activities of daily living, measured using the modified Barthel Index and analyzed with 6-month and 12-month data.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome did not favorably differ with HomeHealth; at 12 months the mean Barthel Index difference was 0.250 (95% CI -0.932 to 1.432), and the authors concluded that HomeHealth did not maintain independence.

primary_endpoint_description: Target lesion failure at 5 years, defined as a composite of cardiac death, target vessel myocardial re-infarction, or clinically indicated target lesion revascularisation.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 8% versus 11% of patients (RR 0.70, 95% Bayesian credible interval 0.51–0.95). The posterior probability for superiority was 0.988, exceeding the prespecified threshold of 0.975, so the superiority criterion was met in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Dual primary endpoints of progression-free survival and overall survival in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: Progression-free survival showed favorable superiority (HR 0.72; p=0.0002), whereas overall survival did not meet the prespecified significance criterion and remained under follow-up. The abstract does not state the overall success rule for these dual primary endpoints.

primary_endpoint_description: IBS Severity Scoring System (IBS-SSS) score at 6 months
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome showed a statistically significant between-group difference favoring low-dose amitriptyline over placebo at 6 months (difference -27.0, 95% CI -46.9 to -7.10; p=0.0079), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary outcomes were retention in care among participants with diabetes or hypertension (superiority) and HIV plasma viral load suppression below 1000 copies/mL (noninferiority margin 10%).
brief_rationale: Retention was not superior with integrated care (adjusted risk difference -0.60%, p=0.81), whereas HIV viral suppression met noninferiority (p<0.0001). Because the coprimary results were mixed and the abstract does not explicitly state the overall success rule, trial success is indeterminable.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to first generalised pustular psoriasis flare, assessed by demonstrating a non-flat dose-response relationship.
brief_rationale: The prespecified primary objective was to demonstrate a non-flat dose-response curve for time to first GPP flare. A non-flat relationship was established, with statistically significant results for all predefined dose-response models.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary outcomes of clinically important perioperative atrial fibrillation and myocardial injury after non-cardiac surgery (MINS) during 14 days of follow-up
brief_rationale: Neither coprimary outcome showed significant favorable superiority with colchicine: atrial fibrillation HR 0.85 (95% CI 0.65–1.10; p=0.22) and MINS HR 0.89 (95% CI 0.76–1.05; p=0.16).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of all-cause death or intervention for heart failure decompensation
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred less often with adaptive CRT, but the superiority criterion was not met (hazard ratio 0.89, 95% CI 0.78-1.01; p=0.077); the trial also crossed its futility boundary and stopped early.

primary_endpoint_description: Incident tuberculosis (all forms) among household contacts during follow-up
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies incident tuberculosis (all forms) as the primary outcome. Nutritional supplementation significantly reduced this outcome versus control (adjusted IRR 0.61, 95% CI 0.43–0.85; adjusted HR 0.59, 95% CI 0.42–0.83), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival by blinded independent review per RECIST 1.1 and overall survival in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary endpoints favored camrelizumab plus rivoceranib over sorafenib: progression-free survival improved significantly (HR 0.52; one-sided p<0.0001) and overall survival was significantly extended at interim analysis (HR 0.62; one-sided p<0.0001).

primary_endpoint_description: Landmark disease-free survival at 12 and 24 months in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: DFS favored nivolumab at both landmarks (85% vs 77% at 12 months; 84% vs 73% at 24 months), but the abstract does not state a prespecified statistical success criterion or provide a primary-endpoint test establishing that criterion was met; the reported DFS hazard-ratio confidence interval also included 1.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary outcomes: (1) composite maternal mortality or morbidity (superiority) and (2) composite stillbirth, neonatal death, or neonatal unit admission for more than 48 hours (noninferiority margin of 10%).
brief_rationale: The maternal primary outcome did not show superiority (adjusted RR 0.91, 95% CI 0.79–1.05), whereas the perinatal primary outcome met noninferiority (risk difference -3.39%, 90% CI -8.67 to 1.90; p<0.0001). Because the primary outcomes had mixed results and no overall success rule is stated, the trial-level primary endpoint result is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in HbA1c from baseline to 24 weeks.
brief_rationale: At 24 weeks, retatrutide produced significantly greater HbA1c reductions than placebo at all doses except 0.5 mg (p<0.0001), demonstrating favorable superiority on the explicitly identified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary endpoints of percentage change in bodyweight and achievement of at least 5% bodyweight reduction at week 68 with oral semaglutide 50 mg versus placebo.
brief_rationale: Both coprimary endpoints significantly favored oral semaglutide: mean bodyweight change was -15.1% versus -2.4% (difference -12.7 percentage points, 95% CI -14.2 to -11.3; p<0.0001), and 85% versus 26% achieved at least 5% weight reduction (OR 12.6, 95% CI 8.5 to 18.7; p<0.0001). Thus, both coprimary superiority endpoints met the favorable success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival, defined as time from randomisation to death from any cause.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored fruquintinib: median overall survival was 7.4 versus 4.8 months with placebo (HR 0.66, 95% CI 0.55-0.80; p<0.0001), demonstrating significant superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of baseline-seronegative participants achieving a seroprotective chikungunya neutralising antibody level (μPRNT50 titre ≥150) 28 days after vaccination.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was 98.9% (263/266; 95% CI 96.7–99.8; p<0.0001) in the VLA1553 group, but the abstract does not state the prespecified threshold or statistical criterion required for trial success or what the reported p value tested.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of sore throat days collected during the 24 months after random assignment
brief_rationale: The tonsillectomy group had fewer sore throat days than the conservative-management group, with an adjusted incidence rate ratio of 0.53 (95% CI 0.43–0.65; p<0.0001), demonstrating favorable superiority on the explicitly identified primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in HbA1c from baseline to week 26, with a non-inferiority margin of 0.3 percentage points.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed an estimated treatment difference of 0.02 percentage points (95% CI, -0.11 to 0.15) for icodec versus glargine U100. The upper confidence bound was below the prespecified 0.3-point margin, demonstrating non-inferiority (p<0.0001).

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival assessed by an independent review committee in all randomly assigned patients
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored zolbetuximab plus mFOLFOX6, with a significant reduction in progression or death versus placebo plus mFOLFOX6 (HR 0.75, 95% CI 0.60–0.94; p=0.0066).

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of patients achieving a Severity of Alopecia Tool (SALT) score of 20 or less at week 24.
brief_rationale: At week 24, significantly more patients achieved SALT score 20 or less with the evaluated ritlecitinib regimens than with placebo; placebo-adjusted differences were favorable and statistically significant for the 200 mg + 50 mg, 200 mg + 30 mg, 50 mg, and 30 mg groups (p≤0.0002).

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline to week 36 in urine protein-creatinine ratio based on a 24-hour urine sample
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy endpoint favored sparsentan, with a 49.8% reduction versus 15.1% with irbesartan (least-squares mean ratio 0.59, 95% CI 0.51–0.69; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary endpoints: cumulative ongoing pregnancy rate within 12 months in all women and ongoing pregnancy rate after fresh single embryo transfer in a good-prognosis population.
brief_rationale: Neither co-primary endpoint showed a significant favorable difference among groups (p=0.85 and p=0.90), so the trial did not demonstrate superiority of time-lapse-based selection or uninterrupted culture over routine methods.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary endpoints: mean change from baseline in frequency and severity of vasomotor symptoms at weeks 4 and 12.
brief_rationale: Both fezolinetant doses significantly reduced vasomotor symptom frequency and severity versus placebo at weeks 4 and 12, with all reported coprimary comparisons favoring fezolinetant (p≤0.012).

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of participants achieving nasal secretory IgA seroconversion against at least one Bordetella pertussis antigen on day 29 or day 113.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint is explicitly identified and group-specific seroconversion proportions are reported, but the abstract does not state a prespecified threshold, statistical comparison, or other success criterion by which the endpoint can be judged positive or negative.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of myocardial infarction, stroke, heart failure requiring hospitalisation, and cardiovascular disease death during 36 months of follow-up
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary effectiveness outcome occurred less often with the intervention than with usual care (1.62% vs 2.40% per year; HR 0.67, 95% CI 0.61–0.73; p<0.0001), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator-assessed time-normalised number of hereditary angioedema attacks per month during the 6-month treatment period (days 1–182).
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored garadacimab: mean monthly attack rate was 0.27 versus 2.01 with placebo, an 87% reduction (95% CI 58% to 96%; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival assessed by blinded independent central review in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly states that the trial met its primary endpoint: sotorasib significantly improved progression-free survival versus docetaxel (median 5.6 vs 4.5 months; HR 0.66, 95% CI 0.51–0.86; p=0.0017).

primary_endpoint_description: All-cause hospitalisation or death within 28 days of randomisation
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 105 (1%) participants receiving molnupiravir plus usual care versus 98 (1%) receiving usual care alone (adjusted odds ratio 1.06, 95% Bayesian credible interval 0.81–1.41; probability of superiority 0.33). Molnupiravir did not demonstrate favorable superiority on the primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Treatment success rate at 24 months after treatment initiation in the modified intention-to-treat and per-protocol populations
brief_rationale: The shorter regimen had a treatment success rate of 75.0% versus 70.6% with conventional therapy; the between-group difference was 4.4%, with a 97.5% one-sided CI lower bound of -9.5%. This exceeded the prespecified noninferiority margin of -10%, satisfying the stated criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Percentage change from baseline in Eczema Area and Severity Index (EASI) score at week 16
brief_rationale: All four rocatinlimab regimens produced significantly greater reductions in the explicitly identified primary endpoint at week 16 than placebo (p=0.0003, p=0.0002, and p<0.0001 for both other regimens), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Primary safety outcome: safety and tolerability after one and two nOPV2 doses; primary immunogenicity outcome: seroconversion rate for type 2 poliovirus neutralising antibodies 28 days after each dose.
brief_rationale: The abstract reports favorable safety findings and 90% seroconversion by week 8, but it does not state prespecified thresholds, comparison criteria, or an overall success rule for the primary safety and immunogenicity outcomes.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival by blinded independent central review
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored trastuzumab deruxtecan: median progression-free survival was 28.8 versus 6.8 months with trastuzumab emtansine (HR 0.33, 95% CI 0.26–0.43; nominal p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Surgical site infection within 30 days after surgery, assessed using US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention criteria at the participant level
brief_rationale: The intervention significantly reduced the explicitly identified primary outcome: SSI occurred in 16.0% of the intervention group versus 18.9% with current practice (adjusted risk ratio 0.87, 95% CI 0.79–0.95; p=0.0032), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of non-fatal myocardial infarction, non-fatal stroke, or cardiovascular death
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was explicitly assessed for superiority. It occurred in 11.0% of the allopurinol group and 11.3% of the usual-care group (HR 1.04, 95% CI 0.89–1.21; p=0.65), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Complete abortion after initial treatment, assessed at the 6-week interview
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was 4%. The telemedicine-versus-standard-care risk difference was -1.1% (95% CI, -4.0% to 1.7%) by modified intention-to-treat and -1.0% (95% CI, -3.8% to 1.9%) per protocol; the authors explicitly concluded that telemedicine was noninferior for complete abortion.

primary_endpoint_description: Difference between treatment pathways in 7-day average daily pain during the final week of each 16-week pathway
brief_rationale: The three pairwise primary-endpoint differences were small, with 98.3% confidence intervals crossing zero, and were explicitly reported as not significant. Therefore, no treatment pathway demonstrated superiority on the primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of asthma exacerbations treated with systemic corticosteroids during 52 weeks in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored mepolizumab: mean exacerbations were 0.96 versus 1.30 with placebo, with a rate ratio of 0.73 (95% CI 0.56–0.96; p=0.027), demonstrating statistically significant superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Functional independence at 90 days, defined as modified Rankin Scale score 0–2 or return to baseline
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was −0.10. The risk-difference 95% CIs crossed below this margin in both the intention-to-treat analysis (−0.051; 95% CI, −0.160 to 0.059) and per-protocol analysis (−0.062; 95% CI, −0.173 to 0.049), so noninferiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of patients with a modified Rankin Scale score of 0–1 at 90–120 days after treatment in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: The tenecteplase–alteplase risk difference was 2.1% (95% CI, -2.6% to 6.9%). The lower confidence bound exceeded the prespecified noninferiority margin of -5%, so the primary endpoint met the success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary week-24 responder rates for dysmenorrhoea and non-menstrual pelvic pain, based on Numerical Rating Scale scores and analgesic use.
brief_rationale: Relugolix combination therapy significantly improved both co-primary responder endpoints versus placebo in both SPIRIT 1 and SPIRIT 2 (all p<0.0001), with favorable confidence intervals for the treatment differences.

primary_endpoint_description: Freedom from progression, defined as biochemical failure, clinical failure, or death from any cause
brief_rationale: The final analysis reported 5-year freedom from progression of 70.9%, 81.3%, and 87.4% in groups 1, 2, and 3, respectively, and explicitly states that, per protocol criteria, group 3 was superior to both groups 1 and 2.

primary_endpoint_description: Complete clinical response at 6 months after local imiquimod treatment or one surgical intervention
brief_rationale: The per-protocol complete clinical response rates were 80% with imiquimod and 79% with surgery; the abstract explicitly reports that imiquimod met the prespecified 20% noninferiority criterion (p=0.0056).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of myocardial injury, non-fatal cardiac arrest, and all-cause mortality within 30 days after surgery
brief_rationale: The primary composite occurred in 9.9% with aggressive warming versus 9.6% with routine management (RR 1.04, 95% CI 0.87–1.24; p=0.69). Aggressive warming did not demonstrate favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator-assessed recurrence-free survival, defined as time from randomisation to recurrence or death, in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was explicitly considered met if pembrolizumab significantly improved recurrence-free survival versus placebo at either multiplicity-controlled interim analysis. At the first interim analysis, pembrolizumab significantly reduced recurrence or death (HR 0.65, 95% CI 0.46–0.92; p=0.0066), meeting the stated success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: First occurrence of symptomatic RT-PCR-positive COVID-19 beginning 28 days after the third dose.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred in 20 of 12,350 ZyCoV-D recipients versus 61 of 12,320 placebo recipients, yielding 66.6% vaccine efficacy (95% CI 47.6%–80.7%) in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator-assessed progression-free survival while receiving randomized therapy in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored trametinib: median progression-free survival was 13.0 versus 7.2 months, with a hazard ratio of 0.48 (95% CI 0.36-0.64; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean change in best-corrected visual acuity at 1 year, averaged over weeks 48, 52, and 56
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly states that noninferiority on the primary endpoint was achieved for both faricimab dosing regimens versus aflibercept in both YOSEMITE and RHINE, using the prespecified 4-ETDRS-letter margin.

primary_endpoint_description: Noninferiority of anti-spike IgG antibody responses 28 days after heterologous versus homologous booster vaccination, using a geometric mean ratio margin of 0.67.
brief_rationale: All three heterologous regimens met the prespecified noninferiority criterion: their geometric mean ratios versus homologous boosting were 6.7, 13.4, and 7.0, with all 95% CI lower bounds well above the 0.67 margin.

primary_endpoint_description: Geometric mean ratio of serum SARS-CoV-2 anti-spike IgG concentrations at 28 days after the second dose for each heterologous versus homologous vaccination schedule, with noninferiority defined by a one-sided 98.75% CI above 0.63.
brief_rationale: Noninferiority was met for ChAd/m1273, ChAd/NVX, and BNT/m1273, but not for BNT/NVX. Because the abstract reports mixed results across the primary comparisons without stating an overall success rule, the trial-level primary endpoint result is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary endpoints were mean percentage total bodyweight loss and responder rate (at least 5% total bodyweight loss) at 32 weeks.
brief_rationale: Mean percentage total bodyweight loss significantly favored aIGB, and the aIGB responder rate was 92%; however, the abstract does not report the control responder rate or state the overall success rule for the coprimary endpoints, so overall primary-endpoint success cannot be determined.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of patients experiencing any grade 3–5 toxic effect over 3 months
brief_rationale: The intervention significantly reduced the explicitly identified primary outcome versus usual care (51% vs 71%; RR 0.74, 95% CI 0.64–0.86; p=0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Combined endpoint of ischaemic or haemorrhagic stroke, systemic embolism, bleeding leading to hospitalisation, and all-cause death over at least 5 years
brief_rationale: The intervention had significantly fewer primary endpoint events than control (31.9% vs 33.0%; hazard ratio 0.96, 95% CI 0.92–1.00; p=0.045), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of all-cause mortality and total heart failure events (heart failure hospitalisations and urgent heart failure hospital visits) at 12 months in all randomly assigned patients.
brief_rationale: In the overall prespecified primary analysis, the event rate was not significantly lower with haemodynamic-guided management (HR 0.88, 95% CI 0.74–1.05; p=0.16). The favorable result in the prespecified pre-COVID-19 analysis does not change the negative overall primary-endpoint result.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary endpoints: time to first self-reported recovery and COVID-19-related hospital admission or death within 28 days.
brief_rationale: Time to recovery met its prespecified superiority threshold (>0.999 vs 0.99), but hospital admission or death did not (0.963 vs 0.975). The abstract does not specify the overall success rule for these mixed coprimary results.

primary_endpoint_description: Complication rate, a composite of infection, venous thrombosis, pulmonary embolus, inability to aspirate blood, mechanical failure, and other complications, assessed through device removal, withdrawal, or 1 year.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome had three prespecified comparisons with mixed results: PICC noninferiority versus Hickman was not confirmed, whereas PORT was superior to both Hickman and PICC. No overall success rule for combining these comparisons is stated.

primary_endpoint_description: Prevention of PCR-confirmed symptomatic COVID-19 occurring at least 14 days after the second dose in the per-protocol population.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy endpoint favored CoronaVac: 9 cases occurred in the vaccine group versus 32 with placebo, corresponding to 83.5% vaccine efficacy (95% CI 65.4–92.1; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary investigator-assessed radiographical progression-free survival in the PTEN-loss-by-immunohistochemistry population and in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: The PTEN-loss coprimary endpoint met its stated significance threshold (HR 0.77; p=0.034 at α=0.04), whereas the intention-to-treat coprimary endpoint did not (HR 0.84; p=0.043 at α=0.01). The abstract does not state the overall success rule for these mixed coprimary results.

primary_endpoint_description: Time from caesarean delivery to first analgesia request and the total amounts and types of analgesics used during the first 24 hours.
brief_rationale: Several primary outcomes were specified without an overall success rule. Time to first analgesia request was significantly shorter with nurse-supported care, an apparently unfavorable result, while some analgesic-use measures were similar or favored nurse-supported care, and total amounts/types were not fully reported. Overall primary-endpoint success is therefore indeterminable.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: Progression-free survival was explicitly identified as the primary endpoint. Isatuximab plus carfilzomib-dexamethasone significantly improved it versus control (HR 0.53, 99% CI 0.32–0.89; one-sided p=0.0007), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean between-group difference in time in range (sensor glucose 3.9–10.0 mmol/L) after 6 months in the intention-to-treat sample.
brief_rationale: Time in range was significantly higher with rtCGM than with isCGM after 6 months (59.6% vs 51.9%; mean difference 6.85 percentage points, 95% CI 4.36–9.34; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: 24-month composite of all-cause death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, stroke, readmission due to acute coronary syndrome, and BARC bleeding type 3 or greater in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary composite outcome occurred less often with clopidogrel than aspirin (5.7% vs 7.7%; HR 0.73, 95% CI 0.59–0.90; p=0.0035), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Complete renal response at 52 weeks, defined by urine protein-creatinine ratio, stable renal function, no rescue medication, and restricted prednisone use.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred significantly more often with voclosporin than placebo (41% vs 23%; odds ratio 2.65, 95% CI 1.64–4.27; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: 3-year event-free survival, with events defined as biochemical or clinical recurrence or progression, or initiation of systemic therapy, among patients who received radiotherapy
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored PET-guided radiotherapy: 3-year event-free survival was 75.5% versus 63.0% with conventional imaging alone (difference 12.5 percentage points, 95% CI 4.3–20.8; p=0.0028), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in upper-extremity impairment measured by the Fugl-Meyer Assessment-Upper Extremity (FMA-UE) score on the first day after completion of 6 weeks of in-clinic therapy.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored active VNS: mean FMA-UE improvement was 5.0 points versus 2.4 points with sham, a between-group difference of 2.6 points (95% CI 1.0–4.2; p=0.0014), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Catheter-related bloodstream infection (CRBSI), adjudicated by masked infectious diseases physicians, for central venous access devices and peripheral arterial catheters
brief_rationale: With a prespecified 2% margin, the CRBSI risk-difference CI was within the equivalence bounds for central venous access devices (0.32%, 95% CI −0.73% to 1.37%) and satisfied noninferiority for peripheral arterial catheters (0.28%, 95% CI −0.27% to 0.83%).

primary_endpoint_description: Time to 12-month remission
brief_rationale: The trial explicitly designated time to 12-month remission as the primary outcome and tested noninferiority of levetiracetam versus valproate. Levetiracetam did not meet the noninferiority criterion in the ITT analysis (HR 1.19, 95% CI 0.96–1.47; noninferiority margin 1.314).

primary_endpoint_description: Time to 12-month remission, comparing noninferiority of both levetiracetam and zonisamide with lamotrigine
brief_rationale: Results were mixed: levetiracetam did not meet noninferiority in the ITT analysis, whereas zonisamide did. The abstract does not specify the overall success rule for the two primary noninferiority comparisons.

primary_endpoint_description: Clinical cure 15 days after first antibiotic intake, defined by apyrexia, resolution or improvement of respiratory symptoms, and no additional antibiotic treatment for any cause.
brief_rationale: With a prespecified 10-percentage-point noninferiority margin, stopping β-lactam therapy after 3 days was noninferior to continuing for 8 days for day-15 cure in both ITT and per-protocol analyses; the abstract explicitly states noninferiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary endpoints of percentage change in bodyweight and achievement of at least 5% weight reduction at 68 weeks with semaglutide 2.4 mg versus placebo
brief_rationale: Both coprimary endpoints significantly favored semaglutide 2.4 mg: bodyweight change was −9.6% versus −3.4% (difference −6.2 percentage points; 95% CI −7.3 to −5.2; p<0.0001), and 68.8% versus 28.5% achieved at least 5% weight loss (OR 4.88; 95% CI 3.58 to 6.64; p<0.0001). Thus, both superiority endpoints met the favorable success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival and progression-free survival per masked independent review committee
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary endpoints favored cemiplimab over chemotherapy: overall survival improved (HR 0.57, p=0.0002) and progression-free survival improved (HR 0.54, p<0.0001) in the prespecified PD-L1 ≥50% population, with significant improvements also reported in the intention-to-treat population.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival among all randomly assigned participants
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was overall survival. Nivolumab plus ipilimumab significantly improved overall survival versus chemotherapy (median 18.1 vs 14.1 months; HR 0.74, 96.6% CI 0.60-0.91; p=0.0020), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: 50% improvement from baseline in Clinical Disease Activity Index (CDAI50%) at 16 weeks in the B-cell-poor population
brief_rationale: The trial was powered for superiority of tocilizumab over rituximab in the B-cell-poor population. In the histologically classified B-cell-poor population, the primary CDAI50% response did not differ significantly (56% vs 45%; difference 11%, 95% CI -11 to 33; p=0.31), so the superiority criterion was not met. The significant RNA-sequencing-based reclassification result does not alter the negative prespecified primary analysis.

primary_endpoint_description: Symptomatic, nucleic acid amplification test-confirmed COVID-19 occurring more than 14 days after the second vaccine dose in baseline-seronegative participants.
brief_rationale: The primary efficacy analysis showed overall vaccine efficacy of 70.4% (95.8% CI 54.8%–80.6%), with fewer cases in the vaccine group (30/5807) than in controls (101/5829). The confidence interval excluded no efficacy and favored vaccination, meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of hospitalisation for non-fatal myocardial infarction or biomarker-positive acute coronary syndrome, non-fatal stroke, or cardiovascular death
brief_rationale: The prespecified on-treatment primary cardiovascular endpoint met the noninferiority criterion: adjusted HR for febuxostat versus allopurinol was 0.85 (95% CI 0.70–1.03), with the upper confidence bound below the noninferiority limit of 1.3 (p<0.0001).

primary_endpoint_description: Two trial-specific primary outcomes: absolute QVLP vaccine efficacy against laboratory-confirmed respiratory illness caused by antigenically matched influenza strains in adults aged 18–64 years; and relative QVLP vaccine efficacy versus QIV against laboratory-confirmed influenza-like illness caused by any strain in adults aged 65 years or older.
brief_rationale: The publication reports two separate trials with mixed primary results: the 18–64 study did not meet its primary efficacy target, whereas the 65-plus study met its primary noninferiority endpoint. No single overall success rule applies across the two trials, so a unified publication-level result is indeterminable.

primary_endpoint_description: Rate of vertical transmission of cytomegalovirus
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred in 5/45 (11%) amniocenteses with valaciclovir versus 14/47 (30%) with placebo (OR 0.29, 95% CI 0.09–0.90; p=0.027), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Clinical status at day 15 after randomisation on a six-point ordinal scale, with higher scores indicating worse condition
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was not significantly different between azithromycin plus standard care and standard care alone (OR 1.36, 95% CI 0.94–1.97; p=0.11). Thus, favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of cardiac death; hospital admission for a cardiac event; recurrence or persistence of angina requiring addition, switch, or dose increase of at least one antianginal drug; or recurrence or persistence of angina requiring coronary angiography.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy endpoint occurred in 23.3% of the trimetazidine group versus 23.7% of the placebo group (HR 0.98, 95% CI 0.88–1.09; p=0.73), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: A composite response of either a ≥1.5 mL/kg/min increase in peak oxygen consumption with at least one NYHA class reduction, or a ≥3.0 mL/kg/min increase without NYHA class worsening, at 30 weeks.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was met by 37% of mavacamten patients versus 17% of placebo patients, a favorable difference of 19.4 percentage points (95% CI 8.7 to 30.1; p=0.0005), demonstrating superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Difference between groups in improvement of psychotic symptoms measured by PANSS at 6 months, using follow-up assessments at 3 and 6 months.
brief_rationale: The intervention produced a significantly lower 6-month PANSS score than control (adjusted mean difference −15.01, 95% CI −21.17 to −8.84; p=0.0001), demonstrating favorable superiority on the explicitly identified primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Total patient-rated wrist evaluation (PRWE) score at 52 weeks after randomisation
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome showed no significant superiority of early surgery over cast immobilisation (adjusted mean difference -2.1, 95% CI -5.8 to 1.6; p=0.27), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Difference between groups in mean DAS28-ESR change from baseline to week 24
brief_rationale: The continued-prednisone group had superior disease activity control on the primary endpoint: between-group difference 0.61 (95% CI 0.35–0.88; p<0.0001), favoring continued prednisone.

primary_endpoint_description: Incident HIV infection at the primary efficacy analysis
brief_rationale: The primary efficacy endpoint met the prespecified noninferiority criterion: the HIV incidence rate ratio was 0.47 (95% CI 0.19–1.15), with the upper confidence bound below the noninferiority margin of 1.62.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival assessed by intention to treat
brief_rationale: KdD significantly prolonged the explicitly identified primary endpoint of progression-free survival versus Kd (median not reached vs 15.8 months; HR 0.63, 95% CI 0.46-0.85; p=0.0027), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of mortality or major complications within 6 months of randomisation
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 38% with urgent ERCP versus 44% with conservative treatment (RR 0.87, 95% CI 0.64–1.18; p=0.37), so urgent ERCP did not demonstrate favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of patients achieving at least 50% improvement from baseline in facial Vitiligo Area Scoring Index (F-VASI50) at week 24 in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was achieved by significantly more patients receiving ruxolitinib cream 1.5% twice daily (45%) or once daily (50%) than vehicle (3%), demonstrating favorable superiority for these dose groups.

primary_endpoint_description: Development of colorectal cancer
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored aspirin: colorectal cancer occurred in 9% versus 13% with placebo, with a significantly reduced intention-to-treat hazard (HR 0.65, 95% CI 0.43-0.97; p=0.035), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator-assessed progression-free survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was significantly improved with atezolizumab versus control: median progression-free survival 15.1 versus 10.6 months (HR 0.78, 95% CI 0.63-0.97; p=0.025), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Safety and immunogenicity at day 42 after the first immunisation
brief_rationale: The abstract identifies safety and immunogenicity as primary endpoints but gives no overall success rule. Safety was generally favorable despite increased local reactions and one grade 3 rash, while immunogenicity differed by vaccine formulation and assay; therefore overall primary-endpoint success is indeterminable.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary efficacy endpoints were investigator-assessed RECIST 1.1 progression-free survival and overall survival for atezolizumab plus chemotherapy versus placebo plus chemotherapy, and overall survival for atezolizumab monotherapy versus placebo plus chemotherapy, with the monotherapy comparison tested only if combination overall survival was positive.
brief_rationale: The combination significantly improved progression-free survival (HR 0.82; one-sided p=0.007), while the interim overall-survival comparison had one-sided p=0.027 and the monotherapy comparison had HR 1.02. The abstract does not state the multiplicity-adjusted success thresholds or an overall rule for these mixed co-primary results, so overall primary-endpoint success cannot be determined.

primary_endpoint_description: Absence of clinically apparent seizures with improved consciousness and without additional antiseizure medication at 1 hour after the start of drug infusion.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy outcome was reported across drugs and age groups, but no efficacy differences were detected among levetiracetam, fosphenytoin, and valproate within any age group; thus favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall vaccine efficacy against virologically confirmed dengue during the first 11 months beginning 30 days after the second dose
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly states that the primary endpoint was achieved, with overall vaccine efficacy of 80.2% (95% CI 73.3% to 85.3%); 61 VCD cases occurred with TAK-003 versus 149 with placebo.

primary_endpoint_description: Disease-free survival analyzed by intention to treat
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was disease-free survival. Adjuvant chemotherapy significantly improved it versus surveillance (HR 0.45, 95% CI 0.30–0.68; p=0.0001), and the prespecified interim efficacy criterion for early closure was met.

primary_endpoint_description: Favourable functional outcome 90 days after randomisation, defined as a modified Rankin Scale score of 0–2
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 61.4% of the nerinetide group and 59.2% of the placebo group (adjusted risk ratio 1.04, 95% CI 0.96–1.14; p=0.35), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Development of atopic dermatitis by age 12 months
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was atopic dermatitis by 12 months. Neither skin emollients nor early complementary feeding reduced its development; estimated risk differences favored control and both 95% confidence intervals included no difference.

primary_endpoint_description: Occurrence of clinically detectable hernia at the stoma closure site 2 years after randomisation, assessed by intention to treat.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 12% of the biological mesh group versus 20% of the standard-closure group (adjusted RR 0.62, 95% CI 0.43–0.90; p=0.012), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Conversion to normal sinus rhythm for at least 30 minutes at any time after randomisation through immediately after up to three shocks
brief_rationale: Conversion occurred in 96% of the drug-shock group versus 92% of the shock-only group (absolute difference 4%, 95% CI 0% to 9%; p=0.07), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA), measured as letters read, at 12 months
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed an adjusted mean difference of 1.73 letters favoring eplerenone, but the 95% CI crossed zero (-1.12 to 4.57) and p=0.24. Thus, eplerenone did not demonstrate superiority to placebo.

primary_endpoint_description: Major adverse cardiac or cerebrovascular events (MACCE), comprising all-cause mortality, non-procedural myocardial infarction, repeat revascularisation, and stroke
brief_rationale: Noninferiority of PCI required the upper limit of the 95% CI for the hazard ratio versus CABG not to exceed 1.35. The primary endpoint HR was 1.58 (95% CI 1.24–2.01), so the upper limit exceeded the margin and PCI did not meet the noninferiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to recovery, defined as return to usual activities with fever, headache, and muscle ache minor or absent.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored oseltamivir plus usual care: recovery was faster than with usual care alone (hazard ratio 1.29, 95% Bayesian credible interval 1.20–1.39), with an estimated mean benefit of 1.02 days (95% credible interval 0.74–1.31).

primary_endpoint_description: ASAS40 response at weeks 16 and 52
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies ASAS40 responses at weeks 16 and 52 as the primary endpoints and states that both were met. Both ixekizumab regimens produced significantly higher response rates than placebo at each time point.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in ClinESSDAI score at week 24
brief_rationale: The 15 mg/kg nipocalimab group showed a favorable, statistically significant reduction versus placebo in the explicitly identified primary endpoint (least-squares mean difference −2.65, 90% CI −4.03 to −1.28; p=0.0018), although the 5 mg/kg dose was not significant.

primary_endpoint_description: Occurrence of moderate or severe acute kidney injury within 72 hours after surgery in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: The preventive care strategy significantly reduced the primary outcome versus usual care (14.4% vs 22.3%; odds ratio 0.57, 95% CI 0.40–0.79; p=0.0002), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Objectively confirmed venous thromboembolism through day 12 after the first study-drug dose in both ROXI-VTE-I and ROXI-VTE-II.
brief_rationale: The two trials had mixed primary-endpoint outcomes: REGN9933A2 did not meet the superiority criterion versus enoxaparin in ROXI-VTE-I (posterior probability 78.5%, below 95%), whereas REGN7508Cat met it in ROXI-VTE-II (99.8%). No single overall success rule for combining the two trials is stated.

primary_endpoint_description: Hospitalisation for influenza or pneumonia
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred less often with HD-IIV than with SD-IIV (0.56% vs 0.62%), with favorable relative vaccine effectiveness of 8.8% (95% CI 1.7 to 15.5; one-sided p=0.0082), demonstrating superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator-assessed progression-free survival, stratified by immunochemotherapy choice and analyzed in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored ibrutinib-rituximab over immunochemotherapy, with an adjusted hazard ratio of 0.69 (95% CI 0.52-0.90; p=0.0034), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Asthma attacks, measured as the rate per participant per year over 52 weeks.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored budesonide-formoterol, with annualized asthma-attack rates of 0.23 versus 0.41 per participant-year (relative rate 0.55, 95% CI 0.35-0.86; p=0.012), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: 24-month vein graft disease rate, defined as the proportion of saphenous vein grafts with at least 50% occlusion on coronary CT angiography or clinically indicated invasive angiography
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 21.7% of grafts with evolocumab versus 19.7% with placebo (difference 2.0%, 95% CI -3.1 to 7.1; p=0.44). Evolocumab therefore did not demonstrate the intended reduction in vein graft disease.

primary_endpoint_description: Between-group difference in disease-specific quality of life at 1 year, assessed with the VascuQoL-6 questionnaire.
brief_rationale: The primary efficacy endpoint showed no improvement with paclitaxel-coated devices versus uncoated devices (mean difference -0.02, 95% CI -0.66 to 0.62; p=0.96), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Percentage excess weight loss (%EWL) at 2 years
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was significantly better with SADI-S than with RYGB (mean difference -6.72 percentage points, 95% CI -12.64 to -0.80; p=0.026), confirming superiority in the intended favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Improvement in liver fibrosis by at least one stage without worsening of MASH at week 24
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies the week-24 fibrosis endpoint as primary but states only that it was previously reported. This publication reports a week-96 evaluation, so the prespecified primary endpoint result cannot be assessed from the supplied information.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to first major adverse cardiovascular event (cardiovascular death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, acute coronary syndrome, stroke, or hospitalisation for heart failure)
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 24% of each group, with no favorable superiority of spironolactone over placebo (HR 1.00, 95% CI 0.73–1.36; p=0.98).

primary_endpoint_description: Time to the composite of cardiovascular mortality or hospitalisation for heart failure
brief_rationale: The primary composite outcome was explicitly identified and occurred with an HR of 0.92 (95% CI 0.78–1.09; p=0.35) for spironolactone versus placebo. The trial was stopped early for futility, and favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Treatment-related serious adverse events up to 365 days after immunisation
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was explicitly identified and reported: all seven serious adverse events in the RmAb group were considered unrelated to treatment, while one treatment-related serious adverse event occurred in the ERIG group. However, the abstract provides no prespecified threshold or comparative success criterion for this safety endpoint, so primary-endpoint success cannot be determined.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival assessed by blinded independent central review in all randomized patients (intention-to-treat population)
brief_rationale: Adagrasib significantly improved the primary endpoint versus docetaxel: median progression-free survival was 5.5 versus 3.8 months (hazard ratio 0.58, 95% CI 0.45–0.76; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of treatment-emergent adverse events from before dosing on day 1 through the end-of-study visit in each study part
brief_rationale: The primary safety endpoint was explicitly identified and results were reported, but the abstract did not specify a prespecified threshold or other success criterion for the number of treatment-emergent adverse events. Therefore, the statement that amycretin appeared safe and tolerable is insufficient to classify the primary endpoint as positive or negative.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of patients recovered at 18 months, defined as a score below 8 on the six-item carpal tunnel syndrome scale
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored initial surgery: 61% recovered versus 45% with initial corticosteroid injection (relative risk 1.36, 95% CI 1.19–1.56; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Cancer detection rate, defined as the percentage of women with a positive supplemental-imaging result that led to histologically confirmed breast cancer.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome is explicitly identified and detection rates are reported. However, the abstract does not state which between-modality comparison or combination of comparisons constituted prespecified trial success. Reported comparisons were mixed: abbreviated MRI was superior to ABUS (p=0.047) but not to contrast-enhanced mammography (p=0.62).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of all-cause mortality, all stroke, and rehospitalisation at 1 year
brief_rationale: The upper bound of the treatment difference (10.2%) exceeded the prespecified 8.0% noninferiority margin; therefore, ACURATE neo2 did not meet noninferiority and had significantly worse primary-endpoint outcomes than control valves.

primary_endpoint_description: Safety and tolerability of MAR001 (single and multiple doses), with pharmacokinetics also a primary objective in the phase 1 study.
brief_rationale: The abstract identifies safety/tolerability and, for phase 1, pharmacokinetics as primary objectives. Although MAR001 is described as safe and generally well tolerated, no prespecified criterion for primary-endpoint success is stated, and primary pharmacokinetic results are not reported.

primary_endpoint_description: Sustained virological response 12 weeks after treatment completion (SVR12), assessed for the antiviral drug and treatment-strategy comparisons.
brief_rationale: Sofosbuvir-daclatasvir met the prespecified 5% noninferiority margin versus sofosbuvir-velpatasvir, and all treatment strategies met the prespecified 10% noninferiority margin versus standard care.

primary_endpoint_description: 5-year incidence of the composite of death, stroke, or myocardial infarction
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred in 16% of the PCI group versus 14% of the CABG group (HR 1.16, 95% CI 0.89–1.52; p=0.27). The reported difference was not statistically significant, so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary endpoints of immunologic superiority of chikungunya virus serum neutralising antibody titres versus placebo and geometric mean titre at day 22.
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies both coprimary immunogenicity endpoints and states that they were met.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of FITs returned correctly completed and yielding a laboratory result within 3 months of mailing.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was explicit, but the factorial primary analysis produced mixed intervention effects: a significant favorable main effect for deadlines, no benefit from the planning tool, and a significant interaction complicating the main-effect interpretation. The abstract does not state an overall success rule for these intervention hypotheses.

The abstract describes prediction-model development and validation, including validation using data from randomized trials, but does not explicitly identify a prespecified primary endpoint or its success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Good functional outcome on a prespecified sliding dichotomy of the modified Rankin Scale at 90 days in the modified intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 57% with nerinetide and 58% with placebo; the adjusted odds ratio was 1.05 (95% CI 0.73–1.51) and adjusted risk ratio was 1.04 (95% CI 0.85–1.25). Thus, nerinetide did not demonstrate favorable superiority on the primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Favourable functional outcome at 90 days, defined as a modified Rankin Scale score of 0–2
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 45% of the nerinetide group and 46% of the placebo group (adjusted odds ratio 0.97, 95% CI 0.72–1.30; p=0.82), so nerinetide did not demonstrate favorable superiority over placebo.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary superiority composites of PRO clinical response at week 12 plus endoscopic response at week 52, and PRO clinical response at week 12 plus CDAI clinical remission at week 52, for mirikizumab versus placebo.
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly states that both coprimary endpoints were met. Each significantly favored mirikizumab over placebo: 38.0% versus 9.0% for the endoscopic response composite and 45.4% versus 19.6% for the CDAI clinical remission composite (both p<0.0001).

primary_endpoint_description: Utility-weighted modified Rankin Scale score at 90 days
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy outcome showed no favorable superiority of FYTF-919 over placebo: mean scores were 0.44 in both groups, with an adjusted difference of 0.01 (95% CI -0.02 to 0.04; p=0.63).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite incidence of recurrent ischaemic stroke, symptomatic intracranial haemorrhage, unclassifiable stroke, or systemic embolism at 90 days
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 3.3% of each group (adjusted risk difference 0.000, 95% CI -0.011 to 0.012). The CI upper limit was below the prespecified 2-percentage-point noninferiority margin (p=0.0003), so early DOAC initiation met the noninferiority criterion; subsequent superiority testing was negative.

primary_endpoint_description: Primary efficacy outcome: mean change in home systolic blood pressure from baseline to week 12; primary safety outcome: treatment withdrawal due to an adverse event through week 12.
brief_rationale: GMRx2 showed significantly greater home systolic blood pressure reduction than each dual combination, while adverse-event withdrawals did not differ significantly. Because the abstract identifies both efficacy and safety primary outcomes but does not state an overall success rule or a success criterion for the safety outcome, overall primary-endpoint success is indeterminable.

primary_endpoint_description: Dual primary outcomes of blinded independent central review-assessed progression-free survival and overall survival in the full analysis set.
brief_rationale: Both dual primary outcomes favored cadonilimab: progression-free survival improved (HR 0.62, 95% CI 0.49–0.80; p<0.0001) and overall survival improved (HR 0.64, 95% CI 0.48–0.86; p=0.0011), meeting favorable superiority criteria.

primary_endpoint_description: Recovery from depression, defined as a Hamilton Depression Rating Scale score of 7 or lower, at 4 months after randomisation.
brief_rationale: Recovery at 4 months was significantly more frequent with the Positive Health Programme than with treatment as usual (49% vs 37%; adjusted odds ratio 1.97, 95% CI 1.26–3.10), meeting the favorable superiority criterion for the explicitly identified primary outcome.
The abstract explicitly describes a superiority trial and reports hookworm cure rate, but it does not explicitly identify cure rate or any other measure as the prespecified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary week-16 endpoints: Investigator's Global Assessment success (score 0 or 1 with at least a 2-point improvement) and at least 75% improvement in Eczema Area and Severity Index (EASI-75).
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly states that both replicate trials met both coprimary endpoints. Nemolizumab produced significantly higher week-16 IGA success and EASI-75 response rates than placebo in ARCADIA 1 and ARCADIA 2.

primary_endpoint_description: Reoperation rate within 6 months
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was 7.5%. Reoperation was 6.0 percentage points higher without irrigation, with a 95% CI of 0.2 to 11.7, exceeding the margin; the authors explicitly concluded that noninferiority could not be established.

primary_endpoint_description: Objective response rate by independent radiological review using RECIST version 1.1 at week 25 in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored vimseltinib: objective response was 40% (33/83) versus 0% (0/40) with placebo, a 40% difference (95% CI 29–51; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: 30-day composite of all-cause mortality, all stroke, bleeding types 3 and 4, acute kidney injury stages 2-4, major vascular complications, moderate or severe prosthetic valve regurgitation, and conduction system disturbances resulting in permanent pacemaker implantation
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary composite endpoint occurred in 25% with Myval versus 27% with contemporary valves. The one-sided upper 95% CI for the risk difference was 3.8%, below the prespecified 10.44% noninferiority margin (p<0.0001), so the noninferiority criterion was met.

primary_endpoint_description: Metastasis-free survival, defined as distant metastasis arising from prostate cancer or death from any cause.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint did not show favorable superiority for 6 months of ADT versus no ADT (HR 0.886, 95% CI 0.688–1.140; p=0.35); 10-year metastasis-free survival was 80.4% versus 79.2%. The stated improvement criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Modified Rankin Scale score of 5–6 at 180 days
brief_rationale: The primary outcome favored decompressive craniectomy numerically, but the superiority criterion was not met in the intention-to-treat analysis (adjusted risk ratio 0.77, 95% CI 0.59–1.01; p=0.057).

primary_endpoint_description: Quality of life measured using the McGill Quality of Life Questionnaire-Revised (MQOL-R) at 6 months post-randomisation.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored ACT plus usual care over usual care alone, with an adjusted mean difference of 0.66 (95% CI 0.22–1.10; p=0.0031), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary endpoints: superiority for clinically relevant bleeding (BARC types 2, 3, or 5) and noninferiority for major adverse cardiovascular or cerebrovascular events (MACCE) from months 1 to 12 after PCI, tested sequentially.
brief_rationale: The prespecified sequential criteria were met: ticagrelor alone significantly reduced clinically relevant bleeding versus ticagrelor plus aspirin (2.1% vs 4.6%; HR 0.45, 95% CI 0.30–0.66; p<0.0001), permitting MACCE testing, and MACCE met the 2.5-percentage-point noninferiority criterion (difference −0.1%, 95% CI −1.4% to 1.2%; p for noninferiority <0.0001).
The abstract reports safety and immunogenicity assessments but does not explicitly identify any endpoint as the primary endpoint or state an unambiguous equivalent designation.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in best-corrected visual acuity at week 48, with a non-inferiority margin of 4 letters.
brief_rationale: Both aflibercept 8 mg regimens met the prespecified 4-letter non-inferiority criterion versus aflibercept 2 mg: least-squares mean differences were -0.57 letters (95% CI -2.26 to 1.13) for 8q12 and -1.44 letters (95% CI -3.27 to 0.39) for 8q16, with both lower confidence bounds above -4 letters.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of participants with any reduction in inflammatory MRI lesions at 6 months
brief_rationale: At 6 months, the explicitly identified primary outcome occurred in 57% of the abatacept group versus 31% of the placebo group (absolute difference 26.5%, 95% CI 5.9–45.6; p=0.014), demonstrating statistically significant improvement favoring abatacept.

primary_endpoint_description: Protective efficacy of R21/Matrix-M against time to first clinical malaria episode from 14 days after the third vaccination through 12 months, assessed separately at seasonal and standard sites as co-primary endpoints.
brief_rationale: Both co-primary endpoints favored R21/Matrix-M: 12-month vaccine efficacy was 75% at seasonal sites and 68% at standard sites, with p<0.0001 for each.

primary_endpoint_description: Recurrence-free survival in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored combination therapy (HR 0.561, 95% CI 0.309–1.017; two-sided p=0.053), but the abstract does not state the prespecified significance threshold. Because the CI includes 1 and p exceeds 0.05 while a different prespecified alpha might have applied, trial success cannot be determined from the supplied information.

primary_endpoint_description: Perinatal mortality from 24 weeks' gestation to infant discharge
brief_rationale: Perinatal mortality was 0.3% in both groups (13/4774 concealed vs 13/4718 revealed; OR 1.45, 95% CI 0.76–2.76; p=0.262), so the intervention did not achieve a favorable significant reduction in the explicitly identified primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of post-ERCP pancreatitis
brief_rationale: Noninferiority required the upper bound of the two-sided 95% CI for the risk difference (indomethacin alone minus combination therapy) to be below 5% in both analysis populations. The reported risk difference was 3.6% (95% CI 0.6% to 6.6%); because the upper bound exceeded 5%, noninferiority was not established.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival, measured up to 12 months
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies progression-free survival as the primary endpoint and states that the primary efficacy endpoint was met at a preplanned interim analysis. Median progression-free survival favored SBRT plus standard of care (7.2 vs 3.2 months; HR 0.53, 95% CI 0.35–0.81; p=0.0035).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite risk of major perinatal morbidity
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was significantly reduced by the intervention versus control over time (adjusted OR 0.72, 95% CI 0.52–0.99; p=0.042; adjusted risk difference −1.2%, 95% CI −2.0 to −0.1), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: 8-week red blood cell transfusion independence, defined as no RBC transfusions for at least 8 consecutive weeks
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred in 40% of patients receiving imetelstat versus 15% receiving placebo, with a favorable rate difference of 25% (95% CI 9.9–36.9; p=0.0008), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in log-transformed urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio at week 12, comparing zibotentan 1.5 mg plus dapagliflozin with dapagliflozin plus placebo
brief_rationale: The primary comparison showed a favorable 33.7% reduction in UACR versus dapagliflozin plus placebo (90% CI 23.5% to 42.5% reduction; p<0.0001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in HbA1c from baseline to week 26, tested for noninferiority of once-weekly insulin icodec versus once-daily insulin degludec with a 0.3 percentage-point margin.
brief_rationale: The estimated treatment difference was 0.05 percentage points (95% CI, -0.13 to 0.23); the upper confidence bound was below the prespecified 0.3-point margin, confirming noninferiority (p=0.0065).

primary_endpoint_description: Perforated appendicitis diagnosed during surgery, assessed as the absolute difference in perforation rates between appendicectomy scheduled within 24 h versus within 8 h.
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority margin was 5 percentage points. The absolute risk difference was 0.6% (95% CI, -2.1 to 3.2); because the upper confidence bound remained below 5%, appendicectomy within 24 h met the noninferiority criterion.
The abstract reports ongoing pregnancy rates and a noninferiority margin, but it does not explicitly identify ongoing pregnancy or any other outcome as the prespecified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of expected pregnancies prevented, based on an established model
brief_rationale: Levonorgestrel plus piroxicam prevented 94.7% of expected pregnancies versus 63.4% with levonorgestrel plus placebo; the pregnancy comparison favored piroxicam (OR 0.20, 95% CI 0.02–0.91; p=0.036), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: 3-year change in a global cognition standardised factor score from a comprehensive neurocognitive battery
brief_rationale: In the primary intention-to-treat analysis of the total cohort, cognitive change did not differ significantly between the hearing intervention and control groups (difference 0.002, 95% CI -0.077 to 0.081; p=0.96), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Pain severity at 6 weeks measured by the 10-point pain severity subscale of the Brief Pain Inventory
brief_rationale: The opioid group did not show favorable superiority over placebo on the primary endpoint; pain was numerically worse with opioids, with an adjusted mean difference of 0.53 (95% CI -0.00 to 1.07; p=0.051).

primary_endpoint_description: Deep surgical site infection at 90 days post-randomisation
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred in 1.2% with high-dose dual-antibiotic cement versus 1.7% with standard cement; the difference was not statistically significant (adjusted OR 1.43, 95% CI 0.87–2.35; p=0.16). Thus, favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary endpoints of progression-free survival by blinded independent central review and overall survival.
brief_rationale: Neither co-primary endpoint showed favorable superiority for atezolizumab plus cabozantinib: progression-free survival HR 1.03 (95% CI 0.83–1.28; p=0.78) and overall survival HR 0.94 (95% CI 0.70–1.27; p=0.69).

primary_endpoint_description: Radiographic progression-free survival (rPFS) by blinded independent central review in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: At the planned primary analysis, talazoparib plus enzalutamide significantly improved the explicitly identified primary endpoint versus placebo plus enzalutamide (HR 0.63, 95% CI 0.51-0.78; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of second eyes with a target refractive outcome of 1.0 dioptre or less at 4 weeks postoperatively.
brief_rationale: The rate was 97% with immediate versus 98% with delayed surgery; the difference was -1% (90% CI, -3% to 1%), remaining above the prespecified -5% noninferiority margin and thereby establishing noninferiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Activity limitation at 13 weeks measured by the 24-point Roland Morris Disability Questionnaire (primary clinical outcome), and quality-adjusted life-years (primary economic outcome).
brief_rationale: Both CFT groups showed greater improvement than usual care in the primary clinical endpoint (mean difference -4.6 for each comparison, with 95% CIs excluding no difference). The abstract also reports that both interventions were more effective than usual care for QALYs.

primary_endpoint_description: Amputation-free survival, defined as time to first major above-ankle amputation or death from any cause in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: The primary composite event occurred significantly more often with vein bypass first than with best endovascular treatment first (adjusted HR 1.35, 95% CI 1.02–1.80; p=0.037), demonstrating superior amputation-free survival with the endovascular-first strategy.

primary_endpoint_description: 28-day mortality among all randomized participants
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was 28-day mortality. Mortality was significantly higher with higher-dose corticosteroids than with usual care (19% vs 12%; rate ratio 1.59, 95% CI 1.20–2.10; p=0.0012), indicating harm rather than favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean annualised bleeding rate during the efficacy period in the intention-to-treat population, estimated by a negative binomial model
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was significantly lower with fitusiran prophylaxis than with on-demand bypassing agents (1.7 vs 18.1), a favorable 90.8% reduction (p<0.0001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of all-cause mortality, myocardial infarction, any unplanned ischaemia-driven revascularisation, or cerebrovascular events at 1 year
brief_rationale: The prespecified noninferiority criterion required the upper bound of the 95% CI for the hazard ratio not to exceed 1.39. The observed HR was 0.78 (95% CI 0.55–1.11), so the upper bound met the criterion (p for noninferiority=0.0011).

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of patients with an SLE Responder Index (SRI)-4 response at week 52 for baricitinib 4 mg compared with placebo
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed no favorable superiority of baricitinib 4 mg over placebo: SRI-4 response was 47% versus 46% (odds ratio 1.07, 95% CI 0.75–1.53; difference 1.5%, 95% CI −7.1 to 10.2).

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of patients achieving an SLE Responder Index (SRI)-4 response at week 52 with baricitinib 4 mg versus placebo.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored baricitinib 4 mg: 57% achieved SRI-4 versus 46% with placebo (odds ratio 1.57, 95% CI 1.09–2.27; p=0.016). The abstract explicitly states that the primary endpoint was met.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary endpoints: incidence of grade 3 or worse late radiation-induced complications and overall survival.
brief_rationale: Both co-primary endpoints favored hyperfractionation: severe late toxicity was significantly lower (34% vs 57%; p=0.023), and overall survival was significantly better (HR for death 0.54, 95% CI 0.33–0.88; p=0.014).

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of patients achieving hidradenitis suppurativa clinical response at week 16 in the overall population, defined as at least a 50% decrease in abscess and inflammatory nodule count without an increase in abscesses or draining fistulae versus baseline.
brief_rationale: The every-2-weeks secukinumab regimen produced significantly higher week-16 clinical response rates than placebo in both SUNSHINE (45% vs 34%; p=0.0070) and SUNRISE (42% vs 31%; p=0.015), meeting the primary superiority endpoint. The every-4-weeks regimen was significant only in SUNRISE.

primary_endpoint_description: Surgical intervention to resolve the ectopic pregnancy
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 30% of the gefitinib group versus 29% of the placebo group, with no favorable significant difference (adjusted risk ratio 1.15, 95% CI 0.85–1.58; p=0.37). Thus, adding gefitinib did not demonstrate superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Estimated glomerular filtration rate (GFR) slope over the 24-month treatment phase
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed no significant favorable difference between sodium bicarbonate and placebo: mean difference 0.032 mL/min per 1.73 m² per year (95% CI -1.644 to 1.707; p=0.97; Wilcoxon p=0.51). Therefore, the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Malaria case incidence over 2 years after net distribution among children aged 6 months to 10 years in the intention-to-treat population.
