brief_rationale: Both upadacitinib doses significantly improved both coprimary endpoints versus placebo. EASI-75 and vIGA-AD response rates were higher with 15 mg and 30 mg upadacitinib, with p<0.0001 for every comparison, meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Protective efficacy of R21/Matrix-M against clinical malaria from 14 days after the third vaccination through 6 months
brief_rationale: At the 6-month primary efficacy analysis, vaccine efficacy versus rabies-vaccine control was 74% (95% CI 63–82) with 25 μg Matrix-M and 77% (95% CI 67–84) with 50 μg Matrix-M; both confidence intervals demonstrated favorable efficacy.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of treatment-emergent adverse events from baseline to the end of follow-up
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was reported (566 adverse events in 92 participants, with similar proportions experiencing events across groups), but the abstract does not specify a prespecified threshold or other success criterion for this safety endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Livebirth after the first embryo transfer from the initiated cycle
brief_rationale: The trial tested whether intracytoplasmic sperm injection increased livebirth versus conventional IVF. The primary outcome occurred in 35% versus 31%, but the difference was not statistically significant (absolute difference 3.4%, 95% CI -2.4 to 9.2; RR 1.11, 95% CI 0.93 to 1.32; p=0.27), so superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Virologically confirmed symptomatic COVID-19 occurring more than 14 days after the second vaccine dose.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 84/8597 vaccine recipients versus 248/8581 controls, corresponding to 66.7% vaccine efficacy (95% CI 57.4%–74.0%). The confidence interval showed statistically significant efficacy in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Cumulative all-cause mortality through day 42 in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: Day-42 mortality was 15% with posaconazole versus 21% with voriconazole; the treatment difference was -5.3% (95% CI, -11.6% to 1.0%). The prespecified 10% noninferiority criterion was met (p<0.0001), so posaconazole was noninferior to voriconazole.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of participants with PCR-confirmed COVID-19 from day 21 after the first dose
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred in 0.1% of vaccine recipients versus 1.3% of placebo recipients, corresponding to 91.6% vaccine efficacy (95% CI 85.6%–95.2%). This demonstrates statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Diabetes remission at 2 years, defined as HbA1c below 6.5% and fasting glycaemia below 5.55 mmol/L without ongoing medication for at least 1 year.
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies 2-year diabetes remission as the primary endpoint, but this 10-year follow-up does not adequately report the primary comparison between randomized groups at 2 years or whether its success criterion was met.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of participants with seroconversion 28 days after vaccination, comparing one-fifth fractional doses with standard doses for four yellow fever vaccines
brief_rationale: Noninferiority was prespecified as less than a 10% decrease in seroconversion with fractional versus standard dosing. The abstract explicitly reports that fractional doses of all four vaccines met this criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of infants with successful orotracheal intubation on the first attempt
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored video laryngoscopy: first-attempt success was 93% versus 88% with direct laryngoscopy, with an adjusted absolute risk difference of 5.5% (95% CI 0.7% to 10.3%; p=0.024), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Primary objectives were safety in all participants and noninferiority of day-28 seroprotection for novel OPV2 versus monovalent OPV2 in infants, using a 10% margin.
brief_rationale: Safety was favorable, and noninferiority was shown for both doses of OPV2-c1 and high-dose OPV2-c2, but it was not reported as shown for low-dose OPV2-c2. The abstract does not specify the overall success rule across the multiple primary objectives and vaccine-dose comparisons.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary outcomes were efficacy, measured by symptomatic virologically confirmed COVID-19 cases, and safety, measured by serious adverse events.
brief_rationale: This preliminary phase 2 report explicitly identifies efficacy and safety as coprimary outcomes, but it does not report the efficacy outcome. Serious adverse events are described, but the complete coprimary endpoint result and an overall success criterion are not provided.

primary_endpoint_description: 12-month estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) in paired donated kidneys for which both transplants were functioning at the end of follow-up
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored oxygenated perfusion numerically, but the mean difference was not statistically significant (3.7 mL/min per 1.73 m², 95% CI -1.0 to 8.4; p=0.12), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of PCI-related type 4a or 4b myocardial infarction or major myocardial injury within 48 hours of PCI (or hospital discharge if earlier).
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 35% with ticagrelor versus 36% with clopidogrel (OR 0.97, 95% CI 0.80–1.17; p=0.75), so ticagrelor did not meet the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Survival to hospital discharge
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was survival to hospital discharge. Survival was 43% with early ECMO-facilitated resuscitation versus 7% with standard ACLS (risk difference 36.2%); the posterior probability of ECMO superiority was 0.9861 and exceeded the prespecified monitoring boundary, meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Use of effective contraception (hormonal or intrauterine) at 4 months
brief_rationale: The intervention increased the explicitly identified primary outcome by 20.1 percentage points versus control (95% CI 5.2–35.0; p=0.011), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Dual primary outcomes of worst and average pain scores on a numerical rating scale during weeks 13–16 after randomisation.
brief_rationale: Neither primary pain outcome showed favorable superiority of gabapentin over placebo: worst pain adjusted mean difference −0.20 (97.5% CI −0.81 to 0.42; p=0.47) and average pain adjusted mean difference −0.18 (97.5% CI −0.71 to 0.35; p=0.45).

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in mean annualised growth velocity at 52 weeks in vosoritide-treated patients compared with placebo controls.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored vosoritide, with an adjusted between-group difference of 1.57 cm/year (95% CI 1.22 to 1.93; two-sided p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite maternal or perinatal adverse outcome: maternal, fetal, or neonatal death, or severe morbidity in the mother or baby
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was similar between intervention and control clusters (24% vs 22%; adjusted OR 1.17, 95% CI 0.90–1.51; p=0.24). The intervention therefore did not achieve the intended superior reduction in adverse outcomes.

primary_endpoint_description: Diagnosis of Barrett's oesophagus at 12 months after enrolment, expressed as a rate per 1000 person-years, comparing all intervention participants with all usual-care participants.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored the Cytosponge-TFF3 strategy: 140 of 6834 intervention participants versus 13 of 6388 usual-care participants were diagnosed with Barrett's oesophagus (adjusted rate ratio 10.6, 95% CI 6.0-18.8; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary outcomes of new-onset atrial fibrillation and delirium occurring between ICU admission and postoperative day 5 or hospital discharge
brief_rationale: Dexmedetomidine did not significantly reduce either co-primary outcome versus placebo: atrial fibrillation RR 0.90 (97.8% CI 0.72–1.15; p=0.34), while delirium was nonsignificantly increased (RR 1.48, 97.8% CI 0.99–2.23). Thus, neither co-primary superiority endpoint met the intended favorable success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary outcomes: PLATO major or minor bleeding (superiority) and net clinical benefit comprising all-cause death, myocardial infarction, stroke, and PLATO major or minor bleeding (noninferiority margin 2%).
brief_rationale: Both co-primary endpoints met their stated criteria: bleeding was significantly lower with clopidogrel (HR 0.71, 95% CI 0.54–0.94; p=0.02 for superiority), and net clinical benefit met the prespecified noninferiority criterion (p=0.03).

primary_endpoint_description: Cumulative incidence of locally acquired malaria cases for each of three comparisons: rfMDA versus RACD, RAVC versus no RAVC, and rfMDA plus RAVC versus RACD only.
brief_rationale: All three primary comparisons showed significantly lower malaria incidence in the intervention groups: adjusted incidence rate ratios 0.52 (p=0.009), 0.48 (p=0.002), and 0.26 (p=0.006), respectively, indicating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Independent review committee-assessed progression-free survival comparing acalabrutinib plus obinutuzumab with obinutuzumab plus chlorambucil
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored acalabrutinib plus obinutuzumab: median progression-free survival was not reached versus 22.6 months, with HR 0.10 (95% CI 0.06–0.17; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Accuracy of first-line imaging for identifying pelvic nodal or distant metastatic disease, defined by the receiver-operating curve against a predefined reference standard.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored PSMA PET-CT, which had 27% greater accuracy than conventional imaging (92% vs 65%; 95% CI for the difference 23–31; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Lesion healing (full epithelialisation or stable scar) without recurrence at 52 weeks after starting antimicrobial therapy
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred in 96% with RC8 versus 95% with RS8; the reported difference was -0.5% (95% CI -5.2 to 4.2), satisfying the prespecified 12% noninferiority margin. The abstract explicitly concludes that RC8 was noninferior to RS8.

primary_endpoint_description: Eczema at age 2 years, defined by UK Working Party criteria
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 23% of the emollient group and 25% of controls (adjusted relative risk 0.95, 95% CI 0.78–1.16; p=0.61), so daily emollient did not demonstrate favorable superiority in preventing eczema.

primary_endpoint_description: Three coprimary 1-year endpoints: net adverse clinical events, major adverse cardiac or cerebral events, and any actionable non-surgical bleeding, assessed hierarchically in high-bleeding-risk and non-high-bleeding-risk strata.
brief_rationale: Results were mixed across the stratified comparisons: 1-month DAPT failed noninferiority for the first coprimary endpoint in the high-bleeding-risk stratum, whereas 3-month DAPT met noninferiority and superiority criteria for the coprimary endpoints in the non-high-bleeding-risk stratum. The abstract does not provide a single overall trial success rule resolving these mixed stratum-specific results.

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator-assessed disease-free survival in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was significantly improved by adding nivolumab to cisplatin and radiotherapy (HR 0.76, 95% CI 0.60-0.98; stratified log-rank p=0.034), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary endpoints of EASI-75 response at week 24 and vIGA-AD score of 0 or 1 with at least a 2-point improvement from baseline at week 24, in both ROCKET-IGNITE and ROCKET-HORIZON.
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly states that both placebo-controlled superiority trials met both coprimary endpoints. Rocatinlimab produced significantly higher EASI-75 and vIGA-AD 0/1 response rates than placebo at week 24 in both trials (all reported p≤0.002), in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean percent change in bodyweight from baseline to week 72
brief_rationale: All three orforglipron doses produced significantly greater mean percentage bodyweight reductions than placebo at week 72 (estimated treatment differences −2.7, −4.5, and −7.1 percentage points; all p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion for the explicitly identified primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: Percent change in bodyweight from baseline after 48 weeks of treatment
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint is explicitly identified and descriptive results favor eloralintide, but the abstract does not report prespecified between-group superiority criteria, treatment-effect comparisons, or inferential statistics establishing that the success criterion was met.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to first major adverse cardiovascular event (cardiovascular death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, or non-fatal stroke).
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies time to first MACE as the primary outcome and reports that semaglutide significantly reduced MACE incidence compared with placebo, meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Relative change in Apnoea-Hypopnea Index using the 3% desaturation/arousal definition (AHI3a) from baseline to week 15
brief_rationale: All three sultiame doses produced statistically significant placebo-subtracted reductions in the explicitly identified primary efficacy endpoint at week 15 (p=0.032 for 100 mg and p<0.0001 for 200 mg and 300 mg), favoring sultiame.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary endpoints: proportions achieving IGA 0 or 1 with at least a two-grade improvement and PASI 90 at week 16 with icotrokinra versus placebo.
brief_rationale: Both coprimary endpoints were met in both trials. Icotrokinra produced significantly higher week-16 IGA 0/1 and PASI 90 response rates than placebo (both p<0.0001 in each trial), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in glycated haemoglobin (HbA1c) from baseline to week 30.
brief_rationale: Tirzepatide was superior to placebo for the explicitly identified primary endpoint: pooled tirzepatide reduced HbA1c by 2.23% versus a 0.05% increase with placebo (estimated treatment difference −2.28%, 95% CI −2.87 to −1.69; p<0.0001).

primary_endpoint_description: Ipsilateral major amputation (above the ankle) during follow-up
brief_rationale: The primary efficacy endpoint did not significantly differ between paclitaxel-coated and uncoated devices (HR 1.05, 95% CI 0.87-1.27; p=0.61), so the intended reduction in major ipsilateral amputation was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Radiographic progression-free survival (rPFS) by blinded independent central review in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies rPFS as the primary endpoint and states that the primary analysis showed significant improvement with talazoparib plus enzalutamide versus control. The updated analysis remained favorable (HR 0.67, 95% CI 0.55–0.81; p<0.0001), supporting successful superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Radiographic progression-free survival (time from randomisation to radiographic progression or death, whichever occurred first) by blinded independent central review in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies radiographic progression-free survival as the primary endpoint and states that it was significantly improved with talazoparib plus enzalutamide. The updated result remained favorable (HR 0.47, 95% CI 0.36–0.61; p<0.0001; median 30.7 vs 12.3 months), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary endpoints: proportion of wounds with at least 50% healing and reduction in wound pain from baseline at week 24.
brief_rationale: Both coprimary endpoints favored prademagene zamikeracel over control: at least 50% healing occurred in 81% versus 16% of wounds (p<0.0001), and pain improved by a greater amount (mean pairwise difference -2.23, p=0.0002).

primary_endpoint_description: 5-year recurrence-free survival, defined as absence of locoregional recurrent or persistent structural disease, distant metastases, or death from thyroid cancer
brief_rationale: The prespecified 5-percentage-point noninferiority margin was met: the 5-year absolute risk difference was 0.5 percentage points (95% CI, -2.2 to 3.2; p for noninferiority=0.033) in the ITT analysis, and the abstract explicitly states that noninferiority was reached.

primary_endpoint_description: Time from randomisation to wound healing, defined as complete epithelial cover
brief_rationale: The primary superiority outcome showed no clear evidence of faster wound healing with NPWT versus usual care (hazard ratio 1.08, 95% CI 0.88–1.32; p=0.47), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Percent change in apolipoprotein B concentration from baseline to day 180 with solbinsiran versus placebo.
brief_rationale: For the explicitly identified primary outcome, solbinsiran 400 mg produced a favorable placebo-adjusted apoB reduction of 14.3% (95% CI 3.9% to 23.6% reduction; p=0.0085), meeting the superiority criterion. The 100 mg and 800 mg comparisons were not significant.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of death, myocardial infarction, or revascularisation at 12 months in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: The event rate was 6.3% with angiography-derived FFR guidance versus 6.0% with intravascular ultrasound guidance. The upper boundary of the one-sided 97.5% CI for the absolute difference was 2.4 percentage points, below the prespecified 2.5-percentage-point noninferiority margin (p_noninferiority=0.022), so noninferiority was established.

primary_endpoint_description: Two powered coprimary endpoints: target vessel failure at 1 year and post-procedural minimal stent area at the site of maximal calcification.
brief_rationale: Neither coprimary endpoint showed favorable superiority of orbital atherectomy: 1-year target vessel failure was 11.5% versus 10.0% (HR 1.16; p=0.28), and minimal stent area was 7.67 versus 7.42 mm² (mean difference 0.26; p=0.078).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of perinatal mortality (stillbirth and death up to 28 days postpartum) and six severe neonatal morbidities
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 8% of infants with atosiban versus 9% with placebo (RR 0.90, 95% CI 0.58–1.40). The confidence interval included no effect, and the authors explicitly stated that superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Dual primary endpoints of blinded independent central review-assessed progression-free survival for nivolumab plus ipilimumab versus chemotherapy in the first-line setting and versus nivolumab alone across all treatment lines.
brief_rationale: The reported primary endpoint met superiority: nivolumab plus ipilimumab significantly improved progression-free survival versus nivolumab (HR 0.62, 95% CI 0.48–0.81; p=0.0003). The abstract also states that the other dual primary endpoint previously showed superior progression-free survival versus chemotherapy.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in CDASI-A score at week 12 for the skin-predominant cohorts, and safety for the muscle-predominant cohort.
brief_rationale: The skin-cohort primary efficacy outcome significantly favored dazukibart, but safety was also designated as a primary outcome for the muscle-predominant cohort. No prespecified safety success criterion or overall rule integrating these cohort-specific primary outcomes is stated.

primary_endpoint_description: First-time malaria infection in children aged 6 months to younger than 10 years, assessed by survival analysis
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored the spatial repellent: the hazard rate of first-time malaria infection was reduced by 33.4% versus placebo (95% CI 11.1–50.1; p=0.0058), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Clinical remission at induction week 12 and maintenance week 44
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary endpoints favored guselkumab over placebo: induction remission was 23% versus 8% (p<0.0001), and maintenance remission was 50% and 45% for the two guselkumab regimens versus 19% for placebo (both p<0.0001).

primary_endpoint_description: Disease-free survival
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was disease-free survival. Pembrolizumab significantly improved disease-free survival versus control (HR 0.61, 90% CI 0.39-0.96; one-sided log-rank p=0.035), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Device-oriented clinical endpoint of target lesion failure at 12 months, a composite of cardiovascular death, target vessel myocardial infarction, and ischaemia-driven target lesion revascularisation
brief_rationale: Target lesion failure occurred in 2.4% with the bioadaptor versus 2.8% with DES. The absolute risk difference was -0.41% (95% CI -1.94% to 1.11%); the CI upper limit was below the prespecified 4.2% noninferiority margin (p<0.0001), so the primary endpoint met the success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival and overall survival in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary endpoints favored induction chemotherapy plus chemoradiotherapy: progression-free survival HR 0.65 (95% CI 0.46–0.91; p=0.013) and overall survival HR 0.60 (95% CI 0.40–0.91; p=0.015). Both superiority endpoints were statistically significant in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: 5-year overall survival in the intention-to-treat and per-protocol populations
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored liver transplantation plus chemotherapy: in the intention-to-treat population, 5-year overall survival was 56.6% versus 12.6% with chemotherapy alone (HR 0.37, 95% CI 0.21-0.65; p=0.0003), demonstrating significant superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Dual primary endpoints of overall survival and event-free survival in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: Overall survival significantly favored perioperative pembrolizumab and crossed the prespecified interim threshold (one-sided p=0.0052 vs threshold 0.0054; HR 0.72). Event-free survival also favored pembrolizumab (HR 0.59), and the abstract states it was significantly improved at the first interim analysis.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival and overall survival
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary endpoints favored pembrolizumab. Progression-free survival was reported as significantly improved at the first interim analysis, and overall survival improved at the second interim analysis (HR 0.67, 95% CI 0.50–0.90; p=0.0040), explicitly meeting the protocol-specified primary objective.

primary_endpoint_description: Major adverse cardiac events at 1 year after PCI, defined as a composite of cardiac death, myocardial infarction, stent thrombosis, or ischaemia-driven target-vessel revascularisation.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred less often with OCT-guided PCI than with angiography-guided PCI (5% vs 7%; HR 0.62, 95% CI 0.41-0.93; p=0.023). The confidence interval was below the stated superiority margin of HR 1.0, demonstrating favorable superiority.

This prespecified heart-failure subgroup analysis lists several endpoints but does not explicitly identify any as the trial's primary endpoint. Therefore, the primary-endpoint success criterion cannot be assessed from the supplied abstract.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of intravitreal ranibizumab injections required over 2 years, tested for superiority (fewer injections).
brief_rationale: The SRT group required fewer injections than sham (mean 10.7 vs 13.3; adjusted reduction 2.9 injections, 95% CI 1.6 to 4.2 fewer; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion for the explicitly identified primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival by blinded, independent, central radiology assessment
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored 177Lu-Dotatate plus octreotide: median progression-free survival was 22.8 versus 8.5 months, with a stratified hazard ratio of 0.276 (95% CI 0.182-0.418; p<0.0001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Event-free survival from randomisation to locoregional or distant disease recurrence or death from any cause in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored sintilimab: 36-month event-free survival was 86% versus 76%, with a stratified hazard ratio of 0.59 (95% CI 0.38-0.92; p=0.019), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: HiSCR50 at week 16: at least a 50% reduction from baseline in total abscess and inflammatory nodule count, with no increase in abscess or draining tunnel count.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was met for bimekizumab every 2 weeks versus placebo in both trials, with significantly higher response rates in BE HEARD I (48% vs 29%; p=0.0060) and BE HEARD II (52% vs 32%; p=0.0032).

primary_endpoint_description: Number of biochemically confirmed ovulatory events over 52 weeks, assessed by weekly serum progesterone measurements
brief_rationale: The surgical group had more ovulations than the medical-care group (median 6 vs 2; incidence rate ratio 2.5, 95% CI 1.5–4.2; p<0.0007), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction for the explicitly identified primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Metastasis-free survival, defined as metastasis arising from prostate cancer or death from any cause
brief_rationale: Long-course ADT significantly improved the explicitly identified primary endpoint versus short-course ADT (HR 0.773, 95% CI 0.612–0.975; p=0.029), meeting the two-sided 5% superiority criterion in the favorable direction.

The abstract reports descriptive safety and immunogenicity outcomes but does not explicitly identify any endpoint as the prespecified primary endpoint; therefore, primary-endpoint success cannot be assessed.

primary_endpoint_description: Target vessel failure at 1 year, defined as a composite of cardiac death, target vessel myocardial infarction, or clinically driven target vessel revascularisation.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred less often with intravascular ultrasound guidance than with angiography guidance (4.0% vs 7.3%; HR 0.55, 95% CI 0.41–0.74; p=0.0001), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary endpoints of progression-free survival and overall survival
brief_rationale: Progression-free survival met the protocol-specified primary objective (HR 0.70, 95% CI 0.55–0.89; p=0.0020), whereas overall survival had not crossed the statistical-significance boundary (HR 0.73, 95% CI 0.49–1.07). The abstract does not state the overall success rule for these mixed co-primary results.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary outcomes of knee pain (0–10 numerical rating scale) and physical function (0–68 WOMAC) at 3 months after randomisation
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies pain and physical function at 3 months as primary outcomes and reports that telerehabilitation was non-inferior to in-person care for both outcomes.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA) at week 48
brief_rationale: Both aflibercept 8 mg regimens met noninferiority versus aflibercept 2 mg for the primary endpoint. The lower bounds of the 95% CIs for treatment differences (-2.87 and -2.97 letters) remained above the prespecified -4-letter noninferiority margin.

primary_endpoint_description: Parent-reported Strengths and Difficulties Questionnaire (SDQ) score at 6 months post-randomisation
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored MICE: adjusted effect −1.7 (95% CI −2.8 to −0.5; p=0.0040), and the abstract states that MICE was superior to assessment-enhanced usual care.

primary_endpoint_description: Rate of progression-free survival at 12 months according to real-time central RECIST version 1.1 review
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly states that the primary endpoint was met: 12-month progression-free survival was 36% (14/39; 90% CI 23–50) with sunitinib, satisfying the design criterion intended to establish efficacy.

primary_endpoint_description: 3-month cumulative rate of symptomatic venous thromboembolism during the intervention phase among patients with a TRiP(cast) score below 7
brief_rationale: The prespecified safety criterion required a venous thromboembolism rate below 1% with the upper 95% CI below 2%. The observed rate was 0.7% (95% CI 0.3%–1.4%), meeting both thresholds.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to development of clinical synovitis in at least three joints or rheumatoid arthritis by 2010 ACR/EULAR criteria, whichever occurred first.
brief_rationale: The primary time-to-event endpoint favored abatacept: fewer participants met it during treatment (6% vs 29%), and arthritis-free survival over 24 months was significantly better with abatacept (log-rank p=0.044).

primary_endpoint_description: Perinatal composite of stillbirth, early neonatal death, or neonatal unit admission
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary composite outcome did not differ significantly between revealed repeat PlGF-based testing and usual care (31.2% vs 27.8%; relative risk 1.21, 95% CI 0.95–1.33; p=0.18), so the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of administered high-risk drug combinations per 1000 drug administrations per patient
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome decreased by 12% with the tailored alerts (95% CI 5%–18%; p=0.0008), a statistically significant effect in the intended favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of Plasmodium infection detected in peripheral or placental blood or tissue from 2 weeks after the first study dose to delivery.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored dihydroartemisinin-piperaquine: infection incidence was 25.4 versus 77.3 per 100 person-years (incidence rate ratio 0.32, 95% CI 0.22–0.47; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in first-morning-void urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (UACR) from baseline at the second randomisation to the end of treatment at week 14.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint is explicit and UACR changes are reported for placebo and each BI 690517 dose, but the abstract does not provide the prespecified statistical success criterion or direct treatment-versus-placebo inferential results. Therefore, whether the primary endpoint formally met the trial's success criterion cannot be determined.

primary_endpoint_description: Dual primary endpoints of investigator-assessed progression-free survival by RECIST version 1.1 and overall survival in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: Both primary endpoints significantly favored atezolizumab: progression-free survival HR 0.62 (95% CI 0.49–0.78; p<0.0001) and overall survival HR 0.68 (95% CI 0.52–0.88; p=0.0046).

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in weekly Urticaria Activity Score (UAS7) at week 12
brief_rationale: Both ligelizumab doses were superior to placebo but not to omalizumab on the primary endpoint in both trials. The abstract does not specify whether trial success required superiority to placebo, superiority to omalizumab, or both, so the overall primary-endpoint success criterion cannot be determined.

primary_endpoint_description: Total physical activity measured by accelerometer in counts per minute after the intervention
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome did not differ significantly between groups after adjustment (mean difference -33.5 counts per minute; p=0.213), and the walking program did not increase physical activity.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of children with asthma aged 4–15 years who had a preventer prescription between August 1 and September 30, 2021
brief_rationale: The intervention did not significantly increase the primary outcome versus usual care: 35.3% versus 35.1% (OR 1.01, 95% CI 0.97–1.05). Thus, the favorable superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Absence of moderate or severe intensity headache within 24 hours after the study-drug dose
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred after 46% of ubrogepant-treated versus 29% of placebo-treated prodrome events (odds ratio 2.09, 95% CI 1.63–2.69; p<0.0001), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence risk of Plasmodium vivax parasitaemia on day 63
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored high-dose short-course primaquine: day-63 P vivax parasitaemia was 2.5% versus 11.0% with standard care (hazard ratio 0.20, 95% CI 0.08–0.51; p=0.0009), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in proteinuria between sparsentan and irbesartan groups at 36 weeks.
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies 36-week proteinuria change as the primary endpoint and states that sparsentan significantly reduced proteinuria versus irbesartan, meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: NALIRIFOX significantly improved the explicitly identified primary endpoint of overall survival versus nab-paclitaxel plus gemcitabine (median 11.1 vs 9.2 months; HR 0.83, 95% CI 0.70–0.99; p=0.036), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Time-weighted average of estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) over 2 years
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy endpoint showed a statistically significant benefit with Nefecon versus placebo: difference 5.05 mL/min per 1.73 m² (95% CI 3.24 to 7.38; p<0.0001), in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Self-reported insomnia severity at 6 months, measured with the Insomnia Severity Index (ISI).
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored sleep restriction therapy: adjusted mean ISI difference −3.05 versus sleep hygiene (95% CI −3.83 to −2.28; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Recurrence-free survival
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint was recurrence-free survival. Although numerically longer with everolimus, the result did not meet the prespecified statistical significance threshold of p=0.044 (reported p=0.050/0.051), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in mean monthly migraine days across the 12-week treatment period
brief_rationale: Both atogepant regimens produced significantly greater favorable reductions in monthly migraine days than placebo: least-squares mean differences were -2.4 days (adjusted p<0.0001) for 30 mg twice daily and -1.8 days (adjusted p=0.0009) for 60 mg once daily.

primary_endpoint_description: 4-year event-free survival, defined by local, regional, or distant recurrence; second primary lung cancer; or death
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint significantly favored I-SABR: 4-year event-free survival was 77% versus 53% with SABR alone, with HR 0.42 (95% CI 0.22–0.80; p=0.0080) in the ITT analysis and consistent per-protocol results.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to disease flare during the double-blind withdrawal period
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored baricitinib: time to disease flare was significantly longer with baricitinib than placebo (hazard ratio 0.241, 95% CI 0.128–0.453; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Change in Montgomery-Åsberg Depression Rating Scale (MADRS) score at week 6
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint showed no intergroup difference between active and sham tDCS (difference 0.3, 95% CI -2.4 to 2.9), and the abstract states that active tDCS was not superior to sham.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in HbA1c at week 32
brief_rationale: CagriSema produced a significantly greater HbA1c reduction than cagrilintide (p<0.0001) but not semaglutide (p=0.075). The abstract does not state whether superiority over one or both active comparators was required for overall primary-endpoint success.

primary_endpoint_description: Delayed graft function, defined as receiving dialysis within 7 days after transplantation
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred less often with balanced crystalloid than with saline (30% vs 40%; adjusted relative risk 0.74, 95% CI 0.66–0.84; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to conversion of atrioventricular-nodal-dependent paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia to sinus rhythm for at least 30 seconds within 30 minutes after the first dose
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored etripamil: conversion by 30 minutes was 64% versus 31% with placebo, with a hazard ratio of 2.62 (95% CI 1.66–4.15; p<0.0001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Red blood cell transfusion independence for at least 12 weeks with a concurrent mean haemoglobin increase of at least 1.5 g/dL during weeks 1-24
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was achieved by 59% of patients receiving luspatercept versus 31% receiving epoetin alfa, with a favorable risk difference of 26.6 percentage points (95% CI 15.8-37.4; p<0.0001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Livebirth rate
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was livebirth rate. LMWH did not significantly increase livebirths versus standard care (72% vs 71%; adjusted OR 1.08, 95% CI 0.65–1.78; absolute risk difference 0.7%, 95% CI −9.2% to 10.6%), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Functional recovery at 6 months, measured by the distribution of modified Rankin Scale scores and analysed using proportional ordinal logistic regression.
brief_rationale: The care bundle significantly reduced the likelihood of a poor functional outcome versus usual care on the explicitly identified primary outcome (common odds ratio 0.86, 95% CI 0.76–0.97; p=0.015), indicating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Histological resolution of non-alcoholic steatohepatitis without worsening of fibrosis at 1-year follow-up.
brief_rationale: In the intention-to-treat analysis, the primary endpoint occurred significantly more often after Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (56%) and sleeve gastrectomy (57%) than with lifestyle modification plus best medical care (16%); both comparisons had p<0.0001, meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival by blinded independent central review in the full analysis set
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored trastuzumab deruxtecan: median progression-free survival was 17.8 versus 6.9 months, with HR 0.36 (95% CI 0.28–0.45; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Modified Rankin Scale (mRS) score at 90 days after randomisation
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome showed a favorable shift toward better 90-day mRS outcomes with endovascular treatment versus control (adjusted common OR 1.67, 95% CI 1.20-2.32), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Receipt of influenza vaccination on or before Jan 1, 2023.
brief_rationale: For the explicitly identified primary endpoint, the cardiovascular-benefit letter and repeated-letter strategy each significantly increased vaccination uptake versus usual care using multiplicity-adjusted comparisons, demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Clinical remission at weeks 12 and 52 in ELEVATE UC 52 and at week 12 in ELEVATE UC 12.
brief_rationale: All explicitly identified primary efficacy endpoints favored etrasimod over placebo and were statistically significant: week 12 and week 52 in ELEVATE UC 52 (both p<0.0001), and week 12 in ELEVATE UC 12 (p=0.026).

primary_endpoint_description: Disease-free survival according to masked independent central review
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint did not show favorable superiority for nivolumab plus ipilimumab versus placebo (HR 0.92, 95% CI 0.71–1.19; p=0.53), and the abstract states that disease-free survival was not improved.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to discharge alive from hospital up to 60 days after ICU admission
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy outcome did not show favorable superiority with high-dose protein: alive hospital discharge hazard ratio 0.91 (95% CI 0.77–1.07; p=0.27).

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of infectious complications and mortality within 90 days after appendicectomy
brief_rationale: The adjusted absolute risk difference for 2 versus 5 days of antibiotics was 2.0% (95% CI, -1.6% to 5.6%). The upper confidence bound was below the prespecified 7.5% noninferiority margin, so noninferiority was demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Day-14 global cure (EMA) and 30-day all-cause mortality (FDA), each assessed for noninferiority of rezafungin versus caspofungin with a 20% margin
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary endpoints met the prespecified 20% noninferiority criterion. The abstract reports a day-14 global-cure difference of -1.1% (95% CI -14.9 to 12.7) and a 30-day mortality difference of 2.4% (95% CI -9.7 to 14.4), and explicitly concludes noninferiority for both.

primary_endpoint_description: Favourable status at 76 weeks, defined as negative cultures for Mycobacterium tuberculosis without a preceding unfavourable outcome, for the 9-month oral bedaquiline regimen versus the 9-month control regimen.
brief_rationale: The primary comparison was the 9-month oral bedaquiline regimen versus control. Favourable status occurred in 83% versus 71%, with an adjusted difference of 11.0% (95% CI 2.9 to 19.0) and p<0.0001 for noninferiority; the abstract further concludes superior efficacy after the prespecified gated testing.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of heart failure readmission or all-cause death through 180 days
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred less often with high-intensity care than usual care (15.2% vs 23.3%; adjusted risk difference 8.1%, 95% CI 2.9–13.2; risk ratio 0.66, 95% CI 0.50–0.86; p=0.0021), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Functional recovery at 90 days, assessed by the distribution of modified Rankin Scale scores.
brief_rationale: The intensive-treatment group had significantly worse functional outcomes than the less-intensive group (common OR for poor outcome 1.37, 95% CI 1.07–1.76). Thus, the primary efficacy endpoint did not demonstrate benefit in the intended favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to hospitalisation or death due to definite or probable peptic ulcer bleeding.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was significantly reduced with H pylori eradication during the first 2.5 years (HR 0.35, 95% CI 0.14–0.89; p=0.028), in the intended favorable direction. The benefit was not sustained during later follow-up.

primary_endpoint_description: Surgical site infection, comprising superficial incisional infection within 30 days or deep incisional/organ-space infection within 90 days after surgery.
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 7% of participants in each group; povidone-iodine versus chlorhexidine yielded an odds ratio of 1.11 (95% CI 0.74–1.65; p=0.61). Thus, favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Time to first occurrence of vascular death or hospitalisation for non-fatal myocardial infarction or non-fatal stroke.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 3.4% with evening dosing versus 3.7% with morning dosing (HR 0.95, 95% CI 0.83–1.10; p=0.53), so evening dosing did not demonstrate favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Investigator-assessed disease-free survival in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: Disease-free survival was not significantly improved with atezolizumab versus placebo (HR 0.93, 95% CI 0.75–1.15; p=0.50), so the primary superiority endpoint did not meet its success criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Dose-response effect of asundexian on the composite of incident MRI-detected covert brain infarcts and recurrent symptomatic ischaemic stroke by 26 weeks
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy outcome showed no favorable dose-response effect (t=-0.68; p=0.80), and event rates were similar to placebo; therefore, the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Allergy to any interventional food at 36 months of age
brief_rationale: For the explicitly identified primary outcome, early food introduction significantly reduced food allergy versus no food intervention (risk difference -1.6%, 95% CI -2.7 to -0.5; OR 0.4, 95% CI 0.2 to 0.8), meeting a favorable superiority criterion. The skin intervention did not reduce the outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Event-free survival, with response assessments by an independent review committee per Lugano 2014 criteria
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint was significantly improved with liso-cel versus standard of care: median event-free survival was 10.1 versus 2.3 months (HR 0.35, 95% CI 0.23–0.53; one-sided p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Week 52 co-primary endpoints of clinical remission (CDAI in the US protocol or stool-frequency and abdominal-pain score in the non-US protocol) and endoscopic response.
brief_rationale: Risankizumab 360 mg achieved higher week 52 clinical remission rates under both protocol definitions and a higher endoscopic response rate versus placebo; all adjusted difference 95% CIs excluded zero in the favorable direction, so the co-primary superiority endpoints were met for this dose.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of major cardiovascular events: myocardial infarction, revascularisation, ischaemic stroke, peripheral artery disease, and cardiovascular death.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint occurred less often with the Mediterranean diet than with the low-fat diet (87 vs 111 events; log-rank p=0.039), with adjusted hazard ratios of 0.719 to 0.753 and 95% confidence intervals excluding 1, demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of patients with blood pressure below 130/80 mm Hg at 18 months
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored the intervention: 57.0% versus 19.9% achieved blood pressure below 130/80 mm Hg, a 37.0 percentage-point difference (95% CI 34.9 to 39.1; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Incident HIV infection in the intention-to-treat population, and grade 2 or higher clinical and laboratory events among women receiving at least one study-product dose.
brief_rationale: The HIV-incidence primary endpoint favored cabotegravir (HR 0.12, p<0.0001), demonstrating superiority. However, the study also explicitly identifies grade 2 or higher clinical and laboratory events as a primary endpoint, and the abstract does not provide a prespecified success criterion or an overall rule combining the efficacy and safety primary endpoints.

primary_endpoint_description: Proportion of women with severe perineal trauma affecting the anal sphincter muscle complex
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was significantly lower with two midwives than with standard care (3.9% vs 5.7%; adjusted OR 0.69, 95% CI 0.49–0.97), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from baseline in mid-level elbow Performance of Upper Limb version 1.2 (PUL 1.2) score at 12 months
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored CAP-1002 over placebo at 12 months by 2.6 points (percentile difference 36.2, 95% CI 12.7–59.7; p=0.014), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Modified Rankin Scale score at 90 days
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome showed no favorable superiority effect: aspirin (adjusted common OR 0.91, 95% CI 0.69–1.21) and unfractionated heparin (0.81, 0.61–1.08) produced nonsignificant shifts toward worse modified Rankin Scale scores.

primary_endpoint_description: 28-day all-cause mortality assessed by intention to treat, primarily in patients seronegative for SARS-CoV-2 antibodies at randomisation.
brief_rationale: In the primary efficacy population of seronegative patients, 28-day mortality was significantly lower with casirivimab–imdevimab than with usual care (24% vs 30%; RR 0.79, 95% CI 0.69–0.91; p=0.0009), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Desensitisation at the end of treatment (week 134), assessed by double-blind, placebo-controlled food challenge to 5000 mg in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: At week 134, 71% of participants receiving peanut oral immunotherapy versus 2% receiving placebo met the primary outcome of desensitisation (risk difference 69%, 95% CI 59–79; p<0.0001), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Prevention of symptomatic, PCR-confirmed COVID-19 occurring at least 28 days after vaccination.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary efficacy endpoint showed 57.5% vaccine efficacy versus placebo (95% CI 39.7–70.0; p=0.0026), demonstrating statistically significant favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of atrial fibrillation during the postoperative in-hospital stay in the intention-to-treat population.
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was significantly reduced with posterior left pericardiotomy versus no intervention (17% vs 32%; adjusted odds ratio 0.44, 95% CI 0.27–0.70; p=0.0005), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: One or more participant-reported solicited systemic reactions within 7 days after the first trial vaccination(s), assessed for noninferiority using a 25% risk-difference margin.
brief_rationale: Noninferiority was met in four vaccine cohorts but not demonstrated in two because their 95% CI upper limits exceeded the 25% margin. The abstract does not specify an overall success rule for these mixed cohort-level primary-endpoint results.

primary_endpoint_description: Reduction in Cohen-Mansfield Agitation Inventory (CMAI) score at 12 weeks
brief_rationale: The primary outcome did not differ significantly between mirtazapine and placebo (adjusted mean difference -1.74, 95% CI -7.17 to 3.69; p=0.53), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, stroke, or BARC type 2, 3, or 5 bleeding from 1 to 12 months
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint occurred in 4.6% with de-escalation versus 8.2% with active control (HR 0.55, 95% CI 0.40–0.76). The prespecified noninferiority margin was HR 1.34, and noninferiority was met (p<0.001); subsequent superiority testing was also significant (p=0.0001).

primary_endpoint_description: Duration of symptoms rated moderately bad or worse, measured by a validated diary for up to 28 days or until symptoms resolved.
brief_rationale: Symptom duration was similar with amoxicillin and placebo (median 5 vs 6 days; HR 1.13, 95% CI 0.90–1.42). The confidence interval included no effect, so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Difference between groups in unattended office systolic blood pressure at 12 weeks
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored the quadpill strategy: unattended office systolic blood pressure at 12 weeks was 6.9 mm Hg lower than with monotherapy (95% CI, 4.9–8.9; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival and progression-free survival across the prespecified populations, including oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma with PD-L1 CPS ≥10, oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma, PD-L1 CPS ≥10, and all randomized patients.
brief_rationale: Pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy demonstrated statistically significant, favorable superiority over placebo plus chemotherapy for every explicitly identified primary overall-survival and progression-free-survival comparison reported.

primary_endpoint_description: Total and overall protection by Vi-TT against blood culture-confirmed typhoid in vaccinees and all cluster residents, respectively
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary endpoints favored Vi-TT: total protection was 85% (97.5% CI 76–91; p<0.0001) and overall protection was 57% (97.5% CI 43–68; p<0.0001), demonstrating significant superiority over the control vaccine.

primary_endpoint_description: Geometric mean ratio of serum SARS-CoV-2 anti-spike IgG concentration 28 days after boost for ChAd/BNT versus ChAd/ChAd and BNT/ChAd versus BNT/BNT.
brief_rationale: The ChAd/BNT comparison met the prespecified noninferiority margin (lower 97.5% CI 7.5, above 0.63), whereas BNT/ChAd did not (lower 97.5% CI 0.43). Because the primary comparisons had mixed results and no overall success rule is stated, trial-level primary-endpoint success is unclear.

primary_endpoint_description: 14-day immunogenicity measured by antibodies against SARS-CoV-2 receptor-binding domain and trimeric spike protein.
brief_rationale: At day 14, both prespecified immunogenicity measures strongly favored BNT162b2 over observation: intervention-to-control ratios were 77.69 for RBD antibodies and 36.41 for trimeric spike IgG, with both 95% CIs excluding 1.

primary_endpoint_description: Overall survival and progression-free survival by blinded independent central review for nivolumab plus chemotherapy versus chemotherapy alone in patients with PD-L1 combined positive score of 5 or greater.
brief_rationale: Both explicitly identified primary endpoints favored nivolumab plus chemotherapy and were statistically significant: OS HR 0.71 (98.4% CI 0.59–0.86; p<0.0001) and PFS HR 0.68 (98% CI 0.56–0.81; p<0.0001).

primary_endpoint_description: Percentage change from baseline in high-sensitivity C-reactive protein after 12 weeks of ziltivekimab treatment compared with placebo.
brief_rationale: At 12 weeks, all three ziltivekimab doses produced substantially greater high-sensitivity CRP reductions than placebo, with pairwise differences of -66.2%, -77.7%, and -87.8%; all comparisons had p<0.0001, demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Death due to ovarian or tubal cancer by June 30, 2020
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was ovarian or tubal cancer mortality. Neither multimodal screening (p=0.58) nor ultrasound screening (p=0.36) significantly reduced deaths compared with no screening, so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: 28-day mortality in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome favored tocilizumab: 28-day mortality was 31% with tocilizumab versus 35% with usual care (rate ratio 0.85, 95% CI 0.76–0.94; p=0.0028), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Number of days alive and free of renal replacement therapy between randomisation and day 28
brief_rationale: The trial hypothesised that the more-delayed strategy would increase RRT-free days. The primary outcome was not significantly better with more-delayed initiation (median 10 vs 12 days with the delayed strategy; p=0.93), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Clinical malaria incidence recorded by active case detection over 2 years in cohorts of children aged 6 months to 10 years.
brief_rationale: The intervention significantly reduced the explicitly identified primary endpoint versus control (1.43 vs 2.29 cases per child-year; hazard ratio 0.62, 95% CI 0.51–0.76; p<0.0001), demonstrating favorable superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Cardiovascular morbidity and mortality, assessed as time to first cardiovascular event
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was explicitly identified and showed no significant difference between tE2 and LHRHa (HR 1.11, 95% CI 0.80–1.53; p=0.54), but the abstract does not specify a superiority, noninferiority, or equivalence success criterion. Therefore, whether this result met the prespecified criterion cannot be determined.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary endpoints were PASI90 response and Investigator's Global Assessment response of clear or almost clear (score 0 or 1) at week 16.
brief_rationale: Both coprimary endpoints significantly favored bimekizumab over ustekinumab and placebo at week 16 (PASI90 and IGA response, all p<0.0001), meeting the superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary week-16 endpoints: the proportions of patients achieving PASI90 and an Investigator's Global Assessment score of 0 or 1.
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly states that both coprimary endpoints were met. Bimekizumab was superior to placebo for PASI90 (91% vs 1%; p<0.0001) and IGA 0/1 (93% vs 1%; p<0.0001) at week 16.
The abstract reports safety/reactogenicity and multiple immunogenicity measures but does not explicitly identify any endpoint as the prespecified primary endpoint or primary outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary outcomes were daytime proportion of time with glucose above 180 mg/dL, tested for superiority, and 24-hour proportion of time with glucose below 54 mg/dL, tested for noninferiority with a 2% margin.
brief_rationale: Both coprimary endpoints met their respective criteria: the advanced system significantly reduced daytime time above 180 mg/dL versus 670G (difference -3.00%, 95% CI -3.97 to -2.04; p<0.0001), and met noninferiority for time below 54 mg/dL (difference -0.06%, 95% CI -0.11 to -0.02; p<0.0001 for noninferiority).

primary_endpoint_description: Clinical outcome at 6 months assessed by the modified Rankin Scale, dichotomised as good (0–3) versus poor (4–6) outcome.
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint did not show favorable superiority: good outcome occurred in 60% with tranexamic acid versus 64% with control (adjusted OR 0.86, 95% CI 0.66–1.12). The abstract concludes that tranexamic acid did not improve 6-month clinical outcome.

primary_endpoint_description: Change from the 4-week observation period in mean monthly migraine days during weeks 9–12 of double-blind treatment
brief_rationale: Rimegepant was superior to placebo on the explicitly identified primary endpoint: the least-squares mean difference was -0.8 migraine days per month (95% CI -1.46 to -0.20; p=0.0099), favoring rimegepant.

primary_endpoint_description: HIV-1 RNA ≥50 copies per mL at week 48 in the intention-to-treat exposed population (Snapshot analysis)
brief_rationale: Every-8-week dosing was noninferior to every-4-week dosing for the primary endpoint: 2% versus 1%, with an adjusted difference of 0.8 percentage points (95% CI −0.6 to 2.2), whose upper bound was below the prespecified 4% noninferiority margin.

primary_endpoint_description: Dual primary efficacy endpoints were progression-free survival and overall survival in the PD-L1 CPS ≥10, CPS ≥1, and intention-to-treat populations; this interim analysis definitively assessed progression-free survival.
brief_rationale: The prespecified hierarchical progression-free-survival primary objective was met in the first-tested CPS ≥10 population: median 9.7 versus 5.6 months, HR 0.65, with one-sided p=0.0012 below the prespecified α=0.00411. The abstract explicitly states that this primary objective was met; overall-survival follow-up was ongoing.

primary_endpoint_description: Composite of total hospitalisations for heart failure and cardiovascular death up to 52 weeks after randomisation
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint favored ferric carboxymaltose numerically but did not meet the conventional superiority criterion (RR 0.79, 95% CI 0.62–1.01; p=0.059).

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival in the intention-to-treat population
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary endpoint favored selinexor, bortezomib, and dexamethasone: median progression-free survival was 13.93 versus 9.46 months (HR 0.70, 95% CI 0.53-0.93; p=0.0075), demonstrating statistically significant superiority.

This prespecified 3-year follow-up reports major adverse cardiac events and other outcomes, but the supplied title and abstract do not explicitly identify a primary endpoint for this follow-up. Therefore, the noninferiority success criterion cannot be assessed for an explicitly designated primary endpoint.

primary_endpoint_description: 28-day all-cause mortality
brief_rationale: The primary outcome was explicitly identified as 28-day all-cause mortality. Mortality was 23% with lopinavir-ritonavir versus 22% with usual care (rate ratio 1.03, 95% CI 0.91–1.17; p=0.60), so favorable superiority was not demonstrated.

primary_endpoint_description: Oxford Shoulder Score (0–48) at 12 months after randomisation, analysed by initial randomisation group
brief_rationale: All between-group mean differences in the primary endpoint were smaller than the prespecified target differences (5 OSS points versus physiotherapy or 4 points between surgical groups); therefore, no intervention met the criterion for clinically meaningful superiority.

primary_endpoint_description: Freedom from distant metastases
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies freedom from distant metastases as the primary outcome, designed to detect improvement with adjuvant radiotherapy. However, these initial results report biochemical progression-free survival and other outcomes, not the primary endpoint result.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary endpoints were pathological complete response in the all-randomised population and in the PD-L1-positive population.
brief_rationale: The all-randomised co-primary endpoint met its significance boundary (one-sided p=0.0044; boundary 0.0184), whereas the PD-L1-positive co-primary endpoint did not (p=0.021; boundary 0.0184). The abstract does not state the overall success rule for these mixed co-primary results.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary endpoints: risk of the composite of blood transfusion or death, and number of blood transfusions, from randomisation to 30 days postoperatively.
brief_rationale: Neither coprimary endpoint showed favorable superiority of intravenous iron over placebo: transfusion or death occurred in 29% versus 28% (risk ratio 1.03, 95% CI 0.78–1.37; p=0.84), and transfusion counts were similar (rate ratio 0.98, 95% CI 0.68–1.43; p=0.93).

primary_endpoint_description: Failure to spontaneously pass the gestational sac within 7 days after random assignment
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome occurred less often with mifepristone plus misoprostol than with placebo plus misoprostol (17% vs 24%; RR 0.73, 95% CI 0.54–0.99; p=0.043), demonstrating statistically significant superiority in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Co-primary outcomes were maximum urinary flow rate (Qmax) and International Prostate Symptom Score (IPSS) at 12 months after surgery.
brief_rationale: Equivalence was shown for IPSS, whereas Qmax did not demonstrate equivalence and favored TURP. The abstract does not specify the overall success rule for these mixed co-primary endpoint results.

primary_endpoint_description: Death due to bleeding within 5 days of randomisation
brief_rationale: The primary outcome occurred in 222/5956 (4%) patients receiving tranexamic acid and 226/5981 (4%) receiving placebo (RR 0.99, 95% CI 0.82–1.18). Tranexamic acid did not demonstrate favorable superiority in reducing bleeding-related death.

primary_endpoint_description: Parasite prevalence by microscopy in children aged 2–10 years at 6, 12, and 18 months after LLIN distribution in the as-treated population.
brief_rationale: PBO-containing LLINs significantly reduced the explicitly identified primary outcome versus conventional LLINs at 6 months (adjusted PR 0.74, 95% CI 0.62–0.87; p=0.0003), 12 months (PR 0.73; p=0.0001), and 18 months (PR 0.84; p=0.029), all in the favorable direction.

primary_endpoint_description: Efficacy, defined as 42-day PCR-corrected adequate clinical and parasitological response
brief_rationale: The primary endpoint is explicit and results are reported across several site-specific treatment comparisons, but the abstract does not state a unified prespecified success criterion or overall rule for determining trial success. Although one comparison is explicitly described as noninferior and another shows superiority, the overall primary-endpoint conclusion cannot be determined from the supplied information.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival at week 48 for each investigational regimen versus paclitaxel plus ART, using a 15% noninferiority margin
brief_rationale: Noninferiority was not shown for either investigational arm; both confidence intervals overlapped the prespecified 15% noninferiority margin, and the trial reports the investigational regimens as inferior to paclitaxel plus ART.

primary_endpoint_description: Mean total HIV DNA isolated from peripheral blood CD4+ T cells at weeks 16 and 18 after randomisation
brief_rationale: The intervention did not significantly improve the explicitly identified primary endpoint versus ART alone (mean difference 0.04 log10 copies per 10^6 CD4+ T cells, 95% CI -0.03 to 0.11; p=0.26), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Coprimary outcomes of mortality and a composite of major complications at 90 days after randomisation
brief_rationale: Neither coprimary superiority outcome significantly favored accelerated surgery: mortality HR 0.91 (95% CI 0.72–1.14; p=0.40) and major complications HR 0.97 (95% CI 0.83–1.13; p=0.71).

primary_endpoint_description: Patient-reported Achilles tendon rupture score (ATRS) at 9 months
brief_rationale: The primary outcome showed no significant between-group difference (adjusted mean difference -1.38, 95% CI -4.9 to 2.1; p=0.44), so the superiority criterion was not met.

primary_endpoint_description: Primary clinical endpoint: surgery success at 3 months, a composite of absence of severe perioperative complications, BCVA ≤0.0 LogMAR, absolute refractive error ≤0.75 dioptres, and unchanged corneal astigmatism; primary economic endpoint: incremental cost per additional patient with treatment success at 3 months.
brief_rationale: FLACS did not improve the primary clinical success rate versus phacoemulsification (41.1% vs 43.6%; adjusted OR 0.85, 95% CI 0.64–1.12; p=0.250), so the superiority criterion was not met. The economic result was also unfavorable to FLACS, with higher costs and no additional benefit.

primary_endpoint_description: Incidence of all breast cancer (invasive breast cancer and ductal carcinoma in situ)
brief_rationale: The explicitly identified primary outcome was all breast cancer. Anastrozole significantly reduced breast cancer versus placebo (85 vs 165 cases; HR 0.51, 95% CI 0.39-0.66; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.

primary_endpoint_description: Progression-free survival
brief_rationale: The abstract explicitly identifies progression-free survival as the primary endpoint and reports that it remained significantly improved with D-VMP versus VMP (HR 0.42, 95% CI 0.34–0.51; p<0.0001), meeting the favorable superiority criterion.
